rechargerelay.shortDesc: Volt Switch heals the incoming teammate by 1/8 max HP.
rechargerelay.desc: Switching with Volt Switch heals the incoming teammate by 1/8 of its base maximum HP.

undertow.shortDesc: Water HP hits ground surviving foes.
undertow.desc: Water attacks that deal HP damage ground surviving foes as with Smack Down. Does not trap foes or bypass protection, Substitute or Water immunity.

lockinggrip.shortDesc: First damaging Bug attack each entry can inflict Torment; hitting Substitute spends the use.
lockinggrip.desc: Once per entry, its first damaging Bug attack against a foe applies Torment after HP damage if the foe survives. Substitute damage spends the use without tormenting its holder, including before later hits. Misses, protection and immunity preserve the use. Ability replacement does not reset it; switching does.

palmmastery.shortDesc: Force Palm always paralyzes when it lands, subject to immunity.
palmmastery.desc: Force Palm paralysis is a primary move effect rather than a secondary roll. It always paralyzes when it lands, subject to status immunity and status.

lockjaw.shortDesc: Biting HP hits inflict 2-turn Torment on surviving foes.
lockjaw.desc: Biting attacks that deal HP damage apply Torment to surviving foes for 2 turns. Does not prevent switching or bypass Substitute.

mirechorus.shortDesc: Sound becomes Water (Ice on Icy), 1.2x power; noncontact sound can poison.
mirechorus.desc: Sound moves become Water-type, or Ice-type on Icy Field, and have 1.2x power. Each foe damaged by a noncontact sound hit has a 20% poison chance. Shield Dust and Covert Cloak prevent this added poison.

tempestfury.shortDesc: Once per battle: survive a foe hit to charge a Water critical hit. Anger Point.
tempestfury.desc: Once per battle, surviving opposing direct HP damage charges the next damaging Water move to critically hit, subject to normal critical-hit prevention. Opposing HP or Substitute damage spends the charge; misses, protection and immunity preserve it. The charge and spent acquisition persist through switching and form changes. Selected Tempest Fury, when supplied separately, remains repeatable; its charge is separate and does not transfer into this passive. Includes full local Anger Point: the first damaging hit after activation raises Attack by 1, and a surviving critical hit maximizes Attack at the normal +6 cap.

serratedscales.desc: Contact attackers lose 1/8 base max HP per triggering hit; Thorn Tempered users are exempt. Prevents and cures paralysis. Other Pokemon and field effects cannot lower its Speed; self-inflicted costs and item slowdowns still apply. Trick Room and removal of Speed boosts or Tailwind still work. Limber has its normal ability-bypass rules; Rough Skin retaliation is not bypassed.

controlledfury.shortDesc: Anger Point; no rampage lock or ending confusion.
controlledfury.desc: Full local Anger Point: the first damaging hit after entry raises Attack by 1 stage; surviving a critical hit raises Attack to maximum. Outrage, Thrash, Petal Dance and Raging Fury do not lock the user in or cause ending confusion, including repeated manual uses. Acquiring this effect during a rampage clears only that rampage lock without confusion. Existing confusion, Choice locks, Encore and move field effects remain unchanged.

orchardbond.desc: Eligible single-target damaging moves hit three times; multi-hit moves, spread moves outside Free-for-All, charging moves, delayed attacks, Z/Max moves and moves barred from extra hits are excluded. The second and third hits deal 30% damage and retarget the foe's ally if the first target fainted. In Free-for-All battles, single-target moves hit all foes once at 1.3x power; spread moves hit all foes three times, with later hits at 30% power, and full-power spread moves stay full power. Moves have 1.2x power on Dragon's Den. Other Pokemon cannot remove its held item while it survives, except Sticky Barb.
orchardbond.shortDesc: Eligible attacks hit three times; protects its held item.

venomheal.desc: Poison damage instead heals 1/8 max HP. Also heals 1/8 each turn on Corrosive Mist and Murkwater Surface, or while grounded on Corrosive and Wasteland. Contact attackers have a 30% poison chance, or 60% on Wasteland. Its Poison-type moves have 1.5x STAB.

venomveil.desc: Prevents and cures burns; immune to sandstorm and hail damage. Gains Aqua Ring on entry. Cures status each turn on Water Surface and Underwater. Moves can poison Steel- and Poison-type foes. Poisoning does not lower their defenses.
venomveil.shortDesc: Can poison Steel/Poison foes; burn/weather protection and Aqua Ring.

elevate.desc: Move KOs raise its highest stat by 1, ignoring stat stages when choosing the stat.
elevate.shortDesc: Move KOs raise its highest stat.

abysslure.desc: Absorbs Electric and Water attacks, healing 1/4 max HP and raising Attack and Special Attack by 1. Does not redirect attacks. Prevents forced switching. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn on Underwater, grounded on Water Surface, or grounded and Poison-type on Murkwater Surface. Heals 1/16 max HP on Electric Terrain and Short-Circuit.
abysslure.shortDesc: Absorbs Electric/Water attacks for healing and boosts; prevents forced switching; field healing.

parasitism.desc: While above 50% HP, its weaknesses are neutralized, Magic Guard is active, opposing status moves fail, and opposing attack secondary effects are blocked. The first time Parasect would faint, it fake-faints at 1 HP, then becomes Parasect-Parasite at the end of the turn and revives at full HP. This Ability cannot be suppressed and is immune to Neutralization.
parasitism.shortDesc: Above half HP, guards weaknesses, indirect damage, status moves and secondaries; one revival.

safeharbor.desc: Contact attackers have a 30% chance of frostbite. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn in hail or snow, or on Icy, Snowy Mountain and Cold Eclipse without those weathers; hail on Cold Eclipse heals 1/8 instead. Immune to hail damage. Absorbs other Pokemon's Water moves, healing 1/4 max HP instead of being hit. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn on Underwater, grounded on Water Surface, or grounded and Poison-type on Murkwater Surface.
safeharbor.shortDesc: Contact frostbite chance; Ice Body, Water Absorb and field healing.

witheringshell.desc: Physical HP hits set opposing Stealth Rock except on water fields. Heals 1/16 max HP in effective rain. Sticky Hold prevents other Pokemon from removing its item under the normal local rules.
witheringshell.shortDesc: Crumbling Shell + Rain Dish + Sticky Hold.

razorreach.desc: Slicing moves have 1.5x power except on Cold Eclipse. Moves do not make contact and have one extra critical-hit stage. Entry raises accuracy by 1, sharing the Mirror Arena entry reward with passive Keen Eye. Move accuracy is 0.9x on Rocky or Grassy Field; moves have 1.5x power on Mountain or Snowy Mountain.
razorreach.shortDesc: Boosts slicing moves and critical-hit rate; no contact; entry accuracy and field bonuses.

slipstream.shortDesc: Keen Eye; first Flying HP hit each entry sets three-turn Tailwind.
slipstream.desc: Full local Keen Eye prevents opposing accuracy drops, ignores opposing evasion boosts and reveals opposing Illusions on activation. Mirror Arena entry grants +1 accuracy and Laser Focus, with shared entry rewards applied once. Once per switch-in, its first Flying-type attack to damage opposing HP sets Tailwind on its side for 3 turns; Tailwind is extended to at least 3 turns, never shortened.

evergreen.desc: Applicable Berry effects are doubled, including the full local Ripen behavior.

scavenger.desc: Other Pokemon cannot lower its Defense. Heals 1/3 max HP on switching out.
scavenger.shortDesc: Defense-drop protection; heals 1/3 HP on switching out.

echofiend.desc: Sound moves become Flying, Fire on Volcanic Field, or Crystal on Crystal Cavern. Sound moves have 1.5x power, or 2x on Cave, Volcanic and Crystal Cavern. Protects allies from allied damaging sound moves. This selected package cannot be suppressed.
echofiend.shortDesc: Converts and boosts sound attacks; protects allies from allied sound damage.

vaultkeeper.desc: Compatibility name for local Prankster: status moves gain +1 priority; opposing Dark types block them except on Bewitched Woods. Does not prevent screen removal. Klefki receives Prankster as its species passive; this compatibility name has the same priority effect.

mourningsnow.desc: On entry, it summons Hail for 8 turns, and Aurora Veil used by it lasts 8 turns. During Hail or Snow, it heals 1/16 max HP each turn. Its damaging moves of any type gain an additional 30% chance to inflict frostbite, preserving their effects; this does not require weather. It is immune to Hail damage. When another Pokemon faints, it restores 1/8 max HP, or 1/4 if the faint was caused by an Ice move, Hail, Snow, or Curse. Damaging hits disable the attacker's move when possible.
mourningsnow.shortDesc: Extended Hail/Veil; frostbite attacks; weather/faint healing; guaranteed eligible Disable.

hydroelectric.desc: Dealing Water-move HP damage has the once-per-turn 1/8 max HP healing. Once per entry, after a Water attack finishes dealing actual opposing HP damage, gains +1 Speed. Multiple hits and targets grant only one boost; allies, Substitute-only damage, misses, protection and absorption do not qualify. Ability changes do not refresh the entry allowance.
hydroelectric.shortDesc: Water HP hits heal 1/8 once/turn; first Water attack dealing opposing HP damage grants +1 Speed after the move.

doomwarning.desc: Magic Guard and Anticipation. On fainting, has its delayed Doom Desire against opposing slots.

palmmastery.desc: Force Palm always inflicts paralysis when it lands, subject to status immunities. Its paralysis becomes a primary effect rather than a secondary roll.
palmmastery.shortDesc: Force Palm always paralyzes when it lands.

glacialmass.desc: Doubles weight and halves physical attack damage. On entry to Factory Field, Defense rises one stage and Speed falls one stage. On Cold Eclipse, Defense and Sp. Def are 1.5x, the field Speed penalty is ignored, and hail heals 1/10 max HP each turn.
glacialmass.shortDesc: Double weight and half physical attack damage; field effects.

apexarmor.desc: Blocks bullet, pulse, and Mega Launcher-boosted moves and takes 20% less attack damage. Moves ignore redirection. On New World, Starlight Arena, Fairy Tale and Chessboard entry, gains +1 Sp. Atk. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn and prevents sandstorm and hail damage.
apexarmor.shortDesc: Blocks bullet/pulse attacks; 20% less damage; ignores redirection; heals 1/16 HP/turn; immune to sand/hail; field entry bonuses.

smolderingshroud.desc: The first foe-caused stat-drop event prevented each entry raises Special Attack by 1. Shares White Smoke protection and Volcanic entry boosts with its passive without doubling them.
smolderingshroud.shortDesc: First blocked opposing stat drop each entry raises Sp. Atk by 1.

silksights.desc: Keen Eye prevents external accuracy drops, ignores evasion boosts and reveals opposing Illusions. Mirror Arena entry grants +1 accuracy and Laser Focus once, shared with passive Compound Eyes. Electric attacks ignore positive defensive stages against slowed foes. Once per entry, Bug attacks dealing opposing HP damage to a foe whose Speed was already lowered attempt to Disable its last move through the following turn. Normal Disable eligibility applies; only success consumes the use.
silksights.shortDesc: Keen Eye; Electric bypasses slowed foes' boosts; once/entry Bug HP hit on slowed foe Disables its last move.

lockjaw.desc: Biting hits inflict Torment on a surviving foe for 2 turns. Does not prevent switching.
lockjaw.shortDesc: Biting hits inflict Torment on a surviving foe for 2 turns. Does not prevent switching.

freezerburn.desc: Doubles Speed in hail, snow or on Icy, Snowy Mountain and Cold Eclipse. Levitate makes it airborne and immune to Ground attacks and grounded hazards unless grounded. Its Ice-type attacks deal 1.2x damage against targets that are already burned, including Normal moves converted to Ice by its separate Refrigerate passive. Other move types and other target statuses receive no extra damage; this ability does not inflict burn.
freezerburn.shortDesc: Slush Rush + Levitate; Ice damage is 1.2x against burned targets.

voidomen.desc: Full Friend Guard reduces attack damage to other allies by 25%. While active, doubles secondary-effect chances for its holder and actual allies without stacking with Serene Grace or other providers. Void Omen can skip one required charge turn per receiving Pokemon per stay on the field, including its holder. Only that recipient switching resets its allowance; provider switches, ability changes, Transform and multiple providers do not refill it. Field skips, Power Herb and independent Serene Grace do not consume the allowance. Suppression disables the grant. Once per entry, the first successful damaging-move secondary or successful self-targeted status move sets or refreshes Safeguard to at least 3 turns. Separately, after activation, the first successfully applied secondary effect creates a ward against the next opposing stat-drop event targeting the holder or an adjacent active ally. Positive changes and self-inflicted drops remain. The ward ends when spent or the holder leaves.
voidomen.shortDesc: Friend Guard; doubled secondary chances; one charge skip per recipient per stay; Safeguard and stat-drop ward.

ragingstorm.desc: Moves ignore bypassable opposing abilities. Attacks bypass Substitute, screens and defensive stat stages and gain +1 critical-hit stage. Takes half damage from priority attacks. Immune to hail damage. Move KOs damage remaining foes by 60% of the last damage dealt; if there is no valid target or no damage is dealt, gains +1 Attack instead. Magic Guard prevents this splash damage. Cannot be suppressed.
ragingstorm.shortDesc: Bypasses screens and defensive stages; halves priority damage; KOs damage other foes.

mirechorus.desc: Sound moves become Water-type, or Ice-type on Icy Field, and have 1.2x power. Each foe damaged by a noncontact sound move also has an independent 20% chance to be poisoned. Shield Dust and Covert Cloak block this added poison chance.
mirechorus.shortDesc: Noncontact sound hits have a 20% poison chance.

undertow.desc: Damaging Water hits ground surviving foes as with Smack Down. Does not trap them or bypass protection, Substitute or Water immunity.
undertow.shortDesc: Water HP hits ground surviving foes.

rechargerelay.desc: Switching with Volt Switch restores 1/8 of the incoming teammate's max HP.
rechargerelay.shortDesc: Switching with Volt Switch restores 1/8 of the incoming teammate's max HP.

toxicspines.desc: Physical HP hits set one Toxic Spikes layer on the attacker’s side, up to two; allied attackers use the opposing side. Contact attackers lose 1/6 base max HP, without an additional Iron Barbs hit. Can poison Poison and Steel types; Poison attacks bypass Steel immunity. Poisoning does not lower defenses. Wasteland has four separate 2.5% frostbite, burn, paralysis and poison secondary chances; incoming damage remains 1.5x on Corrosive and Corrosive Mist.
toxicspines.shortDesc: Physical hits set Toxic Spikes; contact retaliates for 1/6 HP; poison bypass.

saltbastion.desc: When passive Sturdy saves it from a direct hit, its side gains Safeguard for 5 turns.
saltbastion.shortDesc: When passive Sturdy saves it from a direct hit, its side gains Safeguard for 5 turns.

roughscale.shortDesc: Tough Claws; first resisted opposing HP attack each entry grants +1 Defense after the move.
roughscale.desc: Full local Tough Claws gives contact moves 1.3x power. Once per switch-in, after the first resisted opposing attack to damage HP finishes all its hits, raises Defense by 1 if the holder survives and remains active. Normal boost prevention applies. Misses, protection, immunity, Substitute-only damage and zero HP damage do not activate it.

quarrycannon.desc: Full Mega Launcher: pulse and bullet moves gain 50% power. Damaging pulse and bullet moves become Physical, using Attack against Defense, except Z/Max moves. Accuracy, secondary effects, hit counts, and recharge rules are unchanged.
quarrycannon.shortDesc: Mega Launcher; damaging pulse/bullet moves become Physical (except Z/Max).

slowclamp.desc: Full local Own Tempo prevents and cures confusion and blocks Intimidate's Attack drop, subject to normal suppression and ability bypass. Analytic has its 1.3x power when no other active Pokemon has a move left to use that turn.

crueltag.desc: Infiltrator and Bad Dreams. This selected package is retained pending approval of its replacement.

joyride.desc: Eligible Normal moves become Flying and gain 1.2x power. On its first active turn, Speed is 1.5x and Attack is 1.2x. Fighting attacks retain 1.3x Attack or Sp. Atk.
joyride.shortDesc: Aerilate + Violent Rush; Fighting attacks use 1.3x Attack or Sp. Atk.

stormsovereign.shortDesc: Updraft (Competitive), eight-turn Strong Winds and opposing Flying chip.
stormsovereign.desc: Summons replaceable Strong Winds for 8 turns on entry. Each turn, non-immune foes take Flying damage equal to 1/16 base maximum HP; type effectiveness scales this chip only in Free-for-All. Flying-type foes are immune. Full Updraft: Full Competitive: opposing stat drops raise Special Attack by 2 outside Chessboard; on Chessboard, instead boosts damage with missing HP up to 2x at 20% HP. Flying moves ignore evasion boosts. Once per switch-in, the first Flying attack dealing opposing HP damage raises the living adjacent ally with the lowest HP percentage by 1 Speed stage, or the holder if no such ally exists. Only one recipient is boosted; ability restarts and Mega Evolution do not reset the entry allowance.

lunarorbit.desc: Magic Guard prevents indirect damage; HP costs, Pain Split, confusion and Struggle recoil still apply. Fairy Tale entry gives +1 Sp. Def. On entry or Mega Evolution, sets Gravity for 5 turns. Water Surface sinks to Underwater, Underwater to Midnight Zone, and Corrosive Mist to Corrosive, except on New World.
lunarorbit.shortDesc: Magic Guard and five-turn Gravity entry.

woolyconductor.desc: Fluffy. Once per turn, an opposing contact attacker that deals HP damage loses 1 Speed.

sandsovereign.desc: Sets or refreshes Sandstorm to 8 turns on entry. Full local Solid Rock. Its retained matchup effect keeps damaging Rock moves Rock-type with normal Rock STAB, but uses the better overall Rock or Ground type-chart matchup; Ground-immune typings do not replace the Rock matchup. Manually used Arenite Wall lasts 8 turns. Each turn, non-immune foes take Rock damage equal to 1/16 max HP; type effectiveness scales this chip only in Free-for-All.
sandsovereign.shortDesc: Solid Rock; better Rock/Ground matchup; eight-turn sand and Rock chip.

ironvise.desc: Contact moves have 1.3x power. Once per switch-in, the first opposing direct hit deals 25% less damage and lowers the attacker's Attack by 1 stage. Multi-hit moves spend this protection on the first hit.

voidvoice.desc: Queenly Majesty and Dream Sickness, retaining its protective and stat-control effects.
voidvoice.shortDesc: Queenly Majesty and Dream Sickness, retaining its protective and stat-control effects.

dreadmaw.desc: Biting moves have 1.5x power. Healing received by it and its allies is multiplied by 1.3. At turn end, it has a 50% chance to cure each adjacent ally's status condition.

heavenlychorus.desc: Takes half contact damage and double Fire damage; contact Fire attacks deal normal damage. Switching out cures status and heals 1/8 max HP only if a status was cured. Bewitched Woods cures status at turn end without this heal.

cursedmarionette.shortDesc: Curses foes; cursed foes deal 20% less damage.
cursedmarionette.desc: Its attacks and status moves curse opposing targets, and being hit curses the attacker. Cursed foes deal 0.8x damage to it. Its Curse deals 1/8 max HP. When it faints, opposing Pokemon become cursed and it creates Haunted Field for 5 turns, ignoring Neutralization. Ordinary Ghost Curse costs 1/3 max HP; ability-applied curses do not pay this cost.

coldlogic.desc: Forewarn reveals a strongest opposing move and removes foe Illusions on entry. Takes 20% less move damage, or 25% less from the revealed move until switching out; these reductions do not stack, and OHKO moves are excluded from learned-move protection. A successful reveal on Psychic Terrain grants +2 Sp. Atk. Opponents cannot lower its accuracy stages. An opposing move that knocks it out triggers Aftermath even without contact: the attacker loses 1/4 max HP, or 1/2 on Corrosive Mist. Damp prevents this, and indirect-damage protection applies.
coldlogic.shortDesc: Forewarn + Aftermath; opposing accuracy-drop immunity; noncontact KO retaliation.

uncheckedassault.desc: Vital Spirit prevents and cures sleep, blocks Yawn, and gives Fighting attacks 1.3x Attack or Sp. Atk. Opportunist copies opposing positive stat changes after moves, entries, transformations and at turn end. Limber prevents and cures paralysis and has its Speed-drop protection. Existing confusion prevention and cure remain.

frostsovereign.desc: Sets or refreshes Snow Warning weather to 8 turns on entry. Full local Ice Body and Filter, and gains full Soundproof immunity to other Pokemon's sound moves. Manually used Aurora Veil lasts 8 turns. Each turn, non-immune foes take Ice damage equal to 1/16 max HP; type effectiveness scales this chip only in Free-for-All.
frostsovereign.shortDesc: Ice Body + Filter + Soundproof; eight-turn snow and Ice chip.

sacrededge.desc: Dual Wield and entry healing for adjacent allies, including the Fairy Tale bonus.
sacrededge.shortDesc: Dual Wield and entry healing for adjacent allies, including the Fairy Tale bonus.

divineintervention.desc: Vital Signs emergency treatment, Triage, Regenerator and Friend Guard. The emergency treatment allowance remains once per recipient per battle.
divineintervention.shortDesc: Vital Signs emergency treatment, Triage, Regenerator and Friend Guard.

neurotoxin.desc: Eligible single-target damaging moves hit three times; multi-hit moves, spread moves outside Free-for-All, charging moves, delayed attacks, Z/Max moves and moves barred from extra hits are excluded. The second and third hits deal 30% damage and retarget the foe's ally if the first target fainted. In Free-for-All battles, single-target moves hit all foes once at 1.3x power; spread moves hit all foes three times, with later hits at 30% power, and full-power spread moves stay full power. Moves have 1.2x power on Dragon's Den. Heals 1/3 max HP on switching out.

patternshift.desc: Protean and Unaware, retaining their full local field interactions.

surgeconduit.desc: Redirects eligible Electric moves, including allied moves, and absorbs Electric hits for +1 Attack and Sp. Atk. Electric Terrain entry grants both boosts. Rock Head prevents move recoil except Struggle.

railguncircuit.desc: Redirects eligible Electric moves, including allied moves, and absorbs Electric hits for +1 Attack and Sp. Atk. Electric Terrain entry grants both boosts. Electric attacks use 1.3x Attack or Sp. Atk, or 2x on Electric Terrain and Factory.

completeparasitism.shortDesc: Above half HP: neutralizes weaknesses, blocks indirect damage and opposing status moves.
completeparasitism.desc: While above half HP, weaknesses are neutralized, indirect damage is blocked and opposing status moves fail. Has its lethal-hit fake faint and full-HP Parasect-Parasite revival, including the separate Mega revival allowance. Cannot be suppressed and remains immune to Neutralization. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn and ignores sandstorm/hail. Switching cures major status and heals 1/8 max HP only when curing status; Bewitched Woods has its end-turn cure without that extra heal.

sacredpower.desc: Duskilate and Magic Guard retain their full local effects.

solarhydra.desc: Full local Hydra Bond and Grassy Surge.

goldentalons.desc: Sharpness and Good as Gold retain their full local field effects.

argentdevotion.shortDesc: Sworn Duty, Serene Grace and Mold Breaker.
argentdevotion.desc: Sworn Duty, Serene Grace and Mold Breaker retain their full local effects.

execution.shortDesc: Double power against foes at half HP or less; has offense-drop limits, field Speed protection and KO healing.
execution.desc: Has Mold Breaker, double attack power against targets at half HP or less, limits to Attack and Special Attack drops, prevention of Speed drops while a field exists, and 1/8 max HP healing per move KO.

corrosivetouch.desc: Contact hits have a 30% chance to poison the target. Shield Dust and Covert Cloak block this effect. Grass attacks receive a 1.5x same-type attack bonus.

desertspirit.shortDesc: Sand Stream + Overcoat + Tinted Lens; Ground STAB.
desertspirit.desc: Summons sandstorm on entry for 5 turns, or 8 with Smooth Rock. Overcoat protects against powder effects and sandstorm/hail damage. Ground attacks receive STAB despite its Dragon/Bug typing. Tinted Lens doubles damage from resisted attacks.

tremor.shortDesc: Resonance Force, Sand Force and extra Bug STAB.
tremor.desc: Own and allied damaging sound moves have 1.5x power. Its sound moves use its higher offensive stat without changing category; allied sound attacks do not damage allies. Does not bypass Soundproof. Rock, Ground and Steel attacks have 1.3x power in sandstorm or on Desert/Ashen Beach Terrain, and sandstorm damage is blocked. Bug attacks receive STAB.

sirius.desc: Has full Apex Venom, Whiplash, Venam’s Kiss and local Shed Skin (50% end-turn ailment/low-HP recovery; Dragon’s Den guaranteed). Mega Seviper’s Poison Fang slot becomes Drake Fang: 85 BP Dragon Physical, 100 accuracy, 15 PP, bite/contact and inherited poison effects. Current PP and slot persist through switching; actual form reversal restores Poison Fang. Strong Jaw gives Fang attacks 1.5x power before STAB, with no separate signature multiplier. Dragon Drake Fang uses ordinary Dragon effectiveness and does not trigger Poison-only Venam effects. Poison HP hits poison eligible Steel/Poison foes; all foes can be drained (one-third damage, capped at 1/4 base max HP per turn), while already-poisoned foes are heal-blocked and have 0.75x Speed. Cannot be suppressed, replaced or bypassed by Mold Breaker.
sirius.shortDesc: Apex Venom + Whiplash + Venam’s Kiss; Poison Fang becomes Drake Fang.

windchime.desc: Full local Armorize and Punk Rock, including field interactions.

astralengine.desc: Allies' moves have 1.3x power, or 1.5x on Haunted, Bewitched Woods, Holy and Psychic fields.

hauntedchime.desc: Airborne: immune to Ground attacks and grounded hazards unless grounded. Absorbs wind moves for +1 Sp. Atk. Gains +1 Sp. Atk when Tailwind starts on its side or it enters during Tailwind. Strong Winds gives +1 Attack and Sp. Atk each turn. Damaging attacks have a 30% chance to be disabled, guaranteed on Haunted and disabled on Holy Field. Excludes Max moves, delayed attacks and Struggle. On fainting, curses all active foes.

predator.shortDesc: 2x power and targeted defense bypass against active Ultra abilities; has authority and first-action bonuses.
predator.desc: Against active Ultra Ego, Ultra Instinct or composites containing them, attacks have 2x power, ignore positive Defense/Sp. Def stages and bypass only Ultra incoming-damage reductions. This replaces the first-action bonus. Negative defensive stages, unrelated ability effects, screens, Substitute, Protect, type immunities and post-hit healing remain. The matchup is disabled by ordinary component suppression and Bewitched Woods, Haunted or Holy Terrain. Existing authority and ordinary first-action bonuses are unchanged.

nighthunt.desc: Biting moves have 1.5x power. On entry, lowers adjacent foes' Attack by 1. Substitute and Intimidate protections still apply. Prevents other Pokemon's accuracy drops and ignores evasion boosts. Reveals opposing Illusions on activation. Mirror Arena entry lowers foes' accuracy by 1. Starlight Arena entry gives +2 Sp. Atk and puts Spotlight on its first adjacent ally. Shared Illusion reveals occur once.

voidcraft.shortDesc: Shadow Shield, Temporal Shift and full Insomnia; has its recurring hex.
voidcraft.desc: Has Shadow Shield, full Insomnia and its unique Temporal Shift protection and recurring Ghost hex.

stormbell.desc: Sets rain with full local Drizzle and grants Levitate's Ground immunity.

reapersgrip.shortDesc: Self Sufficient, Dark Aura and Haunted Terrain reactions.
reapersgrip.desc: Has Self Sufficient, Dark Aura and its unique Haunted Terrain triggers.

streettyrant.desc: On entry, lowers adjacent foes' Attack by 1 with normal Substitute and Intimidate protections. Moves ignore bypassable opposing abilities.

adaptivepower.desc: Doubles Attack. Prevents indirect damage; HP costs, Pain Split, confusion and Struggle recoil still apply. Fairy Tale entry grants +1 Sp. Def.

stormcircuit.shortDesc: Electric Surge, rain/water-field Speed and extra Special Attack from Coil.
stormcircuit.desc: Has Electric Surge, its rain and water-field Speed multiplier, and Coil's additional +1 Special Attack.

soulcremation.desc: Has full Soul Siphon and Malice Well, including their field effects. Mega Chandelure with active Soul Cremation bypasses Soul Fire's Fire/Ghost attack absorption only. Ordinary type effectiveness and type immunities remain; this grants neither general Mold Breaker nor a damage multiplier. Will-O-Wisp and Soul Fire redirection are unchanged.

phantomfist.desc: Contact moves pierce protection at 1/4 damage (75% less); Max Guard blocks them. Unprotected damage is unchanged. Punching moves have 1.4x power. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn and ignores sandstorm and hail damage. A contact attacker that knocks it out loses 1/4 max HP, or 1/2 on Corrosive Mist; Damp prevents this damage.

auramaster.shortDesc: Dual Wield, Technician and Inner Focus.
auramaster.desc: Has its paired attacks, Technician power and Inner Focus.

royalsun.desc: Summons sun for 5 turns, or 8 with Heat Rock. Each fainted ally adds 10% move power, capped at 5 after Free-for-All doubles the effective count, for at most 1.5x power. At 2 fallen allies, gains Infiltrator; at 4, flinch immunity; at 5, Magic Guard and a one-time +1 Attack and Sp. Atk.

inversion.shortDesc: Sets Inverse Field; Infiltrator; Hypnosis bypasses accuracy. Contrary is separate.
inversion.desc: Sets Inverse Field on entry. Full Infiltrator bypasses Substitute and opposing screens. Hypnosis bypasses accuracy checks while this ability is active; protection and sleep immunities still apply.

divinemockery.shortDesc: Hydra Bond and extra Water STAB.
divinemockery.desc: Full local Hydra Bond and extra Water STAB.

perfectego.shortDesc: Ability bypass, combat healing and stat gains.
perfectego.desc: Has all Ultra Ego combat healing, offensive and field defensive stat gains, pinch healing, ability bypass and field suppression. Against an opposing effective Ultra Instinct (including composites), its attacks ignore its own negative Attack and Sp. Atk stages. Ultra Instinct instead reduces its first HP-damaging move each turn by 40% and ignores positive Attack or Sp. Atk stages for that protected move. Stored stages are unchanged; normal +1 retaliation is unchanged. The rivalry is disabled on Bewitched Woods, Haunted and Holy.

echosense.desc: Has full Echo Fiend, Telepathy and Infiltrator with their suppression rules and field effects.

corrosiveburn.desc: Full local Corrosion and Venom Ignition: Fire attacks deal 1.2x damage against poisoned targets without consuming poison.

aquashell.desc: Full local Heatproof and Frisk. Incoming Fire attacks use half the attacker’s Attack or Special Attack; burn damage is halved. On activation, reveals opposing active Illusions and held items; each opposing item holder independently has a 30% chance of five-turn Embargo.

rainsovereign.shortDesc: Extends entry rain to 8 turns; Electric/Water/Flying STAB and opposing Water chip.
rainsovereign.desc: Rain Sovereign extends that rain to eight turns and has Electric, Water and Flying STAB plus opposing Water chip each turn, regardless of weather. Existing immunities and Free-for-All type scaling remain.

verdantsanctuary.desc: On entry, Hospitality heals each adjacent ally by 1/4 max HP. Friend Guard reduces damage to allies to 3/4.

bogbody.desc: Full local Thick Fat and Dry Skin: Fire and Ice offensive stats are halved, Water absorption, the Fire power penalty, rain healing, sun damage and all field recovery or damage.

mastercourse.shortDesc: Water/Dragon HP hits charge an ally, or itself alone, after the move.
mastercourse.desc: Once per turn, dealing opposing HP damage with a Water or Dragon attack prepares a nonstacking +1 critical-hit-stage charge after the entire move finishes. Give it to the living adjacent ally with the lowest HP percentage, or to itself if none exists. The next executed damaging move consumes the charge even on a miss, protection or immunity; status moves preserve it, and switching clears it. A successful charged Water or Dragon move can prepare another charge afterward.

glacialheart.shortDesc: Ice Body; alternating Ice/Dragon hits bypass positive defensive stages.
glacialheart.desc: Full Ice Body: contact attackers have a 30% frostbite chance; heals 1/16 maximum HP in hail/snow or qualifying cold fields, 1/8 in hail on Cold Eclipse; immune to hail damage. After dealing positive opposing HP damage with an Ice attack, prepares Dragon; Dragon damage prepares Ice. The next successful attack of the prepared type ignores positive Defense or Special Defense stages for its whole move, including every hit; negative stages remain. Preparation updates only after the move finishes, never stacks, and clears on switching. Misses, protection, immunity, Substitute-only damage, status moves and unrelated types do not change preparation. Suppression disables both preparation and its benefit without consuming stored preparation.

enlightenment.desc: Prevents flinching and Intimidate's Attack drop. Moves with effective power of 60 or less have 1.5x power; the threshold is 80 on Factory.

stormfright.desc: Rain multiplies Sp. Atk by 1.5 and costs 1/8 max HP at turn end. Redirects eligible Electric moves, including allied moves, and absorbs them for +1 Attack and Sp. Atk. Electric Terrain entry grants both boosts.

toxicrenewal.desc: Uses full local Adaptability for same-type moves, including its higher-STAB interaction. Contact hits have a 30% chance to poison; Shield Dust and Covert Cloak block this effect.

gigavolt.desc: Moves ignore bypassable opposing abilities. Redirects single-target Electric moves to itself and absorbs Electric moves for +1 Attack and Sp. Atk. Electric Terrain entry also grants both boosts.

fluffyevo.shortDesc: Off-type moves gain STAB; damaging moves ignore type immunities.
fluffyevo.desc: Moves that do not match its type gain STAB. Its damaging moves ignore type immunities while respecting resistances.

irondominion.shortDesc: Pressure, stat-drop reflection and field bonuses.
irondominion.desc: On entry, lowers adjacent foes' Defense and Sp. Def by 1, or 2 on Cold Eclipse. Pressure increases opposing PP use. Reflects opposing stat drops. Fairy Tale entry grants +1 Defense and Sp. Def; Mirror Arena grants +1 evasion. Has Starlight Arena priority protection. Outside Cold Eclipse, its Defense and Sp. Def drop is attempted only once per opposing Pokemon per battle for each Pressure user. Switching, Transform and ability loss or regain do not reset that allowance; a blocked or reflected attempt spends it. Cold Eclipse retains repeatable -2 drops on entry and neither spends nor resets the ordinary allowance.

warship.desc: Doubles Speed in rain or on Water Surface, Murkwater Surface, Underwater and Midnight Zone. Takes 20% less attack damage, or 40% less from super-effective attacks.

furnaceengine.shortDesc: Steam Engine, healing, damage reduction and Fire/Rock HP-hit chip.
furnaceengine.desc: Fire or Water HP hits give +6 Speed. Entry on Burning, Superheated or Volcanic gives +6 Speed; Dragon's Den and Volcanic give +1 Defense and Sp. Def; Cold Eclipse entry uses only passive Flame Body's +1 Defense and Sp. Def. Midnight Zone entry makes it Water-type. Water Surface, Underwater and Volcanic give +1 Speed each turn. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn. Takes 20% less attack damage, or 40% less from super-effective attacks. If it dealt Fire- or Rock-type move damage to opposing HP that turn, at the end of the turn opposing Pokemon take Fire-type damage equal to 1/16 max HP, blocked by Fire immunities. Only in Free-for-All does Fire type effectiveness scale this chip.

sweetdecay.desc: Attack is 1.5x, but physical moves have 0.8x accuracy. Prevents sleep and Yawn for itself and allies, including Rest. Does not cure sleep. Can poison Poison and Steel types; Poison moves bypass Steel immunity. Newly poisoned foes lose 1 Defense and Sp. Def. On Wasteland, move secondary effects become separate 2.5% frostbite, burn, paralysis and poison chances. On Corrosive and Corrosive Mist, incoming damage is multiplied by 1.5.

bakedbliss.shortDesc: Well-Baked Body, Thick Fat and Sweet Veil.
bakedbliss.desc: Absorbs Fire moves for +2 Defense. Gains +1 Defense each turn on Burning, Superheated, Dragon's Den and Volcanic. Incoming Fire and Ice attacks use half the attacker's offensive stat. Immune to hail damage. Prevents sleep and Yawn for itself and allies, including Rest. Does not cure sleep.

duneterror.shortDesc: Summons sand, Ground chip in sand, Desert Field on fainting.
duneterror.desc: On entry, summons sandstorm for 5 turns, or 8 with Smooth Rock. When it is hit by an attack, the effect of Sandstorm begins. Summons sand on entry and when hit; during Sandstorm, opposing Pokemon take Ground-type damage equal to 1/16 max HP, blocked by Ground immunities. On fainting, creates Desert Field for 5 turns.

riotamp.shortDesc: Converts Normal moves to Electric; amplifies sound moves.
riotamp.desc: Eligible Normal moves become Electric with 1.2x power. Its side's sound moves have 1.5x power and cannot damage allies; its sound moves use its higher attacking stat.

heatcoil.shortDesc: Speed Boost; freeze cure and Water/Ice damage reduction.
heatcoil.desc: Gains +1 Speed at the end of each full turn it spends active. Cures freeze. Incoming Water and Ice attacks use half the attacker's offensive stat.

wickedsnare.shortDesc: Intimidate; damaging Dark moves lower each damaged foe's Defense after all hits.
wickedsnare.desc: Full Intimidate lowers adjacent foes' Attack by one stage on entry, respecting its normal protections. After a damaging Dark move finishes all hits, each opponent that took positive HP damage loses one Defense stage, once per target per move. Substitute-only damage, misses, protection and immunity do not trigger this effect. Native effects remain independent: Crunch can also cause its own Defense drop.

sweetsanctuary.shortDesc: Ripen; successful Decorate heals its boosted target by 1/4 max HP.
sweetsanctuary.desc: Full local Ripen doubles HP restored and stat boosts from Berries, and doubles resistance Berries' damage reduction. When Decorate actually raises at least one stat, heals that target by 1/4 of its current maximum HP once after the move. Failed or blocked Decorate, or no actual positive boost, grants no healing. Normal healing restrictions apply. Ripen does not multiply this healing.

treasuretitan.shortDesc: Intimidate, super-effective reduction, Ground absorption and weight-move floor.
treasuretitan.desc: On entry, lowers adjacent foes' Attack by 1. Substitute and Intimidate protections still apply. Takes 25% less super-effective attack damage. Absorbs Ground moves from other Pokemon and heals 1/4 max HP. Copperajah-Gmax's weight-based moves have at least 120 power.

alloycore.desc: Prevents indirect damage; HP costs, Pain Split, confusion and Struggle recoil still apply. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn. Immune to sandstorm and hail damage.

phantombarrage.shortDesc: Hydra Bond, Clear Body and Infiltrator; adaptive Dragon Darts/Spirit Volley.
phantombarrage.desc: Other Pokemon cannot lower its stat stages. Moves bypass Substitute, Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil, Safeguard and Mist. Eligible single-target damaging moves hit three times; multi-hit moves, spread moves outside Free-for-All, charging moves, delayed attacks, Z/Max moves and moves barred from extra hits are excluded. The second and third hits deal 30% damage and retarget the foe's ally if the first target fainted. In Free-for-All battles, single-target moves hit all foes once at 1.3x power; spread moves hit all foes three times, with later hits at 30% power, and full-power spread moves stay full power. Moves have 1.2x power on Dragon's Den. Dragon Darts and G-Max Spirit Volley use its higher offensive stat and gain 20% power from Hydra Bond instead of extra hits. Dragon Darts keeps its two-hit pattern; Spirit Volley keeps its full-power hit and weaker follow-up against another foe. In Free-for-All battles, Dragon Darts hits all opposing Pokemon twice.

sweetresonance.shortDesc: Hydra Bond; lowers adjacent foes' evasion on entry. Field effects vary.
sweetresonance.desc: Full local Hydra Bond. On entry, lowers adjacent foes' evasion by 1 unless protected by Substitute. The entry effect has its Flower Garden and Misty field extensions.

scaleshelter.desc: Full local Overcoat prevents powder moves, Rage Powder redirection, Effect Spore, sandstorm damage and hail damage. Opposing Pokemon cannot lower its accuracy. Self and ally accuracy changes remain possible.

burningrage.shortDesc: Brute Force (Reckless + Rock Head), Iron Fist and Mold Breaker.
burningrage.desc: Brute Force (Reckless + Rock Head), Iron Fist and Mold Breaker. Brute Force: recoil and crash moves, Explosion, Self-Destruct and Misty Explosion have 1.2x power; Struggle is excluded. On Chessboard, all moves gain a further 1.2x power. Prevents move recoil except Struggle; crash and Life Orb damage still apply. Iron Fist: punching moves have 1.4x power. Mold Breaker: moves ignore bypassable opposing abilities.

absolutepressure.name: Absolute Pressure
absolutepressure.desc: Pressure + Inner Focus + Insomnia + Mold Breaker, including their entry effects and Insomnia’s 1.3x Dark/Ghost power. Entry and Mega Evolution refill an attack shield equal to 1/3 max HP; excess damage reaches HP. Status and indirect damage bypass the shield. Once per battle, a would-be faint as Mega Mewtwo instead restores base Mewtwo at half max HP with its original ability and a fresh shield. Its Mega use stays spent.
absolutepressure.shortDesc: Pressure + Inner Focus + Insomnia + Mold Breaker; 1/3-HP shield; once-battle Mega return.

absolutezero.name: Absolute Zero
absolutezero.desc: On entry, it summons Snow. Moves ignore bypassable opposing abilities. Takes 20% less attack damage, or 40% less from super-effective attacks.
absolutezero.shortDesc: On entry, it summons Snow; Moves ignore bypassable abilities; 40% less if super effective.

abyssalclaws.name: Abyssal Claws
abyssalclaws.desc: Tough Claws boosts contact moves once. Water attacks receive ordinary 1.5x STAB without adding Water typing or stacking another STAB bonus if already Water-type. Incoming Fire, Water, Ice and Steel attacks receive one extra resistance factor. Does not add Water weaknesses or lower Speed.
abyssalclaws.shortDesc: Tough Claws; Water STAB; halves Fire, Water, Ice and Steel damage.

abyssalcurrent.name: Abyssal Current
abyssalcurrent.desc: Water Absorb. Once per turn after a Dark attack damages opposing HP, attempts to lower one damaged surviving opponent’s Attack by one stage after the whole attack. No ally or Substitute-only trigger; normal stat-drop protection applies.
abyssalcurrent.shortDesc: Water Absorb; Dark HP attack lowers one foe’s Attack once per turn.

abyssalfang.name: Abyssal Fang
abyssalfang.desc: Strong Jaw. Once per turn after a biting attack damages opposing HP, attempts to lower one damaged surviving opponent’s Special Defense by one stage after the whole attack. No ally or Substitute-only trigger; normal stat-drop protection applies.
abyssalfang.shortDesc: Strong Jaw; bite HP attack lowers one foe’s Sp. Def once per turn.

abyssalrebirth.name: Abyssal Rebirth
abyssalrebirth.desc: Full local Hydra Bond and Levitate, including three-hit, Free-for-All, Gilded Helix and Dragon Den rules. Reawakening: once per battle, an opposing damaging move taking this Pokemon from above half HP to half HP or less restores 1/4 maximum HP after the entire move finishes, if it survives. All hits finish before recovery. Allies, recoil, hazards, weather and status damage cannot trigger it. Switching, form changes and ability restarts do not reset the use. Ability suppression prevents Reawakening without queuing a later heal; Hydra Bond and passive Levitate retain their normal passive rules, including Ground-immunity bypass. Berserk resolves independently before recovery.
abyssalrebirth.shortDesc: Hydra Bond + Levitate; once/battle, survive crossing half HP to heal 25%.

abysslure.name: Abyss Lure
abysslure.desc: It absorbs Electric- and Water-type moves that hit it, restoring 1/4 of its max HP and raising its Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage. Prevents other Pokemon's accuracy drops and ignores evasion boosts. Reveals opposing Illusions on activation. Mirror Arena entry lowers foes' accuracy by 1. Starlight Arena entry gives +2 Sp. Atk and puts Spotlight on its first adjacent ally. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn on Underwater, grounded on Water Surface, or grounded and Poison-type on Murkwater Surface. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn on Electric Terrain and Short-Circuit.
abysslure.shortDesc: Absorbs Electric/Water for 1/4 HP and +1 Attack/Sp. Atk; accuracy protection and field healing.

abysssniper.name: Abyss Sniper
abysssniper.desc: It gains 1 Accuracy on entry. Its critical hits deal 2.25x damage instead of 1.5x. Moves cannot be redirected. On New World, Starlight Arena, Fairy Tale and Chessboard entry, gains +1 Sp. Atk. Its critical hits deal increased damage, and its moves cannot be redirected.
abysssniper.shortDesc: Critical hits deal 2.25x damage; +1 Sp. Atk on specified fields.

accumulation.name: Accumulation
accumulation.desc: Incoming Fire and Ice attacks use half the attacker's offensive stat. Immune to sandstorm and hail damage. It can use Belch without eating a Berry and automatically gains one Stockpile every second eligible active turn, first gaining one after two eligible turns. Genuine switching resets this wait; ability restarts do not. Suppressed or otherwise ineligible turns do not advance the counter. Manual Stockpile is unchanged. After reaching 3 Stockpiles, it waits one full turn before randomly choosing Belch or Spit Up with equal odds, then can release every other turn. Its established Spit Up and Swallow combinations still apply.
accumulation.shortDesc: Fire/Ice protection; Stockpile every 2 eligible turns; at 3, waits one turn then auto-releases.

adaptability.name: Adaptability
adaptability.desc: Same-type attack bonus becomes 2x instead of 1.5x, or 2.25x instead of a 2x bonus.

adaptivearsenal.name: Adaptive Arsenal
adaptivearsenal.desc: Before an incoming damaging move, temporarily uses the alphabetically first type with a genuine chart resistance to its type, never a chart immunity. Keeps that type through all hits and restores underlying typing after the whole move, including failure or KO. No change against ??? or Stellar (no chart resistance), or while Terastallized. Ordinary Multi-Attack targets all opposing Pokémon at 1.2x power without a spread penalty; ???-type Multi-Attack receives another 1.5x (1.8x total). RKS System and Memory behavior remain separate.
adaptivearsenal.shortDesc: Temporary resisting type when attacked; Multi-Attack spreads at 1.2x (??? 1.8x).

adaptivecell.name: Adaptive Cell
adaptivecell.desc: It ignores powder moves, sandstorm and hail damage and its Special Attack is multiplied by 1.3. Its first move slot sets its opening type: Fighting for physical moves or Psychic for special moves. Each later damaging move changes its type to match its category. Physical moves use its boosted Special Attack as Attack; special moves use its boosted Special Attack normally.
adaptivecell.shortDesc: Category-based Fighting/Psychic typing; attacks use 1.3x Sp. Atk; powder/weather immunity.

adaptivecore.name: Adaptive Core
adaptivecore.desc: On entry, it compares the opposing side's combined Defense and Special Defense. If Defense is lower, its Attack rises; otherwise its Special Attack rises. Its first damaging move after switching in is a critical hit. On entry, it compares the opposing side's combined Attack and Special Attack. If Attack is higher or tied, its Defense rises; otherwise its Special Defense rises. Its moves cannot miss. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn and ignores sandstorm and hail damage. Switching out cures major status and heals 1/8 max HP only if a status was cured. Bewitched Woods cures status at turn end without this extra heal.
adaptivecore.shortDesc: First damaging move crits; moves cannot miss.

adaptivecycle.name: Adaptive Cycle
adaptivecycle.desc: Cannot be suppressed by Neutralizing Gas, Gastro Acid or similar effects. Battle-long individual memory pauses while inactive or replaced. After surviving a whole opposing move, its type joins two active memories (oldest archived): active end turns grant 20/35/50% damage reduction. Observed opposing actions grant 1 analysis point per turn (2 with shared typing); 4 points unlock 50% incoming reduction, 1.5x outgoing damage, known harmful move/secondary immunity, interaction-specific negation of that individual's entire ability (including composites) and resistant countertyping. Damaging attacks from that foe are at least resisted; attacks against it bypass type immunities and are at least super effective. Stronger natural effectiveness is retained; completed defender adaptation wins if both have analyzed each other. Fixed-damage and OHKO moves retain their normal damage rules. Type/opponent reductions use the stronger only. Learns each foe's bypass or encountered defensive reduction at turn end. Two observed boosted turns counter positive combat/accuracy stages, not Speed. Status and named chip causes complete in two active end turns, curing/removing the learned condition. Each full field/weather completes in three: ignores personal penalties and incoming direct damage bonuses, retaining benefits, Auras and shared transformations. See the Adapted display for observed progress.
adaptivecycle.shortDesc: Learns foes, two active attack types, status/chip, fields and weather; keeps memory when switching.

adaptivepower.name: Adaptive Power
adaptivepower.desc: Doubles Attack. Prevents indirect damage; HP costs, Pain Split, confusion and Struggle recoil still apply. Fairy Tale entry grants +1 Sp. Def.

adhesivearmor.name: Adhesive Armor
adhesivearmor.desc: Sticky Hold protects the held item. Opposing moves and effects cannot force it to switch. Voluntary switches and its own pivot moves remain available.
adhesivearmor.shortDesc: Sticky Hold; cannot be forced to switch.

aerilate.name: Aerilate
aerilate.desc: Its Normal-type moves become Flying-type moves and have their power multiplied by 1.2. This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects.
aerilate.shortDesc: Its Normal-type moves become Flying type and have 1.2x power.

aevianascendance.name: Aevian Ascendance
aevianascendance.desc: Transforms Poliwrath into Normal/Dragon Poliwrath-Rejuv on entry. Suppresses weather effects; Rainbow Field grants one random non-maxed stat stage other than evasion each turn. Full local Mind's Eye: Normal/Fighting attacks can hit Ghosts, Fairy/Dark moves gain STAB, moves ignore evasion boosts, and external accuracy drops fail. Cold Eclipse gives 30% damage reduction and 1.3x damaging move power. Water moves heal 1/4 base max HP instead of hitting; Water Absorb also heals 1/16 each turn on Underwater, grounded Water Surface, or grounded Poison types on Murkwater.
aevianascendance.shortDesc: Cloud Nine + Mind's Eye + Water Absorb. Poliwrath becomes Rejuv.

aevianbolt.name: Aevian Bolt
aevianbolt.desc: On entry, Druddigon permanently transforms into Druddigon-Rejuv. If Rain Dance or Primordial Sea is active, its Special Attack is multiplied by 1.5 and it loses 1/8 of its max HP at turn end. Contact attackers have a 30% paralysis chance, or 60% on Electric Terrain and Short-Circuit. Absorbs other Pokemon's Electric moves, healing 1/4 max HP instead of being hit. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn on Electric Terrain and Short-Circuit. If this Ability is suppressed, its Rejuv form reverts to the normal species until it switches out, even if suppression ends earlier.

aeviandream.name: Aevian Dream
aeviandream.desc: Sleeping foes, including Comatose users, lose 1/8 max HP each turn. Disabled on Rainbow Field. At turn end, if statused, affected by a listed ailment, negatively boosted or at half HP or less, has a 50% chance to heal 1/4 max HP, cure status, clear negative stages and remove Attract, confusion, Curse, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Leech Seed, Nightmare, Perish Song, Taunt, Torment and Yawn. On Dragon's Den, activation is guaranteed but only cures status and heals, then raises its higher attacking stat by 1 and lowers both defenses by 1. Contact moves have 1.3x power. When it enters battle as Musharna, it transforms into Musharna-Rejuv. If this Ability is suppressed, its Rejuv form reverts to the normal species until it switches out, even if suppression ends earlier.

aevianfrost.name: Aevian Frost
aevianfrost.desc: Contact attackers have a 30% chance of frostbite. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn in hail or snow, or on Icy, Snowy Mountain and Cold Eclipse without those weathers; hail on Cold Eclipse heals 1/8 instead. Immune to hail damage. Attack is 1.5x while statused, and burn does not weaken physical attacks.
aevianfrost.shortDesc: No hail damage; ignores burn attack penalty.

aevianglacier.name: Aevian Glacier
aevianglacier.desc: On entry, Turtonator permanently transforms into Turtonator-Rejuv. Summons hail. On Cold Eclipse, damaging attacks disable their user unless already disabled; excludes Max moves, delayed attacks and Struggle. Contact attackers have a 30% chance of frostbite. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn in hail or snow, or on Icy, Snowy Mountain and Cold Eclipse without those weathers; hail on Cold Eclipse heals 1/8 instead. Eligible Normal moves become Ice and have 1.2x power, or 1.5x on Icy and Snowy Mountain. Excludes moves whose type is set by their own effect, damaging Z-Moves and Terastallized Tera Blast. If this Ability is suppressed, its Rejuv form reverts to the normal species until it switches out, even if suppression ends earlier.

aeviangrief.name: Aevian Grief
aeviangrief.desc: Opposing status moves that check accuracy have 50% base accuracy. On Rainbow Field, opposing status moves fail their accuracy check. Airborne: immune to Ground attacks, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web and Arena Trap unless grounded. Thousand Arrows can still hit. Prevents indirect damage; HP costs, Pain Split, confusion and Struggle recoil still apply. Fairy Tale entry gives +1 Sp. Def. Damaging attacks have a 30% chance to be disabled, guaranteed on Haunted and disabled on Holy Field. Excludes Max moves, delayed attacks and Struggle. On fainting, curses all active foes.
aeviangrief.shortDesc: Opposing status moves that check accuracy have 50% base accuracy.

aevianking.name: Aevian King
aevianking.desc: Transforms Politoed into Politoed-Rejuv on entry. Full Guardian Presence, Soundproof and Water Absorb: allies take 25% less attack damage and their moves have 1.3x power (1.5x on Haunted, Bewitched Woods, Holy and Psychic fields). Sound moves from other Pokemon fail. Water moves heal 1/4 max HP instead of dealing damage; heals 1/16 base max HP each turn on Underwater, grounded on Water Surface, or grounded and Poison-type on Murkwater Surface.
aevianking.shortDesc: Guardian Presence + Soundproof + Water Absorb. Politoed becomes Rejuv.

aevianoath.name: Aevian Oath
aevianoath.desc: On entry, heals each adjacent ally by 1/4 max HP, or 1/3 on Fairy Tale. Eligible slicing, pulse, bullet, horn, drill, and Arrow moves normally hit twice at 60% power, each with its own accuracy check. If an offensive ability power or damage multiplier applies, the first hit retains its full ability boosts and the second uses 15% of original move power without those offensive ability multipliers. Stat multipliers, items, STAB and ordinary weather or field modifiers remain separate. In Free-for-All, the second hit targets another random living foe when possible; Siege Launcher retains its full-power pair. Existing multi-hit moves do not gain an extra pair. Prevents critical hits and takes 20% less attack damage. Gains +1 Defense on Fairy Tale entry and +2 Defense when a foe lowers its stats.
aevianoath.shortDesc: On entry, heals each adjacent ally by 1/4 max HP, or 1/3 on Fairy Tale.

aevianrocket.name: Aevian Rocket
aevianrocket.desc: When Veluza enters battle with this Ability, it changes into Veluza-Rejuv. It has Brute Force's Reckless power boost and Rock Head recoil protection, restores 1/3 of its max HP on switching out through Regenerator, ignores opposing Abilities with Mold Breaker, and doubles its Speed under Swift Swim's conditions. If this Ability is suppressed, its Rejuv form reverts to the normal species until it switches out, even if suppression ends earlier.

aevianspark.name: Aevian Spark
aevianspark.desc: Moves with effective power of 60 or less have 1.5x power; the threshold is 80 on Factory Field. Contact attackers have a 30% paralysis chance, or 60% on Electric Terrain and Short-Circuit. Sleep lasts half as long, rounded down. Breloom becomes Breloom-Rejuv on entry.

aeviantoxin.name: Aevian Toxin
aeviantoxin.desc: Biting moves have 1.5x power. Doubles Defense; immune to powder effects, sandstorm and hail damage. Attacks always critically hit poisoned foes or on Corrosive, Corrosive Mist, Murkwater Surface and Wasteland, unless critical hits are blocked. On Chessboard, gains one critical-hit stage per 20% of the target's missing base max HP, up to three. Drapion becomes Drapion-Rejuv on entry.

aevianweb.name: Aevian Web
aevianweb.desc: Transforms Galvantula into Bug/Rock Galvantula-Rejuv on entry. Full local Guts gives 1.5x Attack while statused and ignores the burn damage penalty. Keen Eye prevents external accuracy drops, ignores evasion boosts and reveals opposing Illusions; Mirror Arena entry grants +1 accuracy and Laser Focus. Solid Rock reduces attack damage by 20%, or 40% total for super-effective attacks.
aevianweb.shortDesc: Guts + Keen Eye + Solid Rock; Galvantula becomes Rejuv.

aevianwing.name: Aevian Wing
aevianwing.desc: Prevents move recoil except Struggle. Crash and Life Orb damage still apply. Gains +2 Attack when a foe lowers its stats. Unfezant becomes Unfezant-Rejuv on entry.

afterlifegate.name: Afterlife Gate
afterlifegate.desc: Once per turn after a whole special Ghost or Poison attack damages an opposing Pokemon's HP, curses one surviving active foe if it is not already cursed. This ability-sourced Curse deals 1/8 base max HP each turn and costs its user no HP. Once per turn, a foe knocked out by its own attack or its own Afterlife Gate Curse heals it for 1/8 max HP, only while it is alive and active. Other curses and unrelated knockouts do not qualify. Shadow Shield reduces attack damage by 20%, or 40% for super-effective attacks, at any HP; it has its Cold Eclipse hail immunity.
afterlifegate.shortDesc: Special Ghost/Poison HP hits curse once per turn; own KOs heal; Shadow Shield.

aftermath.name: Aftermath
aftermath.desc: A contact attacker that knocks it out loses 1/4 max HP, or 1/2 on Corrosive Mist. Damp prevents this damage.
aftermath.shortDesc: Contact KO costs attacker 1/4 HP (1/2 on Corrosive Mist).

agonyflame.name: Agony Flame
agonyflame.desc: After a damaging Fire move finishes, burns each surviving active opponent that lost HP and applies Heal Block for 2 turns including the current turn. Normal status protections apply. A longer Heal Block is not shortened. A target already burned by the move is not burned again after a curing Berry. Protected, immune, Substitute-only, allied, self and delayed damage do not qualify. As a species passive it remains active under ability suppression.
agonyflame.shortDesc: Fire hits burn foes and block healing for 2 turns; requires actual opposing HP damage.

aimassist.name: Aim Assist
aimassist.desc: After a successful status move in a turn with no damaging attack attempted, locks the last directly targeted active foe, otherwise the opposing-position foe or first living foe, through next turn. The next eligible attack against it uses Lock-On accuracy and ignores positive Defense/Sp. Def stages across the whole attack. Consumes on attempt; protection and immunities remain. Clears when either leaves. Excludes OHKO, Z/Max and generated attacks; independent of manual Lock-On.
aimassist.shortDesc: Status-only turn locks one foe; next attack cannot miss and ignores positive defenses.

airlock.name: Air Lock
airlock.desc: While it is active, the effects of weather conditions are disabled.
airlock.shortDesc: While it is active, the effects of weather conditions are disabled.

alchemistsurge.name: Alchemist Surge
alchemistsurge.desc: On entry, creates Psychic Terrain for 5 turns, or 8 with Amplifield Rock, subject to field and Aura rules. Foe stat drops give +2 Sp. Atk, except on Chessboard. On Chessboard, move power instead rises with missing HP, from 1x at full HP to 2x at 20% HP or less. Eligible single-target attacks hit three times. In singles and doubles, native variable multi-hit moves use their maximum hit count, keeping native per-hit accuracy and damage. Remaining native hits can continue into another living opposing active Pokemon after a KO at 70% damage. Excludes non-FFA spread, charge, delayed, Z/Max and extra-hit-barred moves. Follow-ups deal 30% damage, retargeting another living opposing active Pokemon after a KO. In FFA, single-target moves hit all foes at 1.3x power; spread moves hit all foes three times with 30% follow-ups. Full-power spread stays full power. Moves have 1.2x power on Dragon's Den. Status moves gain +1 priority. Opposing Dark types block these moves except on Bewitched Woods. Psychic Surge follows the field/Aura rules: it can create Psychic Terrain on an empty field or Psychic Aura over a compatible field.
alchemistsurge.shortDesc: Sets Psychic Terrain on entry; Prankster.

alloycore.name: Alloy Core
alloycore.desc: Prevents indirect damage; HP costs, Pain Split, confusion and Struggle recoil still apply. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn. Immune to sandstorm and hail damage. Moves cannot be redirected. On New World, Starlight Arena, Fairy Tale and Chessboard entry, gains +1 Sp. Atk.
alloycore.shortDesc: No indirect/weather damage; heals 1/16 HP per turn; moves ignore redirection.

amethystglow.name: Amethyst Glow
amethystglow.desc: Contact attackers have a 30% chance of frostbite. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn in hail or snow, or on Icy, Snowy Mountain and Cold Eclipse without those weathers; hail on Cold Eclipse heals 1/8 instead. Immune to hail damage. Eligible Normal moves become Ice and have 1.2x power, or 1.5x on Icy and Snowy Mountain. Excludes moves whose type is set by their own effect, damaging Z-Moves and Terastallized Tera Blast. Moves cannot miss. Adds Ice typing in hail or snow and on Icy, Snowy Mountain and Cold Eclipse.
amethystglow.shortDesc: Moves never miss; Normal moves become Ice; Ice/weather healing and protection; gains Ice typing.

analytic.name: Analytic
analytic.desc: Moves have 1.3x power if no other active Pokemon has a move left to use that turn.
analytic.shortDesc: 1.3x power when no other active Pokemon has a move left.

anchorbridge.name: Anchor Bridge
anchorbridge.desc: Immune to OHKO moves; at full HP survives an otherwise fatal direct hit with 1 HP. Takes 0.8x attack damage, or 0.6x from super-effective attacks. Normal ability suppression and Mold Breaker rules apply.
anchorbridge.shortDesc: 20% less attack damage, 40% less if super effective.

anchoredbattery.name: Anchored Battery
anchoredbattery.desc: Full local Mega Launcher boosts bullet and pulse moves by 1.5x. After each such attack, each surviving active foe whose HP it damaged loses 1 Speed stage, once for the whole move. Normal stat-drop protections apply. Allied targets, blocked hits and Substitute-only damage do not qualify.
anchoredbattery.shortDesc: Bullet/pulse power 1.5x; damaged foes lose 1 Speed stage per move.

ancientassembly.name: Ancient Assembly
ancientassembly.desc: Each different allied Regirock, Regice, Registeel, Regieleki or Regidrago that enters battle shortens its Slow Start by 1 turn, up to 3 turns. In Primordial form, each instead adds 10% damage, up to 30%. Each species counts once per battle.
ancientassembly.shortDesc: Allied Regis shorten Slow Start; in Primordial form, boost damage.

ancientbloom.name: Verdant Crown
ancientbloom.desc: Pollen Bloom supplies Thick Fat and Unaware: Fire and Ice attacks use half the attacking stat; ignores opposing stat stages through local Unaware and reveals Illusions on entry. Each turn, drains 1/16 base max HP from non-Grass foes and heals the damage actually dealt; Grass immunities apply, and type effectiveness scales this only in Free-for-All. Self-Sufficient independently heals 1/16 max HP each turn and prevents sandstorm and hail damage. Friend Guard reduces attack damage to allies by 25%, without protecting the holder. Fairy Tale, New World, Cold Eclipse and Starlight Arena entry grant +1 Defense and Sp. Def; the latter three give 1.5x move power.
ancientbloom.shortDesc: Pollen Bloom + Self-Sufficient + Friend Guard; field bonuses.

angerpoint.name: Anger Point
angerpoint.desc: The first damaging hit it takes raises its Attack by 1 stage. A critical hit raises its Attack by 12 stages.
angerpoint.shortDesc: First damaging hit: +1 Attack; critical hits: +12 Attack.

angershell.name: Anger Shell
angershell.desc: When it has more than 1/2 its max HP and takes damage from an attack bringing it to 1/2 or less of its max HP, its Attack, Special Attack, and Speed are raised by 1 stage, and its Defense and Special Defense are lowered by 1 stage. This effect applies after all hits from a multi-hit move. This effect is prevented if the move had a secondary effect removed by the Sheer Force Ability.
angershell.shortDesc: At 1/2 or less of its max HP: +1 Atk, Sp. Atk, Spe, and -1 Def, Sp. Def.

anticipation.name: Anticipation
anticipation.desc: Checks each active opponent separately when the holder enters, and rechecks each incoming opponent on every switch-in, including repeat entries. Allies are not checked, and initial checks do not trigger twice. For each check, removes that opponent's Illusion and reveals one super-effective damaging move or OHKO threat. If that opponent has no threat, Psychic Terrain grants +2 Sp. Atk. Until switching out, takes 25% less damage from opposing uses of the most recently revealed damaging non-OHKO move. This replaces weaker Forewarn protection rather than stacking with it.
anticipation.shortDesc: Scans each foe on entry and every switch-in; reveals threats and guards against the latest.

antlioninstinct.name: Antlion Instinct
antlioninstinct.desc: Sheer Force. Bug attacks receive ordinary 1.5x STAB, without stacking extra STAB if already Bug-type. Incoming Grass, Ground and Fighting attacks receive one extra resistance factor, once regardless of defensive typing. No Bug typing or weaknesses are added.
antlioninstinct.shortDesc: Sheer Force; Bug STAB; one extra Grass, Ground and Fighting resistance.

apexarmor.name: Apex Armor
apexarmor.desc: It is immune to bullet, pulse, and all Mega Launcher-boosted moves and takes 20% less damage from attacks. Contact attackers lose 1/8 of their max HP. Moves cannot be redirected. On New World, Starlight Arena, Fairy Tale and Chessboard entry, gains +1 Sp. Atk. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn. Immune to sandstorm and hail damage. Blocks bullet/pulse moves, reduces attack damage by 20%, damages contact attackers by 1/8 max HP, and ignores redirection. Restores 1/16 max HP each turn and prevents hail and sandstorm damage.
apexarmor.shortDesc: Blocks bullets, pulses and Mega Launcher-boosted moves; 20% less attack damage.

apexbond.name: Apex Bond
apexbond.desc: Battle Bond's shared effects plus Supreme Overlord and Rough Skin. Garchomp-Battle-Bond's Dual Chop never misses and always critically hits. Effective fallen count is capped at 5 after Free-for-All doubling, for a maximum 1.5x Supreme Overlord power multiplier.
apexbond.shortDesc: Dual Chop cannot miss and always critically hits.

apexcleave.name: Apex Cleave
apexcleave.desc: Eligible slicing, pulse, bullet, horn, drill, and Arrow moves normally hit twice at 60% power, each with its own accuracy check. If an offensive ability power or damage multiplier applies, the first hit retains its full ability boosts and the second uses 15% of original move power without those offensive ability multipliers. Stat multipliers, items, STAB and ordinary weather or field modifiers remain separate. In Free-for-All, the second hit targets another random living foe when possible; Siege Launcher retains its full-power pair. Existing multi-hit moves do not gain an extra pair. Gains +1 Attack per move KO.

apexflytrap.name: Apex Flytrap
apexflytrap.desc: Levitate grants Ground immunity. A foe that damages it with contact is trapped through the end of the following turn while the holder remains active. Further qualifying hits refresh the short duration. Switching out or fainting releases the trap. Normal trapping immunities and escape effects apply; allied hits and Substitute-only damage do not qualify.
apexflytrap.shortDesc: Levitate; damaging contact traps foes through the following turn.

apexpredator.name: Apex Predator
apexpredator.desc: Full local Wind Rider and Tough Claws: wind-move immunity and Wind Rider’s Tailwind/field Attack effects; contact moves have 1.3x power.

apexvenom.name: Apex Venom
apexvenom.desc: Strong Jaw gives biting attacks 1.5x power. Poison Fang has no separate signature multiplier. Local Poison/Steel matchup overrides, bite protection bypass and toxic chance, and Shed Skin.
apexvenom.shortDesc: Strong Jaw 1.5x; has poison matchups and Shed Skin.

apocalypticflame.name: Apocalyptic Flame
apocalypticflame.desc: Own Tempo. Once per turn after a physical attack deals opposing HP damage, heals 1/8 max HP and attempts to lower one damaged surviving opponent’s stronger attacking stat by one stage, Attack on ties. Normal healing and stat-drop restrictions apply independently.
apocalypticflame.shortDesc: Own Tempo; physical HP hit heals 1/8 and lowers foe’s stronger attack once per turn.

aquashell.name: Aqua Shell
aquashell.desc: Full local Heatproof and Frisk. Incoming Fire attacks use half the attacker’s Attack or Special Attack; burn damage is halved. On activation, reveals opposing active Illusions and held items; each opposing item holder independently has a 30% chance of five-turn Embargo.

arenatrap.name: Arena Trap
arenatrap.desc: Traps adjacent grounded foes; takes 20% less damage from trapped targets. Only the Arena Trap holder receives the damage reduction, and only when attacked by a foe it is trapping.
arenatrap.shortDesc: Traps adjacent grounded foes; takes 20% less damage from trapped targets.

argentdevotion.name: Argent Devotion
argentdevotion.desc: Eligible Normal moves become Steel with 1.2x power, or 1.5x on Factory, Short-Circuit, Fairy Tale, Dragon's Den, Starlight Arena, New World and Holy Field. Immune to hail damage on Cold Eclipse. On entry, heals each adjacent ally by 1/4 max HP, or 1/3 on Fairy Tale. Doubles move secondary-effect chances and removes charging turns. Moves ignore bypassable opposing abilities.
argentdevotion.shortDesc: Normal becomes Steel; ally entry healing; doubled secondaries; no charging; ability bypass.

armorize.name: Armorize
armorize.desc: Its Normal-type moves become Steel-type moves and have their power multiplied by 1.2.
armorize.shortDesc: Normal moves become Steel type and have 1.2x power.

armortail.name: Armor Tail
armortail.desc: Priority moves used by opposing Pokemon targeting it or its allies are prevented from having an effect.
armortail.shortDesc: It and its allies are protected from opposing priority moves.

aromaveil.name: Aroma Veil
aromaveil.desc: Protects itself and allies from Attract, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Taunt and Torment.
aromaveil.shortDesc: Team protection from attraction and move restrictions.

ascendance.name: Ascendance
ascendance.desc: All damaging moves deal 1.5x damage, can hit type immunities, and gain a 1.5x STAB-style boost when they do not match its type. On Holy Field, its Attack and Special Attack are raised by 1 on entry. Eevee-Starter and Umbreon transform into Divineon on entry; Umbreon uses Umbreon-Perfect's appearance while retaining Umbreon's full movepool.
ascendance.shortDesc: 1.5x attack damage, immunity bypass and off-type STAB; Eevee-Starter/Umbreon becomes Divineon.

asoneglastrier.name: As One (Glastrier)
asoneglastrier.desc: Blocks opposing Berries; move KOs give +1 Attack per knockout.
asoneglastrier.shortDesc: Blocks opposing Berries; move KOs give +1 Attack per knockout.

asonespectrier.name: As One (Spectrier)
asonespectrier.desc: Blocks opposing Berries; move KOs give +1 Sp. Atk per knockout.
asonespectrier.shortDesc: Blocks opposing Berries; move KOs give +1 Sp. Atk per knockout.

astralconcord.name: Astral Concord
astralconcord.desc: Has all local Forewarn warning, Illusion reveal, damage protection and Psychic Terrain effects. Competitive raises Special Attack by two stages when an opponent lowers a stat. Its Forewarn component: Checks each active opponent separately when the holder enters, and rechecks each incoming opponent on every switch-in, including repeat entries. Allies are not checked, and initial checks do not trigger twice. Each check retains its usual Psychic Terrain bonus condition and latest-warned-move protection.

astralcore.name: Astral Core
astralcore.desc: Doubles Attack, or Sp. Atk instead on Psychic Terrain. Switching out cures major status and heals 1/8 max HP only if a status was cured. Bewitched Woods cures status at turn end without this heal. Prevents other Pokemon's accuracy drops and ignores evasion boosts. Reveals opposing Illusions on activation. Mirror Arena entry lowers foes' accuracy by 1. Starlight Arena entry gives +2 Sp. Atk and puts Spotlight on its first adjacent ally.
astralcore.shortDesc: Psychic Terrain doubles Sp. Atk instead; Woods cures status each turn; reveals Illusions.

astralengine.name: Astral Engine
astralengine.desc: Allies' moves have 1.3x power, or 1.5x on Haunted, Bewitched Woods, Holy and Psychic fields.

astralward.name: Astral Ward
astralward.desc: Opponents cannot lower its accuracy. Its moves ignore opposing positive evasion stages.
astralward.shortDesc: Prevents opposing accuracy drops; ignores opposing evasion boosts.

astralwatcher.name: Astral Watcher
astralwatcher.desc: On entry, reveals all opposing Illusions and held items. Each opposing item holder independently has a 30% chance to receive Embargo for 5 turns. Status moves gain +1 priority.
astralwatcher.shortDesc: Reveals opposing Illusions/items; 30% Embargo chance per item holder; +1 status-move priority.

astralwitchcraft.name: Astral Witchcraft
astralwitchcraft.desc: Levitate grants Ground immunity and airborne benefits unless grounded. Magic Guard prevents indirect damage under its normal rules. Void Guile provides Magician item theft and Infiltrator screen, Substitute, Safeguard and Mist bypass. Entry grants +1 Sp. Atk on Fairy Tale, Bewitched Woods, Haunted, Misty or New World; on Psychic, incoming status moves with numeric accuracy use 50 accuracy. Its separate Fairy Tale and New World entry bonus grants another +1 Sp. Atk and +1 Sp. Def.
astralwitchcraft.shortDesc: Levitate + Magic Guard + Void Guile (Magician + Infiltrator).

atrocity.name: Atrocity
atrocity.desc: Unbound Blaze + Tough Claws + Fire Ward
atrocity.shortDesc: Unbound Blaze + Tough Claws + Fire Ward

aurabreak.name: Aura Break
aurabreak.desc: While it is active, the effects of the Dark Aura and Fairy Aura Abilities are reversed, multiplying the power of Dark- and Fairy-type moves, respectively, by 3/4 instead of 1.33.
aurabreak.shortDesc: While it is active, the Dark Aura and Fairy Aura power modifier is 0.75x.

auraconvergence.name: Aura Convergence
auraconvergence.desc: Fighting- and Steel-type damaging attacks choose physical or special once per target per move, comparing current staged Attack / Defense with Special Attack / Special Defense. Ties keep the original category. Power, accuracy, contact, secondary effects and drawbacks stay unchanged. Burn and screens apply normally after choosing. Fixed-damage attacks are unchanged.
auraconvergence.shortDesc: Fighting/Steel attacks choose physical or special by the target matchup.

auraguard.name: Aura Guard
auraguard.desc: Damage taken from contact moves is halved, whether the move is physical or special. Noncontact moves are unaffected.
auraguard.shortDesc: Takes half damage from contact moves.

aurainstinct.name: Aura Instinct
aurainstinct.desc: Same-type attack bonus becomes 2x instead of 1.5x, or 2.25x instead of a 2x bonus. Eligible slicing, pulse, bullet, horn, drill, and Arrow moves normally hit twice at 60% power, each with its own accuracy check. If an offensive ability power or damage multiplier applies, the first hit retains its full ability boosts and the second uses 15% of original move power without those offensive ability multipliers. Stat multipliers, items, STAB and ordinary weather or field modifiers remain separate. In Free-for-All, the second hit targets another random living foe when possible; Siege Launcher retains its full-power pair. Existing multi-hit moves do not gain an extra pair. The first otherwise lethal attack has a 50% chance to leave it at 1 HP. This Ability rolls only once per battle, even if the roll fails or it switches out.
aurainstinct.shortDesc: Stronger STAB; eligible moves hit twice; one 50% roll per battle to survive a lethal attack.

auramaster.name: Aura Master
auramaster.desc: Takes half contact damage. Prevents flinching and Intimidate's Attack drop. Moves with effective power of 60 or less have 1.5x power; the threshold is 80 on Factory Field. Eligible slicing, pulse, bullet, horn, drill, and Arrow moves normally hit twice at 60% power, each with its own accuracy check. If an offensive ability power or damage multiplier applies, the first hit retains its full ability boosts and the second uses 15% of original move power without those offensive ability multipliers. Stat multipliers, items, STAB and ordinary weather or field modifiers remain separate. In Free-for-All, the second hit targets another random living foe when possible; Siege Launcher retains its full-power pair. Existing multi-hit moves do not gain an extra pair.
auramaster.shortDesc: Takes half damage from contact moves.

auraprecision.name: Aura Precision
auraprecision.desc: Full local Ultra Instinct, Shield Dust and Mind's Eye. Ultra Instinct supplies its own whole-attack recovery, first-attack reduction and field interactions. Shield Dust blocks secondary effects aimed at this Pokemon while retaining attacker self-effects.
