Mind's Eye lets Normal and Fighting moves hit Ghosts, supplies Fairy and Dark STAB, ignores evasion boosts, prevents external accuracy drops, reveals opposing Illusions and applies its Cold Eclipse power and damage reduction.
auraprecision.shortDesc: Ultra Instinct + Shield Dust + Mind's Eye.

aurasight.name: Aura Sight
aurasight.desc: Aura Sphere uses the higher staged Attack or Sp. Atk and the corresponding defensive stat, choosing Special on ties. It bypasses Substitute. Its normal power, never-miss accuracy, Protect, type immunity and Bulletproof interactions remain unchanged.
aurasight.shortDesc: Aura Sphere uses higher staged offense (Special ties) and bypasses Substitute.

auroracurrent.name: Aurora Current
auroracurrent.desc: It has Snow Warning built in. On entry, it summons Snow. It gains STAB on Electric-type moves. During Snow, its Electric-type moves cannot miss and its Defense and Special Defense are boosted by 1.5x.
auroracurrent.shortDesc: Electric STAB; in Snow, Electric never misses and Def/SpD 1.5x.

auroradomain.name: Aurora Domain
auroradomain.desc: Summons hail on entry. Damaging attacks disable their user on Cold Eclipse, except Max moves, delayed attacks and Struggle; an existing Disable is not replaced. Eligible Normal moves become Ice with 1.2x power, or 1.5x on Icy and Snowy Mountain. Excludes moves with their own type, damaging Z-Moves and Terastallized Tera Blast. On fainting, creates Fairy Tale and sets or refreshes its side's Aurora Veil for 5 turns.
auroradomain.shortDesc: Hail and stronger Ice moves; field and Veil on fainting.

auroraresonance.name: Aurora Resonance
auroraresonance.desc: Sound moves become Water-type, or Ice-type on Icy Field, and have 1.2x power. Absorbs other Pokemon's Water moves, healing 1/4 max HP instead of being hit. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn on Underwater, grounded on Water Surface, or grounded and Poison-type on Murkwater Surface. Contact attackers have a 30% chance of frostbite. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn in hail or snow, or on Icy, Snowy Mountain and Cold Eclipse without those weathers; hail on Cold Eclipse heals 1/8 instead. Immune to hail damage. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn in effective rain. Sound moves become Water type, Water attacks are absorbed, and the holder heals in rain and snow. Does not add Ice typing.
auroraresonance.shortDesc: Sound moves become Water-type, or Ice-type on Icy Field, and have 1.2x power.

baddreams.name: Bad Dreams
baddreams.desc: Sleeping foes, including Comatose users, lose 1/8 max HP each turn. Disabled on Rainbow Field.
baddreams.shortDesc: Sleeping foes lose 1/8 HP per turn, except on Rainbow.

badseeds.name: Bad Seeds
badseeds.desc: On entry, creates Frozen Aura for 5 turns, or 8 with Amplifield Rock; on no field, Icy Field or Snowy Mountain, instead attempts full Cold Eclipse for the same duration. Existing Frozen Aura is not refreshed. Field locks apply; fails on Dragon’s Den. Does not summon hail. Frozen Aura preserves the base field and boosts both sides: Ice attacks 1.3x; Ice Beam, Blizzard, Frost Breath and Aurora Beam an additional 1.2x (1.56x total); Dark Pulse, Snarl, Night Daze, Night Slash, Lash Out, Stomping Tantrum, Raging Fury, Thrash, Outrage, Rage, Freezing Glare, Fiery Wrath, Roar of Time, Bitter Blade and Bitter Malice 1.5x; Chilling Water 2x. Freeze Shock and Ice Burn skip charging; Dragon Rage deals 140 fixed damage. Only on full Cold Eclipse: halves damage exploiting the holder’s current Ice-type weakness after field typing effects, unless bypassed; eligible non-Ice contact attackers acquire Bad Seeds without repeating entry setup; non-Ice holders lose 1 Attack and Sp. Atk at turn end. Active unsuppressed holders prevent changing or breaking Cold Eclipse, but normal duration expiry remains allowed.
badseeds.shortDesc: Entry: Frozen Aura or Cold Eclipse for 5/8 turns; extra effects only on Cold Eclipse.

baitedbloom.name: Baited Bloom
baitedbloom.desc: Gluttony makes pinch Berries activate at half HP and Leftovers heal 1/8 max HP each turn. Regenerator restores 1/3 base max HP when switching out.
baitedbloom.shortDesc: Gluttony and Regenerator: early pinch Berries, stronger Leftovers; heals 1/3 on switching.

baitedcounter.name: Baited Counter
baitedcounter.desc: Full local Filter. Its physical attacks have 1.3x power if it has already taken opposing direct damaging-move HP damage during the current turn and entry. Allied, recoil, residual and Substitute-only damage do not qualify.
baitedcounter.shortDesc: Filter; physical attacks gain 1.3x after opposing attack HP damage that turn.

bakedbliss.name: Baked Bliss
bakedbliss.desc: Absorbs Fire moves for +2 Defense. Gains +1 Defense each turn on Burning, Superheated, Dragon's Den and Volcanic. Incoming Fire and Ice attacks use half the attacker's offensive stat. Immune to hail damage. Prevents sleep and Yawn for itself and allies, including Rest. Does not cure sleep. Berries normally eaten at 1/4 HP activate at 1/2 HP instead.

barbharvest.name: Mineral Grip
barbharvest.desc: Full local Suction Cups. On each genuine switch-in, absorbs and removes Stealth Rock from its own side before it causes entry damage. Other hazards remain. Ability restarts do not activate it, and suppression prevents removal.
barbharvest.shortDesc: Suction Cups; removes own-side Stealth Rock before taking entry damage.

battery.name: Battery
battery.desc: Special moves have 1.3x power, with a further 1.5x boost on Electric Terrain. Allies' special moves have 1.3x power.
battery.shortDesc: Boosts its own and allies' special moves.

battlearmor.name: Battle Armor
battlearmor.desc: Prevents critical hits and takes 20% less attack damage. Gains +1 Defense on Fairy Tale entry and +2 Defense when a foe lowers its stats.
battlearmor.shortDesc: No critical hits; 20% less damage; foe stat drops give +2 Defense.

battlebond.name: Battle Bond
battlebond.desc: Eligible Arcanine, Garchomp and Greninja transform after a move KO while another foe remains. Bond forms heal 1/8 base max HP after move KOs. Heals 1/16 base max HP each turn and prevents sandstorm/hail damage. Attack power is 1.3x against Royal Decree, Empress or Neutralization and independently 1.3x on Cold Eclipse. Cannot be suppressed or swapped.
battlebond.shortDesc: A move KO triggers a Bond form; heals each turn and after Bond-form KOs.

battlefervor.name: Battle Fervor
battlefervor.desc: If it moves before its target, its attacks deal 1.2x damage. Once per switch-in, if it would move after the attacker, damaging attacks against it deal 0.8x damage. The first time per battle it is hit by an opposing damaging move, its Attack and Special Attack rise by 1 stage. Foes cannot eat Berries while it is active, and Seed items are prevented. Bewitched Woods, Haunted, and Holy Field disable these effects.
battlefervor.shortDesc: Fast attacks 1.2x; slow-hit guard once; first hit +Atk/SpA; blocks Berries/Seeds.

battlegrip.name: Battle Grip
battlegrip.desc: Moxie grants +1 Attack for each Pokemon knocked out by its move. Knocking out an opponent with a move also clears its confusion and negative accuracy stages, preserving positive accuracy.
battlegrip.shortDesc: Move KOs against opponents also clear its confusion and negative accuracy.

battlespoils.name: Battle Spoils
battlespoils.desc: Once per turn after a contact attack damages opposing HP, the living active holder restores 1/16 max HP after the whole attack. No ally or Substitute-only trigger. Normal healing restrictions apply.
battlespoils.shortDesc: Contact attacks heal 1/16 max HP once per turn after opposing HP damage.

beadsofruin.name: Beads of Ruin
beadsofruin.desc: Active Pokemon without this Ability have their Special Defense multiplied by 0.75.
beadsofruin.shortDesc: Active Pokemon without this Ability have their Special Defense multiplied by 0.75.

beastboost.name: Beast Boost
beastboost.desc: Its highest stat is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and knocks out another Pokemon. Stat stage changes are not considered. If multiple stats are tied, Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed are prioritized in that order.
beastboost.shortDesc: Its highest stat is raised by 1 if it attacks and KOes another Pokemon.

beguilingbouquet.name: Beguiling Bouquet
beguilingbouquet.desc: Aroma Veil. Damaging Grass moves gain a 30% poison secondary; Serene Grace doubles it to 60%.
beguilingbouquet.shortDesc: Aroma Veil; Grass attacks have a 30% poison chance.

berserk.name: Berserk
berserk.desc: When an attack takes it from above half HP to half or less, gains +1 Attack and Sp. Atk after the move. Dragon's Den entry gives +2 Attack and Sp. Atk.
berserk.shortDesc: Crossing half HP from an attack gives +1 Attack/Sp. Atk.

bewitchingmajesty.name: Bewitching Majesty
bewitchingmajesty.desc: On entry, creates Bewitched Woods for 5 turns. Reflects eligible directly targeted status moves once. Blocks opposing priority moves targeting its side, with the usual side-wide move exceptions.
bewitchingmajesty.shortDesc: Sets Bewitched Woods; reflects targeted status moves; blocks foe priority for its side.

beyondfear.name: Beyond Fear
beyondfear.desc: Immune to flinching and opposing Taunt. Does not prevent Intimidate or other stat drops and does not raise defenses in response. When supplied as a species passive, remains active through selected-ability suppression.
beyondfear.shortDesc: Immune to flinching and opposing Taunt.

bigpecks.name: Big Pecks
bigpecks.desc: Other Pokemon cannot lower its Defense.
bigpecks.shortDesc: Other Pokemon cannot lower its Defense.

blackfang.name: Black Fang
blackfang.desc: Biting moves have 1.5x power. Prevents and cures sleep. Gains +1 Attack for each Pokemon knocked out by its move.
blackfang.shortDesc: Bites have 1.5x power; Prevents and cures sleep; Move KOs give +1 Attack.

blackviper.name: Black Viper
blackviper.desc: Full local Whiplash and Shed Skin. Gains +1 accuracy on entry and 1.5x tail-move power; the first opposing HP-damaging tail hit each entry attempts bad poison. Shed Skin has one 50% end-turn activation chance when statused, afflicted, negatively boosted or at half HP or less: heals 1/4 max HP, cures status, removes its listed ailments and clears negative stages. Has its guaranteed Dragon’s Den behavior. Sirius executes its inherited Shed Skin only once.
blackviper.shortDesc: Entry gives +1 accuracy; 1.5x tail power; first tail hit each entry badly poisons.

blademastery.name: Blade Mastery
blademastery.desc: Full local Sharpness. At 1/4 max HP or less, slicing moves gain +1 priority. Once per genuine entry, the first directly selected damaging slicing attack that damages opposing HP attempts to lower that first damaged foe's Attack by 1 after the whole move if it survives. Ordinary stat-drop protections and reflections apply. Substitute-only, ally and generated attacks do not spend the use. The use is spent by a qualifying HP hit even if the target later faints or blocks the drop. Ability restarts do not reset it.
blademastery.shortDesc: Sharpness; low-HP slicing priority; first selected slicing HP hit each entry lowers foe Attack.

blastchamber.name: Volcanic Spirit
blastchamber.desc: Prevents and cures sleep and blocks Yawn. Fighting attacks use 1.3x Attack or Sp. Atk through full local Vital Spirit. Moves whose actual category is Special and primary type is Fire gain 1.3x power, using ordinary Sp. Atk and Sp. Def. Flame Body remains separate.
blastchamber.shortDesc: Vital Spirit; special Fire moves have 1.3x power.

blaze.name: Blaze
blaze.desc: When it has 1/3 or less of its max HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Fire-type attack.
blaze.shortDesc: At 1/3 or less of its max HP, its offensive stat is 1.5x with Fire attacks.

blazingmane.name: Blazing Mane
blazingmane.desc: Full local Fire Mane: damaging moves with effective Fire typing have 1.5x power, whether or not they receive STAB. At 1/4 max HP or less, damaging Fire moves gain +1 priority.
blazingmane.shortDesc: Fire Mane; damaging Fire moves gain +1 priority at 1/4 HP or less.

blazingtempo.name: Raging Flame
blazingtempo.desc: Gains +1 Speed after each full active turn. Prevents flinching and Intimidate Attack drops. Prevents freezing outside Cold Eclipse and cures freeze. Incoming Water and Ice attacks use half the offensive stat. Dragon Den blocks Fire moves; Dragon Den, Volcanic and Cold Eclipse entry give +1 Defense and Sp. Def.
blazingtempo.shortDesc: Speed Boost + Magma Armor + Inner Focus.

bloodchallenge.name: Blood Challenge
bloodchallenge.desc: Its first opposing direct hit each entry deals 25% less damage. Counter can retaliate against either physical or special attacks. Once per entry, Counter successfully dealing opposing damage heals it by 1/8 max HP.
bloodchallenge.shortDesc: First foe hit each entry: 25% less damage. Counter covers both categories; once/entry heals 1/8 HP.

bloodmoongaze.name: Bloodmoon Gaze
bloodmoongaze.desc: Infiltrator bypasses Substitute and opposing screens. Competitive grants +2 Sp. Atk when an opposing Pokemon lowers a stat; on Chessboard it instead scales move power up to 2x as HP falls.

bloodsickle.name: Blood Sickle
bloodsickle.desc: Full local Hyper Cutter. Slicing attacks heal 25% of actual opposing HP damage, capped at 1/8 max HP across the whole move and all targets. Native draining moves do not gain extra drain. Substitute-only, allied and delayed damage do not qualify. Normal healing modifiers, Heal Block and Liquid Ooze apply.
bloodsickle.shortDesc: Hyper Cutter; slicing hits drain 25%, capped at 1/8 HP per move.

bloomingsun.name: Blooming Sun
bloomingsun.desc: Has the full local effects of Mega Sol and Flower Veil, including their field interactions.

bogbody.name: Bog Body
bogbody.desc: Airborne: immune to Ground attacks, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web and Arena Trap unless grounded. Thousand Arrows can still hit. Absorbs Water moves for 1/4 max HP; incoming Fire moves have 1.25x power. Effective rain heals 1/8 HP per turn; sun costs 1/8. Field healing per turn: 1/16 on Underwater, Swamp, Misty or grounded Water Surface; 1/8 when grounded and Poison-type on Murkwater. Corrosive Mist heals Poison types by 1/8 but damages non-Steel others by 1/8. Desert costs 1/8 HP per turn. Incoming Fire and Ice attacks also use half the attacker's offensive stat.
bogbody.shortDesc: Rain/field healing; Fire/Ice protection with Dry Skin's Fire penalty.

bonewarrior.name: Bone Warrior
bonewarrior.desc: Battle Armor, including critical-hit immunity, 0.8x incoming attack damage and field effects. Once per turn after a bone-flag attack damages opposing HP, the living active holder restores 1/8 max HP after the whole attack. Normal healing restrictions apply.
bonewarrior.shortDesc: Battle Armor; bone attacks heal 1/8 max HP once per turn after opposing HP damage.

boretunnel.name: Bore Tunnel
boretunnel.desc: Absorbs other Pokemon's Ground moves, healing 1/4 max HP instead of being hit. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn on Cave and Desert. The first Ground-type move it absorbs each switch-in also removes Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, and G-Max Steelsurge from its own side.
boretunnel.shortDesc: First Ground absorption each switch-in clears own-side hazards.

bottomlessgullet.name: Bottomless Gullet
bottomlessgullet.desc: Gluttony and Cheek Pouch: qualifying pinch Berries activate at half HP, and eating a Berry heals 1/3 max HP under normal healing rules.

breakaway.name: Breakaway
breakaway.desc: Once per switch-in, surviving an opposing physical hit lowers Defense by 1 stage and raises Speed by 2 stages.
breakaway.shortDesc: Once per entry, surviving a physical hit gives -1 Defense and +2 Speed.

breakwater.name: Breakwater
breakwater.desc: Propeller Tail: moves cannot be redirected and Speed doubles on Water Surface, Underwater and Midnight Zone. Once per switch-in, a directly selected non-pivot physical Water move that deals opposing HP damage clears entry hazards from its side. Flip Turn, substitutes, misses, protection, called and future attacks do not trigger it. The allowance is spent only when hazards are cleared.
breakwater.shortDesc: Water-field Speed boost; first qualifying physical Water hit clears own hazards.

broodguard.name: Broodguard
broodguard.desc: Incoming Fire and Ice attacks use half the attacker's offensive stat. Immune to hail damage. Allies take 25% less attack damage; this does not protect the holder. Once per switch-in, when an adjacent ally survives an opposing hit that takes it from above half HP to half or less, it gains +1 Defense.
broodguard.shortDesc: An ally dropping below half HP grants +1 Defense.

bruteforce.name: Brute Force
bruteforce.desc: Recoil and crash moves, Explosion, Self-Destruct and Misty Explosion have 1.2x power; Struggle is excluded. On Chessboard, all moves gain a further 1.2x power. Prevents move recoil except Struggle. Crash and Life Orb damage still apply.

bulletproof.name: Bulletproof
bulletproof.desc: It is immune to bullet, pulse, and all Mega Launcher-boosted moves and takes 20% less damage from attacks.
bulletproof.shortDesc: Immune to bullet/pulse/Mega Launcher moves; takes 0.8x damage.

bullrush.name: Bull Rush
bullrush.desc: On its first active turn, its Speed is 1.5x and its Attack is 1.2x. On entry, lowers adjacent foes' Attack by 1. Substitute and Intimidate protections still apply.
bullrush.shortDesc: First active turn: 1.5x Spe and 1.2x Atk; Entry lowers adjacent foes' Attack by 1.

buriedcoil.name: Buried Coil
buriedcoil.desc: Sand Spit summons sandstorm when hit by an attack. Once per entry, successfully using Coil clears its confusion and negative accuracy stages, preserving positive accuracy.
buriedcoil.shortDesc: First successful Coil each entry clears confusion and negative accuracy.

buriedtrio.name: Buried Trio
buriedtrio.desc: Each genuine entry, the first opposing damaging move to hit it deals 30% less damage across all hits, including Substitute damage. Misses, protection and immunity do not spend the use. Ability restarts do not reset it.
buriedtrio.shortDesc: First opposing damaging move each entry deals 30% less damage across all hits.

burningcrown.name: Burning Crown
burningcrown.desc: On entry, lowers adjacent foes Attack by 1 under normal Intimidate rules. Unbound Blaze converts eligible Normal moves to Dragon with 1.2x power, or 1.5x on Dragon's Den and Fairy Tale, and grants Dragon STAB. Prevents freezing outside Cold Eclipse and cures freeze; incoming Water and Ice attacks use half the offensive stat. Dragon's Den blocks Fire moves. Dragon's Den, Volcanic and Cold Eclipse entry give +1 Defense and Sp. Def. At turn end, foes take Fire damage of 1/16 base max HP, doubled if burned or the holder used Fire/Dragon that turn. Fire immunities apply; effectiveness scales chip only in Free-for-All. Self-Sufficient heals 1/16 max HP each turn and prevents sandstorm/hail damage. Levitate grants normal airborne Ground and grounded-hazard protection. Has one 20% attack-damage reduction. New World, Cold Eclipse and Starlight Arena retain 1.5x move power.

burningego.name: Burning Ego
burningego.desc: Contact attackers have a 30% burn chance, or 60% on Volcanic. On Cold Eclipse, gains +1 Defense and Sp. Def on entry instead and cannot burn through contact. Prevents freezing outside Cold Eclipse and cures freeze. Incoming Water and Ice attacks use half the attacker's offensive stat. Dragon's Den blocks Fire moves. On Dragon's Den, Volcanic or Cold Eclipse entry, gains +1 Defense and Sp. Def. Moves ignore bypassable abilities. After dealing HP damage, heals 1/16 max HP once per turn. The first opposing HP hit gives +1 Attack and Sp. Atk and heals 1/16 max HP; later hits heal 1/20 until it completes a damaging move and resets this trigger. On Ashen Beach, New World, Starlight Arena, Cold Eclipse and Fairy Tale, the first qualifying physical and special hits also give +1 Defense and Sp. Def respectively. In those fields, a qualifying hit at half HP or less instead heals 1/4 max HP once per activation; blocked healing does not spend it. These effects stop on Bewitched Woods, Haunted and Holy Field. On Cold Eclipse, the two entry effects together give +2 Defense and Sp. Def. Against an opposing effective Ultra Instinct (including composites), its attacks ignore its own negative Attack and Sp. Atk stages. Ultra Instinct instead reduces its first HP-damaging move each turn by 40% and ignores positive Attack or Sp. Atk stages for that protected move. Stored stages are unchanged; normal +1 retaliation is unchanged. The rivalry is disabled on Bewitched Woods, Haunted and Holy.
burningego.shortDesc: Contact attackers have a 30% burn chance, or 60% on Volcanic.

burningquake.name: Burning Quake
burningquake.desc: Raises the critical-hit ratio by 1 stage. Once per turn, after a move finishes landing a critical hit that damages an opponent’s HP, raises the user’s Speed by 1 stage. Multi-hit and spread moves trigger once. Ally and Substitute-only damage do not qualify. The user must survive the move.
burningquake.shortDesc: +1 critical-hit ratio; once/turn after a damaging critical hit, +1 Speed.

burningrage.name: Burning Rage
burningrage.desc: Brute Force (Reckless + Rock Head), Iron Fist and Mold Breaker. Proficient: damaging same-type moves have 1.3x power. Brute Force: recoil and crash moves, Explosion, Self-Destruct and Misty Explosion have 1.2x power; Struggle is excluded. On Chessboard, all moves gain a further 1.2x power. Prevents move recoil except Struggle; crash and Life Orb damage still apply. Iron Fist: punching moves have 1.4x power. Mold Breaker: moves ignore bypassable opposing abilities.
burningrage.shortDesc: Brute Force (Reckless + Rock Head), Iron Fist, Mold Breaker and Proficient.

burningspirit.name: Burning Spirit
burningspirit.desc: Mold Breaker + Inner Focus. Attacks have 1.3x power against an opposing target still queued to move or that switched in this turn, except a target with Battle Bond. The first opposing HP-damaging move each turn deals 30% less damage across all hits. Substitute-only damage preserves the allowance. After a whole attack deals opposing HP damage, heals 1/16 max HP once per turn while alive; healing restrictions apply. Multi-hit and spread moves heal only once; a failed heal cannot retry within the same move. On Ashen Beach, New World, Starlight Arena and Cold Eclipse: 35% reduction and 1/8 healing. The turn allowance persists through switches, form/ability changes and Transform. Bewitched Woods, Haunted and Holy disable Ultra Instinct's effects. Against Ultra Ego or its composites, the protected move deals 40% less damage and ignores positive offensive stages. Ultra Ego ignores its own negative Attack or Sp. Atk stages when attacking Ultra Instinct. Has the Predator interaction. Burning Spirit also has full local Magma Armor: Water and Ice attacks use half attacking stats; Dragon's Den blocks Fire moves; prevents freeze outside Cold Eclipse and cures freeze; Dragon's Den, Volcanic and Cold Eclipse entry grant +1 Defense and Sp. Def. Opportunist copies foes' positive Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def and Speed changes at the normal move, entry, transformation and residual flushes; it does not copy accuracy or evasion. Copied boosts cannot loop, and each queued gain is applied once.
burningspirit.shortDesc: Ultra Instinct + Opportunist (five combat stats only) + Magma Armor.

burrowambush.name: Burrow Ambush
burrowambush.desc: Earth Eater. A direct opposing attack KO arms a retreat. Once a living opposing replacement has completed entry effects and any entry faint chain, the user must choose a legal benched replacement. One retreat per KO batch. No retreat after a battle-winning KO, without a legal bench, or from ally, indirect, delayed, recoil, hazard or Destiny Bond KOs. Fainting, departure, ability loss or suppression cancels the pending retreat. Other pending switches are preserved.
burrowambush.shortDesc: Earth Eater; after a direct foe KO, retreats once the replacement settles.

byxbysiontouch.name: Byxbysion Touch
byxbysiontouch.desc: Its Poison-type damaging moves restore 1/4 of the damage dealt. Ground-type moves deal 1/2 damage to it.
byxbysiontouch.shortDesc: Poison moves drain 1/4 damage; takes half Ground damage.

cactuschorus.name: Cactus Chorus
cactuschorus.desc: Absorbs Water moves for 1/4 max HP and has Water Absorb's field healing. Doubles Speed in sandstorm, Desert and Ashen Beach; prevents sandstorm damage.

calculatedshot.name: Calculated Shot
calculatedshot.desc: Damaging Water moves gain +1 critical-hit stage and always use the highest normal damage roll. Does not increase fixed damage or bypass accuracy checks. Frisk reveals opposing Illusions (including itemless foes), reveals held items and independently has a 30% chance to Embargo each opposing item holder for 5 turns.
calculatedshot.shortDesc: Water attacks gain +1 critical-hit stage and the highest normal damage roll.

calculatedtrajectory.name: Calculated Trajectory
calculatedtrajectory.desc: On genuine entry, uses ordinary Kinesis against the living opposing slot, with a deterministic living active fallback. A successful Kinesis accuracy drop advances this holder's ordinary pending Future Sight in that slot by one turn, once per scheduled attack and no earlier than the current turn's residual. Grandmaster and Perfect Foresight queues are excluded. Normal protection, reflection and field effects apply; ability restarts do not trigger entry.
calculatedtrajectory.shortDesc: Entry Kinesis; successful accuracy drop advances own ordinary Future Sight once.

calderacore.name: Caldera Core
calderacore.desc: Drought and Magma Armor. On entry, summons sun for 5 turns, or 8 with Heat Rock. Prevents freezing outside Cold Eclipse and cures freeze. Incoming Water and Ice attacks use half the attacker's offensive stat. Dragon's Den blocks Fire moves. On Dragon's Den, Volcanic or Cold Eclipse entry, gains +1 Defense and Sp. Def.

canopyarcher.name: Canopy Archer
canopyarcher.desc: Flying STAB and resistances to Bug, Fighting and Grass. Classified arrow moves bypass accuracy/evasion checks. Scrappy lets Normal/Fighting moves hit Ghost types and prevents Intimidate Attack drops. Long Reach removes contact. Protection and other immunities apply.
canopyarcher.shortDesc: Flying STAB/resistances; classified arrow moves never miss.

carrionwatch.name: Carrion Watch
carrionwatch.desc: Full local Frisk + Overcoat. Entry reveals opposing active Illusions and held items, with each item holder independently having a 30% chance of five-turn Embargo. Overcoat prevents powder moves, Rage Powder redirection, Effect Spore, sandstorm damage and hail damage, with its normal ability suppression, bypass and native-passive overlap rules.
carrionwatch.shortDesc: Frisk + Overcoat, including their full local entry and protection effects.

carryon.name: Carry On
carryon.desc: Inner Focus + Healer. Once per battle, adds a fainted ally’s eligible selected ability alongside its own effects; keeps that inheritance across switches while Carry On is selected.
carryon.shortDesc: Inner Focus + Healer; once per battle adds an ally’s ability.

causticchamber.name: Caustic Chamber
causticchamber.desc: Own Tempo prevents and cures confusion and blocks Intimidate Attack drops. Shell Side Arm ignores positive Defense or Sp. Def stages for damage, while retaining its normal Physical/Special selection, negative stages and all other effects.
causticchamber.shortDesc: Shell Side Arm ignores positive defensive stages without changing its category selection.

causticooze.name: Caustic Ooze
causticooze.desc: Liquid Ooze reverses healing from draining moves, Leech Seed and Strength Sap, including doubled damage on Murkwater Surface and Wasteland. Poison attacks have 1.3x power.
causticooze.shortDesc: Liquid Ooze; Poison attacks have 1.3x power.

causticscales.name: Caustic Scales
causticscales.desc: Once per actual switch-in, the first opposing contact attack to damage this Pokemon's HP attempts to poison the attacker and lowers that same attacker's Special Defense by 1 stage. Poison immunity does not prevent the stat drop; stat-drop prevention does not prevent the poison attempt. Normal status immunity, contact protection, stat-drop prevention, reflection and reactions apply. Substitute-only hits, allied hits and noncontact attacks do not spend the effect. Suppression disables it without renewing a spent trigger; losing and reacquiring the ability during the same entry does not renew it. Switching out and back in renews the trigger.
causticscales.shortDesc: Once per entry, first opposing contact HP hit poisons attacker and lowers Sp. Def.

caverndrake.name: Cavern Drake
caverndrake.desc: Absorbs other Pokemon's Ground moves, healing 1/4 max HP instead of being hit. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn on Cave and Desert. Takes 20% less attack damage, or 40% less from super-effective attacks.

celestialheart.name: Celestial Heart
celestialheart.desc: Gains +1 Sp. Atk when any Pokemon faints, plus +2 Sp. Def on Misty or Rainbow Field. Allies take 25% less attack damage; this does not protect the holder.

cellularconcord.name: Cellular Concord
cellularconcord.desc: Cures major status on switching out and, when curing status, heals 1/8 base max HP unless Withering Shell applies. Cures status at turn end on Bewitched Woods. Moves gain the local Analytic power boost when no other active Pokemon has a move remaining in the action queue.

championscommand.name: Champion's Command
championscommand.desc: Ordinary Hyper Beam remains Normal, uses Attack against Defense and receives ordinary STAB without stacking with Normal typing. Deals 25% damage through ordinary Protect without removing it; Max Guard blocks. Only a direct opposing KO skips recharge.
championscommand.shortDesc: Physical STAB Hyper Beam; 25% through Protect; direct opposing KO skips recharge.

championspoise.name: Champion's Poise
championspoise.desc: Once per battle, the first opposing damaging Ice-type move to damage its HP deals half damage for its entire use, including all hits. Misses, protection, immunity and Substitute-only damage do not consume it. Once per genuine entry, Swords Dance that actually raises a stat heals 1/8 max HP under normal healing rules. Switching resets only the healing allowance; restarting the selected ability does not reset either allowance.
championspoise.shortDesc: First opposing Ice attack: half damage for all hits. Once/entry Swords Dance heals 1/8.

chargedtail.name: Charged Tail
chargedtail.desc: Successfully paralyzing a Pokemon with its own Nuzzle grants normal Charge after Nuzzle finishes, doubling its next Electric attack. Charge does not stack; failed paralysis grants nothing.
chargedtail.shortDesc: Successful Nuzzle paralysis grants Charge for the next Electric attack.

cheekpouch.name: Cheek Pouch
cheekpouch.desc: If it eats a held Berry, it restores 1/3 of its max HP, rounded down, in addition to the Berry's effect. This effect can also activate after the effects of Bug Bite, Fling, Pluck, Stuff Cheeks, and Teatime if the eaten Berry had an effect on it.
cheekpouch.shortDesc: If it eats a Berry, it restores 1/3 of its max HP after the Berry's effect.

chillingneigh.name: Chilling Neigh
chillingneigh.desc: Its Attack is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and knocks out another Pokemon.
chillingneigh.shortDesc: Its Attack is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and KOes another Pokemon.

chlorophyll.name: Chlorophyll
chlorophyll.desc: Doubles Speed in sun or Stage 4 Flower Garden.
chlorophyll.shortDesc: Double Speed in sun or Stage 4 Flower Garden.

cinderscales.name: Cinder Scales
cinderscales.desc: Flame Body and Swarm, including their field effects. Prevents externally inflicted accuracy-stage drops; self-inflicted accuracy costs still apply.
cinderscales.shortDesc: Flame Body and Swarm, including their field effects.

clearbody.name: Clear Body
clearbody.shortDesc: Other Pokemon cannot lower its stats.

climatereserve.name: Climate Reserve
climatereserve.desc: On genuine entry, an active Heat Rock, Damp Rock, Smooth Rock or Icy Rock sets sun, rain, sandstorm or hail for exactly 5 turns; rocks do not extend this weather. Forecast still follows effective external weather. Without effective weather, the current active rock gives Sunny, Rainy, Sandy or Snowy form; no rock gives Normal form. Item loss, replacement or suppression updates this default. Ability suppression disables the default and entry weather, but not the Forecast passive. Ability restarts do not set weather. Grants no Perfect Forecast bonuses or Sp. Def boost.
climatereserve.shortDesc: Held weather rock sets 5-turn weather on entry; sets default form when weather is ineffective.

closedcircuit.name: Closed Circuit
closedcircuit.desc: Clear Body prevents other Pokemon from lowering its stat stages. If both Gear Grind hits damage the target, heals 1/16 max HP after the move, once per use. No healing if either hit misses, is blocked, hits only Substitute, or the first hit ends the attack. Normal healing restrictions apply.
closedcircuit.shortDesc: Heals 1/16 HP after Gear Grind if both hits damage the target.

cloudnine.name: Cloud Nine
cloudnine.desc: Suppresses weather effects while active. On Rainbow Field, gains one random non-maxed stat stage other than evasion each turn.
cloudnine.shortDesc: Suppresses weather; Rainbow gives a random stat boost each turn.

coldexpertise.name: Cold Expertise
coldexpertise.desc: Full local Oblivious and Thick Fat: prevents and cures attraction and Taunt, blocks Captivate and Intimidate's Attack drop. Fire and Ice attacks use half the attacker's offensive stat; immune to hail damage. Mamoswine's passive.

coldlogic.name: Cold Logic
coldlogic.desc: Forewarn reveals a strongest opposing move and removes foe Illusions on entry. Takes 20% less move damage, or 25% less from the revealed move until switching out; these reductions do not stack, and OHKO moves are excluded from learned-move protection. A successful reveal on Psychic Terrain grants +2 Sp. Atk. Opponents cannot lower its accuracy stages. An opposing move that knocks it out triggers Aftermath even without contact: the attacker loses 1/4 max HP, or 1/2 on Corrosive Mist. Damp prevents this, and indirect-damage protection applies. Its Forewarn component: Checks each active opponent separately when the holder enters, and rechecks each incoming opponent on every switch-in, including repeat entries. Allies are not checked, and initial checks do not trigger twice. Each check retains its usual Psychic Terrain bonus condition and latest-warned-move protection.
coldlogic.shortDesc: Forewarn + Aftermath; opposing accuracy-drop immunity; noncontact KO retaliation.

coldopen.name: Cold Open
coldopen.desc: Its first successful damaging move each genuine entry ignores positive defensive stat stages and screens. All hits of that move benefit. Misses and Protect preserve the effect; it does not bypass Substitute. Ability changes or restarts do not refresh the spent entry budget.
coldopen.shortDesc: First successful damaging move each entry ignores boosted defenses and screens.

colorchange.name: Color Change
colorchange.desc: Its type changes to match the type of the last move that hit it, unless that type is already one of its types. This effect applies after all hits from a multi-hit move. This effect is prevented if the move had a secondary effect removed by the Sheer Force Ability.
colorchange.shortDesc: Its type changes to the type of a move it's hit by, unless it has the type.

colossalframe.name: Colossal Frame
colossalframe.desc: Damage from physical attacks is multiplied by 0.75.
colossalframe.shortDesc: Takes 25% less damage from physical attacks.

comatose.name: Comatose
comatose.desc: It is considered to be asleep and cannot become affected by a non-volatile status condition or Yawn.
comatose.shortDesc: It cannot be statused, and is considered to be asleep.

cometheart.name: Comet Heart
cometheart.desc: Levitate. Its Doom Desire has 1.5x power.

comfortingpresence.name: Comforting Presence
comfortingpresence.desc: After a successful status move targeting another ally, restores 1/16 of that ally's max HP, once per turn. Failed moves and self-targeting do not qualify. Full-HP or blocked healing does not spend the turn's use.
comfortingpresence.shortDesc: Successful status moves targeting an ally heal it by 1/16 max HP, once per turn.

commander.name: Commander
commander.desc: If it is a Tatsugiri and a Dondozo is an active ally, it goes into the Dondozo's mouth. The Dondozo has its Attack, Special Attack, Speed, Defense, and Special Defense raised by 2 stages. During the effect, the Dondozo cannot be switched out, it cannot select an action, and attacks targeted at it will be avoided but it will still take indirect damage. If it faints during the effect, a Pokemon can be switched in as a replacement but the Dondozo remains unable to be switched out. If the Dondozo faints during the effect, it regains the ability to select an action.
commander.shortDesc: If ally is Dondozo: it cannot act or be hit, +2 to all Dondozo's stats.

competitive.name: Competitive
competitive.desc: Foe stat drops give +2 Sp. Atk, except on Chessboard. On Chessboard, move power instead rises with missing HP, from 1x at full HP to 2x at 20% HP or less.
competitive.shortDesc: Foe stat drops give +2 Sp. Atk; Chessboard boosts power instead.

completeparasitism.name: Complete Parasitism
completeparasitism.desc: While above half HP, weaknesses are neutralized, indirect damage is blocked and opposing status moves fail. Has its lethal-hit fake faint and full-HP Parasect-Parasite revival, including the separate Mega revival allowance. Cannot be suppressed and remains immune to Neutralization. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn and ignores sandstorm/hail. Switching cures major status and heals 1/8 max HP only when curing status; Bewitched Woods has its end-turn cure without that extra heal.
completeparasitism.shortDesc: Above half HP: neutralizes weaknesses, blocks indirect damage and opposing status moves.

compoundeyes.name: Compound Eyes
compoundeyes.desc: Moves have 1.3x accuracy. Mirror Arena entry gives +1 accuracy and Laser Focus.
compoundeyes.shortDesc: 1.3x accuracy; Mirror Arena entry grants accuracy/Laser Focus.

conductivity.name: Conductivity
conductivity.desc: Its Electric-type moves hit Steel-type Pokemon super effectively.
conductivity.shortDesc: Electric moves hit Steel types super effectively.

conquerorswill.name: Conqueror's Will
conquerorswill.desc: Unnerve prevents opposing Pokemon from eating Berries or using field Seeds. On Cold Eclipse entry, lowers each foe's Speed one stage unless behind Substitute. Kowtow Cleave removes opposing Reflect, Light Screen and Aurora Veil before damage, even through Substitute; protection, a miss or immunity prevents removal. Suppression disables these active effects.

constrictingcoils.name: Constricting Coils
constrictingcoils.desc: After an attack deals opposing HP damage, applies ordinary Wrap binding once to each surviving opponent. Existing binding is not refreshed. Incoming attacks from bound foes deal 0.8x damage. Heals actual residual binding HP damage caused by this living active holder; Heal Block and Liquid Ooze apply.
constrictingcoils.shortDesc: Attacks bind foes; bound foes deal 0.8x damage; drains own binding damage.

constrictingheat.name: Constricting Heat
constrictingheat.desc: White Smoke prevents other Pokemon from lowering its stats and grants +1 Attack and Sp. Atk on Volcanic entry. Fire Lash damage partially traps a surviving foe as Fire Spin for this turn end and the next. Only one ability trap per holder; a new trapped foe releases the previous one. No stacking with partial traps. Traps end when the holder leaves, loses the ability or Dynamaxes/Gigantamaxes. Normal escape, protection and residual-damage rules apply.
constrictingheat.shortDesc: Damaging Fire Lash binds one foe for two turns. Switching or Dynamax/Gigantamax ends it.

continentalpull.name: Continental Pull
continentalpull.desc: After its damaging contact move, lowers the Speed of each opponent whose HP it damaged by one stage, at most once per target per turn. Multihit moves cause only one drop. Misses, protection, immunity and Substitute-only hits do not qualify.
continentalpull.shortDesc: Its contact attacks lower damaged foes' Speed by 1, once per target each turn.

contrary.name: Contrary
contrary.desc: Reverses received stat-stage changes, except Z-Power changes.

controlledfury.name: Controlled Fury
controlledfury.desc: Full local Anger Point: the first damaging hit after entry raises Attack by 1 stage; surviving a critical hit raises Attack to maximum. Outrage, Thrash, Petal Dance and Raging Fury do not lock the user in or cause ending confusion, including repeated manual uses. Acquiring this effect during a rampage clears only that rampage lock without confusion. Existing confusion, Choice locks, Encore and move field effects remain unchanged.
controlledfury.shortDesc: Anger Point; no rampage lock or ending confusion.

corneredfang.name: Cornered Fang
corneredfang.desc: Attack is 1.5x while statused, and burn does not weaken physical attacks. Once per switch-in, the first biting move selected while at half HP or less has +1 priority. Using that move spends the priority effect even if it misses or is blocked.
corneredfang.shortDesc: At half HP, the first biting move each entry gains +1 priority.

coronafurnace.name: Corona Furnace
coronafurnace.desc: Full local Flame Body: eligible contact attackers have a 30% burn chance, or 60% on Volcanic Field. On Cold Eclipse, ability activation instead grants +1 Defense and Sp. Def and contact burns are disabled. Damaging moves with effective Fire typing ignore only positive defensive stages. Negative stages, screens, type effectiveness and defensive abilities still apply.
coronafurnace.shortDesc: Flame Body; damaging Fire moves ignore positive defensive stages.

corrosion.name: Corrosion
corrosion.desc: Can poison Poison and Steel types; Poison moves bypass Steel immunity. Newly poisoned foes lose 1 Defense and Sp. Def. On Wasteland, move secondary effects become separate 2.5% frostbite, burn, paralysis and poison chances. On Corrosive and Corrosive Mist, incoming damage is multiplied by 1.5.
corrosion.shortDesc: Poison bypasses type immunity; poisoned foes lose defenses.

corrosiveburn.name: Corrosive Burn
corrosiveburn.desc: Corrosion allows poisoning Poison/Steel types and Poison attacks to hit Steel; newly poisoned foes lose 1 Defense and Sp. Def stage, with field effects retained. Oblivious blocks and cures attraction/Taunt, blocks Captivate and prevents Intimidate. Fire damaging attacks deal 1.2x damage if the target is poisoned or badly poisoned when damage is calculated, once per hit.

corrosivetouch.name: Corrosive Touch
corrosivetouch.desc: Contact hits have a 30% chance to poison the target. Shield Dust and Covert Cloak block this effect. Grass attacks receive a 1.5x same-type attack bonus.

costar.name: Costar
costar.desc: On switch-in, it copies all of its ally's stat stage changes.
costar.shortDesc: On switch-in, it copies all of its ally's stat stage changes.

cottondown.name: Cotton Down
cottondown.desc: When it is hit by an attack, the Speed of all other Pokemon on the field is lowered by 1 stage.
cottondown.shortDesc: If it is hit, it lowers the Speed of all other Pokemon on the field 1 stage.

cradleward.name: Cradle Ward
cradleward.desc: Sweet Veil prevents sleep and Yawn for itself and allies, including Rest, without curing sleep. Successfully setting Trick Room also sets normal five-turn Safeguard on its own side. Turning Trick Room off does not count.
cradleward.shortDesc: Setting Trick Room also sets five-turn Safeguard on its side.

creepingbloom.name: Creeping Bloom
creepingbloom.desc: Infiltrator: moves bypass Substitute, Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil, Safeguard and Mist. Once per entry, the first Poison attack to damage a foe also attempts regular poison on each opposing target damaged by that same move, once per target. Damage spends the charge even if poison is blocked or the foe already has status; misses, protection and damage immunity do not. Bonus ability poison respects normal poison immunities, Safeguard and status protection. Allies are never poisoned by this bonus, and normal move secondaries are unchanged.
creepingbloom.shortDesc: First Poison attack to damage a foe each entry also attempts poison on all foes it damages.

crescentrend.name: Crescent Rend
crescentrend.desc: Damaging Flying attacks, including Aerilate conversions, ignore Reflect, Light Screen and Aurora Veil damage reduction and make no contact. When a hit breaks a Substitute, damage exceeding its remaining HP carries into the target as part of the same hit. Damage is calculated once; secondary effects and hit reactions occur once. Subsequent multihits continue normally. Protect, immunities, survival effects, recoil and drain still apply.
crescentrend.shortDesc: Flying attacks: no contact, ignore screens; excess Substitute damage reaches its owner.

crosscurrent.name: Crosscurrent
crosscurrent.desc: Doubles Speed in rain or on Water Surface, Murkwater Surface, Underwater and Midnight Zone. After it damages a foe, its next damaging move has 1.3x power if it uses the opposite category, Physical or Special. Misses and status moves do not change the last landed category. This bonus does not stack with itself.
crosscurrent.shortDesc: Alternating damaging physical and special attacks gain 1.3x power.

crossfire.name: Crossfire
crossfire.desc: Damaging an opponent's HP with a Grass attack primes Fire, and a Fire attack primes Grass. The next damaging attack of the primed type has 1.2x power across all hits and targets, spending the charge even if it misses or is blocked. Repeating the same type keeps the opposite type primed. Status moves and Substitute-only hits do not prime a head; switching clears the charge.
crossfire.shortDesc: Grass hits prime Fire; Fire hits prime Grass. Primed attacks have 1.2x power.

crosswire.name: Crosswire
crosswire.desc: Punching moves have 1.4x power. Prevents flinching and Intimidate Attack drops.

cruelshell.name: Cruel Shell
cruelshell.desc: Full local Shell Armor: prevents critical hits and takes 20% less attack damage. Gains +1 Defense on Fairy Tale or Dragon's Den entry and +2 Sp. Def when a foe lowers its stats.
cruelshell.shortDesc: Prevents critical hits; takes 20% less attack damage. Field effects vary.

crueltag.name: Cruel Tag
crueltag.desc: Prevents opposing Pokemon from choosing to switch out, unless they are holding a Shed Shell, are a Ghost type, or also have this Ability. It takes 0.8x damage from attacks. On Haunted Field, it reveals foes' held items on entry. This Ability cannot be suppressed. Moves bypass Substitute, Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil, Safeguard and Mist. Sleeping foes, including Comatose users, lose 1/8 max HP each turn. Disabled on Rainbow Field.
crueltag.shortDesc: Traps foes; 20% less damage; Infiltrator + Bad Dreams. Cannot be suppressed.

crumblingshell.name: Crumbling Shell
crumblingshell.desc: When it is hit by a Physical attack, Stealth Rock is set on the attacker's side unless a water field is active or that side already has Stealth Rock.
crumblingshell.shortDesc: Physical hits set Stealth Rock, except in water fields.

crushingdepths.name: Crushing Depths
crushingdepths.desc: Once per turn after a whole physical Water attack damages an opposing Pokemon's HP, lowers one surviving active target's Defense by 1. Normal stat-drop prevention and reflection apply. Physical Steel attacks deal 1.3x damage to targets whose Defense stage is already negative. Multi-hit and spread attacks do not repeat the Defense drop. Substitute-only damage, protection, misses and immunities do not qualify.
crushingdepths.shortDesc: Physical Water HP hits lower Defense once per turn; Steel hits exploit lowered Defense.

crushingvenom.name: Crushing Venom
crushingvenom.desc: Strong Jaw gives biting moves 1.5x power. Once per entry, its first damaging bite against a foe applies two-turn Heal Block after HP damage. A hit absorbed by Substitute spends the use without affecting its holder; misses, protection and immunity do not spend it.
crushingvenom.shortDesc: First damaging bite each entry applies two-turn Heal Block after damage.

crystalbastion.name: Crystal Bastion
crystalbastion.desc: Sturdy. Once per entry, its own Wide Guard actually blocking an opposing damaging attack clears only its negative Defense and Sp. Def stages. Positive stages remain.
crystalbastion.shortDesc: First own Wide Guard block each entry clears negative Defense and Sp. Def.

crystalfocus.name: Crystal Focus
crystalfocus.desc: Its Dragon attacks ignore the target's positive Defense or Sp. Def stages and Reflect, Light Screen and Aurora Veil.
crystalfocus.shortDesc: Dragon attacks ignore positive defensive stages and screens.

crystalresonance.name: Crystal Resonance
crystalresonance.desc: Contact attackers have a 30% chance of frostbite. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn in hail or snow, or on Icy, Snowy Mountain and Cold Eclipse without those weathers; hail on Cold Eclipse heals 1/8 instead. Immune to hail damage. Eligible Normal moves become Ice and have 1.2x power, or 1.5x on Icy and Snowy Mountain. Excludes moves whose type is set by their own effect, damaging Z-Moves and Terastallized Tera Blast. Moves cannot miss. Adds Ice typing in hail or snow and on Icy, Snowy Mountain and Cold Eclipse. Reflects eligible status moves and entry hazards once; reflected moves cannot bounce again. Fairy Tale entry gives +1 Sp. Def; Mirror Arena entry gives +1 evasion. On Mirror Arena, reflecting a directly targeted move also gives its original user +1 evasion.
crystalresonance.shortDesc: Stronger Ice moves; Ice healing/protection; reflects status moves.

crystalward.name: Crystal Ward
crystalward.desc: Blocks opposing ball/bomb moves targeting it or adjacent active allies. Allied Pollen Puff still works. Protection ends if it leaves, faints or is suppressed; Mold Breaker and Ability Shield apply normally.
crystalward.shortDesc: Blocks opposing ball/bomb moves for itself and adjacent allies.

cudchew.name: Cud Chew
cudchew.desc: After eating a Berry, repeats the last eligible Berry once at the end of the next turn. A successful delayed Eat event grants a nonstacking guard that reduces damage to its HP by 25% from the next damaging move that hits it, including all hits of that move. Successful reconsumption grants the guard even if the Berry gives no benefit; a rejected Eat event does not. Protect, misses, immunities, Substitute-only hits, status moves and indirect damage do not spend the guard. Suppression pauses the repeat and guard; switching or losing the ability clears them. Bug Bite and Pluck do not schedule a repeat.
cudchew.shortDesc: Repeats a Berry next turn, then guards the next damaging move by 25%.

curiousmedicine.name: Curious Medicine
curiousmedicine.desc: On entry, clears negative stat stages and confusion from the holder and active allies, keeping positive stages. Each Pokemon actually cleansed recovers 1/8 max HP, subject to normal healing restrictions. Does not affect the bench.
curiousmedicine.shortDesc: On entry, clears self/allies' negative stages and confusion; each cleansed Pokemon heals 1/8 HP.

currentcoil.name: Current Coil
currentcoil.desc: Swift Swim, including this server's eligible water fields. Coil additionally raises Sp. Atk by 1 stage, preserving its other boosts.

cursedarmament.name: Cursed Armament
cursedarmament.desc: Own non-fixed, non-delayed Ghost and Steel attacks gain 20% power, retaining their physical or special category. Once per turn after a whole attack damages a surviving active foe, steal up to 2 PP from its queued move; a newly entered foe without a queued move instead loses up to 2 PP from one random damaging move. Stealing PP stores one charge. The next eligible attack consumes it on attempt, including a miss, protection or immunity, and gains 40% power instead of 20%. A successful charged attack steals up to 3 PP from the last attempted current move, or the queued move if none was used, plus 1 PP from every other current move. Newly entered foes always use one random damaging move as the charged primary, even with earlier move history. Charged attacks cannot recharge themselves. Both drains share one use per turn and affect one surviving foe; Substitute-only damage and KOs do not qualify. Switching, fainting, suppression or losing the ability clears the charge. Curse has its ordinary local behavior and HP cost.
cursedarmament.shortDesc: Ghost/Steel attacks gain 20% power; stolen PP charges a 40% attack.

cursedbody.name: Cursed Body
cursedbody.desc: Damaging attacks have a 30% chance to be disabled, guaranteed on Haunted and disabled on Holy Field. Excludes Max moves, delayed attacks and Struggle. On fainting, curses all active foes.
cursedbody.shortDesc: 30% chance to disable attacks; curses foes on faint.

curseddoll.name: Cursed Doll
curseddoll.desc: Tough Claws gives contact moves 1.3x power. Local Shadow Shield reduces attack damage to 0.8x at any HP, or 0.6x total for super-effective attacks; ability-ignoring moves cannot bypass it, but suppression disables it. Immune to hail on Cold Eclipse. On fainting, creates Haunted Field for 5 turns. Damaging attacks do not automatically curse foes.
curseddoll.shortDesc: Contact power 1.3x; incoming damage 0.8x, or 0.6x if super effective.

cursedkeepsake.name: Cursed Keepsake
cursedkeepsake.desc: When it is hit by an opposing damaging move, the attacker becomes cursed. Cursed Pokemon deal 0.5x damage to it. It restores HP equal to 1/2 of Curse damage it caused. When it faints, opposing Pokemon become cursed and it creates Haunted Field for 5 turns, ignoring Neutralization.
cursedkeepsake.shortDesc: Curses attackers; cursed foes deal 0.5x; heals 1/2 Curse damage.

cursedmarionette.name: Cursed Marionette
cursedmarionette.desc: Its attacks and status moves curse opposing targets, and being hit curses the attacker. Cursed foes deal 0.8x damage to it. Its Curse deals 1/8 max HP. When it faints, opposing Pokemon become cursed and it creates Haunted Field for 5 turns, ignoring Neutralization. Ordinary Ghost Curse costs 1/3 max HP; ability-applied curses do not pay this cost.
cursedmarionette.shortDesc: Curses foes; cursed foes deal 20% less damage.

curtaincall.name: Curtain Call
curtaincall.desc: Ice Body and Filter. Ice Body has 30% contact frostbite, hail immunity, 1/16 recovery in hail/snow or qualifying cold fields and 1/8 in hail on Cold Eclipse. Filter multiplies non-super-effective attack damage by 0.8 and super-effective attack damage by 0.6; does not permanently change raw defenses.

cushionchorus.name: Cushion Chorus
cushionchorus.desc: Friend Guard + Aroma Veil: allies take 25% less attack damage; protects the holder and allies from mental effects.

cutecharm.name: Cute Charm
cutecharm.desc: There is a 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with it will become infatuated if it is of the opposite gender.
cutecharm.shortDesc: 30% chance of infatuating Pokemon of the opposite gender if they make contact.

damp.name: Damp
damp.desc: Prevents Explosion, Self-Destruct, Mind Blown, Misty Explosion and Aftermath damage. Incoming Fire attacks use half the attacker's offensive stat. On Corrosive Mist, also prevents Eruption, Fire Pledge, Flame Burst, Heat Wave, Incinerate, Lava Plume, Searing Shot and Inferno Overdrive.
damp.shortDesc: Blocks explosions/Aftermath; halves incoming Fire attacking stats.

dancer.name: Dancer
dancer.desc: After another Pokemon uses a dance move, it uses the same move. The copied move is subject to all effects that can prevent a move from being executed. A move used through this Ability cannot be copied again by other Pokemon with this Ability.
dancer.shortDesc: After another Pokemon uses a dance move, it uses the same move.

darkaura.name: Dark Aura
darkaura.desc: All damaging Dark moves have 4/3x power, or 0.75x with Aura Break. Multiple users do not stack. Immune to hail damage on Cold Eclipse.
darkaura.shortDesc: Boosts everyone's Dark moves; Aura Break reverses it.

darkdominion.name: Dark Dominion
darkdominion.desc: All damaging Dark moves have 4/3x power, or 0.75x with Aura Break. Multiple users do not stack. Immune to hail damage on Cold Eclipse. Damaging Dark hits inflict Heal Block on surviving foes for 2 turns, including the current turn. Respects protection and Substitute; does not shorten a longer Heal Block.
darkdominion.shortDesc: Dark hits Heal Block surviving foes for 2 turns.

dauntlessshield.name: Dauntless Shield
dauntlessshield.desc: On switch-in, its Defense is raised by 1 stage. Once per battle.
dauntlessshield.shortDesc: On switch-in, its Defense is raised by 1 stage. Once per battle.

dawnherald.name: Dawn Herald
dawnherald.desc: On entry, summons sun for 5 turns, or 8 with Heat Rock. Allies take 25% less attack damage; the holder does not. Normal weather blocking, ability suppression and bypass rules apply.
dawnherald.shortDesc: Summons sun; allies take 25% less attack damage.

dazzling.name: Dazzling
dazzling.desc: Priority moves used by opposing Pokemon targeting it or its allies are prevented from having an effect.
dazzling.shortDesc: It and its allies are protected from opposing priority moves.

deadwater.name: Deadwater
deadwater.desc: Foes receive half their normal passive end-of-turn healing. Absorbs the HP actually prevented, capped at 1/8 of its max HP per turn. Excludes healing moves, Wish, draining, Leech Seed and switching recovery. Multiple Deadwater holders do not stack.
deadwater.shortDesc: Halves foes' passive end-turn healing and absorbs up to 1/8 HP per turn.

decoypincers.name: Decoy Pincers
decoypincers.desc: Once per switch-in, the first opposing direct hit deals 25% less damage and lowers the attacker's Attack by 1 stage. Multi-hit moves spend this protection on the first hit.
decoypincers.shortDesc: First direct hit each entry deals 25% less and lowers the attacker's Attack.

deepbore.name: Deep Bore
deepbore.desc: Full Mold Breaker and Power Drill. Moves ignore bypassable opposing abilities. Drill and horn moves have 1.5x power, or 2x on Rocky, Mountain, Snowy Mountain, Cave and Volcanic, where they bypass protection at full damage. Once per entry, after a directly selected drill or horn move damages an opponent's HP and the holder survives, clears its side's entry hazards and its own Leech Seed and binding. Only spends the use when something is removed.
deepbore.shortDesc: Once per entry, a selected drill/horn HP hit clears own hazards, seed and binding.

deepchill.name: Deep Chill
deepchill.desc: Oblivious + Intimidate. After surviving a whole opposing damaging move that deals HP damage, lowers the attacker’s Speed by 1 once per turn.
deepchill.shortDesc: Oblivious + Intimidate; surviving a hit lowers attacker Speed once/turn.

deepresonance.name: Deep Resonance
deepresonance.desc: Soundproof. Psychic Noise that damages a surviving foe also lowers that foe's Attack by one stage, once per target per move. Normal stat-drop protection applies; Psychic Noise has its effects.
deepresonance.shortDesc: Psychic Noise damage lowers surviving foes' Attack once per target per move.

defeatist.name: Defeatist
defeatist.desc: While it has 1/4 or less of its max HP, its Attack and Special Attack are halved. It also has Relic Armor's effect.
defeatist.shortDesc: At 1/4 HP or less, Atk/SpA are halved; also has Relic Armor.

defiant.name: Defiant
defiant.desc: Gains +2 Attack when a foe lowers its stats.

defragment.name: Defragment
defragment.desc: On entry, it compares the opposing side's combined Attack and Special Attack. If Attack is higher or tied, its Defense rises; otherwise its Special Defense rises. Its moves cannot miss.
defragment.shortDesc: Entry defensive boost based on foes' offenses; moves cannot miss.

deltastream.name: Delta Stream
deltastream.desc: On switch-in, the weather becomes Delta Stream, which removes the weaknesses of the Flying type from Flying-type Pokemon. This weather remains in effect until this Ability is no longer active for any Pokemon, or the weather is changed by the Desolate Land or Primordial Sea Abilities.
deltastream.shortDesc: On switch-in, strong winds begin until this Ability is not active in battle.

demolitiontrunk.name: Demolition Trunk
demolitiontrunk.desc: Sheer Force. Once per entry, the first Heavy Slam or Heat Crash to damage a foe removes Reflect, Light Screen and Aurora Veil from that foe's side after damage. Both moves share one charge; misses, protection and hits only on Substitute do not spend it.
demolitiontrunk.shortDesc: First Heavy Slam or Heat Crash damage each entry clears the foe side's screens after damage.

desertrift.name: Desert Rift
desertrift.desc: Rock, Ground and Steel moves have 1.3x power in sandstorm or on Desert and Ashen Beach. Immune to sandstorm damage. On entry, summons sandstorm for 5 turns, or 8 with Smooth Rock. Doubles weight and halves physical attack damage. Factory entry gives +1 Defense and -1 Speed. On entry, summons a sandstorm and creates Desert Field for 5 turns. Rock-, Ground-, and Steel-type attacks gain 30% power during sandstorm or Desert Field. It is immune to sandstorm damage, has doubled weight, and takes half damage from physical moves. Its four moves are always Heat Crash, Heavy Slam, Earthquake, and Stone Edge. Its Desert Field creation or refresh is attempted once per battle; switching or ability changes do not reset it. Mountain Rift has its explicit field-transition exceptions.

desertshell.name: Desert Shell
desertshell.desc: Multi-hit moves always use their maximum hit count and have 1.5x power. Moves that normally check accuracy per hit check only once. Incoming Fire attacks use half the attacker's offensive stat. Burn damage is halved. On entry, summons sandstorm for 5 turns, or 8 with Smooth Rock. Multi-hit moves always hit the maximum number of times and have 1.5x power. Damage from Fire-type moves and burns is halved. Summons sandstorm on entry.
desertshell.shortDesc: 1.5x multi-hit power; Half Fire attacking stats and burn damage; Summons sandstorm on entry.

desertspirit.name: Desert Spirit
desertspirit.desc: On entry, summons sandstorm for 5 turns, or 8 with Smooth Rock. Immune to powder effects and sandstorm/hail damage. Ground-type attacks receive STAB. Tinted Lens doubles damage from resisted attacks. Levitate provides airborne protection unless grounded.

desertvigil.name: Desert Vigil
desertvigil.desc: Full local Overcoat. Once per genuine entry, the first directly selected damaging Dark attack that damages opposing HP attempts Torment on that first damaged foe after the whole move if it survives. Normal volatile immunities apply. Substitute-only, ally and generated attacks do not spend the use. A qualifying HP hit spends the use even if the target later faints or blocks Torment. Ability restarts do not reset it.
desertvigil.shortDesc: Overcoat; first selected Dark HP hit per entry Torments its surviving foe after the move.

desolateland.name: Desolate Land
desolateland.desc: On switch-in, the weather becomes Desolate Land, which includes all the effects of Sunny Day and prevents damaging Water-type moves from executing. This weather remains in effect until this Ability is no longer active for any Pokemon, or the weather is changed by the Delta Stream or Primordial Sea Abilities.
desolateland.shortDesc: On switch-in, extremely harsh sunlight begins until this Ability is not active in battle.

digestivesap.name: Digestive Sap
digestivesap.desc: Direct Poison-type attacks heal it for 1/3 of actual opposing HP damage, capped at 1/8 of its max HP per turn across all hits and targets. Native draining moves do not receive additional healing. Does not drain substitutes, allies, or delayed attacks; normal healing prevention and Liquid Ooze apply.
digestivesap.shortDesc: Poison attacks drain 1/3 actual foe HP damage; healing capped at 1/8 max HP each turn.

disguise.name: Disguise
disguise.desc: Intact Mimikyu and Totem Mimikyu block one damaging hit, become busted and lose 1/8 max HP. An opposing attacker is cursed for 1/8 max HP each turn. Confusion can break Disguise; Mold Breaker bypasses it. Transform does not grant protection.
disguise.shortDesc: Intact disguise blocks one hit, then costs 1/8 HP and curses an opposing attacker.

dishearten.name: Dishearten
dishearten.desc: On entry, lowers adjacent opposing Pokemon Sp. Atk by 1 stage. Blocked by Substitute and normal stat-drop protection; normal stat-drop reflection and reactions apply. Intimidate-specific immunities and reactions do not apply.
dishearten.shortDesc: On entry, lowers adjacent foes Sp. Atk by 1 stage.

disorientingmind.name: Disorienting Mind
disorientingmind.desc: Full local Infiltrator. Each Psychic attack that damages a surviving foe's HP attempts to inflict Torment, following normal Torment restrictions. Can activate again after Torment ends.
disorientingmind.shortDesc: Infiltrator; damaging Psychic hits inflict Torment.

dissonantchime.name: Dissonant Chime
dissonantchime.desc: Immune to opposing sound moves. Each sound attack that damages a foe's HP clears that foe's positive stat stages. Allied targets, blocked hits and Substitute-only damage do not trigger the reset.
dissonantchime.shortDesc: Immune to opposing sound; damaging sound hits clear positive stages.

dissonantecho.name: Dissonant Echo
dissonantecho.desc: The holder's damaging sound moves have 1.2x power. Its or an adjacent ally's resisted sound attack dealing opposing HP damage can mark one foe for its side through the next turn. The next damaging sound attempt by the holder or an adjacent ally against that foe consumes the mark and ignores resistance, not immunity. Marks can be earned again, but not by the consuming attack. One shared mark per side; duplicate holders do not stack it. Provider suppression or departure, target departure and expiry clear the mark. Substitute-only hits and Soundproof do not qualify.
dissonantecho.shortDesc: Sound attacks: 1.2x power. Allied resisted sound hits mark a foe for shared resistance bypass.

divefisher.name: Dive Fisher
divefisher.desc: Water Veil: prevents/cures burns, grants Aqua Ring on entry, prevents hail/sandstorm damage, and cures status on Water Surface or Underwater at turn end. Ordinary Dive executes in one turn as Special using Sp. Atk against Sp. Def, with normal power, flags, accuracy and Gulp Missile loading.
divefisher.shortDesc: Water Veil; ordinary Dive is one-turn Special.

divineintervention.name: Divine Intervention
divineintervention.desc: Includes Invigorate: healing received by the holder and its allies is multiplied by 1.3, each adjacent ally has a 50% chance to have its major status cured at turn end, and Safeguard lasts 5 turns. After an opposing damaging move finishes, each active teammate, including the holder, that lost HP to that move, survived, and is at half HP or less is healed by 1/4 max HP and cured of major status. Invigorate normally increases this healing to 32.5%. Each recipient can receive this emergency treatment only once per battle, even after switching, changing abilities or being revived. Healing obeys normal restrictions; the allowance is spent only if healing or curing succeeds. Allied, residual and Substitute-only damage do not trigger it. Healing moves, including draining attacks, and supported status-cleansing moves gain +3 priority; Wish remains delayed. Heals 1/3 max HP on switching out. Other allies take 25% less attack damage; the holder is not protected by this reduction.
divineintervention.shortDesc: Emergency team healing and cleansing with priority recovery and ally protection.

divinemockery.name: Divine Mockery
divinemockery.desc: Full local Hydra Bond, Mold Breaker and extra Water STAB.

doomwarning.name: Doom Warning
doomwarning.desc: Reflects eligible status moves and hazards once. On Mirror Arena, reflecting a directly targeted move gives its original user +1 evasion. Prevents indirect damage; HP costs, Pain Split, confusion and Struggle recoil still apply. On entry, reveals opposing Illusions and alerts to an opposing super-effective or OHKO move. If no threat is found, Psychic Terrain grants +2 Sp. Atk. On fainting, schedules a special, 140-power Steel Doom Desire against each foe. An existing delayed attack is delayed by another 2 turns instead. Its Anticipation component: Checks each active opponent separately when the holder enters, and rechecks each incoming opponent on every switch-in, including repeat entries. Allies are not checked, and initial checks do not trigger twice. Each check retains its usual Psychic Terrain bonus condition and latest-warned-move protection.
doomwarning.shortDesc: Reflects status moves; no indirect damage; reveals threats; Doom Desire against foes on fainting.

doublestrike.name: Double Strike
doublestrike.desc: Local Skill Link multihit and accuracy handling. Moves at 60 effective base power or less gain 1.5x power; the threshold is 80 on Factory Field.
doublestrike.shortDesc: Skill Link; moves at 60 effective BP or less gain 1.5x power.

download.name: Download
download.desc: On entry, it compares the opposing side's combined Defense and Special Defense. If Defense is lower, its Attack rises; otherwise its Special Attack rises. Its first damaging move after switching in is a critical hit.
download.shortDesc: Boosts the offense targeting foes' weaker defense; first damaging move crits.

dozinggiant.name: Dozing Giant
dozinggiant.desc: Oblivious. While actually asleep, takes 25% less Special attack damage and opponents cannot force it to switch. Voluntary switching still works. Sleep Talk cannot select Rest.
dozinggiant.shortDesc: While asleep, takes 25% less special damage and cannot be forced out; Sleep Talk excludes Rest.

draconicforce.name: Draconic Force
draconicforce.desc: Eligible Normal moves become Dragon with 1.2x power, or 1.5x on Dragon's Den and Fairy Tale. Dragon moves receive STAB. Biting moves have 1.5x power. Moves ignore bypassable opposing abilities.
draconicforce.shortDesc: Eligible Normal moves become Dragon with 1.2x power, or 1.5x on Dragon's Den and Fairy Tale.

dragonize.name: Dragonize
dragonize.desc: Its Normal-type moves become Dragon-type moves and have their power multiplied by 1.2. It gains STAB on Dragon-type moves.
dragonize.shortDesc: Normal moves become Dragon type; Dragon STAB; converted moves 1.2x.

dragonsmaw.name: Dragon's Maw
dragonsmaw.desc: Its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Dragon-type attack.

dreaddominion.name: Dread Dominion
dreaddominion.desc: Hydra Bond and Moxie. Intimidate lowers adjacent foes' Attack by 1 on entry, respecting Substitute and normal Intimidate protections. Does not change Dark/Fairy type matchups.

dreadjaw.name: Dread Jaw
dreadjaw.desc: Gains +1 Attack for each Pokemon knocked out by its move. A move KO also stores one charge that lowers the next opposing entrant's Attack by 1 stage. Charges do not stack and end when the holder leaves.
dreadjaw.shortDesc: A move KO lowers the next opposing entrant's Attack.

dreadmaw.name: Dread Maw
dreadmaw.desc: Strong Jaw + Invigorate: biting moves have 1.5x power; it and its allies receive 1.3x healing; each adjacent statused ally has a 50% cure chance at turn end. Once per entry, a bite damaging a surviving foe’s HP blocks healing through the next turn. Only a new Heal Block spends the use; blocks are not refreshed.
dreadmaw.shortDesc: Strong Jaw + Invigorate; once per entry, a bite blocks foe healing for 2 turns.

dreadpresence.name: Dread Presence
dreadpresence.desc: Full local Unnerve + Dark Aura. Blocks opposing Berries and field Seeds; Cold Eclipse entry lowers opposing Speed. Boosts Dark moves on both sides by 4/3, reversed by Aura Break, without stacking. Immune to hail on Cold Eclipse.

dreadwings.name: Dread Wings
dreadwings.desc: Intimidate and Unnerve: on entry, lowers adjacent foes' Attack one stage under normal Intimidate protections; foes cannot eat Berries or use field seeds while Unnerve is active. On Cold Eclipse entry, lowers opposing Speed one stage unless protected by Substitute. A Dark Pulse that damages a surviving foe also applies Torment under normal volatile-status rules, preventing consecutive use of the same move. Existing Torment does not stack.
dreadwings.shortDesc: Weakens foes on entry; Dark Pulse damage applies Torment to surviving foes.

dreamrefuge.name: Dream Refuge
dreamrefuge.desc: Telepathy: immune to allied damaging moves and doubles Speed on Psychic Terrain or its aura. Once per entry, its first successful Moonlight also cures one active ally's major status, choosing the affected ally with the lowest HP percentage. Ordinary Moonlight healing and failure rules apply.
dreamrefuge.shortDesc: First successful Moonlight each entry cures the statused active ally with lowest HP percentage.

dreamsickness.name: Dream Sickness
dreamsickness.desc: Prevents and cures sleep, blocks Yawn and boosts Dark/Ghost attacks by 1.3x. On entry, heals adjacent allies by 1/4 max HP, or 1/3 on Fairy Tale. Once per battle, saves an adjacent ally from a lethal opposing attack at 1 HP through the remainder of that move, paying 1/4 of the holder’s max HP. The holder must have more HP than the cost. Switching does not restore the rescue.
dreamsickness.shortDesc: Insomnia + Sworn Duty; once per battle rescues an adjacent ally from a lethal attack.

dredger.name: Dredger
dredger.desc: Once per turn after its Ground attack deals opposing HP damage, removes one layer of its side's Spikes, or one Toxic Spikes layer if no Spikes remain. No other hazards are removed. Multihit and spread attacks activate once.
dredger.shortDesc: First Ground HP hit each turn removes one own Spikes layer, then Toxic Spikes if none remain.

dreepyvanguard.name: Dreepy Vanguard
dreepyvanguard.desc: Full local Stalwart and Technician. Moves cannot be redirected; specified Stalwart field entries raise Sp. Atk. Moves at most 60 effective BP (80 on Factory) receive 1.5x power. Once per entry, the first Dragon Darts dealing opposing HP damage removes Reflect if Physical or Light Screen if Special from each opposing side it damaged after both darts finish. Uses the actual higher-offense category; ability changes do not reset the use.
dreepyvanguard.shortDesc: Stalwart + Technician; first Dragon Darts breaks the matching screen.

drizzle.name: Drizzle
drizzle.desc: On entry, summons rain for 5 turns, or 8 with Damp Rock.

drought.name: Drought
drought.desc: On entry, summons sun for 5 turns, or 8 with Heat Rock.

drumguard.name: Drum Guard
drumguard.desc: Soundproof. Once per entry, Drum Beating successfully lowering an opposing Pokemon's Speed clears only the user's negative Defense and Sp. Def stages. Positive stages remain. Misses, immunity and blocked Speed drops do not trigger or spend the use.
drumguard.shortDesc: First successful Drum Beating Speed drop each entry clears own negative Defense and Sp. Def.

dryskin.name: Dry Skin
dryskin.desc: Absorbs Water moves for 1/4 max HP; incoming Fire moves have 1.25x power. Effective rain heals 1/8 HP per turn; sun costs 1/8. Field healing per turn: 1/16 on Underwater, Swamp, Misty or grounded Water Surface; 1/8 when grounded and Poison-type on Murkwater. Corrosive Mist heals Poison types by 1/8 but damages non-Steel others by 1/8. Desert costs 1/8 HP per turn.
dryskin.shortDesc: Absorbs Water; rain/water fields heal; Fire, sun and Desert hurt.

dualwield.name: Dual Wield
dualwield.desc: Eligible slicing, pulse, bullet, horn, drill, and Arrow moves normally hit twice at 60% power, each with its own accuracy check. If an offensive ability power or damage multiplier applies, the first hit retains its full ability boosts and the second uses 15% of original move power without those offensive ability multipliers. Stat multipliers, items, STAB and ordinary weather or field modifiers remain separate. In Free-for-All, the second hit targets another random living foe when possible; Siege Launcher retains its full-power pair. Existing multi-hit moves do not gain an extra pair.
dualwield.shortDesc: Two 60% rolls; offensive ability boost: full first hit + 15% original-power follow-up.

duneclaws.name: Dune Claws
duneclaws.desc: Tough Claws: contact moves have 1.3x power. After a STAB attack damages opposing HP, clears its side’s entry hazards and its own Leech Seed and partial trapping. Cleanup occurs once after the whole attack and can repeat on later attacks; contact is not required.
duneclaws.shortDesc: Tough Claws; STAB HP hits clear own hazards, Leech Seed and binding.

duneterror.name: Dune Terror
duneterror.desc: On entry, summons sandstorm for 5 turns, or 8 with Smooth Rock. At turn end, if statused, affected by a listed ailment, negatively boosted or at half HP or less, has a 50% chance to heal 1/4 max HP, cure status, clear negative stages and remove Attract, confusion, Curse, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Leech Seed, Nightmare, Perish Song, Taunt, Torment and Yawn. On Dragon's Den, activation is guaranteed but only cures status and heals, then raises its higher attacking stat by 1 and lowers both defenses by 1. When it is hit by an attack, the effect of Sandstorm begins. Summons sand on entry and when hit; during Sandstorm, opposing Pokemon take Ground-type damage equal to 1/16 max HP, blocked by Ground immunities. On fainting, creates Desert Field for 5 turns.
duneterror.shortDesc: Desert Field for 5 turns on faint.

duskdrive.name: Dusk Drive
duskdrive.desc: Full local Opportunist and Ultra Ego. Copies opposing positive stat changes at normal flush events; ability-bypassing attacks, damage-triggered attack boosts and recovery retain Ultra Ego's local field and rivalry rules.

duskilate.name: Duskilate
duskilate.desc: Its Normal-type moves become Dark-type moves and have their power multiplied by 1.3.
duskilate.shortDesc: Normal moves become Dark type and have 1.3x power.

earlybird.name: Early Bird
earlybird.desc: Sleep lasts half as long, rounded down.

eartheater.name: Earth Eater
eartheater.desc: Absorbs other Pokemon's Ground moves, healing 1/4 max HP instead of being hit. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn on Cave and Desert.
eartheater.shortDesc: Absorbs Ground for 1/4 HP; heals on Cave/Desert.

echofiend.name: Echo Fiend
echofiend.desc: It is immune to sound moves, and this immunity cannot be suppressed. Its sound moves become Flying type and have 1.5x power. Its side is immune to its own damaging sound-based moves.
echofiend.shortDesc: Unsuppressible sound immunity; sound -> Flying 1.5x; allies avoid own sound damage.

echosense.name: Echo Sense
echosense.desc: It is immune to sound moves, and this immunity cannot be suppressed. Its sound moves become Flying type and have 1.5x power. Its side is immune to its own damaging sound-based moves. On entry, reveals all opposing active Illusions and held items. Each item holder independently has a 30% chance to be Embargoed for 5 turns. Avoids allied damaging moves. Speed doubles on Psychic Terrain or Psychic Aura. Moves bypass Substitute, Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil, Safeguard and Mist.
echosense.shortDesc: Allies avoid own sound damage; 30% chance of 5-turn Embargo; double Speed on Psychic field/aura.

eclipse.name: Eclipse
eclipse.desc: This Ability cannot be suppressed. During weather, its attacks deal 1.5x damage. In clear weather, attacks deal 0.5x damage to it. Its Psychic-type moves become Dark type if Dark would do more damage, and its Dark-type moves become Psychic type if Psychic would do more damage.
