It restores 1/4 max HP instead of taking damage from Psychic- or Dark-type moves.
eclipse.shortDesc: Cannot be suppressed; weather attacks 1.5x; clear damage halved; Psychic/Dark choose type.

eclipsevision.name: Eclipse Vision
eclipsevision.desc: Special Attack is multiplied by 1.3. Its first move slot sets its opening type if Psychic or Dark, and later Psychic- or Dark-type moves change it to that type. Psychic typing restores 1/8 base max HP at turn end; Dark typing restores HP equal to 1/4 damage dealt. Species-passive effects remain separate from the selected ability and do not double when copied into that slot.
eclipsevision.shortDesc: SpA 1.3x; opening Psychic/Dark type; moves switch type; Psychic heals, Dark drains.

effectspore.name: Effect Spore
effectspore.desc: Damaging hits have separate 10% chances to inflict sleep, paralysis or poison on the attacker; powder immunity blocks this. If Sleep Clause blocks sleep, a further roll can inflict paralysis or poison instead.
effectspore.shortDesc: Damaging attackers may sleep, be paralyzed or poisoned.

eject.name: Eject
eject.desc: Once per battle, its first would-be knockout breaks its appliance. It cannot act or lose HP for the rest of that turn, then returns as base Rotom at full HP with Infiltrator after residual effects. Appliance-type physical attacks become Astonish and special attacks become Hex. Other moves and status moves remain; each slot keeps its remaining PP, capped by the replacement's PP, without a refill.
eject.shortDesc: Once per battle, a lethal hit ejects it; returns as full-HP Rotom at turn end.

elasticbelly.name: Elastic Belly
elasticbelly.desc: Once per genuine entry, after surviving an entire opposing damaging move that starts it above half HP and ends at half or below, restores 1/8 base max HP. Substitute-only damage, ally attacks, residual damage and HP costs do not trigger it. Ability restarts do not reset it.
elasticbelly.shortDesc: Once per entry, surviving a foe move crossing half HP heals 1/8 max HP.

eldritchremedy.name: Eldritch Remedy
eldritchremedy.desc: Own Tempo + Curious Medicine: prevents confusion and Intimidate Attack drops. On entry, clears negative stages and confusion from self and active allies, keeping positive stages; each Pokemon cleansed heals 1/8 max HP. Once per turn, a damaging Eerie Spell cures one major status: the holder first, otherwise the statused active ally with lowest HP percentage. Does not affect the bench.
eldritchremedy.shortDesc: Eerie Spell cures one major status on self or an active ally once/turn.

electricsurge.name: Electric Surge
electricsurge.desc: On entry, creates Electric Terrain or Electric Aura for 5 turns, or 8 with Amplifield Rock, subject to field rules.

electromorphosis.name: Electromorphosis
electromorphosis.desc: It gains the Charge effect when it takes a hit from an attack.
electromorphosis.shortDesc: It gains the Charge effect when it takes a hit from an attack.

elevate.name: Elevate
elevate.desc: Airborne: immune to Ground attacks and grounded hazards unless grounded. Move KOs raise its highest stat by 1, ignoring stat stages when choosing the stat.
elevate.shortDesc: Airborne; move KOs raise its highest stat.

embodyaspectcornerstone.name: Embody Aspect (Cornerstone)
embodyaspectcornerstone.desc: On switch-in, its Defense is raised by 1 stage.
embodyaspectcornerstone.shortDesc: On switch-in, its Defense is raised by 1 stage.

embodyaspecthearthflame.name: Embody Aspect (Hearthflame)
embodyaspecthearthflame.desc: On switch-in, its Attack is raised by 1 stage.
embodyaspecthearthflame.shortDesc: On switch-in, its Attack is raised by 1 stage.

embodyaspectteal.name: Embody Aspect (Teal)
embodyaspectteal.desc: On switch-in, its Speed is raised by 1 stage.
embodyaspectteal.shortDesc: On switch-in, its Speed is raised by 1 stage.

embodyaspectwellspring.name: Embody Aspect (Wellspring)
embodyaspectwellspring.desc: On switch-in, its Special Defense is raised by 1 stage.
embodyaspectwellspring.shortDesc: On switch-in, its Special Defense is raised by 1 stage.

emergencyexit.name: Emergency Exit
emergencyexit.desc: When it has more than 1/2 its max HP and takes damage bringing it to 1/2 or less of its max HP, it immediately switches out to a chosen ally. This effect applies after all hits from a multi-hit move. This effect is prevented if the move had a secondary effect removed by the Sheer Force Ability. This effect applies to both direct and indirect damage, except Curse and Substitute on use, Belly Drum, Pain Split, and confusion damage.
emergencyexit.shortDesc: It switches out when it reaches 1/2 or less of its max HP.

emperorsresolve.name: Emperor's Resolve
emperorsresolve.desc: Opposing stat drops give +2 Sp. Atk. Doubles Speed in hail, snow or on Icy, Snowy Mountain and Cold Eclipse. Doubles Speed in rain or on Water Surface, Murkwater Surface, Underwater and Midnight Zone. The two Speed boosts do not stack.
emperorsresolve.shortDesc: Opposing stat drops give +2 Sp. Atk.

empress.name: Empress
empress.desc: Full local Queenly Majesty and Royal Decree, Fighting STAB and protection against Poison/Steel targeting its Fairy type. Once per battle, after surviving a whole opposing damaging move that starts it above half HP and ends at or below half, cures its own and adjacent active allies' major status and confusion, and sets 5-turn Safeguard without shortening a longer Safeguard. Switching or restarting the ability does not reset the use. Ally attacks, Substitute-only hits, recoil, residual damage and HP costs do not qualify.
empress.shortDesc: Queenly Majesty + Royal Decree; once-battle half-HP rally cures allies and sets Safeguard.

encorearia.name: Encore Aria
encorearia.desc: Serene Grace doubles secondary-effect chances, including chance-based self effects, and removes charge flags. On genuine switch-in, grants the team Safeguard for 5 turns, preserving any longer duration. Ending suppression or restarting/copying the ability does not refresh Safeguard.
encorearia.shortDesc: Serene Grace; entry grants team Safeguard for at least 5 turns.

enlightenment.name: Enlightenment
enlightenment.desc: Prevents flinching and Intimidate's Attack drop. Moves with effective power of 60 or less have 1.5x power; the threshold is 80 on Factory.

entrenched.name: Entrenched
entrenched.desc: Prevents opposing moves and items from forcing the holder to switch. Voluntary switching, self-switching moves and allied effects still work.
entrenched.shortDesc: Opposing moves and items cannot force it to switch.

errorhandler.name: Error Handler
errorhandler.desc: Aroma Veil protects it and its allies from Attract, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Taunt and Torment. Infiltrator bypasses Substitute and opposing screens.

eternalflower.name: Eternal Flower
eternalflower.desc: Includes Mold Breaker. Its attacks deal 2x damage to all Pulse forms. Its Grass-type moves use 1.5x Attack and Special Attack. Opposing Mega, G-Max, Terastallized, Stellar, and Ultra Beast Pokemon have Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed reduced to 0.7x while it is active. This debuff does not affect allies. When it faints, it creates Bewitched Woods for 5 turns.
eternalflower.shortDesc: 2x damage to Pulse; Grass offenses 1.5x; weakens opposing gimmicks.

eternalice.name: Eternal Ice
eternalice.desc: Immune to Fire moves and burns. Prevents negative stat changes caused by damaging moves, including its own moves. Status moves can still lower its stats.
eternalice.shortDesc: Immune to Fire and burns; damaging moves cannot lower its stats.

evaporate.name: Evaporate
evaporate.desc: Absorbs Water moves for 1/4 max HP; incoming Fire moves have 1.25x power. Effective rain heals 1/8 HP per turn; sun costs 1/8. Field healing per turn: 1/16 on Underwater, Swamp, Misty or grounded Water Surface; 1/8 when grounded and Poison-type on Murkwater. Corrosive Mist heals Poison types by 1/8 but damages non-Steel others by 1/8. Desert costs 1/8 HP per turn. On entry, ends ordinary rain but not Primordial Sea. Once per stay, ending rain or absorbing Water grants one Steam Veil; the next damaging special HP hit deals 0.75x damage and consumes it. It cannot stack or refresh within that stay.
evaporate.shortDesc: Ends ordinary rain; once per stay, ending rain or absorbing Water gives a special-hit veil.

evergreen.name: Evergreen
evergreen.desc: Overcoat + Ripen: immune to powder moves and sandstorm/hail damage; doubles applicable Berry effects and positive held-Seed stat boosts. Seed stat drops and other effects are unchanged.

evilsanta.name: Evil Santa
evilsanta.desc: Present hits all adjacent Pokémon and rolls one extra effect per hit. Delibird gets Dark STAB on other Dark moves, but not Present. A failed extra effect is not rerolled.
evilsanta.shortDesc: Present hits all adjacent Pokémon and rolls one extra effect per hit.

exalt.name: Exalt
exalt.desc: Mold Breaker: moves ignore bypassable opposing abilities. It has Defiant: opposing stat drops raise its Attack by 2 stages. It cannot flinch. Its slicing moves and Steel Wing have 1.5x power, except on Cold Eclipse, as with Sharpness. Intimidate still lowers its Attack and triggers Defiant. Flinch protection can be bypassed by Mold Breaker; ability suppression disables all effects.
exalt.shortDesc: Cannot flinch; Steel Wing also receives the slicing-move power boost.

exaltedaether.name: Exalted Aether
exaltedaether.desc: Eligible single-target physical Dragon- and Flying-type attacks strike twice, including Aerilate conversions. The first strike deals normal damage and heals 12.5% of actual opposing HP damage dealt, in addition to any native drain. The second deals 25% of normal damage and ignores positive Defense stages. Defensive screens apply normally to both strikes. Target secondary effects and user effects occur only on the first strike. Uses one PP and the ordinary accuracy check. No extra strike for spread, existing multi-hit, charging, delayed, OHKO, Z, Max or bond-excluded moves. Never transfers to another Pokemon. Substitute damage and allied damage do not heal. Normal healing prevention, contact, recoil, abilities and immunities apply. Suppression disables this ability.
exaltedaether.shortDesc: Physical Dragon/Flying hits twice: 12.5% first-hit healing; 25% follow-up ignores Defense boosts.

execution.name: Execution
execution.desc: Eligible Normal moves become Dark, or Fairy on Holy and Rainbow, with 1.3x power. This rises to 1.5x on Dark Crystal Cavern, New World, Starlight Arena, Cold Eclipse, Short-Circuit, Haunted, Bewitched Woods, Holy and Rainbow. Immune to hail damage on Cold Eclipse. Moves ignore bypassable abilities. Attacks against targets at half HP or less gain 1.3x power. Once per switch-in, a direct hit that brings a surviving foe from above half HP to half or less marks it; the next Dark or Ghost hit against that foe ignores positive defensive boosts and spends the mark. The mark ends if either Pokemon switches. Restores 1/8 max HP per KO; Attack and Sp. Atk cannot fall below -1, and Speed cannot be lowered while a field is active.
execution.shortDesc: Normal becomes Dark/Fairy; ability bypass; stronger vs weakened foes; KOs heal 1/8 HP.

expiration.name: Expiration
expiration.desc: Full local Worldbreaker and Controlled Fury. Berserk raises Attack and Sp. Atk by 1 after surviving a move crossing half HP, and by 2 on Dragon Den entry. Duskilate converts Normal moves to Dark with its normal power and field effects. Each damaging hit independently has a 30% chance to double base power; Fickle Beam uses only its own all-out roll. The first damaging hit received each entry raises Attack by 1; surviving a critical hit instead maximizes Attack. Outrage, Thrash, Petal Dance and Raging Fury cause no rampage lock or ending confusion. Existing confusion and other move locks remain unchanged.

fairyaura.name: Fairy Aura
fairyaura.desc: While it is active, the power of Fairy-type moves used by active Pokemon is multiplied by 1.33.
fairyaura.shortDesc: While it is active, a Fairy move used by any Pokemon has 1.33x power.

fairyring.name: Fairy Ring
fairyring.desc: Special Defense is multiplied by 1.3. Recovery from draining moves, Strength Sap, Leech Seed, Ingrain and Aqua Ring is multiplied by 1.3, stacking once with Big Root. Each turn, each major-statused opposing Pokemon loses 1/16 max HP and it drains the actual HP lost with its recovery bonus. Magic Guard prevents the residual loss; Liquid Ooze reverses draining recovery. Heal Block prevents recovery, not opposing residual damage. On genuine entry, applies ordinary Spotlight to one living adjacent ally until the end of the turn; does not repeat Illuminate's Spotlight.
fairyring.shortDesc: Sp. Def 1.3x; draining healing 1.3x; drains statused foes; entry Spotlights an ally.

fallenstar.name: Fallen Star
fallenstar.desc: Mold Breaker: moves ignore bypassable opposing abilities. Designated arrow moves gain +1 priority at 1/4 max HP or less and 1.3x power against trapped foes: Spirit Shackle, Thousand Arrows, Triple Arrows, Snipe Shot, Razor Leaf, Magical Leaf, Spike Cannon, Pin Missile, Icicle Spear, Rock Blast, Bullet Seed, Scale Shot, Psycho Cut and Ceaseless Edge. Has its arrow follow-up and protective effects.
fallenstar.shortDesc: Arrows: +1 priority at 1/4 HP. Trapped-target and same-type attacks gain 1.3x power.

falsebouquet.name: False Bouquet
falsebouquet.desc: Its first damaging Flower Trick against a surviving foe each entry attempts Leech Seed; Grass immunity and Substitute still apply. Includes full local Magician: when itemless, steals a removable item after an eligible damaging move, respecting normal theft restrictions. Fairy Tale, Bewitched Woods, Haunted, Misty and New World entry grant +1 Sp. Atk; on Psychic Terrain, incoming status moves with numeric accuracy use 50 accuracy.
falsebouquet.shortDesc: First Flower Trick hit each entry attempts Leech Seed.

falsedevotion.name: False Devotion
falsedevotion.desc: Full local Prankster and Serene Grace. Status moves gain +1 priority with Prankster targeting rules and its Bewitched Woods exception. Doubles secondary-effect chances up to 60%, preserving effects already above the cap, including guaranteed effects. Skips move charge turns. Repeated Serene Grace applications do not multiply the same effect again.
falsedevotion.shortDesc: Prankster + Serene Grace: priority status; capped secondary boosts; skips charge turns.

falseliberation.name: False Liberation
falseliberation.desc: Mold Breaker. Once per entry, Dark damage to a foe’s HP inflicts Torment. Only a newly applied Torment spends the use; Torment is not refreshed.
falseliberation.shortDesc: Mold Breaker; once per entry, a Dark HP hit inflicts Torment.

familyguardian.name: Family Guardian
familyguardian.desc: Friend Guard reduces damage to other allies by 25%; full local Healer gives each adjacent statused ally a 30% chance to be cured each turn. Once per genuine entry, after the user or an adjacent ally survives an opposing whole damaging attack that takes it from above half HP to half HP or less, it heals 1/4 of its max HP after all hits. One shared budget is spent only when healing succeeds. Heal Block prevents healing; residual damage, friendly fire and Substitute-only damage do not qualify. Ability restarts do not refresh the budget.
familyguardian.shortDesc: Friend Guard + Healer; once/entry heals self or a nearby ally 1/4 HP after crossing half HP.

feedback.name: Feedback
feedback.desc: Sound attacks that damage opposing HP mark that foe. A marked foe's sound attacks deal 20% less damage while the originating holder remains active. Repeated marks and multiple holders do not stack. Marks end when their source leaves or the marked foe switches. Substitute-only damage does not mark.
feedback.shortDesc: Sound HP hits mark foes; their sound moves deal 20% less damage while it stays active.

festivalstep.name: Festival Step
festivalstep.desc: Landing a damaging dance move against a foe clears its negative stat stages after damage. Positive stages are preserved; blocked or missed moves do not trigger the effect.
festivalstep.shortDesc: Dance hits clear its negative stat stages.

fightingfiend.name: Fighting Fiend
fightingfiend.desc: Moves cannot miss. Prevents and cures sleep and blocks Yawn. Fighting attacks use 1.3x Attack or Sp. Atk. Takes 20% less attack damage, with a further 50% reduction at full HP (60% total).
fightingfiend.shortDesc: Moves never miss; stronger Fighting attacks; 20% less damage, 60% at full HP.

filter.name: Filter
filter.desc: Takes 20% less attack damage, or 40% less from super-effective attacks.
filter.shortDesc: 20% less attack damage; 40% less if super effective.

finalnote.name: Final Note
finalnote.desc: Once per switch-in, its first sound move selected while at half HP or less gains +1 priority. Using it spends the effect even if it misses or is blocked.
finalnote.shortDesc: At half HP, the first sound move each entry gains +1 priority.

firemane.name: Fire Mane
firemane.desc: Damaging moves with effective Fire typing have 1.5x power, whether or not they receive STAB. Non-Fire STAB moves and status moves are not boosted.

fireward.name: Fire Ward
fireward.desc: Defense and Sp. Def are multiplied by 1.3, or 1.5 on Cold Eclipse or Dragon’s Den.
fireward.shortDesc: Defense and Sp. Def 1.3x; 1.5x on Cold Eclipse or Dragon’s Den.

flamebody.name: Flame Body
flamebody.desc: Contact attackers have a 30% burn chance, or 60% on Volcanic. On Cold Eclipse, gains +1 Defense and Sp. Def on entry instead and cannot burn through contact.
flamebody.shortDesc: 30% contact burn (60% Volcanic); Cold Eclipse gives defenses instead.

flareboost.name: Flare Boost
flareboost.desc: Its Fire-type attacks have 1.5x power. While it is burned, the power of its special attacks is also multiplied by 1.5.
flareboost.shortDesc: Fire attacks have 1.5x power; burned special attacks also have 1.5x power.

flashfire.name: Flash Fire
flashfire.desc: Absorbs Fire moves and gains a 1.5x Fire boost until switching out or losing the ability. Burning Field or grounded Volcanic Field also grants the boost. On Cold Eclipse, Fire absorption is disabled and entry gives +1 Defense and Sp. Def.
flashfire.shortDesc: Absorbs Fire for a 1.5x Fire boost; Cold Eclipse gives defenses instead.

flintfracture.name: Flint Fracture
flintfracture.desc: Connecting slicing moves remove the target side's Reflect and Aurora Veil before damage. Opposing HP damage applies stone splinters dealing 1/16 max HP at the end of this turn and the following turn. Reapplication refreshes, never stacks; switching clears splinters.
flintfracture.shortDesc: Slicing attacks break Reflect/Veil; HP hits inflict two turns of 1/16 stone splinters.

floehunter.name: Floe Hunter
floehunter.desc: Full local Slush Rush doubles Speed in hail or snow and on Icy, Snowy Mountain and Cold Eclipse fields. Physical Ice attacks ignore only the Water type’s Ice resistance; the target’s other defensive types still apply.
floehunter.shortDesc: Slush Rush; physical Ice attacks ignore Water’s Ice resistance.

flowergift.name: Flower Gift
flowergift.desc: If it is a Cherrim and Sunny Day is active, it changes to Sunshine Form and the Attack and Special Defense of it and its allies are multiplied by 1.5. These effects are prevented if the Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.
flowergift.shortDesc: If user is Cherrim and Sunny Day is active, it and allies' Attack and Sp. Def are 1.5x.

flowerveil.name: Flower Veil
flowerveil.desc: Grass-type Pokemon on its side cannot have their stat stages lowered by other Pokemon or have a non-volatile status condition inflicted on them by other Pokemon.
flowerveil.shortDesc: This side's Grass types can't have stats lowered or status inflicted by other Pokemon.

fluffy.name: Fluffy
fluffy.desc: Takes half damage from contact attacks and double damage from Fire attacks; contact Fire attacks deal normal damage.
fluffy.shortDesc: Half contact damage; double Fire damage.

fluffyevo.name: Fluffy Evo
fluffyevo.desc: Moves that do not match its type gain STAB. Its damaging moves ignore type immunities while respecting resistances, and it ignores powder moves, sandstorm and hail damage.
fluffyevo.shortDesc: 1.5x off-type move power; attacks bypass type immunities; no powder/weather damage.

forecast.name: Forecast
forecast.desc: Castform changes to Sunny in sun, Rainy in rain, Snowy in hail or snow, Sandy in sandstorm, Windy in Delta Stream, and Normal otherwise. Effective weather and Utility Umbrella apply. Does not transform copied Pokemon.
forecast.shortDesc: Castform changes form with effective weather.

forestsurge.name: Forest Surge
forestsurge.desc: On entry, it sets Forest Terrain and Grassy Aura for 5 turns, or 8 turns with Amplifield Rock.
forestsurge.shortDesc: Sets Forest and Grassy Aura for 5 turns, or 8 with Amplifield Rock.

forewarn.name: Forewarn
forewarn.desc: Checks each active opponent separately when the holder enters, and rechecks each incoming opponent on every switch-in, including repeat entries. Allies are not checked, and initial checks do not trigger twice. For each check, removes that opponent's Illusion and reveals one of its strongest damaging moves, choosing randomly among ties. Each successful reveal on Psychic Terrain grants +2 Sp. Atk. Takes 20% less move damage, or 25% less from opposing uses of the most recently revealed damaging non-OHKO move until switching out. These reductions do not stack; OHKO moves receive no learned-move protection.
forewarn.shortDesc: Scans each foe on entry/switch-in. Takes 20% less move damage; 25% less from the latest warned move.

forgegrit.name: Forge Grit
forgegrit.desc: Attack is 1.5x while statused, and burn does not weaken physical attacks. Once per switch-in, the first damaging move it takes from a foe while statused raises its Defense by one stage.
forgegrit.shortDesc: First opposing HP hit while statused each entry gives +1 Defense.

forsakensleeper.name: Forsaken Sleeper
forsakensleeper.desc: Full local Comatose, Soundproof and Rattled. Counts as asleep without a normal status and blocks major status; immune to other Pokemon's sound moves; Bug, Dark or Ghost hits and opposing Intimidate can raise Speed.

fortressshell.name: Tidal Crown
fortressshell.desc: Stalwart bypasses redirection and gives +1 Sp. Atk on New World, Starlight Arena, Fairy Tale or Chessboard entry. Water chip cycles 1/16, 2/16, then 3/16 foe base max HP; Water immunities apply, and effectiveness scales chip only in Free-for-All. Self-Sufficient heals 1/16 max HP each turn and prevents sandstorm/hail damage. Shell Armor prevents critical hits and reduces attack damage by 20%; Fairy Tale and Dragon Den entry give +1 Defense, and opposing stat drops trigger +2 Sp. Def. Guardian Presence boosts allies move power by 1.3x, or 1.5x on Haunted, Bewitched Woods, Holy and Psychic fields, and reduces their attack damage by 25%; neither applies to the holder. During Electric Aura or Electric Terrain, Murkwater Surface, Water Surface, Underwater, Midnight Zone, Factory and Short-Circuit, redirects and absorbs Electric moves for +1 Attack and Sp. Atk. Existing Fairy Tale, New World, Cold Eclipse and Starlight Arena entry/terrain bonuses give +1 Defense and Sp. Def; the latter three retain 1.5x move power.
fortressshell.shortDesc: Water Barrage (without Dual Wield), Self-Sufficient, Shell Armor and Guardian Presence.

fortunatewing.name: Fortunate Wing
fortunatewing.desc: Raises critical-hit rate by one stage. Once per entry, its first critical hit dealing opposing HP damage sets 5-turn Safeguard and cures confusion on active allies. Does not shorten a longer Safeguard or repeat the reward.
fortunatewing.shortDesc: First damaging critical hit each entry sets Safeguard and cures active allies’ confusion.

fossilfrenzy.name: Fossil Frenzy
fossilfrenzy.desc: Once per opposing damaging move it survives, after the entire move finishes, gains +1 Attack and Speed and attempts confusion. Allied, self and indirect damage do not trigger it. Has Klutz item suppression and its exceptions, Fling failure and local Chess Board move restrictions. While confused, incoming attack damage is 1.25x; hurting itself in confusion also costs 1/8 max HP.
fossilfrenzy.shortDesc: Surviving each opposing attack gives +1 Attack/Speed and confusion. Confusion still hurts.

fossilram.name: Fossil Ram
fossilram.desc: Prevents move recoil except Struggle. Crash and Life Orb damage still apply. Once per turn, damaging a foe with a recoil move lowers its Speed by 1 stage. Struggle recoil is not prevented.
fossilram.shortDesc: Once per turn, recoil-move damage lowers the foe’s Speed.

freeflight.name: Free Flight
freeflight.desc: Full local Wind Power and Moxie. Absorbs wind moves for +1 Sp. Atk. Tailwind activation or entry under Tailwind grants +1 Sp. Atk. Strong Winds grants +1 Attack and Sp. Atk each turn. Successfully setting its own Tailwind clears confusion and negative accuracy stages. Gains +1 Attack for each Pokemon knocked out by its move.

freezerburn.name: Freezer Burn
freezerburn.desc: Doubles Speed in hail, snow or on Icy, Snowy Mountain and Cold Eclipse. Levitate makes it airborne and immune to Ground attacks and grounded hazards unless grounded. Its Ice-type attacks deal 1.2x damage against targets that are already burned, including Normal moves converted to Ice by its separate Refrigerate passive. Other move types and other target statuses receive no extra damage; this ability does not inflict burn.
freezerburn.shortDesc: Slush Rush + Levitate; Ice damage is 1.2x against burned targets.

freshplumage.name: Fresh Plumage
freshplumage.desc: Local Natural Cure cures status on switching and heals 1/8 max HP only when curing status; Bewitched Woods has its end-turn cure. First successful Flying attack each entry deals 1.2x damage across all hits, including Substitute damage. Misses, protection and immunity preserve the charge. Roost does not recharge it.
freshplumage.shortDesc: Natural Cure; first successful Flying attack each entry deals 1.2x damage.

friendguard.name: Friend Guard
friendguard.desc: Allies take 25% less attack damage; this does not protect the holder.

frightfulwings.name: Frightful Wings
frightfulwings.desc: On entry lowers adjacent foes Attack by 1 stage under normal Intimidate rules. Full Own Tempo prevents and cures confusion and blocks Intimidate Attack drops.

frillflash.name: Frill Flash
frillflash.desc: Dazzling. When its Electrify actually converts an opposing move from another type to Electric, attempts to Disable that converted move after it finishes, through the end of the following turn. Normal Disable eligibility and protection apply. No bonus for failed Electrify, inability to act, an already-Electric move, or an allied move.
frillflash.shortDesc: Its Electrify conversion Disables the opposing move after execution through next turn.

frisk.name: Frisk
frisk.desc: On entry, reveals all opposing active Illusions and held items. Each item holder independently has a 30% chance to be Embargoed for 5 turns.
frisk.shortDesc: Reveals foe Illusions/items; 30% chance of 5-turn Embargo.

frostsiren.name: Frost Siren
frostsiren.desc: Eligible Normal moves become Ice and have 1.2x power, or 1.5x on Icy and Snowy Mountain. Excludes moves whose type is set by their own effect, damaging Z-Moves and Terastallized Tera Blast. On entry, it reveals a strongest move known by an opposing Pokemon and removes foe Illusions. In Psychic Terrain, it gains 2 Sp. Atk and takes 0.8x damage from moves. Absorbs Water moves for 1/4 max HP; incoming Fire moves have 1.25x power. Effective rain heals 1/8 HP per turn; sun costs 1/8. Field healing per turn: 1/16 on Underwater, Swamp, Misty or grounded Water Surface; 1/8 when grounded and Poison-type on Murkwater. Corrosive Mist heals Poison types by 1/8 but damages non-Steel others by 1/8. Desert costs 1/8 HP per turn.
frostsiren.shortDesc: Icy-field boost; takes 0.8x damage; Fire, sun and Desert hurt.

frostsovereign.name: Frost Sovereign
frostsovereign.desc: Sets or refreshes Snow Warning weather to 8 turns on entry. Full local Ice Body and Filter, and gains full Soundproof immunity to other Pokemon's sound moves. Manually used Aurora Veil lasts 8 turns. Each turn, non-immune foes take Ice damage equal to 1/16 max HP; type effectiveness scales this chip only in Free-for-All.
frostsovereign.shortDesc: Ice Body + Filter + Soundproof; eight-turn snow and Ice chip.

froststalker.name: Frost Stalker
froststalker.desc: Attacks use double the offensive stat against targets that entered this turn. Slicing moves have 1.5x power, except on Cold Eclipse. Eligible Normal moves become Ice and have 1.2x power, or 1.5x on Icy and Snowy Mountain. Excludes moves whose type is set by their own effect, damaging Z-Moves and Terastallized Tera Blast. Doubles attacking stats against foes that just entered battle. Slicing moves have 1.5x power except on Cold Eclipse. Eligible Normal moves become Ice with 1.2x power, or 1.5x on Icy and Snowy Mountain fields.
froststalker.shortDesc: Attacks use double the offensive stat against targets that entered this turn.

frozenfeast.name: Frozen Feast
frozenfeast.desc: Biting moves have 1.5x power. Ice moves dealing opposing HP damage lower each surviving target's Speed by 1 after the whole move, once per target, unless that move already successfully lowered its Speed. Biting attacks drain one quarter of their actual opposing HP damage if that target had negative Speed stages before the attack began. Normal draining interactions apply.
frozenfeast.shortDesc: Ice HP hits lower Speed once; bites drain 25% against already-slowed foes.

frozenfortress.name: Frozen Fortress
frozenfortress.desc: Full local Ice Body heals in hail, snow and icy fields, prevents hail damage and may inflict frostbite on contact attackers. Crumbling Shell sets Stealth Rock after physical hits if that side has none, except on Water Surface, Underwater, Murkwater Surface and Swamp fields. Allied hits place it on the opposing side.
frozenfortress.shortDesc: Ice Body. Physical hits scatter Stealth Rock on the attacker’s side.

fruitfulbough.name: Fruitful Bough
fruitfulbough.desc: Harvest: at each turn end, has a 50% chance to restore its last consumed Berry or eligible field seed if it has no item; always restores in sun, Grassy Terrain or Flower Garden 2. Consuming its own Berry heals each active ally by 1/8 of that ally's max HP once per turn. The holder receives only the Berry's normal benefit. Removed, stolen or restored items and consumed seeds do not trigger ally healing.
fruitfulbough.shortDesc: Consuming its own Berry heals active allies 1/8 HP once/turn, excluding itself.

fullmetalbody.name: Full Metal Body
fullmetalbody.desc: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering its stat stages.
fullmetalbody.shortDesc: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering its stat stages.

funeralchoir.name: Funeral Choir
funeralchoir.desc: Damaging sound moves restore 1/32 max HP per currently fainted teammate, capped at 1/8 and once per turn. While a teammate is fainted, damaging Ghost moves also become sound moves, including sound interactions such as Soundproof and Substitute bypass.
funeralchoir.shortDesc: Sound hits heal per fainted ally; Ghost attacks become sound after an ally faints.

furnaceengine.name: Furnace Engine
furnaceengine.desc: Fire or Water HP hits give +6 Speed. Entry on Burning, Superheated or Volcanic gives +6 Speed; Dragon's Den, Volcanic and Cold Eclipse give +1 Defense and Sp. Def. Midnight Zone entry makes it Water-type. Water Surface, Underwater and Volcanic give +1 Speed each turn. Contact attackers have a 30% burn chance, or 60% on Volcanic; this cannot burn on Cold Eclipse. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn. Takes 20% less attack damage, or 40% less from super-effective attacks. If it dealt Fire- or Rock-type move damage to opposing HP that turn, at the end of the turn opposing Pokemon take Fire-type damage equal to 1/16 max HP, blocked by Fire immunities. Only in Free-for-All does Fire type effectiveness scale this chip.
furnaceengine.shortDesc: Fire/Water hits: +6 Speed. Contact burns, recovery, damage reduction and Fire chip.

galebloom.name: Gale Bloom
galebloom.desc: Full local Shield Dust blocks incoming move secondary effects on this Pokemon, while retaining effects on the attacker and primary move effects. Shield Dust follows normal ability bypass rules. Once per actual entry, its first Flying attack hit to damage a foe's HP raises its own Speed by 1 stage, even without an ally. Separately, its first such hit with a living adjacent ally raises the lowest HP-percentage adjacent ally's Sp. Atk by 1 stage. Multi-hit and spread moves do not multiply either boost. Misses, immunity, protection, Substitute-only damage, allied hits, status moves and residual damage do not trigger either boost. Suppression disables these effects without renewing spent boosts; ability restarts or reacquisition do not reset them. Actual reentry resets both boosts.
galebloom.shortDesc: Shield Dust; first Flying foe HP hit each entry gives +1 Speed and boosts an ally's Sp. Atk.

galewings.name: Gale Wings
galewings.desc: Flying moves gain +1 priority at 75% HP or more. During unsuppressed Strong Winds, all moves gain +1 priority at any HP.
galewings.shortDesc: Flying: +1 priority at 75%+ HP. In effective Strong Winds: all moves +1 priority at any HP.

galvanicspirit.name: Galvanic Spirit
galvanicspirit.desc: Prevents and cures sleep and blocks Yawn. Fighting attacks use 1.3x Attack or Sp. Atk through full local Vital Spirit. Moves whose actual category is Special and primary type is Electric gain 1.3x power, using ordinary Sp. Atk and Sp. Def. Static remains separate.
galvanicspirit.shortDesc: Vital Spirit; special Electric moves have 1.3x power.

galvanize.name: Galvanize
galvanize.desc: Eligible Normal moves become Electric and have 1.2x power, 1.5x on Factory or Electric Terrain, or 2x on Short-Circuit. Excludes moves whose type is set by their own effect, damaging Z-Moves and Terastallized Tera Blast.
galvanize.shortDesc: Normal moves become Electric with 1.2x power; field boosts.

garlandgift.name: Garland Gift
garlandgift.desc: Flower Veil, including its field effects. Once per entry, successful Floral Healing also clears the recipient's confusion and negative accuracy stages. Positive accuracy remains; failed healing does not spend the use.
garlandgift.shortDesc: First successful Floral Healing each entry clears recipient confusion and negative accuracy.

gemeye.name: Gem Eye
gemeye.desc: Prevents indirect damage. Prevents opposing accuracy drops, ignores evasion boosts and reveals opposing Illusions. Fairy Tale entry grants +1 Sp. Def; Mirror Arena entry grants +1 accuracy and Laser Focus. Does not reflect status moves.

gentlegiant.name: Gentle Giant
gentlegiant.desc: Cloud Nine suppresses weather effects and has its Rainbow Field random stat boost. Once per entry, gains one Sp. Atk stage when an adjacent ally survives an opposing attack that takes it from above half HP to half HP or less. No trigger from self-damage, allied attacks, indirect damage, or a KO. Normal boost rules apply.
gentlegiant.shortDesc: Once per entry, +1 Sp. Atk when an adjacent ally survives a foe hit crossing half HP.

gentlescales.name: Gentle Scales
gentlescales.desc: Moves have 1.3x accuracy. Mirror Arena entry gives +1 accuracy and Laser Focus. Once per turn, successfully healing an ally with Pollen Puff also cures that ally's major status. Failed or zero healing does not cure status.
gentlescales.shortDesc: Pollen Puff healing also cures an ally's major status once per turn.

gigavolt.name: Gigavolt
gigavolt.desc: Moves ignore bypassable opposing abilities. Redirects single-target Electric moves to itself and absorbs Electric moves for +1 Attack and Sp. Atk. Electric Terrain entry also grants both boosts. Contact attackers have a 30% paralysis chance, or 60% on Electric Terrain and Short-Circuit.

gildedgrace.name: Gilded Grace
gildedgrace.desc: Once per switch-in, it prevents the first Special Attack reduction caused by its own damaging move. The entire reduction is prevented. Opposing moves and status moves are unaffected. A reduction that cannot occur at -6 does not spend the use. Losing, regaining, or suppressing this Ability does not refresh it; switching out and back in does.
gildedgrace.shortDesc: Once per entry, prevents its first Sp. Atk drop from its own damaging move.

glacialheart.name: Glacial Heart
glacialheart.desc: Ice Body: contact attackers have a 30% frostbite chance; heals 1/16 max HP in hail/snow or qualifying cold fields, 1/8 in hail on Cold Eclipse; immune to hail damage. After dealing positive opposing HP damage with an Ice attack, prepares Dragon; Dragon damage prepares Ice. The next successful attack of the prepared type ignores positive Defense or Special Defense stages for its whole move, including every hit; negative stages remain. Preparation updates only after the move finishes, never stacks, and clears on switching. Misses, protection, immunity, Substitute-only damage, status moves and unrelated types do not change preparation. Suppression disables both preparation and its benefit without consuming stored preparation.
glacialheart.shortDesc: Ice Body; alternating Ice/Dragon hits bypass positive defensive stages.

glacialmass.name: Glacial Mass
glacialmass.desc: Heavy Metal + Thick Fat: doubles weight, halves physical attack damage, and halves the attacking stat of Fire- and Ice-type moves. Immune to hail damage. On entry to Factory Field, Defense rises one stage and Speed falls one stage. On Cold Eclipse, Defense and Sp. Def are 1.5x, the field Speed penalty is ignored, and hail heals 1/10 max HP each turn.
glacialmass.shortDesc: Halves physical and Fire/Ice damage; hail immunity.

glacialprime.name: Glacial Prime
glacialprime.desc: Full local Slush Rush and Refrigerate. Doubles Speed in hail, snow or on Icy, Snowy Mountain and Cold Eclipse. Eligible Normal moves become Ice with 1.2x power, or 1.5x on Icy/Snowy Mountain. Excludes moves with their own type-setting effect, damaging Z-Moves and Terastallized Tera Blast.

glacierbreaker.name: Glacier Breaker
glacierbreaker.desc: Mold Breaker. Damaging Ice moves remove Reflect, Light Screen and Aurora Veil before damage, following Brick Break rules.
glacierbreaker.shortDesc: Mold Breaker; damaging Ice moves break screens.

glacierclaws.name: Glacier Claws
glacierclaws.desc: Tough Claws: contact moves have 1.3x power. After a STAB attack damages opposing HP, clears its side’s entry hazards and its own Leech Seed and partial trapping. Cleanup occurs once after the whole attack and can repeat on later attacks; contact is not required.
glacierclaws.shortDesc: Tough Claws; STAB HP hits clear own hazards, Leech Seed and binding.

gluttony.name: Gluttony
gluttony.desc: Berries normally eaten at 1/4 HP activate at 1/2 HP instead.
gluttony.shortDesc: Low-HP Berries activate at half HP.

goldentalons.name: Golden Talons
goldentalons.desc: Moves cannot be redirected. On New World, Starlight Arena, Fairy Tale and Chessboard entry, gains +1 Sp. Atk. It is immune to Status moves. Slicing moves have 1.5x power, except on Cold Eclipse.

goodasgold.name: Good as Gold
goodasgold.desc: It is immune to Status moves.
goodasgold.shortDesc: It is immune to Status moves.

gooey.name: Gooey
gooey.desc: After an opposing damaging move hits, lowers the attacker's Speed by 2 stages, once per move. On Murkwater Surface the drop is 4 stages.
gooey.shortDesc: After an opposing damaging move hits, lowers its user's Speed by 2.

gorillatactics.name: Gorilla Tactics
gorillatactics.desc: Its Attack is multiplied by 1.5, but it can only select the first move it executes. These effects are prevented while it is Dynamaxed.
gorillatactics.shortDesc: Its Attack is 1.5x, but it can only select the first move it executes.

grandmaster.name: Grandmaster
grandmaster.desc: Automatically marks the target of a direct damaging Psychic move with Miracle Eye. Successful direct single-target attacks store a 90 BP Psychic special attack; opposing special HP damage stores a 90 BP special attack of the incoming type. Distinct qualifying attacks each queue a separate attack due two turns later, including against the same opponent. At most one stored attack releases per owner per turn; additional due attacks postpone to the next turn. Stored attacks snapshot its level, Special Attack, stages and typing, survive switching or fainting, and respect live target defenses. Independent of normal Future Sight. If its recorded slot has no living target when due, the same attack retries there next turn and remains queued until it can resolve or the battle ends. Full Inner Focus prevents flinching and Intimidate Attack drops. Immune to powder, sandstorm and hail. Takes 20% less attack damage on turns when it uses a status move. Its Psychic attacks ignore type resistances against foes that have not moved. Ordinary Miracle Eye utility remains.
grandmaster.shortDesc: Automatic Miracle Eye; one stored 90 BP attack after 2 turns.

grandstrategy.name: Grand Strategy
grandstrategy.desc: Mold Breaker. While the holder is active, its team's attacks dealing opposing HP damage prepare that foe for the holder. Its next physical HP-damaging attack consumes the mark after the whole attack, ignoring positive defensive stages and Reflect, Light Screen and Aurora Veil. That attack cannot rearm the mark. Marks do not stack, survive the holder switching out, and clear when the foe switches or faints, or the holder faints or loses this ability. Once per battle, an end-of-turn major-status cure clears negative accuracy stages and grants Laser Focus through the next turn; switching clears Laser Focus. Suppression delays the cure; other cures do not spend it.
grandstrategy.shortDesc: Mold Breaker; team hits prepare foes while active; once-battle cure grants Laser Focus.

graspingcurrent.name: Grasping Current
graspingcurrent.desc: Full local Suction Cups. After a damaging Water move, each surviving opposing target that lost HP has its Speed lowered by 1 once per whole move. Substitute-only damage does not qualify. Normal stat-drop protections apply; this is not a chance secondary.
graspingcurrent.shortDesc: Suction Cups; Water attacks lower damaged foes’ Speed once per move.

grasspelt.name: Grass Pelt
grasspelt.desc: Defense is 1.5x on Grassy and Forest fields. On Corrosive, loses 1/8 max HP each turn unless Poison- or Steel-type.
grasspelt.shortDesc: 1.5x Defense on Grassy/Forest; Corrosive damages non-Poison/Steel.

grassysurge.name: Grassy Surge
grassysurge.desc: On entry, creates Grassy Terrain for 5 turns, or 8 with Amplifield Rock, subject to field and Aura rules.

gravehunger.name: Grave Hunger
gravehunger.desc: Sleeping foes, including Comatose users, lose 1/8 max HP each turn. Disabled on Rainbow Field. Ghost attacks drain 25% of actual opposing HP damage, without adding drain to moves that already drain. While active, halves opposing active Pokemon's healing and gains the HP actually prevented. Combined new healing is capped at 1/8 max HP per turn; opposing healing stays reduced when it is full or capped. Bench healing and switching-out Regenerator are unaffected. Normal healing blockers and drain interactions apply.
gravehunger.shortDesc: Ghost HP hits drain 25%; halves foe healing and takes prevented HP (combined cap 1/8 per turn).

gravewind.name: Gravewind
gravewind.desc: Doubles Speed in sandstorm or on Desert and Ashen Beach. Immune to sandstorm damage. Entering directly into a fainted teammate's slot summons sandstorm for 3 turns. Does not shorten or refresh an existing sandstorm.
gravewind.shortDesc: Entering a fainted ally's slot summons sand for 3 turns.

greatmarsh.name: Great Marsh
greatmarsh.desc: On entry, reveals opposing Illusions and alerts to an opposing super-effective or OHKO move. If no threat is found, Psychic Terrain grants +2 Sp. Atk. Absorbs Water moves for 1/4 max HP; incoming Fire moves have 1.25x power. Effective rain heals 1/8 HP per turn; sun costs 1/8. Field healing per turn: 1/16 on Underwater, Swamp, Misty or grounded Water Surface; 1/8 when grounded and Poison-type on Murkwater. Corrosive Mist heals Poison types by 1/8 but damages non-Steel others by 1/8. Desert costs 1/8 HP per turn. Same-type attack bonus becomes 2x instead of 1.5x, or 2.25x instead of a 2x bonus. Its attacks have a 30% chance of badly poisoning. This effect comes before a move's inherent secondary effect chance. Its Anticipation component: Checks each active opponent separately when the holder enters, and rechecks each incoming opponent on every switch-in, including repeat entries. Allies are not checked, and initial checks do not trigger twice. Each check retains its usual Psychic Terrain bonus condition and latest-warned-move protection.
greatmarsh.shortDesc: Reveals threats; rain/field healing; stronger STAB; hits may badly poison.

grimneigh.name: Grim Neigh
grimneigh.desc: Its Special Attack is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and knocks out another Pokemon.
grimneigh.shortDesc: Its Sp. Atk is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and KOes another Pokemon.

gritgrappler.name: Grit Grappler
gritgrappler.desc: Attack is 1.5x while statused, and burn does not weaken physical attacks. While statused, damaging a foe with a Fighting move restores 1/16 max HP once per turn.
gritgrappler.shortDesc: While statused, damaging Fighting hits heal 1/16 HP once per turn.

groundingtail.name: Grounding Tail
groundingtail.desc: Electric moves treat each Ground typing as a resistance instead of an immunity, retaining all other type factors, and cause no move recoil. Water/Ground takes neutral damage; Ground/Dragon takes quarter damage. Absorption abilities still block them, and incoming Ground attacks are unchanged.
groundingtail.shortDesc: Electric moves have no recoil and treat Ground immunity as resistance.

guarddog.name: Guard Dog
guarddog.desc: Cannot be forced out by opposing moves or items. Intimidate raises Attack by 1 instead of lowering it.
guarddog.shortDesc: Blocks forced switching; Intimidate gives +1 Attack.

guardianpresence.name: Guardian Presence
guardianpresence.desc: Allies take 25% less attack damage; this does not protect the holder. Allies moves have 1.3x power, or 1.5x on Haunted, Bewitched Woods, Holy and Psychic fields. Does not boost the holder.

guidinggallop.name: Guiding Gallop
guidinggallop.desc: Pastel Veil, including poison prevention/cures for itself and allies, opposing Poison-move Attack/Sp. Atk drops and field effects. A successful status move directly targeting another ally also clears that ally's negative Speed stages, preserving positive Speed. Self-targeting and side-wide or field moves do not trigger it.
guidinggallop.shortDesc: Successful status moves directly targeting an ally clear that ally's negative Speed.

guidingglow.name: Guiding Glow
guidingglow.desc: Illuminate reveals opposing Illusion, ignores evasion and prevents opposing accuracy drops, retaining Mirror Arena and Starlight entry effects. Sweet Veil prevents sleep and Yawn on the holder and allies, including Rest, without curing sleep. Its Starlight ally Spotlight does not duplicate Fairy Ring.

guidinglight.name: Guiding Light
guidinglight.desc: Blocks opposing priority moves aimed at its side. Each turn, has a 30% chance to cure each adjacent ally's major status. Successfully using Spotlight on an ally makes that ally take 20% less attack damage for the rest of the turn. Does not stack or change Spotlight redirection rules.
guidinglight.shortDesc: Successful Spotlight on an ally reduces its attack damage taken 20% this turn.

gulpmissile.name: Gulp Missile
gulpmissile.desc: If it is a Cramorant, it changes forme when it hits a target with Surf or uses the first turn of Dive successfully. It becomes Gulping Form with an Arrokuda in its mouth if it has more than 1/2 of its max HP remaining, or Gorging Form with a Pikachu in its mouth if it has 1/2 or less of its max HP remaining. If Cramorant gets hit in Gulping or Gorging Form, it spits the Arrokuda or Pikachu at its attacker, even if it has no HP remaining. The projectile deals damage equal to 1/4 of the target's max HP, rounded down; this damage is blocked by the Magic Guard Ability but not by a substitute. An Arrokuda also lowers the target's Defense by 1 stage, and a Pikachu paralyzes the target. Cramorant will return to normal if it spits out a projectile, switches out, or Dynamaxes. Species passive on all three Cramorant forms, replacing Gluttony; works independently of the selected ability and preserves it through loading and discharge. Water Surface/Underwater force Gulping on entry or terrain change; Electric/Factory/Short-Circuit make Surf load Gorging. Underwater projectile damage is quarter target max HP multiplied by ordinary Water effectiveness (zero if Water-immune); other fields keep the ordinary quarter-HP projectile.
gulpmissile.shortDesc: Surf/Dive loads a counterattack: 1/4 attacker HP plus -1 Defense or paralysis. Field variants.

guts.name: Guts
guts.desc: Attack is 1.5x while statused, and burn does not weaken physical attacks.
guts.shortDesc: 1.5x Attack while statused; ignores burn attack penalty.

hadronengine.name: Hadron Engine
hadronengine.desc: On switch-in, summons Electric Terrain. During Electric Terrain, Sp. Atk is 1.3333x.
hadronengine.shortDesc: On switch-in, summons Electric Terrain. During Electric Terrain, Sp. Atk is 1.3333x.

hardyskin.name: Hardy Skin
hardyskin.desc: Prevents and cures sleep. Effective rain heals 1/8 max HP per turn; effective sun costs 1/8. Move KOs give +1 Attack.
hardyskin.shortDesc: No sleep; rain heals 1/8 HP per turn, sun costs 1/8; move KOs give +1 Attack.

harvest.name: Harvest
harvest.desc: At turn end with an empty item slot, has a 50% chance to restore its last consumed Berry or field seed. Guaranteed in sun or on Grassy Field and Stage 2 Flower Garden.
harvest.shortDesc: 50% chance to restore a consumed Berry/seed each turn.

hauntedchime.name: Haunted Chime
hauntedchime.desc: Airborne: immune to Ground attacks and grounded hazards unless grounded. Absorbs wind moves for +1 Sp. Atk. Gains +1 Sp. Atk when Tailwind starts on its side or it enters during Tailwind. Strong Winds gives +1 Attack and Sp. Atk each turn. Damaging attacks have a 30% chance to be disabled, guaranteed on Haunted and disabled on Holy Field. Excludes Max moves, delayed attacks and Struggle. On fainting, curses all active foes.

hauntingpresence.name: Haunting Presence
hauntingpresence.desc: Levitate: airborne with normal Ground and grounded-hazard immunity. Hex doubles its power against major status or Comatose, or if the target has Taunt, Encore, Disable or Heal Block. These conditions grant only one doubling.
hauntingpresence.shortDesc: Hex also doubles against Taunt, Encore, Disable or Heal Block, without stacking.

hauntingveil.name: Haunting Veil
hauntingveil.desc: Cursed Body + Infiltrator. Damaging hits have a 30% chance to Disable the attacker's move, guaranteed on Haunted Terrain and blocked on Holy Terrain; Disable, Max moves, future moves and Struggle are excluded. On fainting, curses each surviving foe. Moves bypass Substitute, Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil, Safeguard and Mist.

headlongresolve.name: Headlong Resolve
headlongresolve.desc: Full local Reckless boosts recoil, crash and listed explosive moves and has its Chessboard effects. Recoil-listed moves ignore positive defensive stages; negative stages still apply.
headlongresolve.shortDesc: Reckless; recoil moves ignore positive defensive stages.

healer.name: Healer
healer.desc: 30% chance its ally has its non-volatile status condition cured at turn end.
healer.shortDesc: 30% chance its ally has its status cured at turn end.

heatcoil.name: Heat Coil
heatcoil.desc: Speed Boost and Long Reach. Long Reach removes contact. Has the current modified Magma Armor package: cures freeze, and incoming Water/Ice attacks use half the offensive stat; this is not an upgrade to full Magma Armor. No new binding effect.
heatcoil.shortDesc: Speed Boost + Long Reach; modified Magma Armor; Flame Body passive is separate.

heatproof.name: Heatproof
heatproof.desc: Incoming Fire attacks use half the attacker's offensive stat. Burn damage is halved.
heatproof.shortDesc: Half Fire attacking stats and burn damage.

heatreservoir.name: Heat Reservoir
heatreservoir.desc: Absorbs Fire moves and gains a 1.5x Fire boost until switching out or losing the ability. Burning Field or grounded Volcanic Field also grants the boost. On Cold Eclipse, Fire absorption is disabled and entry gives +1 Defense and Sp. Def. After a boosted Armor Cannon deals damage, consumes the Flash Fire charge to prevent Armor Cannon's own Defense and Sp. Def drops.
heatreservoir.shortDesc: A boosted Armor Cannon avoids its own defensive drops.

heavenlychorus.name: Heavenly Chorus
heavenlychorus.desc: Takes half contact damage and double Fire damage; contact Fire attacks deal normal damage. Switching out cures status and heals 1/8 max HP only if a status was cured. Bewitched Woods cures status at turn end without this heal.

heavyartillery.name: Heavy Artillery
heavyartillery.desc: Ignores target Defense/Sp. Def/evasion stages when attacking, and attacker Attack/Defense/Sp. Atk/accuracy stages when defending. Reveals opposing Illusions on entry. Damaging pulse and bullet moves have double power and hit all foes in Doubles and Free-for-All. In Free-for-All, the designated primary target takes full damage and other foes take half their otherwise-calculated damage; protection or immunity of the primary does not promote another target. If no valid primary is supplied, the first active foe in side order is selected. Positive opposing pulse/bullet HP damage breaks that side's Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil, Atlantis Wall and Arenite Wall. Starts Neutral with no defensive contribution. At the end of a turn without executing a damaging move, becomes Loaded: +1 effective Defense and Sp. Def stage. Any damaging move reaching execution becomes Fired before hit resolution: -1 effective Defense and Sp. Def stage, including misses, protection and immunity. Each state replaces the previous state and never stacks. Ordinary boosts remain separate; effective stages stay within -6 to +6. Status moves, charging, recharge and inability to act count as idle turns. Switching, Haze, Clear Smog, defensive stage replacement and ability replacement clear the state to Neutral. Simple and Contrary do not alter these contributions. Suppression pauses the contribution and prevents loading; an existing state still becomes Fired when attacking. No screen removal on Substitute-only damage or failed hits.

heavymetal.name: Heavy Metal
heavymetal.desc: Doubles weight and halves physical attack damage. Factory entry gives +1 Defense and -1 Speed.
heavymetal.shortDesc: Double weight; half physical damage; Factory stat changes.

helios.name: Helios
helios.desc: On entry, it summons harsh sunlight. Its moves ignore opposing Abilities. Berserk raises its Special Attack by one stage when an attack leaves it at half HP or less, and by two stages on entry in Dragon's Den. Swift Swim doubles its Speed in rain, Water Surface, Murkwater Surface, Underwater, or Midnight Zone.
helios.shortDesc: On entry, it summons harsh sunlight. Its moves ignore opposing Abilities.

hellfireeclipse.name: Hellfire Eclipse
hellfireeclipse.desc: On entry, lowers adjacent foes Attack by 1 under normal Intimidate rules. Dark Aura boosts all damaging Dark moves by 4/3, or multiplies them by 0.75 with Aura Break; multiple users do not stack. Immune to hail damage on Cold Eclipse. After a damaging Fire move finishes, Agony Flame burns each surviving active opponent that lost HP and applies Heal Block for 2 turns including the current turn. Normal protections apply; longer Heal Block is preserved and a move burn cured by a Berry is not reapplied.

herdshelter.name: Herd Shelter
herdshelter.desc: Immune to other Pokemon's sound moves. Adjacent allies are also immune to opposing damaging sound moves.
herdshelter.shortDesc: Adjacent allies are immune to opposing damaging sound moves.

hiddenscroll.name: Hidden Scroll
hiddenscroll.desc: Once per switch-in in doubles, a successful single-target status move aimed at a foe also attempts the move against the other adjacent foe. Each target independently respects accuracy, protection, immunity and reflection. Excludes moves that call other moves.
hiddenscroll.shortDesc: In doubles, its first single-target status move each entry also targets the other foe.

highnoon.name: High Noon
highnoon.desc: Pulse and bullet moves have 1.5x power. Eligible slicing, pulse, bullet, horn, drill, and Arrow moves normally hit twice at 60% power, each with its own accuracy check. If an offensive ability power or damage multiplier applies, the first hit retains its full ability boosts and the second uses 15% of original move power without those offensive ability multipliers. Stat multipliers, items, STAB and ordinary weather or field modifiers remain separate. In Free-for-All, the second hit targets another random living foe when possible; Siege Launcher retains its full-power pair. Existing multi-hit moves do not gain an extra pair. Damaging moves cannot miss; Water moves gain another 1.2x power. Gains one critical-hit stage against a newly switched target or one without a successful action this turn.
highnoon.shortDesc: Accurate attacks; stronger pulse/bullet and Water moves; eligible moves hit twice.

hisuianoath.name: Hisuian Oath
hisuianoath.desc: On entry, heals each adjacent ally by 1/4 max HP, or 1/3 on Fairy Tale. Contact moves have 1.3x power. Can poison Poison and Steel types; Poison moves bypass Steel immunity. Newly poisoned foes lose 1 Defense and Sp. Def. On Wasteland, move secondary effects become separate 2.5% frostbite, burn, paralysis and poison chances. On Corrosive and Corrosive Mist, incoming damage is multiplied by 1.5.
hisuianoath.shortDesc: On entry, heals each adjacent ally by 1/4 max HP, or 1/3 on Fairy Tale.

hisuianpath.name: Hisuian Path
hisuianpath.desc: Absorbs Grass moves for +1 Attack and Sp. Atk; allied Grass moves also grant both boosts. Heals 1/8 max HP each turn on Forest and 1/16 on Grassy Field. Prevents flinching and Intimidate's Attack drop. Takes half damage from contact attacks and double damage from Fire attacks; contact Fire attacks deal normal damage.
hisuianpath.shortDesc: Absorbs Grass moves for +1 Attack and Sp. Atk; allied Grass moves also grant both boosts.

hisuianresolve.name: Hisuian Resolve
hisuianresolve.desc: Recoil and crash moves, Explosion, Self-Destruct and Misty Explosion have 1.2x power; Struggle is excluded. On Chessboard, all moves gain a further 1.2x power. Prevents move recoil except Struggle. Crash and Life Orb damage still apply. Prevents freezing outside Cold Eclipse and cures freeze. Incoming Water and Ice attacks use half the attacker's offensive stat. Dragon's Den blocks Fire moves. On Dragon's Den, Volcanic or Cold Eclipse entry, gains +1 Defense and Sp. Def.
hisuianresolve.shortDesc: No move recoil except Struggle; field defenses.

hisuianvanguard.name: Hisuian Vanguard
hisuianvanguard.desc: On its first active turn, its Speed is 1.5x and its Sp. Atk is 1.2x. Prevents flinching and Attack drops from Intimidate.

hivecourier.name: Hive Courier
hivecourier.desc: Once per entry, a damaging Bug-type pivot that deals opposing HP damage clears its side's entry hazards when its switch succeeds, before the replacement enters. Grants the replacement and active allies a nonstacking guard reducing their next whole damaging move by 25%, including every hit. The guard expires at the end of the following turn or on switching. Failed and forced pivots do not activate it; no hazards are required.
hivecourier.shortDesc: Successful Bug pivot clears hazards; replacement and active allies guard the next move by 25%.

hivesanctuary.name: Hive Sanctuary
hivesanctuary.desc: Sweet Veil prevents sleep and Yawn on the holder and its allies, including Rest, without curing sleep. Friend Guard reduces attack damage to allies by 25%; it does not reduce damage to the holder.

holycow.name: Holy Cow
holycow.desc: On its first entry each battle, it attempts to create Holy Field for 5 turns; it cannot refresh an existing Holy Field or bypass a protected field. Once per actual entry, Milk Drink that restores HP also cures its status. Ability changes do not reset this cure.
holycow.shortDesc: First entry: Holy Field for 5 turns. Once per entry, healing Milk Drink cures status.

hospitality.name: Hospitality
hospitality.desc: On entry, heals each adjacent ally by 1/4 of that ally's max HP.
hospitality.shortDesc: Entry heals adjacent allies by 1/4 HP.

hovercannon.name: Hover Cannon
hovercannon.desc: Airborne: immune to Ground attacks, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web and Arena Trap unless grounded. Thousand Arrows can still hit. Above half HP, damaging Electric moves cannot miss or be redirected. Type and ability immunities still apply.
hovercannon.shortDesc: Above half HP, Electric attacks cannot miss or be redirected.

hungerswitch.name: Hunger Switch
hungerswitch.desc: If it is a Morpeko, it changes formes between its Belly Mode and Hangry Mode at turn end.
hungerswitch.shortDesc: If Morpeko, it changes between Belly and Hangry Mode at turn end.

hustle.name: Hustle
hustle.desc: Attack is 1.5x, but physical moves have 0.8x accuracy.

hydrabond.name: Hydra Bond
hydrabond.desc: Eligible single-target attacks hit three times. In singles and doubles, native variable multi-hit moves use their maximum hit count, keeping native per-hit accuracy and damage. Remaining native hits can continue into another living opposing active Pokemon after a KO at 70% damage. Excludes non-FFA spread, charge, delayed, Z/Max and extra-hit-barred moves. Follow-ups deal 30% damage, retargeting another living opposing active Pokemon after a KO. In FFA, single-target moves hit all foes at 1.3x power; spread moves hit all foes three times with 30% follow-ups. Full-power spread stays full power. Moves have 1.2x power on Dragon's Den. Gilded Helix is the exception: three full 50-power hits in every format, with all-foes targeting in Free-for-All; suppression restores its native two hits.
hydrabond.shortDesc: Eligible attacks hit 3 times; maximizes variable hits in singles/doubles; chains after KOs.

hydraflight.name: Hydra Flight
hydraflight.desc: Full local Levitate and Hydra Bond. Ground immunity can be bypassed normally; Hydra Bond remains active. Eligible attacks retain three hits, 30% follow-ups, spread and Free-for-All rules, the full-power Gilded Helix exception and Dragon Den power boost.

hydraheart.name: Hydra Heart
hydraheart.desc: Each opposing attack hit that damages HP heals 1/16 base max HP; the first such hit each turn gives +1 Defense. Full local Hydra Bond has its multihit, Free-for-All and field effects.

hydration.name: Hydration
hydration.desc: Cures major status at turn end in effective rain or on Water Surface, Underwater and Midnight Zone.
hydration.shortDesc: Cures status each turn in rain or water fields.

hydraulicarmor.name: Hydraulic Armor
hydraulicarmor.desc: Stamina. Water Pulse and Hydro Pump use higher boosted Defense or Sp. Atk, remaining Special against Sp. Def. Successful Withdraw uses one free Water Pulse at the corresponding opposing slot, falling back to the first living legal adjacent foe. Protect fires one Water Pulse at the surviving active attacker after the first opposing damaging attack it fully blocks that turn; no trigger from Z/Max chip or generated attacks. Shelter has no attack. A Skull Bash opposing HP strike uses one Hydro Pump at the same surviving active foe after the whole attack. All follow-ups require a living active holder, use no PP, cannot recurse, and retain normal accuracy, protection, immunity and effects.
hydraulicarmor.shortDesc: Stamina; Withdraw/Protect fire Water Pulse; Skull Bash fires Hydro Pump.

hydroelectric.name: Hydroelectric
hydroelectric.desc: Dealing Water-move HP damage has the once-per-turn 1/8 max HP healing. Once per entry, after a Water attack finishes dealing actual opposing HP damage, gains +1 Speed. Multiple hits and targets grant only one boost; allies, Substitute-only damage, misses, protection and absorption do not qualify. Ability changes do not refresh the entry allowance.
hydroelectric.shortDesc: Water HP hits heal 1/8 once/turn; first Water attack to damage a foe grants +1 Speed afterward.

hypercutter.name: Hyper Cutter
hypercutter.desc: Other Pokemon cannot lower its Attack.
hypercutter.shortDesc: Other Pokemon cannot lower its Attack.

hyperdrill.name: Hyper Drill
hyperdrill.desc: Full Power Drill boosts drill and horn moves by 1.5x, or 2x on Rocky, Mountain, Snowy Mountain, Cave and Volcanic fields, where they also bypass protection. Drill and horn moves ignore positive defensive stages. Native Power Drill applies once.
hyperdrill.shortDesc: Power Drill; drill/horn moves ignore positive defensive stages.

iceabsorb.name: Ice Absorb
iceabsorb.desc: It is immune to Ice-type moves and restores 1/4 of its max HP when hit by an Ice-type move.
iceabsorb.shortDesc: It is immune to Ice and heals 1/4 when hit by Ice.

icebody.name: Ice Body
icebody.desc: Contact attackers have a 30% chance of frostbite. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn in hail or snow, or on Icy, Snowy Mountain and Cold Eclipse without those weathers; hail on Cold Eclipse heals 1/8 instead. Immune to hail damage.
icebody.shortDesc: 30% contact frostbite; heals in icy weather/fields; no hail damage.

icebreaker.name: Icebreaker
icebreaker.desc: Hyper Cutter prevents other Pokemon from lowering its Attack. Ice Hammer removes opposing Reflect before damage, including through Substitute, but not on protection, a miss or immunity. Its Speed drop is unchanged.
icebreaker.shortDesc: Ice Hammer breaks Reflect before damage and keeps its Speed drop.

iceface.name: Ice Face
iceface.desc: If it is an Eiscue, the first physical hit it takes in battle deals 0 neutral damage. Its ice face is then broken and it changes forme to Noice Face. Eiscue regains its Ice Face forme when Snow begins or when Eiscue switches in while Snow is active. Confusion damage also breaks the ice face.
iceface.shortDesc: If Eiscue, the first physical hit it takes deals 0 damage. Effect is restored in Snow.

icemirror.name: Ice Mirror
icemirror.desc: Once per switch-in, the first opposing direct hit deals 25% less damage and lowers the attacker's Speed by 1 stage.
icemirror.shortDesc: First direct hit per entry deals 25% less damage and lowers the attacker’s Speed.

icescales.name: Ice Scales
icescales.desc: Takes half damage from special attacks and is immune to hail damage. Mirror Arena entry gives +2 evasion. Icy and Snowy Mountain neutralize weaknesses from its Ice typing. Cold Eclipse doubles Defense.
icescales.shortDesc: Half special damage; no hail damage; icy-field defenses.

illuminate.name: Illuminate
illuminate.desc: Prevents other Pokemon's accuracy drops and ignores evasion boosts. Reveals opposing Illusions on activation. Mirror Arena entry lowers foes' accuracy by 1. Starlight Arena entry gives +2 Sp. Atk and puts Spotlight on its first adjacent ally.
illuminate.shortDesc: No opposing accuracy drops; ignores evasion; reveals Illusions.

illusion.name: Illusion
illusion.desc: Disguises itself as a teammate without copying mechanical traits. The optional Initial Disguise teammate is used on the holder’s first entry only; if unavailable, normal automatic selection applies. Auto and later entries use the last eligible healthy teammate in battle order. Direct damaging hits and normal reveal effects, including opposing Mind’s Eye, break the disguise. Types, STAB, abilities and passives are not copied.
illusion.shortDesc: Teammate disguise only; optional initial teammate, then Auto.

immunity.name: Immunity
immunity.desc: It cannot be poisoned. Gaining this Ability while poisoned cures it.
immunity.shortDesc: It cannot be poisoned. Gaining this Ability while poisoned cures it.

imperialmandate.name: Imperial Mandate
imperialmandate.desc: Outside boosted fields: at 50% HP or higher, attacks have 2x power; below 50%, Speed is doubled. On Fairy Tale, Chessboard, New World, Starlight Arena, and Cold Eclipse: at 50% HP or higher, grants +1 Defense and Special Defense with no attack boost; below 50%, removes its granted defense stages and grants 1.5x attack power and double Speed. Field defense stages do not stack and are removed on leaving these fields.
imperialmandate.shortDesc: At half HP or more: power boost. Below half: Speed boost. Certain fields change the bonuses.

imperialprincess.name: Imperial Princess
imperialprincess.desc: Full local Striker and Vital Spirit, Fighting STAB and protection against Poison/Steel targeting its Fairy type. Kicks ignore positive Defense stages only when the attack actually uses Defense; negative stages, screens and defensive abilities remain. Once per genuine entry, the first directly selected kick damaging opposing HP lowers that first surviving foe's Defense by 1 after the whole move. Kicks with their own native Defense drop neither trigger nor spend this use. Normal stat-drop protections and reflections apply; a blocked attempt spends the use. Substitute-only, allied and generated attacks do not qualify.
imperialprincess.shortDesc: Striker + Vital Spirit; kicks ignore raised Defense; first qualifying kick per entry lowers Defense.

imposter.name: Imposter
imposter.desc: On switch-in, it Transforms into the opposing Pokemon that is facing it. If there is no Pokemon at that position, it does not Transform.
imposter.shortDesc: On switch-in, it Transforms into the opposing Pokemon that is facing it.

inexorable.name: Inexorable
inexorable.desc: Its attacks have 1.3x power if its target has not moved yet or is switching out.
inexorable.shortDesc: 1.3x power against targets that have not moved or are switching.

infernaldominion.name: Infernal Dominion
infernaldominion.desc: Has Intimidate. Does not generate Fire Spin or trap foes. Incoming Rock attack effectiveness is capped at neutral, preserving stronger resistance or immunity. Prevents only this holder's Stealth Rock damage without removing the hazard. A direct Fire attack dealing opposing HP damage clears Sandstorm and, once per turn regardless of weather, grants Molten Guard until turn end. The guard blocks the next opposing Rock attack against this holder, including all hits, without shielding other spread targets. Generated attacks do not arm it. Leaving, ability loss and Mega Evolution clear the guard.
infernaldominion.shortDesc: Intimidate; Molten Guard; Rock effectiveness capped at neutral; melts own Stealth Rock damage.

infiltrator.name: Infiltrator
infiltrator.desc: Moves bypass Substitute, Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil, Safeguard and Mist.
infiltrator.shortDesc: Moves bypass Substitute and opposing screens.

innardsout.name: Innards Out
innardsout.desc: If it is knocked out with a move, that move's user loses HP equal to the amount of damage inflicted on it.
innardsout.shortDesc: If it is KOed with a move, that move's user loses an equal amount of HP.

innerfocus.name: Inner Focus
innerfocus.desc: Prevents flinching and Intimidate's Attack drop.

insight.name: Insight
insight.desc: Full local Ultra Ego, Telepathy and Inner Focus. Ultra Ego supplies its attack power, whole-attack recovery, defensive triggers and field interactions. Telepathy prevents allied damaging moves and doubles Speed on Psychic Terrain or Psychic Aura. Inner Focus prevents flinching and Intimidate.

insomnia.name: Insomnia
insomnia.desc: Prevents and cures sleep, blocks Yawn, and gives Dark and Ghost attacks 1.3x power.
insomnia.shortDesc: No sleep or Yawn; 1.3x Dark/Ghost power.

intimidate.name: Intimidate
intimidate.desc: On entry, lowers adjacent foes' Attack by 1. Substitute and Intimidate protections still apply.
intimidate.shortDesc: Entry lowers adjacent foes' Attack by 1.

intrepidsword.name: Intrepid Sword
intrepidsword.desc: On switch-in, its Attack is raised by 1 stage. Once per battle.
intrepidsword.shortDesc: On switch-in, its Attack is raised by 1 stage. Once per battle.

inversion.name: Inversion
inversion.desc: Sets Inverse Field on entry. Infiltrator bypasses Substitute and opposing screens. Hypnosis bypasses accuracy checks while this ability is active; protection and sleep immunities still apply.
inversion.shortDesc: Sets Inverse Field; Infiltrator; Hypnosis bypasses accuracy. Contrary is separate.

invigorate.name: Invigorate
invigorate.desc: Healing received by it and its allies is multiplied by 1.3. At turn end, it has a 50% chance to cure each adjacent ally's status condition.
invigorate.shortDesc: User/allies receive 1.3x healing; 50% to cure ally status each turn.

invisiblewall.name: Invisible Wall
invisiblewall.desc: Once per entry, when its Wide Guard actually blocks an opposing damaging attack, sets five-turn Safeguard on its own side. Using Wide Guard without blocking an attack gives no reward.
invisiblewall.shortDesc: Its first Wide Guard block each entry sets five-turn Safeguard.

ironbarbs.name: Iron Barbs
ironbarbs.desc: Contact attackers lose 1/8 of their max HP.

ironclamp.name: Iron Clamp
ironclamp.desc: Full local Battle Armor. After an opposing contact move damages its HP, lowers the attacker’s Speed by 1 once after the whole move. Normal stat-drop protections apply.
ironclamp.shortDesc: Battle Armor; opposing contact HP damage lowers attacker Speed once per move.

irondominion.name: Iron Dominion
irondominion.desc: On entry or G-Max activation, it activates Pressure and Mirror Armor's effects and heals its ally like Sworn Duty. Outside Cold Eclipse, its Defense and Sp. Def drop is attempted only once per opposing Pokemon per battle for each Pressure user. Switching, Transform and ability loss or regain do not reset that allowance; a blocked or reflected attempt spends it. Cold Eclipse retains repeatable -2 drops on entry and neither spends nor resets the ordinary allowance.
irondominion.shortDesc: Entry and Gigantamax activation trigger its stat effects and ally healing.

ironlash.name: Iron Lash
ironlash.desc: On entry, it gains +1 accuracy. Its Tail moves have their power multiplied by 1.5. Gains +1 accuracy on entry and tail moves have 1.5x power. Once per turn, damaging a foe with a tail move also raises its Sp. Def by 1 stage.
ironlash.shortDesc: Tail hits raise Sp. Def once per turn.

ironmountain.name: Iron Mountain
ironmountain.desc: Hyper Cutter + Brute Force. Entry clears its side’s Stealth Rock and Spikes after hazards take effect. Mega Evolution also clears them; ability restarts do not.
ironmountain.shortDesc: Hyper Cutter + Brute Force; entry or Mega Evolution clears own Stealth Rock/Spikes.

ironvise.name: Iron Vise
ironvise.desc: Contact moves have 1.3x power. Once per switch-in, the first opposing direct hit deals 25% less damage and lowers the attacker's Attack by 1 stage. Multi-hit moves spend this protection on the first hit.

ironwill.name: Iron Will
ironwill.desc: Takes 20% less attack damage, plus a further 25% reduction against super-effective attacks or on Crystal Cavern and Dark Crystal Cavern (40% total). Defense and Sp. Def are 4/3x on Cold Eclipse, Dark Crystal Cavern and Rainbow. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn. Immune to sandstorm and hail damage. Gains +1 accuracy on entry; tail moves have 1.5x power.

islandcurrent.name: Island Current
islandcurrent.desc: Doubles Speed in rain or on Water Surface, Murkwater Surface, Underwater and Midnight Zone. Absorbs wind moves for +1 Attack. Gains +1 Attack when Tailwind starts on its side or it enters during Tailwind. Strong Winds gives +1 Attack and Sp. Atk each turn.
islandcurrent.shortDesc: Double Speed in rain and water fields; Tailwind/Strong Winds raise Attack.

joyride.name: Joyride
joyride.desc: Eligible Normal moves become Flying and gain 1.2x power. On its first active turn, Speed is 1.5x and Attack is 1.2x. Fighting attacks retain 1.3x Attack or Sp. Atk.
joyride.shortDesc: Aerilate + Violent Rush; Fighting attacks use 1.3x Attack or Sp. Atk.

justified.name: Justified
justified.desc: Its Attack is raised by 1 stage after it is damaged by a Dark-type move.
justified.shortDesc: Its Attack is raised by 1 stage after it is damaged by a Dark-type move.

keeneye.name: Keen Eye
keeneye.desc: Prevents other Pokemon's accuracy drops and ignores evasion boosts. Reveals opposing Illusions on activation. Mirror Arena entry gives +1 accuracy and Laser Focus.
keeneye.shortDesc: No opposing accuracy drops; ignores evasion; reveals Illusions.

keenhunt.name: Keen Hunt
keenhunt.desc: Full local Keen Eye prevents opposing accuracy drops, ignores evasion boosts and reveals opposing Illusions; Mirror Arena entry grants +1 accuracy and Laser Focus. Rock attacks ignore positive Defense stages against opponents at half HP or less. Negative Defense stages remain.
keenhunt.shortDesc: Keen Eye; Rock attacks ignore positive Defense against foes at half HP or less.

keystoneseal.name: Keystone Seal
keystoneseal.desc: Cursed Body + continuous Imprison using its current moveset. Blocks opposing forced switches. Suppression disables the seal.
keystoneseal.shortDesc: Cursed Body; continuous Imprison; blocks opposing forced switches.

kickfiend.name: Kick Fiend
kickfiend.desc: Full local Striker and Limber, including field behavior.

klutz.name: Klutz
klutz.desc: Its held item has no effect. It cannot use Fling successfully. Macho Brace, Power Anklet, Power Band, Power Belt, Power Bracer, Power Lens, and Power Weight still have their effects.
klutz.shortDesc: Its held item has no effect, except Macho Brace. Fling cannot be used.

knightsguard.name: Knight's Guard
knightsguard.desc: On entry, heals adjacent allies by 1/4 max HP, or 1/3 on Fairy Tale. Once per turn, a damaging move dealing opposing HP damage grants the first living adjacent ally without a guard 25% protection against its next opposing attack, covering all hits. The guard cannot stack and expires at the end of the following turn.
knightsguard.shortDesc: Sworn Duty; opposing HP damage earns an adjacent ally a 25% attack guard once per turn.

knightsreprisal.name: Knight's Reprisal
knightsreprisal.desc: Bulletproof: immune to bullet and pulse moves; takes 20% less attack damage. Successfully blocking an opposing damaging move with Spiky Shield stores one nonstacking charge: the next damaging move gains +1 priority. Using that move or switching consumes the charge. Normal priority blockers apply.
knightsreprisal.shortDesc: Blocking an attack with Spiky Shield grants the next damaging move +1 priority.

knuckletide.name: Knuckle Tide
knuckletide.desc: Punching moves have 1.4x power. After a punch damages a foe, the next physical or special Water-type attack to damage a foe ignores positive Defense or Sp. Def stat stages, respectively. A miss or Water-type status move does not spend the charge.
knuckletide.shortDesc: A damaging punch lets the next Water hit ignore positive defensive stages.

lanceguard.name: Lanceguard
lanceguard.desc: Prevents critical hits and takes 20% less attack damage. Gains +1 Defense on Fairy Tale or Dragon's Den entry and +2 Sp. Def when a foe lowers its stats. Blocking a contact move with Protect lowers the attacker's Defense by 1 stage.
lanceguard.shortDesc: Blocking contact with Protect lowers the attacker’s Defense by 1.

lancepoint.name: Lance Point
lancepoint.desc: Drill moves gain one critical-hit stage and do not make contact. Critical-hit prevention still applies.
