lancepoint.shortDesc: Drill moves gain +1 critical-hit stage and make no contact.

lastbrood.name: Last Brood
lastbrood.desc: Swarm. Once per entry after surviving a whole opposing attack that deals HP damage, creates a free Substitute with floor(max HP/4) HP if at half HP or below. An existing Substitute preserves the allowance.
lastbrood.shortDesc: Swarm; once/entry, surviving a hit at half HP creates a free Substitute.

lastingpromise.name: Lasting Promise
lastingpromise.desc: Full local Friend Guard. When a Wish cast by it while this ability is active successfully restores HP to a different ally, it also cures that recipient's major status. Tracks the original wisher across switching. Does not add HP, cure itself, or cure on failed, blocked or full-HP healing. No once-battle restriction.
lastingpromise.shortDesc: Friend Guard; its Wish cures a different ally's major status only after successfully healing it.

lastlaugh.name: Last Laugh
lastlaugh.desc: Moves last within its priority bracket. On Chessboard entry, raises Defense by one stage. Its attacks deal 1.3x damage to a foe that has completed its move action this turn. If no other active Pokemon has a queued move remaining, its damaging move bypasses Substitute; damaging a foe with that move heals 1/8 max HP, once per turn.
lastlaugh.shortDesc: 1.3x after the target acts; last-action attacks bypass Substitute and heal 1/8 once/turn.

layeredcoat.name: Layered Coat
layeredcoat.desc: Doubles Defense. Immune to powder moves, Rage Powder, Effect Spore, sandstorm damage and hail damage.
layeredcoat.shortDesc: Doubles Defense; immune to powder effects, sandstorm and hail damage.

layeredshell.name: Layered Shell
layeredshell.desc: Prevents critical hits and takes 20% less attack damage. Gains +1 Defense on Fairy Tale or Dragon's Den entry and +2 Sp. Def when a foe lowers its stats. Once per switch-in, its first opposing special hit deals a further 25% less damage.
layeredshell.shortDesc: The first special hit each entry deals 25% less damage.

leafguard.name: Leaf Guard
leafguard.desc: If Sunny Day is active, it cannot become affected by a non-volatile status condition or Yawn, and Rest will fail for it. This effect is prevented if it is holding a Utility Umbrella.
leafguard.shortDesc: If Sunny Day is active, it cannot be statused and Rest will fail for it.

leviathanwake.name: Leviathan Wake
leviathanwake.desc: Incoming attack damage is multiplied by 0.8; raw Defense and Special Defense are unchanged. Body Slam and Heavy Slam have 1.5x power. After either ordinary slam successfully damages an opponent or its Substitute, the living active user uses one free normal Surf after the entire slam resolves. Surf costs no PP and has normal targeting, including hitting allies. No trigger on a miss, protection, immunity, or Z/Max versions.
leviathanwake.shortDesc: Takes 0.8x attack damage; slams have 1.5x power and trigger one free Surf.

levitate.name: Levitate
levitate.desc: Airborne: immune to Ground attacks, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web and Arena Trap unless grounded. Thousand Arrows can still hit.
levitate.shortDesc: Airborne; immune to Ground attacks unless grounded.

libero.name: Libero
libero.desc: Before using a move, changes to that move's type. Excludes reflected, delayed, Snatched and move-calling attacks; type-change restrictions still apply.
libero.shortDesc: Changes type to match each eligible move.

lifeguard.name: Life Guard
lifeguard.desc: Allies take 25% less attack damage; this does not protect the holder. On entry, heals each adjacent ally by 1/4 max HP, or 1/3 on Fairy Tale. Moves cannot be redirected. Speed doubles on Water Surface, Underwater and Midnight Zone. In Free-for-All only, successfully blocking an opposing damaging move with a protection move earns a guard that reduces the next opposing damaging hit by 25%, through the end of the following turn. It does not stack or refresh while active, is consumed by only one hit, and clears on switching. Merely using protection, blocking status moves or residual damage does not earn or consume it.
lifeguard.shortDesc: Successful protection in Free-for-All earns one 25% damage guard.

lightmetal.name: Light Metal
lightmetal.desc: Halves weight. Speed is 1.25x while free of major status. Factory entry gives +1 Speed.
lightmetal.shortDesc: Half weight; 1.25x Speed without status; Factory entry +1 Speed.

lightningrod.name: Lightning Rod
lightningrod.desc: Redirects single-target Electric moves to itself and absorbs Electric moves for +1 Attack and Sp. Atk. Electric Terrain entry also grants both boosts.
lightningrod.shortDesc: Redirects/absorbs Electric for +1 Attack and Sp. Atk.

limber.name: Limber
limber.desc: Prevents and cures paralysis. Other Pokemon and field effects cannot lower its Speed; self-inflicted costs and item slowdowns still apply. Does not alter Trick Room or prevent removing Speed boosts or Tailwind.
limber.shortDesc: No paralysis or opposing/field Speed reductions.

lingeringaroma.name: Lingering Aroma
lingeringaroma.desc: Pokemon making contact with it have their Ability changed to Lingering Aroma. Does not affect Pokemon with the As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Lingering Aroma, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero Abilities.
lingeringaroma.shortDesc: Making contact with it has the attacker's Ability become Lingering Aroma.

liquidarsenal.name: Liquid Arsenal
liquidarsenal.desc: Technician: moves with effective power 60 or less gain 1.5x power (80 or less on Factory). Water attacks use the lower of the target's current, fully modified Defense and Sp. Def while keeping their category and normal attacking stat. Ties keep the normal defense. Explicit defensive-stat overrides and fixed-damage rules retain precedence.
liquidarsenal.shortDesc: Water attacks use the target's lower Defense or Sp. Def without changing category.

liquidooze.name: Liquid Ooze
liquidooze.desc: Draining moves, Leech Seed and Strength Sap damage their user by the HP they would restore. This damage doubles on Murkwater Surface and Wasteland.
liquidooze.shortDesc: Drain, Leech Seed and Strength Sap hurt their user.

liquidvoice.name: Liquid Voice
liquidvoice.desc: Sound moves become Water-type, or Ice-type on Icy Field, and have 1.2x power.
liquidvoice.shortDesc: Sound moves: Water (Ice on Icy Field), 1.2x power.

livenet.name: Live Net
livenet.desc: While it is active, it prevents opposing Pokemon from using their Berries. This Ability activates before hazards and other Abilities take effect. While active, Sticky Web placed by it also deals 1/16 max HP of Electric damage to grounded entrants. Heavy-Duty Boots, hazard immunity and Electric immunity prevent the added damage.
livenet.shortDesc: Its Sticky Web also chips grounded entrants with Electric damage.

livewire.name: Livewire
livewire.desc: Full local Transistor, Quick Feet and Iron Barbs.

livewiretrap.name: Livewire Trap
livewiretrap.desc: Full local Static, including its doubled contact paralysis chance on Electric and Short-Circuit fields. Damaging Electric attacks have 1.3x power against opponents with a major status condition.
livewiretrap.shortDesc: Static; Electric attacks gain 1.3x power against statused foes.

livinglegend.name: Living Legend
livinglegend.desc: Flash Fire + Download. Extreme Speed has 1.5x power and +2 critical-hit stages.
livinglegend.shortDesc: Flash Fire + Download; stronger Extreme Speed.

livingtangle.name: Living Tangle
livingtangle.desc: Contact attackers lose 1 Speed stage. Each opposing attack hit that damages HP heals 1/16 max HP. The first such hit each turn also raises Defense by 1, before later hits of a multi-hit move.
livingtangle.shortDesc: Contact slows foes while opposing hits raise Defense and heal.

lockinggrip.name: Locking Grip
lockinggrip.desc: Once per entry, its first damaging Bug attack against a foe applies Torment after HP damage. A hit absorbed by Substitute spends the use without affecting its holder; misses, protection and immunity do not spend it.
lockinggrip.shortDesc: First damaging Bug attack each entry applies Torment after damage.

lockjaw.name: Lockjaw
lockjaw.desc: Biting moves have 1.5x power. Biting hits inflict Torment on a surviving foe for 2 turns. Does not prevent switching.

longreach.name: Long Reach
longreach.desc: Moves used by this Pokemon do not make contact.

loyalguard.name: Loyal Guard
loyalguard.desc: Allies take 25% less attack damage; this does not protect the holder. Cannot be forced out by opposing moves or items. Intimidate raises Attack by 1 instead of lowering it. On entry, lowers adjacent foes' Attack by 1. Substitute and Intimidate protections still apply.
loyalguard.shortDesc: Allies take 25% less attack damage; this does not protect the holder.

lunardread.name: Lunar Dread
lunardread.desc: On entry, lowers adjacent foes Sp. Atk by 1 stage, blocked by Substitute and normal stat-drop protection. Prevents and cures sleep and blocks Yawn. Dark and Ghost attacks have 1.3x power.
lunardread.shortDesc: Dishearten + Insomnia; Dark and Ghost moves have 1.3x power.

lunaridol.name: Lunar Idol
lunaridol.desc: Immune to hail damage. Its Ice-type moves have 1.5x power, and its Special Attack is 1.5x during hail or snow.
lunaridol.shortDesc: Hail-immune; 1.5x Ice power; 1.5x Sp. Atk in hail/snow.

lunarorbit.name: Lunar Orbit
lunarorbit.desc: Full local Magic Guard prevents indirect damage, retaining its normal exceptions and Fairy Tale entry boost. On entry or Mega Evolution, sets Gravity for 5 turns with its field transformations. Magic Bounce remains the species passive. While active, increases move secondary-effect chances for itself and actual allies, capped at 60% while preserving higher native chances and guaranteed effects. Grants one required charge-turn skip per receiving Pokemon per stay, sharing the same allowance as Void Omen. Only that recipient switching resets it; provider switches, ability restarts and Transform do not refill it. Independent field, Power Herb and natural Serene Grace skips do not spend the allowance. Suppression disables the grant.
lunarorbit.shortDesc: Magic Guard; entry Gravity; shares secondary boosts and one charge skip per recipient entry.

lunarspirit.name: Lunar Spirit
lunarspirit.desc: It has STAB on Psychic- and Normal-type moves.
lunarspirit.shortDesc: Psychic- and Normal-type moves get STAB.

lunarward.name: Lunar Ward
lunarward.desc: Full local Pressure and Illuminate, including field effects. Pressure has its once-per-opponent battle memory.

magicbounce.name: Magic Bounce
magicbounce.desc: Reflects eligible status moves and entry hazards once; reflected moves cannot bounce again. Fairy Tale entry gives +1 Sp. Def; Mirror Arena entry gives +1 evasion. On Mirror Arena, reflecting a directly targeted move also gives its original user +1 evasion.
magicbounce.shortDesc: Reflects eligible status moves and hazards; field entry boosts.

magicguard.name: Magic Guard
magicguard.desc: Prevents indirect damage; HP costs, Pain Split, confusion and Struggle recoil still apply. Fairy Tale entry gives +1 Sp. Def.
magicguard.shortDesc: Prevents indirect damage; Fairy Tale entry gives +1 Sp. Def.

magician.name: Magician
magician.desc: If it has no item, it steals the item off a Pokemon it hits with an attack. Does not affect Doom Desire and Future Sight. If multiple targets are hit by an attack the item is stolen from the fastest Pokemon, while considering the effect of Trick Room and prioritizing opposing Pokemon before allies.
magician.shortDesc: If it has no item, it steals the item off a Pokemon it hits.

magmaarmor.name: Magma Armor
magmaarmor.desc: Prevents freezing outside Cold Eclipse and cures freeze. Incoming Water and Ice attacks use half the attacker's offensive stat. Dragon's Den blocks Fire moves. On Dragon's Den, Volcanic or Cold Eclipse entry, gains +1 Defense and Sp. Def.
magmaarmor.shortDesc: Halves Water/Ice attacking stats; prevents freeze; field defenses.

magneticbulwark.name: Magnetic Bulwark
magneticbulwark.desc: Full local Filter: takes 20% less attack damage, or 40% less from super-effective attacks.
magneticbulwark.shortDesc: Takes 20% less attack damage, or 40% less if super effective.

magneticcommand.name: Magnetic Command
magneticcommand.desc: Frisk and Stalwart, including their entry effects and targeting behavior.

magnetpull.name: Magnet Pull
magnetpull.desc: Prevents opposing Steel-type Pokemon from choosing to switch out, unless they are holding a Shed Shell or are a Ghost type.
magnetpull.shortDesc: Prevents opposing Steel-type Pokemon from choosing to switch out.

malicewell.name: Malice Well
malicewell.desc: Flame Body: contact attackers have a 30% burn chance (60% on Volcanic Field); Cold Eclipse instead grants +1 Defense and Sp. Def on entry and disables contact burns. Once per actual entry, the first opposing damaging move that executes against it grants +1 Sp. Atk after the entire move finishes if it remains active and survives, including Protect, misses and immunity. All hits and spread targets share one activation. Ally moves, self damage, residual damage and moves that never execute do not qualify. Ability changes or suppression do not reset usage. The activation is consumed even at +6; switching resets usage and normal stat stages, and Haze removes the boost without refreshing usage.
malicewell.shortDesc: Contact may burn; first survived opposing attack each entry: +1 Sp. Atk, even after Protect.

marshconduit.name: Marsh Conduit
marshconduit.desc: Compatibility name for full local Water Absorb. Absorbs other Pokemon’s Water moves to heal 1/4 max HP. Has 1/16 field healing on Underwater, grounded Water Surface, and grounded Poison-type Murkwater. Seismitoad selects Water Absorb directly.

marshhide.name: Marsh Hide
marshhide.desc: Absorbs other Pokemon Water moves to heal 1/4 max HP. Has Water Absorb field healing: 1/16 on Underwater, grounded Water Surface and grounded Poison-type Murkwater. Contact attackers have a 30% poison chance, or 60% on Wasteland.

marvelscale.name: Marvel Scale
marvelscale.desc: Defense is multiplied by 1.5 while statused or on Misty, Rainbow, Fairy Tale, Dragon’s Den or Starlight Arena fields. These conditions do not stack.
marvelscale.shortDesc: 1.5x Defense while statused or on Misty, Rainbow, Fairy Tale, Dragon’s Den or Starlight fields.

masonsfist.name: Mason's Fist
masonsfist.desc: Punching moves have 1.4x power. When a punching move damages a foe, it removes Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil, Arenite Wall, and Atlantis Wall from that foe's side.
masonsfist.shortDesc: Punches that damage a foe break that side's screens.

mastercourse.name: Master Course
mastercourse.desc: Reverses received stat-stage changes except Z-Power. Once per turn, dealing opposing HP damage with a Water or Dragon attack prepares a nonstacking +1 critical-hit-stage charge after the entire move finishes. Give it to the living adjacent ally with the lowest HP percentage, or to itself if none exists. The next executed damaging move consumes the charge even on a miss, protection or immunity; status moves preserve it, and switching clears it. A successful charged Water or Dragon move can prepare another charge afterward.
mastercourse.shortDesc: Water/Dragon HP hits charge an ally, or itself alone, after the move.

masterkey.name: Master Key
masterkey.desc: Single-target status moves bypass Substitute and ignore opposing abilities under normal Mold Breaker rules. Accuracy, Protect, type/status immunities, Safeguard, terrain and Taunt still apply.
masterkey.shortDesc: Single-target status moves bypass Substitute and ignore opposing abilities.

masterpatissier.name: Master Pâtissier
masterpatissier.desc: Aroma Veil. Its Decorate can target itself or any normally eligible adjacent Pokémon, granting the usual +2 Attack and Sp. Atk.
masterpatissier.shortDesc: Aroma Veil; Decorate can also target itself.

matriarchsvigil.name: Royal Aegis
matriarchsvigil.desc: Full local Thick Fat, Power Drill and Friend Guard. Drill and horn moves have 1.5x power, or 2x on Rocky, Mountain, Snowy Mountain, Cave and Volcanic fields, where they bypass protection. Once per genuine entry, after it or an adjacent ally survives an opposing whole damaging move that takes it from above half HP to half HP or less, the injured Pokemon gains +1 Defense and +1 Sp. Def after all hits. One shared activation per entry. Residual damage, friendly fire and Substitute-only damage do not qualify. Ability restarts do not reset the budget. Friend Guard reduces damage to other allies by 25%, independently stacking with the separate Rivalry passive. Neither ally reduction protects its own holder.
matriarchsvigil.shortDesc: Thick Fat + Power Drill + Friend Guard; once/entry, crossing half HP grants Def/SpD.

measuredcounsel.name: Measured Counsel
measuredcounsel.desc: Own Tempo prevents and cures confusion and blocks Intimidate's Attack drop. Successfully scheduling Future Sight also clears its confusion and negative Sp. Atk stages, preserving positive Sp. Atk. An occupied Future Sight slot does not trigger this effect.
measuredcounsel.shortDesc: Successful Future Sight clears own confusion and negative Sp. Atk.

megalauncher.name: Mega Launcher
megalauncher.desc: Pulse and bullet moves have 1.5x power.

megasol.name: Mega Sol
megasol.desc: Its moves are used as if the effects of Sunny Day were active.
megasol.shortDesc: Its moves are used as if the effects of Sunny Day were active.

memoryleak.name: Memory Leak
memoryleak.desc: Positive stat boosts it would receive are passed to an adjacent ally instead.
memoryleak.shortDesc: Passes positive stat boosts to an adjacent ally.

merciless.name: Merciless
merciless.desc: Attacks always critically hit poisoned targets and on Corrosive, Corrosive Mist, Murkwater Surface and Wasteland, unless critical hits are blocked. On Chessboard, gains one critical-hit stage per 20% of the target's missing base max HP, up to three.
merciless.shortDesc: Critical hits against poisoned foes or on corrosive fields.

meridianseal.name: Meridian Seal
meridianseal.desc: Once per entry, a Fighting hit against a surviving foe can suppress its Ability for two turns, including the current turn. The charge is spent only when suppression succeeds. Protect, Substitute, Ability Shield and unsuppressible Abilities prevent suppression without spending the chance. Switching clears the seal.
meridianseal.shortDesc: Once per entry, Fighting hits suppress a surviving foe for 2 turns; spent only on success.

meteorcore.name: Meteor Core
meteorcore.desc: After an ordinary Meteor Mash damages opposing HP, the living active user attempts one +1 Attack boost if that use did not already trigger its Attack boost. Once per entire move, including extra hits. Normal stat-change rules apply.
meteorcore.shortDesc: Meteor Mash: +1 Attack after opposing HP damage if its own boost did not trigger.

mightyjaw.name: Mighty Jaw
mightyjaw.desc: Biting moves have 1.5x power. On entry, lowers adjacent foes' Attack by 1. Substitute and Intimidate protections still apply. On its first action after switching in, its biting moves have 2 higher priority.
mightyjaw.shortDesc: Biting moves gain +2 priority on first action.

mimecraft.name: Mimecraft
mimecraft.desc: Reflect and Light Screen gain +1 priority. Once per switch-in, the first one it successfully sets heals its lowest-HP active ally by 1/8 of that ally's max HP.
mimecraft.shortDesc: +1 priority for Reflect and Light Screen; first successful screen heals an ally by 1/8.

mimicry.name: Mimicry
mimicry.desc: Its types change to match the active Terrain when it acquires this Ability, or whenever a Terrain begins. Electric type during Electric Terrain, Grass type during Grassy Terrain, Fairy type during Misty Terrain, and Psychic type during Psychic Terrain. If this Ability is acquired without an active Terrain, or a Terrain ends, its types become the original types for its species.
mimicry.shortDesc: Its types change to match the Terrain. Type reverts when Terrain ends.

mindcurrent.name: Mind Current
mindcurrent.desc: Inner Focus blocks flinching and Intimidate. Once per entry, Psychic damage to a foe or its Substitute grants Charge after the move ends, so the triggering move cannot consume it.
mindcurrent.shortDesc: Inner Focus; first Psychic damage each entry grants Charge after the move.

mindfreeze.name: Mind Freeze
mindfreeze.desc: It cannot have this Ability suppressed. It is immune to Ice-type attacks and restores 1/4 of its max HP when hit by one. It has Ice Body's healing and hail immunity. Its damaging Psychic-type moves have a 40% chance to cause frostbite, and Freezing Glare's frostbite chance is doubled. Its Physical Ice-type moves become Special.
mindfreeze.shortDesc: Cannot be suppressed; Ice immunity heals 1/4; Psychic may frostbite.

mindmirror.name: Mind Mirror
mindmirror.desc: Opportunist. On entry, copies the highest positive opposing stage in each stat, keeping its own higher stages.
mindmirror.shortDesc: Opportunist; entry copies each stat’s highest positive opposing stage.

mindseye.name: Mind's Eye
mindseye.desc: Normal and Fighting moves can hit Ghost types; gains Fairy and Dark STAB, ignores target evasion boosts, and prevents external accuracy drops. On Cold Eclipse, has 30% damage reduction and 1.3x damaging move power. Reveals opposing Illusion and Perfect Illusion on activation and after each opposing entry; does not reveal allies. Suppression disables the selected ability’s reveal effects.
mindseye.shortDesc: Normal/Fighting hit Ghost; Fairy/Dark STAB; accuracy protection. Reveals opposing disguises.

minus.name: Minus
minus.desc: Its Electric- and Steel-type moves use 1.3x Attack and Sp. Atk. In Electric Terrain, its Sp. Atk is multiplied by 1.5.
minus.shortDesc: Electric/Steel moves use 1.3x Atk/SpA; Electric Terrain gives 1.5x SpA.

mirechorus.name: Mire Chorus
mirechorus.desc: Sound moves become Water-type, or Ice-type on Icy Field, and have 1.2x power. Contact hits have a 30% chance to poison the target. Shield Dust and Covert Cloak block this effect. Each foe damaged by a noncontact sound move also has an independent 20% chance to be poisoned. Shield Dust and Covert Cloak block this added poison chance.
mirechorus.shortDesc: Noncontact sound hits have a 20% poison chance.

mirrorarmor.name: Mirror Armor
mirrorarmor.desc: When another Pokemon would lower its stat stages, those stat drops are reflected onto that Pokemon instead. It also takes 20% less damage from attacks.
mirrorarmor.shortDesc: Reflects opposing stat drops; takes 0.8x damage from attacks.

mirrorgreed.name: Mirror Greed
mirrorgreed.desc: Reflects eligible status moves and entry hazards once; reflected moves cannot bounce again. Fairy Tale entry gives +1 Sp. Def; Mirror Arena entry gives +1 evasion. Moves have 1.3x power if no other active Pokemon has a move left to use that turn. Takes 20% less attack damage, or 40% less from super-effective attacks. Opportunist copies positive stat boosts gained by opposing Pokemon.
mirrorgreed.shortDesc: Reflects eligible status moves and entry hazards once; reflected moves cannot bounce again.

mistysurge.name: Misty Surge
mistysurge.desc: On entry, creates Misty Terrain for 5 turns, or 8 with Amplifield Rock, subject to field and Aura rules.

moody.name: Moody
moody.desc: It has a random stat, other than accuracy or evasiveness, raised by 2 stages and another stat lowered by 1 stage at turn end.
moody.shortDesc: Boosts a random stat (except accuracy/evasion) +2 and another stat -1 every turn.

moonlightvigil.name: Moonlight Vigil
moonlightvigil.desc: Prevents flinching and Intimidate's Attack drop. On entry, lowers foes' Defense and Sp. Def by 1 (2 on Cold Eclipse) and changes Underwater to Midnight Zone. Foes targeting it spend 1 extra PP, or 2 on Midnight Zone. Prevents other Pokemon's accuracy drops and ignores evasion boosts. Reveals opposing Illusions on activation. Mirror Arena entry lowers foes' accuracy by 1. Starlight Arena entry gives +2 Sp. Atk and puts Spotlight on its first adjacent ally. Outside Cold Eclipse, its Defense and Sp. Def drop is attempted only once per opposing Pokemon per battle for each Pressure user. Switching, Transform and ability loss or regain do not reset that allowance; a blocked or reflected attempt spends it. Cold Eclipse retains repeatable -2 drops on entry and neither spends nor resets the ordinary allowance.
moonlightvigil.shortDesc: Blocks Intimidate; opposing moves spend extra PP; reveals Illusions.

moonlithide.name: Moonlit Hide
moonlithide.desc: Shadow Shield + Magic Guard: takes 20% less attack damage at any HP, or 40% less if super effective. Immune to indirect damage. On entry to Fairy Tale Field, Sp. Def rises one stage. Ability-ignoring moves cannot bypass the damage reductions; suppression disables the ability.
moonlithide.shortDesc: Takes 20% less attack damage, or 40% if super effective. Immune to indirect damage.

moonlitprowl.name: Moonlit Prowl
moonlitprowl.desc: Full local Infiltrator and Limber. Its moves bypass Substitute, Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil, Safeguard and Mist through the normal Infiltrator rules. Prevents and cures paralysis, and prevents externally caused Speed stage drops, including Terrain effects. Self-inflicted Speed drops and held-item Speed effects retain their normal behavior. Limber follows its normal ability bypass rules; bypassing Limber does not remove Infiltrator. Selected-ability suppression disables both components.
moonlitprowl.shortDesc: Infiltrator + full local Limber: paralysis immunity/cure and external Speed-drop protection.

moonlitwings.name: Moonlit Wings
moonlitwings.desc: It has Serene Grace and gains STAB on Fairy-type moves.

moonveil.name: Moon Veil
moonveil.desc: It and its allies cannot be poisoned. Gaining this Ability while it or its ally is poisoned cures them. Before an opposing Pokemon uses a Poison-type move, that Pokemon's Attack and Special Attack are lowered by 1 stage. On entry, creates Misty Terrain for 5 turns, or 8 with Amplifield Rock, subject to field and Aura rules.

mossarmor.name: Moss Armor
mossarmor.desc: Airborne: immune to Ground attacks, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web and Arena Trap unless grounded. Thousand Arrows can still hit. Each opposing attack hit that damages HP heals 1/16 max HP. The first such hit each turn also raises Defense by 1, before later hits of a multi-hit move. Switching out cures major status and heals 1/8 max HP only if a status was cured. Bewitched Woods cures status at turn end without this heal. switching out heals 1/8 max HP only after a Grass attack dealt opposing HP damage on the current or immediately preceding turn, with no intervening action.
mossarmor.shortDesc: Levitate + Stamina + Natural Cure; a Grass HP hit followed by switching adds 1/8 HP healing.

mothborn.name: Mothborn
mothborn.desc: Bug-type damaging moves receive STAB through the normal custom STAB rules, without changing this Pokemon's types or stacking with Bug STAB. Adaptability, Terastallization and form changes retain their normal interactions. Full local Shield Dust blocks incoming move secondary effects on this Pokemon, while preserving effects on the attacker and primary move effects. Shield Dust follows normal ability bypass and suppression rules.
mothborn.shortDesc: Bug attacks gain STAB without stacking; Shield Dust.

motordrive.name: Motor Drive
motordrive.desc: It is immune to Electric-type moves and raises its Speed by 1 stage when hit by an Electric-type move.
motordrive.shortDesc: Its Speed is raised 1 stage if hit by an Electric move; Electric immunity.

mountainbreaker.name: Mountainbreaker
mountainbreaker.desc: Full local Earth Eater + Battle Armor: absorbs Ground moves for 1/4 HP; heals 1/16 on Cave and Desert. Prevents critical hits, has Battle Armor damage reduction, Fairy Tale entry Defense and Defense response to opposing stat drops.

mountaineer.name: Mountaineer
mountaineer.desc: On switch-in, it avoids all Rock-type attacks and Stealth Rock.
mountaineer.shortDesc: On switch-in, it avoids all Rock-type attacks and Stealth Rock.

mountainhide.name: Mountain Hide
mountainhide.desc: Solid Rock and Inner Focus: takes 20% less attack damage, or 40% less from super-effective attacks, and prevents flinching and Intimidate Attack drops.

mountainhunger.name: Mountain Hunger
mountainhunger.desc: Absorbs Grass moves for +1 Attack and Sp. Atk; allied Grass moves also grant both boosts. Heals 1/8 max HP each turn on Forest and 1/16 on Grassy Field. Incoming Fire and Ice attacks use half the attacker's offensive stat. Immune to hail damage. Sleep lasts half as long, rounded down.
mountainhunger.shortDesc: Absorbs Grass for attacking boosts; no hail damage; shorter sleep.

mountainrift.name: Mountain Rift
mountainrift.desc: Prevents critical hits and takes 20% less attack damage. Gains +1 Defense on Fairy Tale or Dragon's Den entry and +2 Sp. Def when a foe lowers its stats. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn. Immune to sandstorm and hail damage. It cannot be critically hit, takes 0.8x damage, gains 2 Sp. Def when a foe lowers its stats, heals 1/16 max HP each turn, and ignores sandstorm and hail damage. On entry, it creates Mountain Field for 5 turns. Once at half HP or less, it starts Gravity and resets Mountain Field to 5 turns. Its four moves are always Earthquake, Desert's Mark, Mountain Gale, and Stone Edge. The first time it would faint, it instead revives at full HP as Torterra-Rift-Shatter, clearing its status, boosts, and volatile conditions.
mountainrift.shortDesc: 5-turn Mountain; half HP: Gravity + Mountain reset; first faint: full reset into Shatter.

mourningcoat.name: Mourning Coat
mourningcoat.desc: Takes half contact damage. Fire moves deal double damage until a teammate has fainted; afterward the extra Fire weakness stays removed for the battle.
mourningcoat.shortDesc: Double Fire damage until a teammate has fainted.

mourningsnow.name: Mourning Snow
mourningsnow.desc: On entry, it summons Hail for 8 turns, and Aurora Veil used by it lasts 8 turns. During Hail or Snow, it heals 1/16 max HP each turn. Its damaging moves of any type gain an additional 30% chance to inflict frostbite, preserving their effects; this does not require weather. It is immune to Hail damage. When another Pokemon faints, it restores 1/8 max HP, or 1/4 if the faint was caused by an Ice move, Hail, Snow, or Curse. When it faints, all opposing Pokemon become cursed. Damaging hits disable the attacker's move when possible.
mourningsnow.shortDesc: 8-turn Hail/Veil; damaging moves add 30% frostbite; faint healing/curse; hit Disable.

mourningvessel.name: Mourning Vessel
mourningvessel.desc: Move power +20% per cumulative allied faint, capped at 2x. Heals 5% max HP per cumulative opposing faint each turn. Includes allied sides in Multi and all opposing sides in Free-for-All.
mourningvessel.shortDesc: +20% power per allied faint, up to 2x; heals 5% HP per opposing faint.

moxie.name: Moxie
moxie.desc: Gains +1 Attack for each Pokemon knocked out by its move.

mudflatdynamo.name: Mudflat Dynamo
mudflatdynamo.desc: Full local Battle Armor, including critical-hit immunity, 20% incoming damage reduction and field callbacks. After surviving an opposing direct HP-damaging move, stores one charge. The next attempted damaging Electric move uses 1.5x power across its whole move and spends the charge, even on a miss, protection or immunity. Electric status moves do not spend it. Charges cannot stack; switching clears them. Allied, recoil, residual and Substitute-only damage do not qualify.
mudflatdynamo.shortDesc: Battle Armor; surviving an opposing attack stores one 1.5x Electric attack.

mudmeditation.name: Mud Meditation
mudmeditation.desc: Takes 25% less special attack damage while waiting to perform a selected status move. Successfully using a status move extends this protection through the rest of that turn; failure does not earn the extension.
mudmeditation.shortDesc: 25% less special damage while awaiting a status move, and through the turn after successful use.

multiscale.name: Multiscale
multiscale.desc: Takes half attack damage at full HP.
multiscale.shortDesc: Half attack damage at full HP.

multitype.name: Multitype
multitype.desc: If it is an Arceus, its type changes to match its held Plate.
multitype.shortDesc: If it is an Arceus, its type changes to match its held Plate.

mummy.name: Mummy
mummy.desc: Pokemon making contact with it have their Ability changed to Mummy. Does not affect Pokemon with the As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Mummy, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero Abilities.
mummy.shortDesc: Pokemon making contact with it have their Ability changed to Mummy.

mycelialbond.name: Mycelial Bond
mycelialbond.desc: Dry Skin, including Water absorption, Fire vulnerability, weather and field effects, once even with Parasitism. Self and adjacent allies’ eligible single-target single-hit attacks hit once more at 25% calculated damage. Does not stack with another holder or multihit/bond, retarget after a KO or recurse. Excludes spread, Z/Max, fixed/OHKO, delayed, charge/recharge, self-KO and item-consuming/repeating exceptions. No extra secondary or self-stat rolls; ordinary per-hit drain, recoil and Substitute interaction remain.
mycelialbond.shortDesc: Dry Skin; self and adjacent allies gain one eligible extra hit at 25% damage.

myceliummight.name: Mycelium Might
myceliummight.desc: Its status moves ignore the target's Ability and move last in their priority bracket. Before it uses a status move, attacks deal 0.75x damage to it. When it successfully uses a status move, it restores 1/8 of its max HP.
myceliummight.shortDesc: Status ignores Abilities and moves last; takes 0.75x before status; heals 1/8.

mythicscale.name: Mythic Scale
mythicscale.desc: Defense is 1.5x while statused or on Misty, Rainbow, Fairy Tale, Dragon's Den and Starlight Arena. Moves have 1.3x accuracy. Mirror Arena entry gives +1 accuracy and Laser Focus. Called or reflected moves do not trigger this bonus. Once per entry, the first foe successfully statused by its directly selected powder move or directly executed G-Max Befuddle grants it +1 Defense and its active allies +1 Sp. Def. These moves share one activation; the holder does not gain Sp. Def. When this activation is earned, first clears negative Defense and Sp. Def stages on the holder and its active allies, then applies those boosts. Shield Dust blocks opposing move secondary effects.
mythicscale.shortDesc: Powder/Befuddle status: clears ally/own defensive drops, then boosts defenses once/entry.

naturalcure.name: Natural Cure
naturalcure.desc: On switching out, cures its major status and heals 1/8 max HP if it had a status to cure. Bewitched Woods also cures its status at turn end.
naturalcure.shortDesc: On switching out, cures status and heals 1/8 max HP if cured.

naturalrecovery.name: Natural Recovery
naturalrecovery.desc: Switching out cures major status and restores 1/3 max HP, plus another 1/8 if a status was cured. Bewitched Woods cures status at turn end without healing.
naturalrecovery.shortDesc: Switching out heals an extra 1/8 HP if a major status was cured.

neuroforce.name: Neuroforce
neuroforce.desc: Its attacks that are super effective against the target have their damage multiplied by 1.25.
neuroforce.shortDesc: Its attacks that are super effective against the target do 1.25x damage.

neurotoxin.name: Neurotoxin
neurotoxin.desc: Eligible single-target attacks hit three times. In singles and doubles, native variable multi-hit moves use their maximum hit count, keeping native per-hit accuracy and damage. Remaining native hits can continue into another living opposing active Pokemon after a KO at 70% damage. Excludes non-FFA spread, charge, delayed, Z/Max and extra-hit-barred moves. Follow-ups deal 30% damage, retargeting another living opposing active Pokemon after a KO. In FFA, single-target moves hit all foes at 1.3x power; spread moves hit all foes three times with 30% follow-ups. Full-power spread stays full power. Moves have 1.2x power on Dragon's Den. Heals 1/3 max HP on switching out.

neutralization.name: Neutralization
neutralization.desc: Once per target per move, when it deals direct damage to an opposing Pokemon with a single-target damaging move, the target's higher attacking stat is lowered by 1 stage. Spread hits do not trigger this effect. This does not affect other Neutralization users or Pokemon immune to stat drops. While active, base field changes are neutralized, but Auras can still be created and remain active; Trick Room, Magic Room, and Wonder Room end on entry but can be established afterward; and Rainbow Field ends on entry. It also suppresses Royal Decree's stat reset, screen removal, and ongoing restrictions, including those granted by Empress and Royal Sun. Ice Spinner and Steel Roller still remove terrain normally.
neutralization.shortDesc: Hits lower higher offense by 1; clears Rooms on entry; locks base fields, not Auras.

neutralizinggas.name: Neutralizing Gas
neutralizinggas.desc: While it is active, Abilities have no effect. This Ability activates before hazards and other Abilities take effect. Does not affect the As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero Abilities.
neutralizinggas.shortDesc: While it is active, Abilities have no effect.

nightforager.name: Night Forager
nightforager.desc: Once per turn, its first damaging Bug- or Poison-type move to deal actual opposing HP damage attempts to heal 1/8 of its current maximum HP. Each turn has only one activation, including all hits and targets; a blocked heal or being at full HP still spends that activation. Substitute-only damage, misses, protection, immunity, ally damage, status moves and residual damage do not trigger it. Normal ability suppression and healing prevention apply.
nightforager.shortDesc: First Bug/Poison move dealing foe HP damage each turn heals 1/8 max HP.

nighthoard.name: Night Hoard
nighthoard.desc: Eating a Berry restores an additional 1/8 max HP and primes the next Dark-type biting attack that damages a foe to apply Taunt for 2 turns. Misses and blocked attacks preserve the charge.
nighthoard.shortDesc: Eating a Berry heals 1/8 more and charges the next Dark bite to Taunt.

nighthunt.name: Night Hunt
nighthunt.desc: Biting moves have 1.5x power. On entry, lowers adjacent foes' Attack by 1. Substitute and Intimidate protections still apply. Prevents other Pokemon's accuracy drops and ignores evasion boosts. Reveals opposing Illusions on activation. Mirror Arena entry lowers foes' accuracy by 1. Starlight Arena entry gives +2 Sp. Atk and puts Spotlight on its first adjacent ally. Shared Illusion reveals occur once.

nightmarepulse.name: Nightmare Pulse
nightmarepulse.desc: Prevents and cures sleep, blocks Yawn, and gives Dark and Ghost attacks 1.3x power. Takes 20% less attack damage, or 40% less from super-effective attacks. Its moves cannot miss. Damaging attacks have a 30% chance to be disabled, guaranteed on Haunted and disabled on Holy Field. Excludes Max moves, delayed attacks and Struggle. On fainting, curses all active foes. Sleeping foes, including Comatose users, lose 1/8 max HP each turn. Disabled on Rainbow Field. On entry, sets Haunted Field for 3 turns if field rules allow. Has sleep immunity, accurate moves, damage reduction, disabling attackers, and damage to sleeping foes. Does not bypass screens or Substitute. Field creation or refresh is attempted only once per battle per holder, even if blocked; switching, suppression, revival, or ability changes never reset this use. Its field creation, refresh and conversion last exactly 3 turns; Amplifield Rock does not extend them.
nightmarepulse.shortDesc: Moves cannot miss; curses foes on faint; Sleeping foes lose 1/8 HP per turn, except on Rainbow.

nightrealm.name: Night Realm
nightrealm.desc: It can use Dream Eater and Nightmare on awake targets.
nightrealm.shortDesc: Dream Eater and Nightmare affect awake targets.

nightwatch.name: Night Watch
nightwatch.desc: Full local Insomnia prevents and cures sleep, blocks Yawn and boosts Dark/Ghost attacks by 1.3x. After an opposing status move successfully affects it, uses normal Disable against that move's user. Failed or blocked moves, self-setup and allied moves do not trigger it. Normal Disable restrictions apply; Night Watch responses cannot trigger one another.
nightwatch.shortDesc: Insomnia; disables opposing status moves that successfully affect it.

noblearmor.name: Noble Armor
noblearmor.desc: Takes 20% less attack damage, or 40% less against super-effective attacks or on Crystal Cavern and Dark Crystal Cavern. Defense and Sp. Def are 4/3x on Cold Eclipse, Dark Crystal Cavern and Rainbow. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn in hail or snow, or on Icy, Snowy Mountain and Cold Eclipse without those weathers; hail on Cold Eclipse heals 1/8 instead. Immune to hail damage.
noblearmor.shortDesc: Reduces damage; boosts defenses on certain fields; recovers in cold conditions.

nobleconduit.name: Noble Conduit
nobleconduit.desc: Special moves have 1.3x power, with a further 1.5x boost on Electric Terrain. Allies' special moves have 1.3x power. In effective sun, Attack and Sp. Atk are 1.5x and it loses 1/8 max HP each turn. Cold Eclipse disables both effects. A contact attacker that knocks it out loses 1/4 max HP, or 1/2 on Corrosive Mist. Damp prevents this damage.
nobleconduit.shortDesc: Special moves have 1.3x power, with a further 1.5x boost on Electric Terrain.

nobledance.name: Noble Dance
nobledance.desc: Full local Dancer and Hospitality: copies eligible dance moves under normal execution and recursion rules, has Dancer’s local stat rewards and Big Top behavior, and heals adjacent allies on entry.

noblerider.name: Noble Rider
noblerider.desc: Doubles Speed in rain or on Water Surface, Murkwater Surface, Underwater and Midnight Zone. Moves ignore bypassable opposing abilities.
noblerider.shortDesc: Double Speed in rain and water fields; Moves ignore bypassable abilities.

noguard.name: No Guard
noguard.desc: Moves used by or against it always hit, including during semi-invulnerable turns.
noguard.shortDesc: Moves used by or against it always hit.

normalize.name: Normalize
normalize.desc: Its moves are changed to be Normal type and have their power multiplied by 1.2. This effect comes before other effects that change a move's type.
normalize.shortDesc: Its moves are changed to be Normal type and have 1.2x power.

noseformation.name: Nose Formation
noseformation.desc: Elevate grants airborne status, subject to grounding, and one highest-stat increase per move KO, using nature-adjusted stats while ignoring stages and other stat modifiers. After a successful opposing attack, fires one trio of 30 BP Special Mini-Noses, choosing Steel, Electric or Rock and retargeting living foes when needed. Each is a normal attack respecting protection, Substitute and immunity. No ally triggers or recursive trios.
noseformation.shortDesc: Elevate; successful opposing attacks trigger three 30 BP Special Mini-Noses.

oblivious.name: Oblivious
oblivious.desc: Prevents and cures attraction and Taunt. Blocks Captivate and Intimidate's Attack drop.
oblivious.shortDesc: No attraction/Taunt, Captivate or Intimidate Attack drop.

oceanicwings.name: Oceanic Wings
oceanicwings.desc: Absorbs other Pokemon's Water moves, healing 1/4 max HP instead of being hit. Cures major status at turn end in effective rain or on Water Surface, Underwater and Midnight Zone. Allies take 25% less attack damage; this does not protect the holder.
oceanicwings.shortDesc: Cures status each turn in rain or water fields; Allies take 25% less attack damage.

oceanlullaby.name: Ocean Lullaby
oceanlullaby.desc: Shell Armor. Once per turn, a successful damaging sound hit heals the holder and active allies by 1/16 max HP, clears confusion, and removes negative accuracy stages. Does not affect benched Pokemon, other stat stages, positive accuracy, or Sing accuracy.
oceanlullaby.shortDesc: Sound hits heal self/allies 1/16 and clear confusion/accuracy drops once/turn.

oldnorth.name: Old North
oldnorth.desc: Full local Ice Body, Ice Scales and Technician. Half special attack damage; hail immunity, contact frostbite and cold-weather/field recovery. Mirror Arena grants +2 evasion; Icy/Snowy Mountain neutralize Ice weaknesses; Cold Eclipse doubles Defense. Moves at most 60 effective BP (80 on Factory) receive Technician's 1.5x boost.

omenedge.name: Omen Edge
omenedge.desc: Slicing moves have 1.5x power, except on Cold Eclipse. Eligible slicing, pulse, bullet, horn, drill, and Arrow moves normally hit twice at 60% power, each with its own accuracy check. If an offensive ability power or damage multiplier applies, the first hit retains its full ability boosts and the second uses 15% of original move power without those offensive ability multipliers. Stat multipliers, items, STAB and ordinary weather or field modifiers remain separate. In Free-for-All, the second hit targets another random living foe when possible; Siege Launcher retains its full-power pair. Existing multi-hit moves do not gain an extra pair. On entry, lowers foes' Defense and Sp. Def by 1 (2 on Cold Eclipse) and changes Underwater to Midnight Zone. Foes targeting it spend 1 extra PP, or 2 on Midnight Zone. On fainting, schedules a physical, 140-power Steel Doom Desire against each foe. An existing delayed attack is delayed by another 2 turns instead. Outside Cold Eclipse, its Defense and Sp. Def drop is attempted only once per opposing Pokemon per battle for each Pressure user. Switching, Transform and ability loss or regain do not reset that allowance; a blocked or reflected attempt spends it. Cold Eclipse retains repeatable -2 drops on entry and neither spends nor resets the ordinary allowance.
omenedge.shortDesc: Stronger slicing; eligible attacks hit twice; extra foe PP cost; physical Doom Desire on fainting.

oneiricdust.name: Oneiric Dust
oneiricdust.desc: On entry, creates Psychic Terrain for 5 turns, or 8 with Amplifield Rock, subject to field and Aura rules. Once per switch-in, its first powder move that successfully hits a foe also lowers that foe's Sp. Def by 1 stage. Misses, immunity and protection do not spend the effect.
oneiricdust.shortDesc: The first landed powder move each entry lowers Sp. Def.

openingoverture.name: Opening Overture
openingoverture.desc: Once per switch-in, successfully using a sound move starts Tailwind for 3 turns. An existing longer Tailwind is not shortened.
openingoverture.shortDesc: Once per entry, a successful sound move starts 3-turn Tailwind.

opensky.name: Open Sky
opensky.desc: While itemless, immune to entry-hazard damage, Toxic Spikes poison and Sticky Web Speed drops; Flying moves do not make contact.
opensky.shortDesc: While itemless: immune to entry hazards; Flying moves make no contact.

opportunist.name: Opportunist
opportunist.desc: Copies foes' positive stat changes after their move, entry or transformation, and at turn end. Copied changes do not loop between users.

orchardbond.name: Orchard Bond
orchardbond.desc: Eligible single-target attacks hit three times. In singles and doubles, native variable multi-hit moves use their maximum hit count, keeping native per-hit accuracy and damage. Remaining native hits can continue into another living opposing active Pokemon after a KO at 70% damage. Excludes non-FFA spread, charge, delayed, Z/Max and extra-hit-barred moves. Follow-ups deal 30% damage, retargeting another living opposing active Pokemon after a KO. In FFA, single-target moves hit all foes at 1.3x power; spread moves hit all foes three times with 30% follow-ups. Full-power spread stays full power. Moves have 1.2x power on Dragon's Den. At turn end with an empty item slot, has a 50% chance to restore its last consumed Berry or field seed. Guaranteed in sun or on Grassy Field and Stage 2 Flower Garden.
orchardbond.shortDesc: FFA singles hit all foes at 1.3x; 50% chance to restore a consumed Berry/seed each turn.

orichalcumpulse.name: Orichalcum Pulse
orichalcumpulse.desc: On switch-in, summons Sunny Day. During Sunny Day, Attack is 1.3333x.
orichalcumpulse.shortDesc: On switch-in, summons Sunny Day. During Sunny Day, Attack is 1.3333x.

overcoat.name: Overcoat
overcoat.desc: Immune to powder moves, Rage Powder, Effect Spore, sandstorm damage and hail damage.
overcoat.shortDesc: Immune to powder effects, sandstorm and hail damage.

overgrow.name: Overgrow
overgrow.desc: When it has 1/3 or less of its max HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Grass-type attack.
overgrow.shortDesc: At 1/3 or less of its max HP, its offensive stat is 1.5x with Grass attacks.

owntempo.name: Own Tempo
owntempo.desc: Prevents and cures confusion and blocks Intimidate's Attack drop.
owntempo.shortDesc: No confusion or Intimidate Attack drop.

palmmastery.name: Palm Mastery
palmmastery.desc: Incoming Fire and Ice attacks use half the attacker's offensive stat. Immune to hail damage. Force Palm always inflicts paralysis when it lands, subject to status immunities. Its paralysis becomes a primary effect rather than a secondary roll.
palmmastery.shortDesc: Force Palm always paralyzes when it lands.

paradoxengine.name: Paradox Engine
paradoxengine.desc: Speed and Fighting/Electric power rise 30% in their conditions. Speed increases by 30% in sun or Electric Terrain; Fighting- and Electric-type moves gain 30% power.
paradoxengine.shortDesc: Speed and Fighting/Electric power rise 30% in their conditions.

paradoxpower.name: Paradox Power
paradoxpower.desc: Its attacks with secondary effects have their power multiplied by 1.3, but the secondary effects are removed. If a secondary effect was removed, it also removes the user's Life Orb recoil and Shell Bell recovery, and prevents the target's Anger Shell, Berserk, Color Change, Emergency Exit, Pickpocket, Wimp Out, Red Card, Eject Button, Kee Berry, and Maranga Berry from activating. Electric moves receive STAB.
paradoxpower.shortDesc: Moves lose secondary effects for 1.3x power; Electric moves receive STAB.

paradoxpull.name: Paradox Pull
paradoxpull.desc: Prevents opposing Steel-type Pokemon from choosing to switch out, unless they are holding a Shed Shell or are a Ghost type. Its Steel typing only contributes resistances and immunities, not weaknesses.
paradoxpull.shortDesc: Prevents opposing Steel-type Pokemon from choosing to switch out — ignores Steel weaknesses.

paradoxwheel.name: Paradox Wheel
paradoxwheel.desc: It gains STAB on Steel- and Electric-type moves.

parasitism.name: Parasitism
parasitism.desc: Absorbs Water moves for 1/4 max HP; incoming Fire moves have 1.25x power. Effective rain heals 1/8 HP per turn; sun costs 1/8. Field healing per turn: 1/16 on Underwater, Swamp, Misty or grounded Water Surface; 1/8 when grounded and Poison-type on Murkwater. Corrosive Mist heals Poison types by 1/8 but damages non-Steel others by 1/8. Desert costs 1/8 HP per turn. While above 50% HP, its weaknesses are neutralized, Magic Guard is active, opposing status moves fail, and opposing attack secondary effects are blocked. The first time Parasect would faint, it fake-faints at 1 HP, then becomes Parasect-Parasite at the end of the turn and revives at full HP. This Ability cannot be suppressed and is immune to Neutralization.
parasitism.shortDesc: Above half: defensive protection; first KO triggers Resuscitation.

parentalbond.name: Parental Bond
parentalbond.desc: Eligible attacks hit twice; the second hit deals 80% damage. Existing multi-hit moves, spread hits, charging or delayed attacks, Z/Max moves and moves barred from extra hits are excluded. Cannot be suppressed. Fixed-damage attacks retain their fixed-damage handling. Existing KO spillover and Free-for-All follow-up rules remain. Family Guardian provides Mega Kangaskhan’s Friend Guard protection.
parentalbond.shortDesc: Eligible attacks hit twice; the second hit deals 80% damage.

pastelsanctuary.name: Pastel Sanctuary
pastelsanctuary.desc: Full local Pastel Veil, including poison prevention and cures for itself and allies, opposing Poison-move Attack and Sp. Atk drops, and all field effects. Once per actual entry, attempts to heal itself and each adjacent living ally by 1/8 of that target's current maximum HP. Normal healing prevention applies; full HP or a blocked heal still spends the entry activation. Other Pokemon entering, ability acquisition and restarting after suppression do not trigger this heal; an entry while suppressed does not postpone it.
pastelsanctuary.shortDesc: Pastel Veil; actual entry heals itself and adjacent allies by 1/8 max HP.

pastelveil.name: Pastel Veil
pastelveil.desc: It and its allies cannot be poisoned. Gaining this Ability while it or its ally is poisoned cures them. Before an opposing Pokemon uses a Poison-type move, that Pokemon's Attack and Special Attack are lowered by 1 stage.
pastelveil.shortDesc: Prevents poison; opposing Poison move users lose Atk/SpA.

patientmarksman.name: Patient Marksman
patientmarksman.desc: Sniper: gains one accuracy stage on entry and has its critical-damage modifier. Successfully using Focus Energy also clears its confusion and negative accuracy stages, preserving positive accuracy and other stages. Failed Focus Energy grants no cleanse.
patientmarksman.shortDesc: Successful Focus Energy clears its confusion and negative accuracy.

patriarchswrath.name: Royal Onslaught
patriarchswrath.desc: Power Drill boosts drill and horn moves by 1.5x, or 2x with protection bypass on its supported rocky fields. Whiplash grants +1 accuracy on entry and 1.5x tail-move power. Poison and Ground attacks use the higher Attack/Defense or Sp. Atk/Sp. Def ratio to choose their damage category. Horn and tail moves gain one critical-hit stage.
patriarchswrath.shortDesc: Power Drill + Whiplash; adaptive Poison/Ground category; horn/tail +1 critical stage.

patternshift.name: Pattern Shift
patternshift.desc: Before using a move, changes to that move's type. Excludes reflected, delayed, Snatched and move-calling attacks; type-change restrictions still apply. At turn end, if statused, affected by a listed ailment, negatively boosted or at half HP or less, has a 50% chance to heal 1/4 max HP, cure status, clear negative stages and remove Attract, confusion, Curse, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Leech Seed, Nightmare, Perish Song, Taunt, Torment and Yawn. On Dragon's Den, activation is guaranteed but only cures status and heals, then raises its higher attacking stat by 1 and lowers both defenses by 1. Ignores target Defense/Sp. Def/evasion stages when attacking, and attacker Attack/Defense/Sp. Atk/accuracy stages when defending. Reveals opposing Illusions on entry.
patternshift.shortDesc: Changes type to match each eligible move; Dragon's Den changes the effect; reveals Illusions.

pearlcurrent.name: Pearl Current
pearlcurrent.desc: Absorbs other Pokemon's Water moves, healing 1/4 max HP instead of being hit. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn on Underwater, grounded on Water Surface, or grounded and Poison-type on Murkwater Surface. The first Water-type move absorbed each switch-in also heals its lowest-HP active ally by 1/8 of that ally's max HP.
pearlcurrent.shortDesc: First Water absorption each entry also heals an ally by 1/8 HP.

pearlsiphon.name: Pearl Siphon
pearlsiphon.desc: Competitive. After an attack without drain deals opposing HP damage, restores 1/8 actual damage, capped at 1/8 max HP per turn. Resolves after the whole attack; excludes ally and Substitute-only damage. Ordinary ability-healing restrictions apply.
pearlsiphon.shortDesc: Competitive; non-draining attacks restore 1/8 opposing HP damage, capped each turn.

pearltide.name: Pearl Tide
pearltide.desc: Hydration. Once per turn after a Water attack damages opposing HP, restores 1/16 max HP to this living active Pokemon and its lowest-HP-percentage adjacent living ally. Resolves after the whole attack; ordinary healing restrictions apply.
pearltide.shortDesc: Hydration; Water HP hit heals self and weakest adjacent ally 1/16 once per turn.

pendulumswing.name: Pendulum Swing
pendulumswing.desc: Prevents and cures sleep, blocks Yawn, and gives Dark and Ghost attacks 1.3x power. Its own moves cannot miss.
pendulumswing.shortDesc: Insomnia; its own moves cannot miss.

peppersting.name: Pepper Sting
peppersting.desc: Prevents and cures sleep, blocks Yawn, and gives Dark and Ghost attacks 1.3x power. After using a Fire move, its first Grass attack to damage a foe each switch-in lowers that foe's Speed and Sp. Def by 1 stage.
peppersting.shortDesc: A Fire move primes the next Grass hit to lower Speed and Sp. Def.

perfectapple.name: Perfect Apple
perfectapple.desc: Pure Power, Self Sufficient and Anger Shell: doubles Attack (Sp. Atk instead on Psychic Terrain), heals 1/16 max HP per turn and prevents sand/hail damage. Crossing from above half HP to half HP or below through qualifying attack damage triggers normal Anger Shell: +1 Attack, Sp. Atk and Speed; -1 Defense and Sp. Def.
perfectapple.shortDesc: Pure Power + Self Sufficient + Anger Shell.

perfectego.name: Perfect Ego
perfectego.desc: Moves ignore bypassable abilities. After dealing HP damage, heals 1/16 max HP once per turn. The first opposing HP hit gives +1 Attack and Sp. Atk and heals 1/16 max HP; later hits heal 1/20 until it completes a damaging move and resets this trigger. On Ashen Beach, New World, Starlight Arena, Cold Eclipse and Fairy Tale, the first qualifying physical and special hits also give +1 Defense and Sp. Def respectively. In those fields, a qualifying hit at half HP or less instead heals 1/4 max HP once per activation; blocked healing does not spend it. These effects stop on Bewitched Woods, Haunted and Holy Field. Moves cannot miss, including on the suppressing fields. Against an opposing effective Ultra Instinct (including composites), its attacks ignore its own negative Attack and Sp. Atk stages. Ultra Instinct instead reduces its first HP-damaging move each turn by 40% and ignores positive Attack or Sp. Atk stages for that protected move. Stored stages are unchanged; normal +1 retaliation is unchanged. The rivalry is disabled on Bewitched Woods, Haunted and Holy.
perfectego.shortDesc: Never misses; ignores abilities; heals and gains stats in combat.

perfectforecast.name: Perfect Forecast
perfectforecast.desc: Changes Castform with effective weather and supplies only its current form's bonuses. Sunny: modified Solar Power (1.5x Sp. Atk in sun, no HP drain) and Flame Body. Rainy: Water Absorb, Rain Dish plus 1/8 extra rain recovery (3/16 total), and Hydration. Snowy: modified Slush Rush and Ice Body (2x Speed, 1/16 healing, hail immunity in supported conditions). Sandy: Earth Eater and Sand Rush. Windy: damaging Flying moves have 1.3x power, without extra Speed or priority. Normal has no added bonus. These effects require active Perfect Forecast; the separate Forecast passive only changes forms.
perfectforecast.shortDesc: Forecast form changes plus the current Castform form's named, modified bonus package.

perfectforesight.name: Perfect Foresight
perfectforesight.desc: Has its opposing-ability copying. Automatically applies target-specific Miracle Eye before a direct damaging Psychic move. Direct single-target HP damage stores a 90 BP Psychic special attack; opposing special HP damage stores a 90 BP special attack of the incoming type. Distinct qualifying attacks each queue a separate attack due next turn, including against the same opponent. At most one stored attack releases per owner per turn; additional due attacks postpone to the next turn. Snapshots its own level, Special Attack, stages and typing, without copied offensive abilities or items. Queues survive switching/fainting and coexist with ordinary Future Sight; normal live defenses apply. If its recorded slot has no living target when due, the same attack retries there next turn and remains queued until it can resolve or the battle ends. Once per battle when Alakazam Mega Evolves, sets real Reflect and Light Screen for 5 turns without shortening longer screens.
perfectforesight.shortDesc: Copies an opposing ability; Miracle Eye, queued attacks and Mega screens.

perfectillusion.name: Perfect Illusion
perfectillusion.desc: Advanced disguise copies its teammate’s STAB types, eligible selected ability and species passives until revealed. The optional Initial Disguise teammate is used on the holder’s first entry only; if unavailable, normal automatic selection applies. Auto uses the last healthy teammate on first entry, then the best threat-scored healthy teammate when possible. Blacklisted form and copying abilities are not copied. Mirror Arena entry grants +1 evasion; Chessboard grants 1.2x move power while disguised; Cold Eclipse prevents hail damage. Direct damage and reveal effects, including opposing Mind’s Eye, remove the disguise and copied traits.
perfectillusion.shortDesc: Advanced teammate disguise copies STAB, eligible ability and passives until revealed.

perfectstriker.name: Perfect Striker
perfectstriker.desc: Kicking moves have 1.4x power. Moves used by or against it always hit, including during semi-invulnerable turns. Before using a move, changes to that move's type. Excludes reflected, delayed, Snatched and move-calling attacks; type-change restrictions still apply.
perfectstriker.shortDesc: 1.4x kicks; moves by/against it always hit; changes type before moves.

performer.name: Performer
performer.desc: Copies another Pokemon’s successful dance or sound move once, without spending PP or its turn. Copies cannot trigger further copies. Has Dancer’s local dance bonuses.

perishbody.name: Perish Body
perishbody.desc: If an enemy hits it with a damaging move, all opposing Pokemon get Perish Song. If an affected opposing Pokemon already has Perish Song, its countdown is reduced by 1 instead. During Haunted Field, affected foes are trapped while adjacent to it. This effect is blocked by Holy Field and does not trigger from allies. Cursola and its forms never shorten an existing Perish Song countdown.
perishbody.shortDesc: Enemy hits apply Perish Song to foes; Cursola never shortens countdowns.

permafrost.name: Permafrost
permafrost.desc: Full local Ice Scales and Refrigerate, including their field effects.

persistent.name: Persistent
persistent.desc: The duration of Gravity, Heal Block, Magic Room, Safeguard, Tailwind, Trick Room, and Wonder Room is increased by 2 turns if the effect is started by it.
persistent.shortDesc: When used, Gravity/Heal Block/Safeguard/Tailwind/Room effects last 2 more turns.

phalanxform.name: Phalanx Form
phalanxform.desc: Eligible single-target attacks hit three times. In singles and doubles, native variable multi-hit moves use their maximum hit count, keeping native per-hit accuracy and damage. Remaining native hits can continue into another living opposing active Pokemon after a KO at 70% damage. Excludes non-FFA spread, charge, delayed, Z/Max and extra-hit-barred moves. Follow-ups deal 30% damage, retargeting another living opposing active Pokemon after a KO. In FFA, single-target moves hit all foes at 1.3x power; spread moves hit all foes three times with 30% follow-ups. Full-power spread stays full power. Moves have 1.2x power on Dragon's Den. Allies take 25% less attack damage; this does not protect the holder. Prevents critical hits and takes 20% less attack damage. Gains +1 Defense on Fairy Tale entry and +2 Defense when a foe lowers its stats.Cannot be trapped.
phalanxform.shortDesc: Hydra Bond, Friend Guard, Battle Armor and trap escape.

phantombarrage.name: Phantom Barrage
phantombarrage.desc: Prevents opposing stat drops. Moves bypass Substitute, Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil, Safeguard and Mist. Airborne: immune to Ground attacks, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web and Arena Trap unless grounded. Thousand Arrows can still hit. Eligible single-target attacks hit three times. In singles and doubles, native variable multi-hit moves use their maximum hit count, keeping native per-hit accuracy and damage. Remaining native hits can continue into another living opposing active Pokemon after a KO at 70% damage. Excludes non-FFA spread, charge, delayed, Z/Max and extra-hit-barred moves. Follow-ups deal 30% damage, retargeting another living opposing active Pokemon after a KO. In FFA, single-target moves hit all foes at 1.3x power; spread moves hit all foes three times with 30% follow-ups. Full-power spread stays full power. Moves have 1.2x power on Dragon's Den. Dragon Darts and G-Max Spirit Volley use its higher offensive stat and gain 20% power from Hydra Bond instead of extra hits. Dragon Darts keeps its two-hit pattern; Spirit Volley keeps its full-power hit and weaker follow-up against another foe. In Free-for-All battles, Dragon Darts hits all opposing Pokemon twice.
phantombarrage.shortDesc: Blocks foe stat drops; bypasses screens/Substitute; extra hits, or 1.2x power for signature moves.

phantomfist.name: Phantom Fist
phantomfist.desc: Contact moves pierce protection at 1/4 damage (75% less); Max Guard blocks them. Unprotected damage is unchanged. Punching moves have 1.4x power. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn and ignores sandstorm and hail damage. A contact attacker that knocks it out loses 1/4 max HP, or 1/2 on Corrosive Mist; Damp prevents this damage.

pickpocket.name: Pickpocket
pickpocket.desc: If it has no item and is hit by a contact move, it steals the attacker's item. This effect applies after all hits from a multi-hit move. This effect is prevented if the move had a secondary effect removed by the Sheer Force Ability.
pickpocket.shortDesc: If it has no item and is hit by a contact move, it steals the attacker's item.

pickup.name: Pickup
pickup.desc: At turn end, if it is not holding an item and at least one adjacent Pokemon used an item during this turn, one of those Pokemon is selected at random and it obtains that Pokemon's last used item. An item is not considered the last used if it was a popped Air Balloon, if the item was picked up by another Pokemon with this Ability, or if the item was lost to Bug Bite, Corrosive Gas, Covet, Incinerate, Knock Off, Pluck, or Thief. Items thrown with Fling can be picked up.
pickup.shortDesc: If it has no item, it finds one used by an adjacent Pokemon this turn.

piercingdrill.name: Piercing Drill
piercingdrill.desc: Contact moves pierce protection at 1/4 damage (75% less). Max Guard blocks them. Unprotected damage is unchanged.
piercingdrill.shortDesc: Contact moves pierce protection at 1/4 damage.

pincercrush.name: Pincer Crush
pincercrush.desc: Contact moves have 1.3x power. Once per switch-in, its first Steel-type contact attack to damage a foe lowers the foe's Defense by 1 stage.
pincercrush.shortDesc: First Steel contact hit per entry lowers the foe’s Defense.

pixilate.name: Pixilate
pixilate.desc: Eligible Normal moves become Fairy and have 1.2x power, or 1.5x on Misty Terrain. Excludes moves whose type is set by their own effect, damaging Z-Moves and Terastallized Tera Blast.
pixilate.shortDesc: Normal moves become Fairy with 1.2x power; Misty boost.

plus.name: Plus
plus.desc: Its Electric- and Steel-type moves use 1.3x Attack and Sp. Atk. In Electric Terrain, its Sp. Atk is multiplied by 1.5.
plus.shortDesc: Electric/Steel moves use 1.3x Atk/SpA; Electric Terrain gives 1.5x SpA.

plushwhiplash.name: Plush Whiplash
plushwhiplash.desc: Entry raises accuracy by 1. Tail attacks gain 1.5x power. Technician checks effective power before the tail boost: moves with 60 or less power (80 on Factory) gain 1.5x power.

poisonheal.name: Poison Heal
poisonheal.desc: Poison damage instead heals 1/8 max HP. Also heals 1/8 each turn on Corrosive Mist and Murkwater Surface, or while grounded on Corrosive and Wasteland.
poisonheal.shortDesc: Poison heals 1/8 HP; healing on corrosive fields.

poisonpoint.name: Poison Point
poisonpoint.desc: Contact attackers have a 30% poison chance, or 60% on Wasteland.

poisonpuppeteer.name: Poison Puppeteer
poisonpuppeteer.desc: If it is a Pecharunt and poisons or badly poisons a target, the target also becomes confused.
poisonpuppeteer.shortDesc: Pecharunt: If it poisons a target, the target also becomes confused.

poisontouch.name: Poison Touch
poisontouch.desc: Contact hits have a 30% chance to poison the target. Shield Dust and Covert Cloak block this effect.
poisontouch.shortDesc: Contact hits have a 30% poison chance.

polarrest.name: Polar Rest
polarrest.desc: Early Bird + Ice Body: sleep lasts half as long; contact attackers have a 30% frostbite chance. Heals 1/16 max HP in hail/snow or on Icy, Snowy Mountain and Cold Eclipse fields; 1/8 in Cold Eclipse hail. Immune to hail damage.

pollenbloom.name: Pollen Bloom
pollenbloom.desc: Thick Fat + Unaware. Fire and Ice attacks use half the attacker's attacking stat; hail causes no damage. Ignores the foe's Defense, Sp. Def and evasion changes when attacking, and their Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk and accuracy changes when defending. Reveals opposing Illusions on entry. At each turn's end, drains 1/16 of each foe's base max HP and heals by the HP actually drained. Grass types and Grass-immune foes are unaffected. In Free-for-All only, Grass weaknesses and resistances change the drain amount.
pollenbloom.shortDesc: Thick Fat, Unaware and Grass chip recovery.

pollenengine.name: Pollen Engine
pollenengine.desc: Doubles Speed in sun or Stage 4 Flower Garden. Once per turn, successfully hitting a foe with a powder move or damaging Grass move heals itself and adjacent allies by 1/16 max HP, or 1/8 in sunlight.
pollenengine.shortDesc: Grass or powder hits heal it and its allies, more in sun.

powerconstruct.name: Power Construct
powerconstruct.desc: If it is a Zygarde in its 10% or 50% Forme, it changes to Complete Forme when it has 1/2 or less of its max HP at the end of the turn.
powerconstruct.shortDesc: If Zygarde 10%/50%, changes to Complete if at 1/2 max HP or less at end of turn.

powerdrill.name: Power Drill
powerdrill.desc: Drill and horn moves have 1.5x power, or 2x on Rocky, Mountain, Snowy Mountain, Cave and Volcanic, where they also bypass protection.
powerdrill.shortDesc: Drill/horn moves have 1.5x power; 2x and pierce protection on rocky fields.

powerofalchemy.name: Power of Alchemy
powerofalchemy.desc: It has Self Sufficient and Regenerator's effects. It copies a fainted ally's Ability while retaining both built-in effects until it switches out.
powerofalchemy.shortDesc: Self Sufficient + Regenerator; copies a fainted ally's Ability and has both.

powerspot.name: Power Spot
powerspot.desc: Allies' moves have 1.3x power, or 1.5x on Haunted, Bewitched Woods, Holy and Psychic fields.
powerspot.shortDesc: Allies' moves have 1.3x power (1.5x on specified fields).

prankster.name: Prankster
prankster.desc: Status moves gain +1 priority. Opposing Dark types block these moves except on Bewitched Woods.
prankster.shortDesc: Status moves gain +1 priority; Dark foes usually block them.

precision.name: Precision
precision.desc: Super-effective moves used by it cannot miss and have an increased critical-hit ratio.
precision.shortDesc: Super-effective moves never miss; boosted critical-hit ratio.

predator.name: Predator
predator.desc: Doubles attack power against active Ultra Ego, Ultra Instinct and composites containing them. In this matchup only, ignores positive Defense and Special Defense stages and those Ultra damage reductions; negative stages, unrelated defenses and post-hit healing remain. This replaces its first-action bonus and is disabled when the Ultra component is suppressed, including Bewitched Woods, Haunted and Holy Terrain. Existing authority bonus remains: 2x against Neutralization, or Royal Decree/Empress without active Neutralization. Otherwise newly switched or pending-action targets take 1.3x power, 2x on Mountain/Snowy Mountain/Rocky, or 1.5x on Fairy Tale/Dragon's Den/Big Top. Reverses received stat-stage changes without stacking with Contrary.
predator.shortDesc: Extra power against authority and active Ultra abilities, or foes that have not acted.

pressure.name: Pressure
pressure.desc: On entry, lowers foes' Defense and Sp. Def by 1 (2 on Cold Eclipse) and changes Underwater to Midnight Zone. Foes targeting it spend 1 extra PP, or 2 on Midnight Zone. Outside Cold Eclipse, its Defense and Sp. Def drop is attempted only once per opposing Pokemon per battle for each Pressure user. Switching, Transform and ability loss or regain do not reset that allowance; a blocked or reflected attempt spends it. Cold Eclipse retains repeatable -2 drops on entry and neither spends nor resets the ordinary allowance.
pressure.shortDesc: Entry: -1 foe Def/SpD once per foe per user per battle; Cold Eclipse repeats -2. Extra PP cost.

pressurekiln.name: Pressure Kiln
pressurekiln.desc: Stores half the actual HP damage from opposing direct moves, up to 1/4 max HP. Its next Fire attack dealing opposing HP damage consumes the reservoir and heals the stored amount. Residual, recoil, ally and Substitute-only damage do not fill it. Switching clears storage.
pressurekiln.shortDesc: Stores half foe move HP damage (cap 1/4 max HP); next Fire HP hit consumes it to heal.

pridecall.name: Pridecall
pridecall.desc: Competitive + Unnerve. Opposing stat drops grant +2 Sp. Atk outside Chess Board; on Chess Board, has Competitive's missing-HP power boost instead. Foes cannot eat Berries or use field seeds while Unnerve is active; has its Cold Eclipse entry Speed drops.

primalego.name: Primal Ego
primalego.desc: Ignores target Defense/Sp. Def/evasion stages when attacking, and attacker Attack/Defense/Sp. Atk/accuracy stages when defending. Reveals opposing Illusions on entry. Moves ignore bypassable abilities. After dealing HP damage, heals 1/16 max HP once per turn. The first opposing HP hit gives +1 Attack and Sp. Atk and heals 1/16 max HP; later hits heal 1/20 until it completes a damaging move and resets this trigger. On Ashen Beach, New World, Starlight Arena, Cold Eclipse and Fairy Tale, the first qualifying physical and special hits also give +1 Defense and Sp. Def respectively. In those fields, a qualifying hit at half HP or less instead heals 1/4 max HP once per activation; blocked healing does not spend it. These effects stop on Bewitched Woods, Haunted and Holy Field. Against an opposing effective Ultra Instinct (including composites), its attacks ignore its own negative Attack and Sp. Atk stages. Ultra Instinct instead reduces its first HP-damaging move each turn by 40% and ignores positive Attack or Sp. Atk stages for that protected move. Stored stages are unchanged; normal +1 retaliation is unchanged. The rivalry is disabled on Bewitched Woods, Haunted and Holy.

primalrhythm.name: Primal Rhythm
primalrhythm.desc: Damaging sound moves become physical and use Attack. These moves spare allies. Retains normal sound interactions, including Soundproof and Throat Chop.
primalrhythm.shortDesc: Sound attacks use Attack and spare allies.

primaltactics.name: Primal Tactics
primaltactics.desc: Its Special Attack is multiplied by 1.5, but it can only select the first move it executes. These effects are prevented while it is Dynamaxed.
primaltactics.shortDesc: Its Sp. Atk is 1.5x, but it can only select the first move it executes.

primevalhunger.name: Primeval Hunger
primevalhunger.desc: Incoming Fire and Ice attacks use half the attacker's offensive stat. Immune to sandstorm and hail damage. It can use Belch without eating a Berry and automatically gains one Stockpile every second eligible active turn, first gaining one after two eligible turns. Genuine switching resets this wait; ability restarts do not. Suppressed or otherwise ineligible turns do not advance the counter. Manual Stockpile is unchanged. After reaching 3 Stockpiles, it waits one full turn before randomly choosing Belch or Spit Up with equal odds, then can release every other turn. Its established Spit Up and Swallow combinations still apply. Draining attacks that damage a foe's HP and successful new Leech Seed applications by Leech Seed or Sappy Seed mark affected foes. Failed, or reflected seeds and residual seed ticks do not trigger this effect. After the whole move, lower one positive Attack or Sp. Atk stage of each affected foe, choosing the more boosted stat and Sp. Atk on ties. Never lowers an unboosted stat or grants the user a boost. Substitute-only damage does not trigger these effects; normal stat-drop protections apply.
primevalhunger.shortDesc: Accumulation; draining hits and new seeds lower one positive offensive stage.

primevalhunt.name: Primeval Hunt
primevalhunt.desc: Multi-hit moves use their maximum hit count, gain 1.5x power and check accuracy once. Flinching raises Speed by one stage but still prevents acting. Electric Terrain entry raises Speed by one stage. Ashen Beach accuracy checks succeed unless the target has Unnerve..

primevalshield.name: Primeval Shield
primevalshield.desc: After each damaging hit from another Pokemon, that attacker takes recoil equal to half the actual HP damage dealt, rounded down with a minimum of 1. The holder recovers the same calculated amount if it survives. Applies to contact and noncontact hits, including allied hits, independently for each hit of multi-hit moves. Substitute-only damage, self-damage and indirect damage do not trigger it. A lethal hit can recoil onto the attacker but cannot revive the holder. Rock Head and Magic Guard can prevent the recoil; normal healing prevention and modifiers apply independently to recovery. Suppression disables both effects.
primevalshield.shortDesc: Each hit: attacker takes 50% damage as recoil; holder heals the same amount.

primevalskull.name: Primeval Skull
primevalskull.desc: Once per battle, a damaging move that would knock this Pokemon out instead leaves it at 1 HP, even if it already has only 1 HP. No chance roll or full-HP requirement. Switching and ability changes do not reset the use. Later hits of a multi-hit move can still knock it out. Suppression prevents activation without consuming the use. Includes Rock Head: prevents ordinary recoil, including Primeval Shield recoil; does not prevent Struggle recoil, crash damage, self-KO costs, weather, status or other indirect damage.
primevalskull.shortDesc: Once per battle, survives a lethal hit at 1 HP from any HP; Rock Head.

primordialconstruct.name: Primordial Construct
primordialconstruct.desc: Above half HP, halves damage from attacks except Dark, Ghost, Ground and Fighting. Checks HP before each hit. Normal typing, weaknesses, resistances and immunities remain unchanged.
primordialconstruct.shortDesc: Above half HP: halves attack damage except Dark, Ghost, Ground and Fighting.

primordialsea.name: Primordial Sea
primordialsea.desc: On switch-in, the weather becomes Primordial Sea, which includes all the effects of Rain Dance and prevents damaging Fire-type moves from executing. This weather remains in effect until this Ability is no longer active for any Pokemon, or the weather is changed by the Delta Stream or Desolate Land Abilities.
primordialsea.shortDesc: On switch-in, heavy rain begins until this Ability is not active in battle.

prismarmor.name: Prism Armor
