prismarmor.desc: Takes 20% less attack damage, plus a further 25% reduction against super-effective attacks or on Crystal Cavern and Dark Crystal Cavern (40% total). Defense and Sp. Def are 4/3x on Cold Eclipse, Dark Crystal Cavern and Rainbow. Immune to hail damage on Cold Eclipse.
prismarmor.shortDesc: 20% less attack damage; 40% less if super effective; field defenses.

prismscale.name: Prism Scale
prismscale.desc: Friend Guard reduces attack damage to allies by 25%. Oblivious blocks Attract, Captivate, Taunt, and Intimidate's Attack drop. Swift Swim boosts Speed in rain and supported water fields.
prismscale.shortDesc: Friend Guard reduces attack damage to allies by 25%.

prismskimmer.name: Prism Skimmer
prismskimmer.desc: Water attacks receive ordinary 1.5x STAB without stacking extra STAB when already Water. Incoming Fire, Water, Ice and Steel attack damage is halved, without adding Water typing or weaknesses. Gains ordinary two-turn Laser Focus on genuine entry and once after surviving opposing attack HP damage; no ally, residual or Substitute-only triggers.
prismskimmer.shortDesc: Water STAB and resistances; Laser Focus on entry or after surviving a hit.

prismwings.name: Prism Wings
prismwings.desc: Tinted Lens doubles calculated damage from resisted attacks. Its first resisted attack hit that deals positive damage to a foe's HP after ability activation raises its Speed by 1 stage immediately after that hit, once per activation, including only once during a multi-hit move. Misses, protection, immunity, Substitute-only hits and allied hits do not trigger the boost. Selected-ability suppression disables these effects. Entry, acquiring this ability, or restarting it after Neutralizing Gas renews the Speed boost; removing Gastro Acid without restarting the ability does not.
prismwings.shortDesc: Tinted Lens; first resisted foe HP hit after activation gives +1 Speed.

propellertail.name: Propeller Tail
propellertail.desc: Moves cannot be redirected. Speed doubles on Water Surface, Underwater and Midnight Zone.
propellertail.shortDesc: Ignores redirection; double Speed on water fields.

protean.name: Protean
protean.desc: Before using a move, changes to that move's type. Excludes reflected, delayed, Snatched and move-calling attacks; type-change restrictions still apply.
protean.shortDesc: Changes type to match each eligible move.

protectiveward.name: Protective Ward
protectiveward.desc: Sound moves become Water-type, or Ice-type on Icy Field, and have 1.2x power. Prevents critical hits and takes 20% less attack damage. Gains +1 Defense on Fairy Tale or Dragon's Den entry and +2 Sp. Def when a foe lowers its stats. Absorbs other Pokemon's Water moves, healing 1/4 max HP instead of being hit. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn on Underwater, grounded on Water Surface, or grounded and Poison-type on Murkwater Surface. It can use Arenite Wall and Aurora Veil regardless of weather or field.

protosynthesis.name: Protosynthesis
protosynthesis.desc: If Sunny Day is active or it uses a held Booster Energy, its highest stat is multiplied by 1.3, or by 1.5 if the highest stat is Speed. Stat stage changes are considered at the time this Ability activates. If multiple stats are tied, Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed are prioritized in that order. If this effect was started by Sunny Day, a held Booster Energy will not activate and the effect ends when Sunny Day is no longer active. If this effect was started by a held Booster Energy, it ends when it is no longer active.
protosynthesis.shortDesc: Sunny Day active or Booster Energy used: highest stat is 1.3x, or 1.5x if Speed.

psychedominion.name: Psyche Dominion
psychedominion.desc: Psychic Surge + Dishearten: entry lowers adjacent foes’ Sp. Atk by 1, respecting Substitute and stat-drop protection. Psychic attacks use the target’s lower effective Defense or Sp. Def, retaining their category and offensive stat.
psychedominion.shortDesc: Psychic Surge + Dishearten; Psychic attacks use the lower defense.

psycheforce.name: Psyche Force
psycheforce.desc: Tough Claws + Iron Fist (1.4x punching power). Contact attacks heal 1/3 of opposing HP damage, stacking with move draining.
psycheforce.shortDesc: Tough Claws + Iron Fist; contact attacks heal 1/3 of opposing HP damage.

psychicsurge.name: Psychic Surge
psychicsurge.desc: On entry, creates Psychic Terrain for 5 turns, or 8 with Amplifield Rock, subject to field and Aura rules.

pulseblockade.name: Pulse Blockade
pulseblockade.desc: On entry, sets Snowy Mountain Field for 3 turns. While active and effective, prevents other fields from being created or replacing the current field. Auras, natural field expiry, and restoration of an underlying field still work. Field creation or refresh is attempted only once per battle per holder, even if blocked; switching, suppression, revival, or ability changes never reset this use. Avalugg-Pulse always uses Avalanche, Earthquake, Hammer Arm, and Heavy Slam; it cannot use Recover. Its field creation or refresh lasts exactly 3 turns; Amplifield Rock does not extend it.
pulseblockade.shortDesc: Sets a 3-turn Snowy Mountain Field; blocks other field creation while active.

pulsebulwark.name: Pulse Bulwark
pulsebulwark.desc: Mr. Mime-Pulse automatically receives Light Screen, Reflect, Dazzling Gleam, and Dark Pulse in that order. On entry, sets Short-Circuit Field for 3 turns. Reflect and Light Screen gain +1 priority. Once per actual entry, successfully creating a new one of these screens cures major status on it and its active allies. Ability changes do not reset the cure. Screens retain their normal duration, removal, and bypass rules. Field creation or refresh is attempted only once per battle per holder, even if blocked; switching, suppression, revival, or ability changes never reset this use. Its field creation, refresh and conversion last exactly 3 turns; Amplifield Rock does not extend them.
pulsebulwark.shortDesc: 3 turns Short-Circuit; +1-priority screens; first new screen per entry cures active allies' status.

pulseeruption.name: Pulse Eruption
pulseeruption.desc: Camerupt-Pulse automatically receives Eruption, Snarl, Shadow Ball, and Earth Power in that order. Sturdy: OHKO moves fail, and direct move damage cannot KO it from full HP. On entry, attempts to create or refresh Super-Heated Terrain for 3 turns, respecting normal field restrictions. Skill Swap fails. At Camerupt-Pulse's fixed 1 HP, Sturdy can prevent repeated direct hits; indirect damage and ability bypass remain effective. Field creation or refresh is attempted only once per battle per holder, even if blocked; switching, suppression, revival, or ability changes never reset this use. Camerupt must be at full HP immediately before Pulse Evolution or it faints before its HP is converted to 1. Its field creation, refresh and conversion last exactly 3 turns; Amplifield Rock does not extend them.
pulseeruption.shortDesc: 5-turn Super-Heated field on entry; no Skill Swap.

pulsefiltration.name: Pulse Filtration
pulsefiltration.desc: Water Absorb and Liquid Ooze, plus Poison-move absorption: Water or Poison moves from another Pokemon heal 1/4 max HP once instead of hitting, even if healing fails. Water Absorb also heals 1/16 on its supported water fields; Liquid Ooze reverses drain, Leech Seed and Strength Sap recovery, doubled on Murkwater Surface or Wasteland. On entry, attempts 3-turn Murkwater Surface. While Swalot-Pulse is active, Underwater immediately becomes 3-turn Murkwater Surface, including after its entry field use is spent; field blockers and suppression still apply. This does not refresh an existing Murkwater Surface. Swalot-Pulse always uses Sludge Wave, Recover, Infestation, and Discharge. Field creation or refresh is attempted only once per battle per holder, even if blocked; switching, suppression, revival, or ability changes never reset this use. Its field creation, refresh and conversion last exactly 3 turns; Amplifield Rock does not extend them.
pulsefiltration.shortDesc: Also absorbs Poison moves; transforms Underwater into Murkwater.

pulsetriad.name: Pulse Triad
pulsetriad.desc: Eligible single-target attacks hit three times. In singles and doubles, native variable multi-hit moves use their maximum hit count, keeping native per-hit accuracy and damage. Remaining native hits can continue into another living opposing active Pokemon after a KO at 70% damage. Excludes non-FFA spread, charge, delayed, Z/Max and extra-hit-barred moves. Follow-ups deal 30% damage, retargeting another living opposing active Pokemon after a KO. In FFA, single-target moves hit all foes at 1.3x power; spread moves hit all foes three times with 30% follow-ups. Full-power spread stays full power. Moves have 1.2x power on Dragon's Den. Airborne: immune to Ground attacks, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web and Arena Trap unless grounded. Thousand Arrows can still hit. Prevents opposing stat drops. On entry, sets Factory Field for 3 turns. Eligible single-target attacks hit three times, it is ungrounded, and opponents cannot lower its stats. Field creation or refresh is attempted only once per battle per holder, even if blocked; switching, suppression, revival, or ability changes never reset this use. Magnezone-Pulse automatically receives Flash Cannon, Discharge, Recover, and Autotomize in that order. Its field creation, refresh and conversion last exactly 3 turns; Amplifield Rock does not extend them.

pulsewaste.name: Pulse Waste
pulsewaste.desc: Muk-Pulse summons Swamp Field for 3 turns, subject to field-generation blockers. Before using a move, changes to that move's type. Excludes reflected, delayed, Snatched and move-calling attacks; type-change restrictions still apply. Contact hits have a 30% chance to poison the target. Shield Dust and Covert Cloak block this effect. Heals 1/3 max HP on switching out. Muk-Pulse always uses Sludge Wave, Earth Power, Muddy Water, and Discharge. Field creation or refresh is attempted only once per battle per holder, even if blocked; switching, suppression, revival, or ability changes never reset this use. Its field creation, refresh and conversion last exactly 3 turns; Amplifield Rock does not extend them.
pulsewaste.shortDesc: Once per battle, attempts to set 5-turn Swamp Field; uses a fixed moveset.

punchfiend.name: Punch Fiend
punchfiend.desc: Keen Eye prevents opposing accuracy drops, ignores evasion boosts and reveals opposing Illusions; Mirror Arena entry grants +1 accuracy and Laser Focus. Unseen Fist lets contact moves pierce protection at 1/4 damage; Max Guard blocks them. Inner Focus prevents flinching and Intimidate Attack drops. Hitmonchan receives Iron Fist separately as its species passive.
punchfiend.shortDesc: Keen Eye, Unseen Fist and Inner Focus.

punkrock.name: Punk Rock
punkrock.desc: Sound moves have 1.3x power, or 1.5x on Big Top and Cave. Takes half damage from sound moves.
punkrock.shortDesc: Boosts sound moves; takes half sound damage.

purepower.name: Pure Power
purepower.desc: Doubles Attack, or Sp. Atk instead on Psychic Terrain.
purepower.shortDesc: Doubles Attack; Psychic Terrain doubles Sp. Atk instead.

purifyingfrost.name: Purifying Frost
purifyingfrost.desc: On activation, cures status conditions from it and its active allies. Once per genuine switch-in, after its first Ice-type move successfully affects a target, it sets Safeguard on its side for 5 turns. Misses, protection, immunity and failed moves do not trigger or spend it. Ability changes or restarts do not refresh the spent entry budget.
purifyingfrost.shortDesc: Cures the active team on entry; first successful Ice move sets Safeguard.

purifyingsalt.name: Purifying Salt
purifyingsalt.desc: It cannot become affected by a non-volatile status condition or Yawn. If a Pokemon uses a Ghost-type attack against it, that Pokemon's offensive stat is halved when calculating the damage to it.
purifyingsalt.shortDesc: Ghost damage to it dealt with a halved offensive stat; can't be statused.

pursuitwake.name: Pursuit Wake
pursuitwake.desc: Infiltrator. Aqua Jet that deals damage clears its negative Speed stages, preserving positive Speed. Misses, protection and damage immunity give no cleanse.
pursuitwake.shortDesc: Damaging Aqua Jet clears its negative Speed stages.

pyrousdominion.name: Grounded Instinct
pyrousdominion.desc: Absorbs other Pokemon Ground moves and heals 1/4 maximum HP. Heals 1/16 maximum HP each turn on Cave or Desert. Prevents external accuracy drops and ignores target evasion boosts. Reveals opposing Illusions on entry; Mirror Arena entry grants +1 accuracy and Laser Focus.

quarkdrive.name: Quark Drive
quarkdrive.desc: If Electric Terrain is active or it uses a held Booster Energy, its highest stat is multiplied by 1.3, or by 1.5 if the highest stat is Speed. Stat stage changes are considered at the time this Ability activates. If multiple stats are tied, Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed are prioritized in that order. If this effect was started by Electric Terrain, a held Booster Energy will not activate and the effect ends when Electric Terrain is no longer active. If this effect was started by a held Booster Energy, it ends when it is no longer active.
quarkdrive.shortDesc: Electric Terrain active or Booster Energy used: highest stat is 1.3x, or 1.5x if Speed.

quarrycannon.name: Quarry Cannon
quarrycannon.desc: Mega Launcher: pulse and bullet moves gain 50% power. Damaging pulse and bullet moves become Physical, using Attack against Defense, except Z/Max moves. Accuracy, secondary effects, hit counts, and recharge rules are unchanged.
quarrycannon.shortDesc: Mega Launcher; damaging pulse/bullet moves become Physical (except Z/Max).

queenlymajesty.name: Queenly Majesty
queenlymajesty.desc: Blocks opposing priority moves aimed at it or its allies. Attacks deal 1.5x damage on Fairy Tale, or on Chessboard unless it has the Queen role.
queenlymajesty.shortDesc: Blocks opposing priority; Fairy Tale/Chessboard attack bonus.

queensguard.name: Queen's Guard
queensguard.desc: Reverses received stat-stage changes, except Z-Power changes. At turn end, if statused, affected by a listed ailment, negatively boosted or at half HP or less, has a 50% chance to heal 1/4 max HP, cure status, clear negative stages and remove Attract, confusion, Curse, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Leech Seed, Nightmare, Perish Song, Taunt, Torment and Yawn. On Dragon's Den, activation is guaranteed but only cures status and heals, then raises its higher attacking stat by 1 and lowers both defenses by 1. On entry, lowers adjacent foes' Attack by 1. Substitute and Intimidate protections still apply.

quickdraw.name: Quick Draw
quickdraw.desc: It has a 30% chance to move first in its priority bracket with attacking moves.
quickdraw.shortDesc: It has a 30% chance to move first in its priority bracket with attacking moves.

quickfeet.name: Quick Feet
quickfeet.desc: Speed is 1.5x while statused, or 2x on Electric Terrain. Ignores paralysis's Speed penalty.
quickfeet.shortDesc: 1.5x Speed while statused; 2x on Electric Terrain.

quillreservoir.name: Quill Reservoir
quillreservoir.desc: Absorbs other Pokemon's Water moves, healing 1/4 max HP instead of being hit. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn on Underwater, grounded on Water Surface, or grounded and Poison-type on Murkwater Surface. Absorbing a Water move primes its next landed damaging Poison move to poison the target. The charge does not stack; normal status immunities apply.
quillreservoir.shortDesc: After absorbing Water, its next landed Poison attack poisons the foe.

racingspirit.name: Racing Spirit
racingspirit.desc: Rock Head + Limber: prevents move recoil except Struggle; prevents and cures paralysis and blocks opposing Speed drops. Crash damage, Life Orb and self-inflicted Speed costs still apply.

ragingbeast.name: Raging Beast
ragingbeast.desc: Attack is 1.5x while statused, and burn does not weaken physical attacks. Moves ignore bypassable opposing abilities.
ragingbeast.shortDesc: Ignores burn attack penalty; Moves ignore bypassable abilities.

ragingcurrent.name: Raging Current
ragingcurrent.desc: Doubles Speed in rain or on Water Surface, Murkwater Surface, Underwater and Midnight Zone. Absorbs Water for 1/4 max HP. Dry Skin gives incoming Fire moves 1.25x power; Damp independently halves their offensive stat, a combined 0.625x before rounding and other modifiers. Effective rain heals 1/8 HP; sun costs 1/8. Field healing: 1/16 on Underwater, Swamp, Misty or grounded Water Surface; 1/8 when grounded and Poison-type on Murkwater. Corrosive Mist heals Poison types by 1/8 but damages non-Steel others by 1/8; Desert costs 1/8. Damp blocks Explosion, Self-Destruct, Mind Blown, Misty Explosion and Aftermath damage. On Corrosive Mist it also blocks Eruption, Fire Pledge, Flame Burst, Heat Wave, Incinerate, Lava Plume, Searing Shot and Inferno Overdrive.

ragingfists.name: Raging Fists
ragingfists.desc: Hydra Bond, Normal/Fighting Ghost-immunity bypass, and damaging moves cannot miss. Has Hydra Bond's Free-for-All targeting and Dragon's Den power bonus, without an extra multi-hit power multiplier. Status moves retain their normal accuracy.
ragingfists.shortDesc: Normal/Fighting hits Ghosts; damaging moves cannot miss.

ragingheart.name: Raging Heart
ragingheart.desc: Full local Inner Focus prevents flinching and Intimidate Attack drops, subject to normal suppression and ability bypass. Directly selected Thrash becomes Ghost type, retaining its physical category, 140 power, chosen adjacent opposing target and 30% Defense-drop chance, with no extra power multiplier. Without separate Controlled Fury it has its 2-3-turn rampage lock but does not cause its own ending confusion while Raging Heart is active. External confusion remains. Annihilape supplies Controlled Fury separately as its species passive.
ragingheart.shortDesc: Inner Focus; selected Thrash becomes Ghost with no ending confusion.

ragingoverlord.name: Raging Overlord
ragingoverlord.desc: Moves ignore bypassable opposing abilities. Attacks bypass Substitute, screens and defensive stat stages and gain +1 critical-hit stage. Takes half damage from priority attacks. Immune to hail damage. Move KOs damage remaining foes by 60% of the last damage dealt; if there is no valid target or no damage is dealt, gains +1 Attack instead. Magic Guard prevents this splash damage. Cannot be suppressed. Each fainted ally adds 10% move damage; in Free-for-All, allies count twice. At 2+ fallen allies it gains Infiltrator; 4+, flinch immunity from Inner Focus; 5+, indirect-damage immunity and a one-time +1 Attack and Sp. Atk. It does not block stat drops. Effective fallen count is capped at 5 after Free-for-All doubling, for a maximum 1.5x Supreme Overlord power multiplier.

ragingstorm.name: Raging Storm
ragingstorm.desc: Moves ignore bypassable abilities, Substitute, screens and defensive stages and gain one critical-hit stage. Incoming priority attack damage is halved. Immune to hail damage. Move KOs retain the 60% damage splash or Attack increase. Cannot be suppressed.
ragingstorm.shortDesc: bypasses screens/defensive stages; priority resistance and KO splash.

railguncircuit.name: Railgun Circuit
railguncircuit.desc: Redirects eligible Electric moves, including allied moves, and absorbs Electric hits for +1 Attack and Sp. Atk. Electric Terrain entry grants both boosts. Electric attacks use 1.3x Attack or Sp. Atk, or 2x on Electric Terrain and Factory.

railsight.name: Rail Sight
railsight.desc: Prevents flinching and Intimidate Attack drops. Once per switch-in, surviving a whole opposing damaging move that hits HP stores a non-stacking 1.5x boost for the next Electric attack. Consumed when that attack executes, including misses, Protect or immunity; charge-only and interrupted turns do not consume it. Switching clears it.
railsight.shortDesc: Inner Focus; once/entry, surviving a foe HP attack powers the next Electric attack by 1.5x.

raincourier.name: Rain Courier
raincourier.desc: Rain Dish: restores 1/16 max HP in effective rain. Once per entry, successfully establishing Tailwind removes entry hazards from its own side. Failed Tailwind while already active does not trigger or spend the use.
raincourier.shortDesc: Once per entry, successfully setting Tailwind clears own-side entry hazards.

raindish.name: Rain Dish
raindish.desc: Heals 1/16 max HP each turn in effective rain.
raindish.shortDesc: Heals 1/16 HP each turn in rain.

rainlitgrowth.name: Rainlit Growth
rainlitgrowth.desc: Rain Dish restores 1/16 base max HP during effective rain or heavy rain. Grass moves have 1.3x power during effective rain or heavy rain; weather suppression disables these rain benefits.
rainlitgrowth.shortDesc: Rain Dish; Grass moves have 1.3x power in effective rain.

rainsovereign.name: Rain Sovereign
rainsovereign.desc: On entry, it sets Rain for 8 turns. Its Electric-, Water-, and Flying-type moves receive STAB. Each turn, non-immune foes take Water damage equal to 1/16 max HP. Only in Free-for-All does Water type effectiveness scale this chip.
rainsovereign.shortDesc: 8-turn Rain; Electric/Water/Flying STAB; Water chip scales by type in FFA.

raisedquills.name: Raised Quills
raisedquills.desc: Successfully using a status move stores one non-stacking retaliation. The next opposing damaging hit spends it and attempts to poison the attacker, whether or not the move makes contact. Normal poison immunities apply. Switching clears preparation.
raisedquills.shortDesc: A successful status move primes poison retaliation against the next opposing damaging hit.

rapidresponse.name: Rapid Response
rapidresponse.desc: On its first active turn, its Speed is 1.5x and its Sp. Atk is 1.2x.
rapidresponse.shortDesc: First active turn: 1.5x Spe and 1.2x Sp. Atk.

rattled.name: Rattled
rattled.desc: Its Speed is raised by 1 stage if hit by a Bug-, Dark-, or Ghost-type attack, or if an opposing Pokemon affected it with the Intimidate Ability.
rattled.shortDesc: Speed is raised 1 stage if hit by a Bug-, Dark-, or Ghost-type attack, or Intimidated.

razorcurrent.name: Razor Current
razorcurrent.desc: On entry, summons rain for 5 turns, or 8 with Damp Rock. Gains +1 Speed at the end of each full turn it spends active.
razorcurrent.shortDesc: Summons rain; gains Speed each full active turn.

razorreach.name: Razor Reach
razorreach.desc: Slicing moves have 1.5x power except on Cold Eclipse. Moves do not make contact. Keen Eye prevents opposing accuracy drops, ignores evasion boosts and reveals opposing Illusions on activation; Mirror Arena grants one Accuracy stage and Laser Focus.

reapersgrip.name: Reaper's Grip
reapersgrip.desc: Ignores target Defense/Sp. Def/evasion stages when attacking, and attacker Attack/Defense/Sp. Atk/accuracy stages when defending. Reveals opposing Illusions on entry. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn. Immune to sandstorm and hail damage. All Dark attacks have 4/3x power, or 0.75x with Aura Break. The first damaging hit leaving it at half HP or less creates Haunted Field for 3 turns, or extends a shorter Haunted Field to 3. On fainting, creates Haunted for 5 turns or adds 5 turns to an existing Haunted Field.
reapersgrip.shortDesc: Ignores foe boosts; heals 1/16 HP/turn; boosts Dark moves; sets Haunted at half HP/on fainting.

rebornflower.name: Reborn Flower
rebornflower.desc: Changes Florges to Florges-Reborn on entry. Each adjacent ally has a 50% chance to be cured of major status at turn end. Grass allies, including itself, are protected from opposing stat drops, major status and Yawn; Bewitched Woods extends this protection to all types. Does not amplify healing. Aromaveil remains separate.
rebornflower.shortDesc: Reborn form; Flower Veil and a 50% adjacent-ally status cure each turn.

rebound.name: Rebound
rebound.desc: On switch-in, it blocks certain status moves and instead uses the move against the original user.
rebound.shortDesc: On switch-in, blocks certain status moves and bounces them back to the user.

receiver.name: Receiver
receiver.desc: It copies the Ability of an ally that faints. Abilities that cannot be copied are As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Trace, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, and Zero to Hero.
receiver.shortDesc: It copies the Ability of an ally that faints.

rechargerelay.name: Recharge Relay
rechargerelay.desc: Battery, including its Electric Terrain effect. Switching with Volt Switch restores 1/8 of the incoming teammate's max HP.
rechargerelay.shortDesc: Volt Switch heals the incoming teammate by 1/8 HP.

reckless.name: Reckless
reckless.desc: Recoil and crash moves, Explosion, Self-Destruct and Misty Explosion have 1.2x power; Struggle is excluded. On Chessboard, all moves gain a further 1.2x power and incoming attacks gain one critical-hit stage.
reckless.shortDesc: Recoil/crash and explosion moves have 1.2x power.

reflector.name: Reflector
reflector.desc: On entry, copies the active foe's types and adds them to its typing. Matching attacks deal half damage unless it is immune. Reflect Type refreshes the copied types. If this Ability is suppressed, its Rejuv form reverts to the normal species until it switches out, even if suppression ends earlier.
reflector.shortDesc: Copies foe types; adds them to its typing; matching attacks deal 0.5x unless immune.

refrigerate.name: Refrigerate
refrigerate.desc: Eligible Normal moves become Ice and have 1.2x power, or 1.5x on Icy and Snowy Mountain. Excludes moves whose type is set by their own effect, damaging Z-Moves and Terastallized Tera Blast.
refrigerate.shortDesc: Normal moves become Ice with 1.2x power; icy-field boost.

regenerator.name: Regenerator
regenerator.desc: Heals 1/3 max HP on switching out.

reinflate.name: Reinflate
reinflate.desc: Punk Rock: sound power 1.3x (1.5x on Big Top/Cave); incoming sound damage halved. Once per turn after a whole sound attack deals opposing HP damage, heals 1/4 max HP while alive and active. Heal Block applies; switching or changing abilities does not refresh the turn allowance.
reinflate.shortDesc: Punk Rock; sound HP damage heals 1/4 max HP once per turn.

relentlesshunt.name: Relentless Hunt
relentlesshunt.desc: Contact attackers lose 1/8 of their maximum HP through Rough Skin. Moves with 60 or less Base Power gain +1 priority; Cold Eclipse raises the threshold to 80 without stacking another priority boost. Damaging moves deal 2x damage on Rocky, Fairy Tale, Big Top, Dragon Den, Mountain, Snowy Mountain or Cold Eclipse, applied once; 1.5x on Desert, Forest, Burning, Superheated, Ashen Beach, Water Surface, Cave, Starlight Arena or New World.
relentlesshunt.shortDesc: Rough Skin; low-power moves gain +1 priority; field damage bonuses.

relentlesslink.name: Relentless Link
relentlesslink.desc: Multi-hit moves always use their maximum hit count and have 1.5x power. Moves that normally check accuracy per hit check only once. Moves ignore bypassable opposing abilities. Drill and horn moves have 1.5x power, or 2x on Rocky, Mountain, Snowy Mountain, Cave and Volcanic, where they also bypass protection.
relentlesslink.shortDesc: Multi-hit moves always use their maximum hit count and have 1.5x power.

relicarmor.name: Relic Armor
relicarmor.desc: On entry on Desert, Fairy Tale, Cave, Crystal Cavern, New World or Volcanic, gains +1 Defense and Sp. Def. Only on Rocky, Fairy Tale, Water Surface, Underwater, Murkwater Surface, Midnight Zone, Starlight Arena, New World, Holy, Mountain, Cave, Volcanic, Dragon's Den, Crystal Cavern and Dark Crystal Cavern, Rock typing adds no Fighting, Ground, Steel, Water or Grass weakness. Other type weaknesses, resistances and immunities remain. Auras do not enable this protection. Takes 10% less attack damage; does not prevent critical hits. Immune to sandstorm and hail damage. After a foe lowers its stats, gains +1 Defense and Sp. Def. Lapras-Aevian gains Ice typing in hail or snow and on Icy, Snowy Mountain and Cold Eclipse.
relicarmor.shortDesc: 10% less damage; Rock-typing weakness protection on specified fields; defensive boosts.

relicbeam.name: Relic Beam
relicbeam.desc: Its Sp. Atk becomes equal to its Defense, and Special Attack stat stages use Defense stages instead. Beam moves and moves boosted by Mega Launcher have 1.5x power.
relicbeam.shortDesc: SpA equals Defense using Def stages; beam/Mega Launcher moves have 1.5x power.

relicinstinct.name: Relic Instinct
relicinstinct.desc: Above half HP, attacks ignore target abilities. At half HP or less, takes 25% less attack damage, cannot be critically hit, heals 1/16 maximum HP each turn, and halves Attack and Sp. Atk.
relicinstinct.shortDesc: Above half HP: ignores abilities. At half HP or less: defensive mode.

relicmishap.name: Relic Mishap
relicmishap.desc: It takes 0.9x damage from attacks and has Self Sufficient, Water Absorb, and Volt Absorb. It restores 1/16 max HP each turn and is immune to Sandstorm and Hail damage. During Sandstorm, its Special Defense is multiplied by 1.5. During Hail or Snow, its Defense is multiplied by 1.5.

requiem.name: Requiem
requiem.desc: Damaging attacks have a 30% chance to be Disabled, guaranteed on Haunted and blocked on Holy; normal Cursed Body exclusions apply. Takes 20% less attack damage, or 40% less from super-effective attacks. On fainting, creates Haunted Field for 5 turns. Existing unsuppressible behavior remains.
requiem.shortDesc: Cursed Body retaliation + Filter; creates Haunted Field on fainting.

reservoir.name: Reservoir
reservoir.desc: Absorbs other Pokemon's Water moves, healing 1/4 max HP instead of being hit. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn on Underwater, grounded on Water Surface, or grounded and Poison-type on Murkwater Surface. Berries normally eaten at 1/4 HP activate at 1/2 HP instead.
reservoir.shortDesc: Water-field healing; Low-HP Berries activate at half HP; halves incoming Fire attacking stats.

resonanceforce.name: Resonance Force
resonanceforce.desc: Sound-based moves used by its side gain 1.5x power. Its side is protected from allied damaging sound-based moves. Each move uses its normal offensive stat.
resonanceforce.shortDesc: Side sound moves gain 1.5x power; allies avoid allied damaging sound moves.

resonantblade.name: Resonant Blade
resonantblade.desc: Slicing moves ignore damage reduction from Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil, Atlantis Wall and Arenite Wall. Does not bypass Substitute.
resonantblade.shortDesc: Slicing moves bypass screens and walls, but not Substitute.

restorativechime.name: Restorative Chime
restorativechime.desc: Once per turn, a successful sound move restores 1/8 base max HP to the living active user and each living adjacent active ally. Damaging sound moves must connect with an opponent; ally-only hits do not count. Heal Bell qualifies if it cures status, restores HP or establishes Safeguard. Fully failed moves do not trigger healing.
restorativechime.shortDesc: Successful sound moves heal it and adjacent active allies by 1/8 max HP, once per turn.

resuscitation.name: Resuscitation
resuscitation.desc: When Parasect revives as Parasect-Parasite, its status, stat stages, and volatile effects are cleared and it returns to full HP. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn and ignores sandstorm and hail damage. Switching out cures major status and heals 1/8 max HP only if a status was cured. Bewitched Woods cures status at turn end without this extra heal. Prevents indirect damage; HP costs, Pain Split, confusion and Struggle recoil still apply.
resuscitation.shortDesc: Revives Parasect as Parasite; healing and status recovery; no indirect/weather damage.

revealinggaze.name: Revealing Gaze
revealinggaze.desc: On genuine entry, uses ordinary Miracle Eye on the living legal opposing target directly across from it, falling back to the first living legal opposing target. Normal protection and reflection apply; costs no PP and does not repeat on selected-ability restart. Its own Psychic attacks ignore positive Sp. Def stages only while the target has Miracle Eye; negative stages and Defense remain unchanged. Ordinary Miracle Eye lets all allies ignore the marked target's positive evasion and Dark immunity to Psychic attacks, and its mark clears when the target leaves. It also gives the user half incoming Ghost damage until switching and +2 Sp. Atk on Psychic Terrain, Fairy Tale or Holy Field.
revealinggaze.shortDesc: Entry uses Miracle Eye; Psychic ignores marked foes’ positive Sp. Def. Keeps Miracle Eye bonuses.

riftdancer.name: Rift Dancer
riftdancer.desc: Doubles Speed in sun or Stage 4 Flower Garden. Copies other Pokemon's dance moves. Grass attacks use 1.5x attacking stats at 1/3 HP or less; Flower Garden stage 2 raises the HP threshold to 2/3, stage 4 gives 1.8x at any HP and stage 5 gives 2x. Grassy Terrain gives 1.5x attacking stats for all attacks. Once per battle, the first damaging hit that would cross below half HP stops at half HP, then immediately heals 25% max HP. Once per battle, its first activation attempts to create a full Stage 1 Flower Garden for 5 turns, respecting protected fields. Existing gardens are not advanced or refreshed; this first attempt spends the use even if creation is blocked. Each actual stage gained adds 1 remaining turn to this garden, including re-growth; lowering a stage or trying to grow at maximum adds nothing. The garden grows one stage at each turn end without requiring weather and keeps this property after the user switches out.
riftdancer.shortDesc: Sun Speed, copied dances, Grass power; once-battle half-HP guard; grows Flower Garden.

rifteater.name: Rift Eater
rifteater.desc: Summons sandstorm on entry. It has Thick Fat and is immune to sandstorm and hail damage. It can use Belch without eating a Berry and automatically gains one Stockpile every second eligible active turn, first gaining one after two eligible turns. Genuine switching resets this wait; ability restarts do not. Suppressed or otherwise ineligible turns do not advance the counter. Manual Stockpile is unchanged. After reaching 3 Stockpiles, it waits one full turn before randomly choosing Belch or Spit Up with equal odds, then can release every other turn. Its established Spit Up and Swallow combinations still apply. Once per battle, the first damaging hit that would cross below half HP stops at half HP, activates its awakening, then immediately heals 25% max HP. Only its fourth move slot is fixed: Sludge Wave before awakening, then Heat Wave afterward. The first three moves stay as selected. At half HP or less, it creates Desert Field, becomes Ground/Fire, and changes its fourth move to Heat Wave. If sandstorm has ended, it summons it again at that moment.
rifteater.shortDesc: Summons sand; Stockpile every 2 eligible turns; once-battle half-HP guard, heal and awakening.

riftofruin.name: Rift of Ruin
riftofruin.desc: All other active Pokemon, including allies, have 0.75x Speed. Lumineon-Rift has a fixed moveset, in slot order: Hydro Pump, Blizzard, Psychic, and Calm Mind. It survives its first faint by becoming Chi Two at full HP, replacing its moves with Surging Strikes, Dynamic Punch, Psychic, and Hypnosis in that order. Once, damage that would take Chi Two below half HP stops at half (rounded down), raises Attack by 1 and grants visible Active No Guard: its own moves cannot miss; incoming attacks gain no accuracy benefit.
riftofruin.shortDesc: All other active Pokemon have 0.75x Speed. Lumineon-Rift revives as Chi Two.

rightfulexalt.name: Rightful Exalt
rightfulexalt.desc: Full local Serene Grace and Inner Focus. Doubles eligible move secondary-effect chances, with Serene Grace's existing exceptions and field interactions. Prevents flinching and Intimidate's Attack drop. Does not increase critical-hit chances.

rimebark.name: Rimebark
rimebark.desc: Thick Fat and Ice Body: incoming Fire and Ice attacks use half the attacker's offensive stat; immune to hail damage. Contact attackers have a 30% frostbite chance. Heals 1/16 max HP in hail/snow or qualifying cold fields, and 1/8 in hail on Cold Eclipse.

rimeboundspirit.name: Rimebound Spirit
rimeboundspirit.desc: Full local Heatproof halves incoming Fire attack power and burn damage, retaining its field interactions. Immune to wind-flagged moves targeting it, including its part of a spread move. It is grounded without Levitate. As a species passive it persists through selected-ability suppression; Mold Breaker can bypass its breakable effects.

rimebreaker.name: Rimebreaker
rimebreaker.desc: Refrigerate, including its field boosts only for converted moves. Once per turn, an Ice move dealing opposing HP damage removes this side's Stealth Rock and one Spikes layer. Toxic Spikes and Sticky Web remain. Natural Ice moves receive no extra ability damage boost.
rimebreaker.shortDesc: Ice HP hits clear own Stealth Rock and one Spikes layer once per turn.

rimeknuckle.name: Rime Knuckle
rimeknuckle.desc: Takes 20% less attack damage, or 40% less from super-effective attacks. Punching moves have 1.4x power. Contact attackers have a 30% chance of frostbite. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn in hail or snow, or on Icy, Snowy Mountain and Cold Eclipse without those weathers; hail on Cold Eclipse heals 1/8 instead. Immune to hail damage. Damaging moves have a 20% chance to cause frostbite (40% on Icy Field). KOs restore 1/8 max HP, or 1/4 against Mega, G-Max, Terastallized, Stellar or Z-Move item targets. Ice Body adds a 30% chance to frostbite contact attackers, hail immunity, and healing in hail/snow or on Icy, Snowy Mountain and Cold Eclipse fields. Healing is 1/16 max HP, or 1/8 in hail on Cold Eclipse.

rimeplate.name: Rimeplate
rimeplate.desc: Takes 75% less damage from hits after the first hit of a multi-hit attack. The first hit and separate attacks deal normal damage. Does not change Glaive Rush's effects.
rimeplate.shortDesc: Later hits of a multi-hit move deal 75% less damage.

ringcraft.name: Ringcraft
ringcraft.desc: Limber prevents and cures paralysis and blocks opposing and field Speed reductions. The first damaging Flying Press hit against a foe each entry attempts two-turn Taunt after damage, under normal Taunt protection. Misses, Protect and Substitute preserve the charge; Taunt is not shortened.
ringcraft.shortDesc: First Flying Press damage each entry attempts two-turn Taunt after the hit.

ringmaster.name: Ringmaster
ringmaster.desc: Tough Claws once. The first damaging Dark move attempted each genuine entry gains +1 priority; misses and protection spend it, but pre-action flinch or paralysis do not. Ability restarts do not reset it. Each successful Dark attack dealing opposing HP damage attempts two-turn Taunt on surviving foes, with ordinary Taunt immunity and reapplication rules. A committed living switch-out, including pivots and forced switches, clears own-side hazards before entry and gives the exact replacement +1 in its highest non-HP stat after entry and Baton Pass transfer. Suppression at departure prevents this benefit; fainting is not a switch-out.
ringmaster.shortDesc: Tough Claws; first Dark attempt +1 priority; Dark hits Taunt; switch-out support.

riotamp.name: Riot Amp
riotamp.desc: Eligible Normal moves become Electric with 1.2x power. Its side's sound moves have 1.5x power and cannot damage allies; its sound moves use its higher attacking stat. Absorbs other Pokemon's Electric moves, healing 1/4 max HP instead of being hit. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn on Electric Terrain and Short-Circuit.
riotamp.shortDesc: Normal moves become Electric; stronger sound moves spare allies.

riotstance.name: Riot Stance
riotstance.desc: Defiant. Once per entry, successfully blocking an opposing damaging attack with Obstruct stores one charge. Its next damaging Dark move gains +1 priority and consumes the charge when actually attempted, not during priority previews. Switching clears the charge; subsequent blocks cannot rearm it that entry. Sucker Punch still requires its usual success condition.
riotstance.shortDesc: First damaging Obstruct block each entry grants +1 priority to its next damaging Dark move.

ripen.name: Ripen
ripen.desc: Applicable Berry effects are doubled. Positive stat boosts from held Seed items are doubled before Simple or Contrary; Seed stat drops and other effects are unchanged. Seed moves are unaffected.
ripen.shortDesc: Doubles applicable Berry effects and positive held-Seed stat boosts.

riptideclaws.name: Riptide Claws
riptideclaws.desc: Doubles Speed in effective rain. Contact moves have 1.3x power. Prevents critical hits and takes 20% less attack damage. Gains +1 Defense on Fairy Tale or Dragon's Den entry and +2 Sp. Def when a foe lowers its stats. Moves ignore bypassable opposing abilities.
riptideclaws.shortDesc: Double Speed in rain; 1.3x contact power; critical-hit/damage protection; ignores abilities.

rivalmalice.name: Rival Malice
rivalmalice.desc: Speed is multiplied by 1.5. Each ordinary calculated attack hit deals 1 + 0.5 times the target current HP fraction in damage. Recalculates each hit. Fixed damage, OHKO and indirect damage are not multiplied.
rivalmalice.shortDesc: Speed 1.5x; attack damage scales from 1x to 1.5x with target HP.

rivalresolve.name: Rival Resolve
rivalresolve.desc: On genuine entry, becomes regularly poisoned if status-free. Poison Heal prevents poison damage and restores 1/8 base max HP, including its Corrosive, Wasteland, Corrosive Mist and Murkwater field recovery. Only this passive recovery bypasses healing prevention; it cannot revive or exceed max HP. Incoming Poison-type attacks are at most 0.5x effective after offensive matchup overrides; immunity and stronger resistance remain. Dragon-type Drake Fang is not Poison.
rivalresolve.shortDesc: Poisons on entry; protected Poison Heal; Poison attacks are at most resisted.

rivalry.name: Rivalry
rivalry.desc: Damaging moves have 1.3x power against targets of the same gender or genderless targets. All other matchups retain normal power with no penalty. Other allies take 25% less attack damage, including friendly fire, regardless of gender; the holder does not protect itself. Protection stacks with Friend Guard and with each other Rivalry holder. The same holder's active and passive Rivalry do not duplicate its effects.
rivalry.shortDesc: 1.3x power vs same-gender or genderless targets; other allies take 0.75x attack damage. Stacks.

rivershell.name: River Shell
rivershell.desc: Shell Armor, including this server's damage reduction and field/stat-drop effects. Shell Smash does not lower its Defense, but still lowers its Sp. Def.
rivershell.shortDesc: Shell Smash keeps Defense but still lowers Sp. Def.

rkssystem.name: RKS System
rkssystem.desc: If it is Silvally, it gains the custom effects tied to its held Memory, even if its current form does not match that Memory, and restores 1/16 of its max HP at turn end. Silvally without a Memory uses Scrappy's effect instead.
rkssystem.shortDesc: Silvally gains its Memory effects and heals 1/16; no Memory gives Scrappy.

rockhead.name: Rock Head
rockhead.desc: Prevents move recoil except Struggle. Crash and Life Orb damage still apply.

rockypayload.name: Rocky Payload
rockypayload.desc: Rock-type attacks receive STAB. The attacking stat used by a Rock-type attack is multiplied by 1.5, or by 2 on Rocky Field.
rockypayload.shortDesc: Rock STAB; Rock attacks use 1.5x offense, or 2x on Rocky Field.

rollingfortress.name: Rolling Fortress
rollingfortress.desc: Full Rock Head prevents move recoil except Struggle. Its own damaging moves cannot lower its Defense or Sp. Def. Crash damage and other costs remain.
rollingfortress.shortDesc: Rock Head; own damaging moves cannot lower Defense or Sp. Def.

rootediron.name: Rooted Iron
rootediron.desc: Compatibility name for full local Stamina. Each opposing attack hit that damages HP heals 1/16 base max HP. The first such hit each turn gives +1 Defense before later multihit strikes. No additional healing for turns without an attack. Ferrothorn selects Stamina directly and has Iron Barbs as its passive.
rootediron.shortDesc: Stamina: each opposing HP hit heals 1/16; first hit each turn gives +1 Defense.

rootrenewal.name: Root Renewal
rootrenewal.desc: Heals 1/3 max HP on switching out. Switching out also cures one adjacent active ally's major status condition.
rootrenewal.shortDesc: Switching out also cures one adjacent active ally’s major status.

roughscale.name: Rough Scale
roughscale.desc: Contact attackers lose 1/8 max HP. Tough Claws gives contact moves 1.3x power. Once per switch-in, after the first resisted opposing attack to damage HP finishes all its hits, raises Defense by 1 if the holder survives and remains active. Normal boost prevention applies. Misses, protection, immunity, Substitute-only damage and zero HP damage do not activate it.
roughscale.shortDesc: Tough Claws; first resisted opposing HP attack each entry grants +1 Defense after the move.

roughskin.name: Rough Skin
roughskin.desc: Contact attackers lose 1/8 of their max HP.

rousingfeast.name: Rousing Feast
rousingfeast.desc: Full local Gluttony and Cud Chew. Eating a Berry clears its negative Attack and Speed stages, preserving positive stages and all other stats. After eating a Berry, repeats the last eligible Berry once at the end of the next turn. A successful delayed Eat event grants a nonstacking guard that reduces damage to its HP by 25% from the next damaging move that hits it, including all hits of that move. Successful reconsumption grants the guard even if the Berry gives no benefit; a rejected Eat event does not. Protect, misses, immunities, Substitute-only hits, status moves and indirect damage do not spend the guard. Suppression pauses the repeat and guard; switching or losing the ability clears them. Bug Bite and Pluck do not schedule a repeat.
rousingfeast.shortDesc: Gluttony + Cud Chew guard; eating a Berry clears negative Attack and Speed.

royalarmament.name: Royal Armament
royalarmament.desc: Steel moves receive STAB. Drill and horn moves have 1.5x power, or 2x on Rocky, Mountain, Snowy Mountain, Cave and Volcanic, where they also bypass protection.
royalarmament.shortDesc: Steel STAB; drill/horn moves have 1.5x power, or 2x and protection bypass on rocky fields.

royaldecree.name: Royal Decree
royaldecree.desc: On entry, all active Pokemon's stat stages are reset to 0, except Pokemon on a side protected by Safeguard, and Reflect, Light Screen, and Aurora Veil are removed from both sides. While it is active, Reflect, Light Screen, and Aurora Veil cannot be created, enemy stat boosts fail, enemy-caused stat drops fail, and charge moves fire immediately. Its own self-inflicted stat drops still work. Neutralization disables these Royal Decree effects while active. If Neutralization is already active on entry, the stat and screen reset does not happen; it does not happen later when Neutralization leaves. The Royal Decree or Empress holder may gain its own self-caused stat boosts and pay its own move-induced stat drops. Opponent-caused changes and changes to other Pokemon retain the restrictions.
royaldecree.shortDesc: Resets/locks foe stats/screens; Safeguard guards stats; skips charges. Neutralization stops it.

royalhive.name: Royal Hive
royalhive.desc: Genuine entry starts in attack stance with +1 Attack and Sp. Atk. A Status move switches to defensive stance, lowering Attack and Sp. Atk by 1 and raising Defense and Sp. Def by 1. A damaging move switches back with the reverse changes. Repeated moves of the same category do not repeat the changes. Defensive stance heals 1/16 base max HP each turn. Active ability restarts and suppression do not reset the passive stance or grant entry boosts.
royalhive.shortDesc: Entry raises offenses; alternates attack/defense stances; defensive stance heals 1/16.

royalpresence.name: Royal Presence
royalpresence.desc: Pressure and Unnerve. Opposing moves targeting it cost extra PP (2 extra in Midnight Zone); entry lowers opposing Defense and Sp. Def, and Underwater becomes Midnight Zone. Unnerve prevents opposing berry use and has its field effects. Outside Cold Eclipse, its Defense and Sp. Def drop is attempted only once per opposing Pokemon per battle for each Pressure user. Switching, Transform and ability loss or regain do not reset that allowance; a blocked or reflected attempt spends it. Cold Eclipse has repeatable -2 drops on entry and neither spends nor resets the ordinary allowance.

royalremedy.name: Royal Remedy
royalremedy.desc: Switching out cures its status and heals 1/8 max HP only if a status was cured. At turn end, each adjacent ally has a 30% chance to have its status cured. Bewitched Woods also cures the holder at turn end without the switch-out heal. Includes full local Natural Cure and Healer; overlapping copies do not stack.

royalscales.name: Royal Scales
royalscales.desc: Marvel Scale boosts Defense while statused or on supported fields. Swift Swim boosts Speed in rain and supported water fields. Its Normal-type moves become Dragon-type moves and have their power multiplied by 1.2. It gains STAB on Dragon-type moves. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn. Immune to sandstorm and hail damage.
royalscales.shortDesc: Marvel Scale, Swift Swim, Dragonize and Self Sufficient.

royalsun.name: Royal Sun
royalsun.desc: Summons sun for 5 turns, or 8 with Heat Rock. Each fainted ally adds 10% move power, capped at 5 after Free-for-All doubles the effective count, for at most 1.5x power. At 2 fallen allies, gains Infiltrator; at 4, flinch immunity; at 5, Magic Guard and a one-time +1 Attack and Sp. Atk.

rubblewake.name: Rubblewake
rubblewake.desc: Once per switch-in, after surviving a physical attack that damages its HP, sets one layer of Spikes on the attacker's side.
rubblewake.shortDesc: Once per entry, surviving a physical hit sets Spikes on the attacker's side.

ruinedsky.name: Ruined Sky
ruinedsky.desc: Its moves have the effects of Mold Breaker. Damage is multiplied by 1.3 if the target is currently Flying-type or Dragon-type; the bonus applies only once against Flying/Dragon targets. This does not bypass type immunities, including Flying's Ground immunity.
ruinedsky.shortDesc: Mold Breaker; 1.3x damage against Flying or Dragon targets (once).

ruinjaw.name: Ruin Jaw
ruinjaw.desc: Biting moves have 1.5x power. Absorbs other Pokemon's Ground moves, healing 1/4 max HP instead of being hit.

runaway.name: Run Away
runaway.desc: It can switch out despite trapping moves and abilities. It is also ignored by entry hazards when it switches in, including Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, Toxic Spikes, and their field variants.
runaway.shortDesc: Can escape trapping; immune to entry hazards.

rupturedheaven.name: Ruptured Heaven
rupturedheaven.desc: Sharpness boosts slicing moves by 1.5, except on Cold Eclipse Terrain. Only slicing moves become non-contact. Other contact moves remain contact moves.

sacredbond.name: Sacred Bond
sacredbond.desc: Battle Bond's shared effects plus Magma Armor, Intimidate, and Flash Fire. Arcanine-Battle-Bond's Extreme Speed always critically hits.

sacrededge.name: Sacred Edge
sacrededge.desc: Slicing moves have 1.5x power, except on Cold Eclipse. Eligible slicing, pulse, bullet, horn, drill, and Arrow moves normally hit twice at 60% power, each with its own accuracy check. If an offensive ability power or damage multiplier applies, the first hit retains its full ability boosts and the second uses 15% of original move power without those offensive ability multipliers. Stat multipliers, items, STAB and ordinary weather or field modifiers remain separate. In Free-for-All, the second hit targets another random living foe when possible; Siege Launcher retains its full-power pair. Existing multi-hit moves do not gain an extra pair. On entry or Mega Evolution, heals adjacent allies by 1/4 max HP, or 1/3 on Fairy Tale.
sacrededge.shortDesc: Slicing moves have 1.5x power, except on Cold Eclipse.

sacredpower.name: Sacred Power
sacredpower.desc: Its Normal-type moves become Dark-type moves and have their power multiplied by 1.3. Prevents and cures sleep, blocks Yawn, and gives Dark and Ghost attacks 1.3x power. Prevents indirect damage; HP costs, Pain Split, confusion and Struggle recoil still apply. Fairy Tale entry gives +1 Sp. Def.
sacredpower.shortDesc: Normal becomes Dark (1.3x power); Dark/Ghost power 1.3x; Fairy Tale entry: +1 Sp. Def.

safeharbor.name: Safe Harbor
safeharbor.desc: Contact attackers have a 30% chance of frostbite. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn in hail or snow, or on Icy, Snowy Mountain and Cold Eclipse without those weathers; hail on Cold Eclipse heals 1/8 instead. Immune to hail damage. Absorbs other Pokemon's Water moves, healing 1/4 max HP instead of being hit. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn on Underwater, grounded on Water Surface, or grounded and Poison-type on Murkwater Surface. Cures major status at turn end in effective rain or on Water Surface, Underwater and Midnight Zone.
safeharbor.shortDesc: No hail damage; water-field healing; Cures status each turn in rain or water fields.

saltbastion.name: Salt Bastion
saltbastion.desc: Prevents OHKO moves. At full HP, survives an otherwise fatal attack hit with 1 HP. When Sturdy saves it from a direct hit, its side gains Safeguard for 5 turns.
saltbastion.shortDesc: When Sturdy saves it, sets 5-turn Safeguard for its side.

saltcrust.name: Salt Crust
saltcrust.desc: Prevents opposing stat drops. While Defense is positively boosted, opponents cannot remove its held item. Does not prevent its boosts being reset, stolen or ignored.
saltcrust.shortDesc: While Defense is boosted, its held item cannot be removed.

sandforce.name: Sand Force
sandforce.desc: Rock, Ground and Steel moves have 1.3x power in sandstorm or on Desert and Ashen Beach. Immune to sandstorm damage.
sandforce.shortDesc: 1.3x Rock/Ground/Steel power in sand or sandy fields.

sandrush.name: Sand Rush
sandrush.desc: Doubles Speed in sandstorm or on Desert and Ashen Beach. Immune to sandstorm damage.
sandrush.shortDesc: Double Speed in sand or sandy fields; no sand damage.

sandsovereign.name: Sand Sovereign
sandsovereign.desc: Sets or refreshes Sandstorm to 8 turns on entry. Full local Solid Rock. Rock moves use the better Rock/Ground matchup keeps damaging Rock moves Rock-type with normal Rock STAB, but uses the better overall Rock or Ground type-chart matchup; Ground-immune typings do not replace the Rock matchup. Manually used Arenite Wall lasts 8 turns. Each turn, non-immune foes take Rock damage equal to 1/16 max HP; type effectiveness scales this chip only in Free-for-All.
sandsovereign.shortDesc: Solid Rock; better Rock/Ground matchup; eight-turn sand and Rock chip.

sandspit.name: Sand Spit
sandspit.desc: When it is hit by an attack, the effect of Sandstorm begins.
sandspit.shortDesc: When it is hit by an attack, the effect of Sandstorm begins.

sandstream.name: Sand Stream
sandstream.desc: On entry, summons sandstorm for 5 turns, or 8 with Smooth Rock.

sandveil.name: Sand Veil
sandveil.desc: If Sandstorm is active, the accuracy of moves used against it is multiplied by 0.8. It takes no damage from Sandstorm.
sandveil.shortDesc: If Sandstorm is active, its evasiveness is 1.25x; immunity to Sandstorm.

sapsipper.name: Sap Sipper
sapsipper.desc: Absorbs Grass moves for +1 Attack and Sp. Atk; allied Grass moves also grant both boosts. Heals 1/8 max HP each turn on Forest and 1/16 on Grassy Field.
sapsipper.shortDesc: Absorbs Grass for +1 Attack/Sp. Atk; grassy-field healing.

savageresolve.name: Savage Resolve
savageresolve.desc: Guts: Attack is multiplied by 1.5 while statused, and burn does not halve physical damage. Once per actual entry, after surviving an entire opposing damaging move that dealt actual HP damage while it was already statused, it gains one Speed stage if still active. Status inflicted after a hit does not make that hit qualify. All hits and opponents share one activation. Substitute-only, ally, self, residual and delayed damage do not qualify. Switching resets usage; ability replacement and suppression do not. Suppression disables the effect. The Speed boost is an ordinary stat stage and does not remove paralysis's Speed penalty.
savageresolve.shortDesc: Surviving a qualifying foe move while statused gives +1 Speed once per entry.

scalerhythm.name: Scale Rhythm
scalerhythm.desc: After a damaging sound move deals opposing HP damage, the living active user gains 1 Defense stage once after the entire move, including spread or multiple hits. This occurs after the ordinary Clanging Scales Defense drop. No boost for misses, protection, immunity or Substitute-only damage; normal stat-change rules apply.
scalerhythm.shortDesc: +1 Defense once after a damaging sound move deals opposing HP damage.

scaleshelter.name: Scale Shelter
scaleshelter.desc: Full local Overcoat prevents powder moves, Rage Powder redirection, Effect Spore, sandstorm damage and hail damage. Opposing Pokemon cannot lower its accuracy. Self and ally accuracy changes remain possible.

scarecrow.name: Scarecrow
scarecrow.desc: Absorbs wind moves for +1 Attack. Gains +1 Attack when Tailwind starts on its side or it enters during Tailwind. Strong Winds gives +1 Attack and Sp. Atk each turn. Steel moves receive STAB and use 1.5x Attack or Sp. Atk (2x on Factory). On Short-Circuit, Steel moves also gain Electric typing. Adds Steel resistances and Poison immunity without Steel weaknesses.

scatterbrain.name: Scatterbrain
scatterbrain.desc: Oblivious and Unaware: prevents infatuation, Taunt and Intimidate drops, clears infatuation/Taunt, breaks opposing Illusion on entry, and ignores relevant opposing stat stages in damage/accuracy calculations.

scavenger.name: Scavenger
scavenger.desc: Immune to powder moves, Rage Powder, Effect Spore, sandstorm damage and hail damage. Other Pokemon cannot lower its Defense. Heals 1/3 max HP on switching out.
scavenger.shortDesc: Immune to powder moves, Rage Powder, Effect Spore, sandstorm damage and hail damage.

scentscout.name: Scent Scout
scentscout.desc: Frisk on entry reveals opposing active Illusions and held items; each item holder independently has a 30% chance of five-turn Embargo. Once per holder entry, the first opponent switching in while it is already active also has its held item revealed. This extra observation only reveals the item and never repeats Frisk's other effects; an empty item slot still spends it.
scentscout.shortDesc: Once per entry, reveals the first incoming opponent's item while already active.

schooling.name: Schooling
schooling.desc: A level 20 or higher Wishiwashi changes to School Form above 1/4 max HP. Underwater and Midnight Zone force School Form; Water Surface and Murkwater force it while grounded. It returns to Solo Form at or below 1/4 max HP otherwise. While in School Form, it has Hydra Bond, Self Repair, and Mold Breaker's effects.
schooling.shortDesc: Changes form with HP and water fields; its School form gains the listed components.

scorchsweep.name: Scorch Sweep
scorchsweep.desc: Full Rock Head prevents move recoil except Struggle. Once per genuine entry, a recoil-listed move that damages an opposing Pokemon’s HP removes entry hazards from its own side. Only removing a hazard spends the use. Ability restarts do not reset it.
scorchsweep.shortDesc: Rock Head; once per entry, a recoil move’s HP hit clears own hazards.

scrapbreaker.name: Scrapbreaker
scrapbreaker.desc: Steel attacks treat the target’s Steel typing as super effective while retaining other type contributions. After damaging an opposing Steel-type Pokemon, attempts +1 Attack once per turn. Gigaton Hammer has screen removal and grounding after HP damage.
scrapbreaker.shortDesc: Steel attacks beat Steel typing; damaging Steel foes grants +1 Atk once per turn.

scrappy.name: Scrappy
scrappy.desc: It can hit Ghost types with Normal- and Fighting-type moves. It is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.
scrappy.shortDesc: Fighting, Normal moves hit Ghost. Immune to Intimidate.

screencleaner.name: Screen Cleaner
screencleaner.desc: On switch-in, the effects of Aurora Veil, Light Screen, and Reflect end for both sides.
screencleaner.shortDesc: On switch-in, the effects of Aurora Veil, Light Screen, and Reflect end for both sides.

seablessing.name: Sea Blessing
seablessing.desc: Its Defense and Special Defense are 1.5x. On entry, it and adjacent allies heal 1/4 max HP, and it gains Aqua Ring. It has Water Veil and Rain Dish.

seafiend.name: Sea Fiend
seafiend.desc: Physical HP hits set Toxic Spikes on the attacker’s side, up to two; contact attackers lose 1/6 base max HP. Incoming Fire attacks use half the attacker’s offensive stat. Prevents and cures burns, ignores sandstorm/hail damage and gains Aqua Ring on entry with its field healing. Aftermath remains separate.
seafiend.shortDesc: Toxic Debris; Fire resistance, burn/weather protection and Aqua Ring.

searescuer.name: Sea Rescuer
searescuer.desc: Once per entry, the first Roost that actually restores HP lets the trainer choose a replacement after healing, if one is available. Switching abilities does not refresh this effect.
searescuer.shortDesc: Once per entry, Roost healing lets it switch out.

seasonalstride.name: Seasonal Stride
seasonalstride.desc: Normal attacks become the current primary type with the 1.2x conversion boost; kicking moves have 1.4x power. Speed doubles only in sun. At turn end, rain selects Spring, sun Summer, sand Autumn and hail/snow Winter; no weather has the current form. The originally selected ability slot maps to the new season. External replacement abilities remain until ordinary restoration; genuine entry restores the selected slot for the current season. Transform does not cycle seasons.
seasonalstride.shortDesc: Normal moves become its primary type at 1.2x; kicks 1.4x; sun Speed 2x; weather changes season.

secondbrew.name: Second Brew
secondbrew.desc: Once per turn, after it actually recovers positive HP from draining-move healing, heals its lowest-HP adjacent ally by 1/8 of that ally's max HP. HP, Heal Block, Liquid Ooze and zero healing do not grant the ally reward or spend the turn's use.
secondbrew.shortDesc: Actual positive draining-move healing also heals its lowest-HP adjacent ally by 1/8, once per turn.

secondwind.name: Second Wind
secondwind.desc: The first otherwise lethal attack has a 50% chance to leave it at 1 HP. This Ability rolls only once per battle, even if the roll fails or it switches out.
secondwind.shortDesc: 50% chance to survive the first lethal attack at 1 HP; one roll per battle.

seedsower.name: Seed Sower
seedsower.desc: When it is hit by an attack, the effect of Grassy Terrain begins.
seedsower.shortDesc: When it is hit by an attack, the effect of Grassy Terrain begins.

selfrepair.name: Self Repair
selfrepair.desc: Heals 1/16 max HP each turn and ignores sandstorm and hail damage. Switching out cures major status and heals 1/8 max HP only if a status was cured. Bewitched Woods cures status at turn end without this extra heal.
selfrepair.shortDesc: Heals 1/16 max HP each turn and ignores sandstorm and hail damage.

selfsufficient.name: Self Sufficient
selfsufficient.desc: Heals 1/16 max HP each turn. Immune to sandstorm and hail damage.
selfsufficient.shortDesc: Heals 1/16 HP each turn; immune to sandstorm and hail damage.

sentinelfist.name: Sentinel Fist
sentinelfist.desc: Iron Fist gives punching moves 1.4x power. Once per entry, when its Wide Guard actually blocks an opposing damaging attack, restores 1/8 max HP under normal healing restrictions. No reward for using Wide Guard without blocking an attack.
sentinelfist.shortDesc: Its first Wide Guard block each entry heals 1/8 max HP.

serenegrace.name: Serene Grace
serenegrace.desc: Doubles probabilistic move secondary-effect chances up to 60%, preserving native chances already above 60% and guaranteed effects. Removes charging turns. Does not add another chance multiplier to Lunar Orbit or Void Omen.
serenegrace.shortDesc: Doubles secondary chances up to 60%; removes charge turns.

serratedscales.name: Serrated Scales
serratedscales.desc: Contact attackers lose 1/8 base max HP per triggering hit; Thorn Tempered users are exempt. Prevents and cures paralysis. Other Pokemon and field effects cannot lower its Speed; self-inflicted costs and item slowdowns still apply. Trick Room and removal of Speed boosts or Tailwind still work. Limber has its normal ability-bypass rules; Rough Skin retaliation is not bypassed.

setpiece.name: Set Piece
setpiece.desc: Successfully using Court Change or damaging a target with Feint stores one charge. Its next damaging Fire attack gains +1 priority and perfect accuracy. The charge is spent only when that attack executes, including failure into protection or immunity; move previews and inability to act do not spend it. Switching clears it.
setpiece.shortDesc: Court Change/damaging Feint primes next Fire attack: +1 priority, cannot miss. Spent on use.

seviischooling.name: Sevii Schooling
seviischooling.desc: Changes Wishiwashi into its Ghost-type Sevii form, or Ghost/Dragon Sevii Schooling form at level 20 or higher above 1/4 max HP. Underwater and Midnight Zone force School Form; Water Surface and Murkwater force it while grounded. The School Form has Hydra Bond, Self Repair, and Mold Breaker's effects.
seviischooling.shortDesc: Changes Wishiwashi to Sevii form; School: Hydra Bond + Self Repair + Mold Breaker.

shadowbond.name: Shadow Bond
shadowbond.desc: Battle Bond's shared effects plus Infiltrator. Ash-Greninja's Water Shuriken hits three times at 30 base power per hit and always critically hits.
shadowbond.shortDesc: Water Shuriken hits 3 times at 30 power and always critically hits.

shadowcurrent.name: Shadow Current
shadowcurrent.desc: Before an eligible damaging move, changes to its type. Technician boosts eligible weak moves. Anticipation reveals a dangerous opposing move and grants 25% damage reduction against that move until switching out; OHKO moves are not reduced. Removes opposing Illusions; if no threat is found, Psychic Terrain grants +2 Sp. Atk. Its Anticipation component: Checks each active opponent separately when the holder enters, and rechecks each incoming opponent on every switch-in, including repeat entries. Allies are not checked, and initial checks do not trigger twice. Each check retains its usual Psychic Terrain bonus condition and latest-warned-move protection.

shadowdouble.name: Shadow Double
shadowdouble.desc: Once per switch-in, damaging an opponent's HP with a Ghost attack creates a shadow double. The next opposing damaging move deals 25% less damage across all its hits. The double lasts until used or switching out. Does not block status effects, fixed damage, or residual damage.
shadowdouble.shortDesc: After a Ghost hit, next opposing attack deals 25% less damage. Once per switch-in.

shadowfeint.name: Shadow Feint
shadowfeint.desc: Ordinary damaging Dark moves penetrate normal protection at one-third damage, without secondary effects through protection. Does not remove Protect, bypass Max Guard, or alter Z/Max move protection rules.
shadowfeint.shortDesc: Dark attacks pierce Protect at one-third power, without secondary effects.

shadowscreen.name: Shadow Screen
shadowscreen.desc: Infiltrator: moves bypass Substitute, Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil, Safeguard and Mist. Mat Block can be used after the first turn, but shares the normal Protect-style consecutive-use failure counter. Grants no additional priority; Mat Block keeps its current local move priority.
shadowscreen.shortDesc: Mat Block works after turn one but uses the normal consecutive-protection failure counter.

shadowshield.name: Shadow Shield
shadowshield.desc: Takes 0.8x attack damage at any HP; super-effective attacks deal a further 0.75x damage (0.6x total). Ability-ignoring moves cannot bypass these reductions, but suppression disables them. Immune to hail damage on Cold Eclipse.
shadowshield.shortDesc: 20% less attack damage at any HP; 40% less if super effective.

shadowtag.name: Shadow Tag
shadowtag.desc: Prevents adjacent opposing Pokemon from choosing to switch out, except Ghost types, Shed Shell holders and other Shadow Tag users. Takes 0.8x incoming attack damage. On Haunted Field, reveals opposing held items on entry. Cannot be suppressed. Other trapping and pivot rules remain unchanged.
shadowtag.shortDesc: Traps foes; takes 0.8x damage from attacks.

sharpness.name: Sharpness
sharpness.desc: Slicing moves have 1.5x power, except on Cold Eclipse.
sharpness.shortDesc: Slicing moves have 1.5x power except on Cold Eclipse.

shattercrust.name: Shattercrust
shattercrust.desc: Full local Crumbling Shell: physical HP hits set Stealth Rock on the attacker’s side if absent; allied attackers use the opposing side. Does not activate on Water Surface, Underwater, Murkwater Surface or Swamp.
shattercrust.shortDesc: Physical HP hits set Stealth Rock on the attacker’s side.

sheddecoy.name: Shed Decoy
sheddecoy.desc: After a genuine entry finishes hazards, items, abilities and field effects, pays floor(max HP/4) to create an ordinary Substitute if HP exceeds that cost and no Substitute exists. No cost if creation fails. Does not trigger on ability restarts or regain; respects Pulse/Rift Substitute restrictions. The direct HP cost cannot be prevented by Magic Guard; berries work normally.
sheddecoy.shortDesc: After entry effects, pays 1/4 max HP to create a Substitute.

shedskin.name: Shed Skin
shedskin.desc: At turn end, if statused, affected by a listed ailment, negatively boosted or at half HP or less, has a 50% chance to heal 1/4 max HP, cure status, clear negative stages and remove Attract, confusion, Curse, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Leech Seed, Nightmare, Perish Song, Taunt, Torment and Yawn. On Dragon's Den, activation is guaranteed but only cures status and heals, then raises its higher attacking stat by 1 and lowers both defenses by 1.
shedskin.shortDesc: 50% end-turn cure/reset and 1/4 heal; Dragon's Den changes the effect.

sheerforce.name: Sheer Force
sheerforce.desc: Its attacks with secondary effects have their power multiplied by 1.3, but the secondary effects are removed. If a secondary effect was removed, it also removes the user's Life Orb recoil and Shell Bell recovery, and prevents the target's Anger Shell, Berserk, Color Change, Emergency Exit, Pickpocket, Wimp Out, Red Card, Eject Button, Kee Berry, and Maranga Berry from activating.
sheerforce.shortDesc: Its attacks with secondary effects have 1.3x power; nullifies the effects.

shellarmor.name: Shell Armor
shellarmor.desc: Prevents critical hits and takes 20% less attack damage. Gains +1 Defense on Fairy Tale or Dragon's Den entry and +2 Sp. Def when a foe lowers its stats.
shellarmor.shortDesc: No critical hits; 20% less damage; foe stat drops give +2 Sp. Def.

shellcracker.name: Shellcracker
shellcracker.desc: Mold Breaker: its moves ignore other Pokemon's bypassable abilities. Crabhammer has 100% base accuracy and always critically hits, unless critical hits are prevented by an effect that is not bypassed. Ability Shield still protects those abilities. Suppression disables both effects.
shellcracker.shortDesc: Crabhammer has 100% base accuracy and guaranteed critical hits.

shellderartillery.name: Shellder Artillery
shellderartillery.desc: Mega Launcher gives pulse and bullet moves 1.5x power. Oblivious prevents infatuation, Captivate, Taunt and Intimidate Attack drops, and cures infatuation and Taunt.

shielddust.name: Shield Dust
shielddust.desc: Blocks secondary effects of other Pokemon's attacks that affect it; effects on the attacker still work.

shieldsdown.name: Shields Down
shieldsdown.desc: Minior changes to Meteor above half HP and its original core at half HP or below, on entry and at turn end. Meteor form blocks major status and Yawn. Has Crumbling Shell: physical hits place Stealth Rock on the attacker’s side (opposing side for allied hits), except on Water Surface, Underwater, Murkwater Surface or Swamp.
shieldsdown.shortDesc: HP-based form change; Meteor blocks status. Crumbling Shell.

siegelauncher.name: Bombardment
siegelauncher.desc: Mega Launcher gives pulse and bullet moves 1.5x power. Water Barrage supplies exactly one eligible Dual Wield pair, each hit at 0.6x power outside Free-for-All: pulse/bullet pairs therefore use 0.9x power per hit before STAB and passives. In Free-for-All both hits use full power, with the second-target selection. Existing multi-hit, charging, delayed, Z/Max and ineligible moves gain no extra pair. Water Barrage supplies Stalwart exactly once: redirection bypass and +1 Sp. Atk on New World, Starlight Arena, Fairy Tale or Chessboard entry. At turn end, foes take cycling Water damage of 1/16, 2/16, then 3/16 max HP; Water immunities block it and type effectiveness scales it only in Free-for-All.

siegemagnet.name: Siege Magnet
siegemagnet.desc: Magnet Pull. Once per entry, the first Electric attack to damage a foe also attempts Heal Block on that foe for this turn and the following turn. Normal volatile-status protection applies; Heal Block is not shortened. Misses, protection and Substitute-only hits preserve the charge. No power boost.
siegemagnet.shortDesc: First Electric attack damage each entry applies two-turn Heal Block.

siegetusks.name: Siege Tusks
siegetusks.desc: Full Mold Breaker ignores bypassable opposing abilities. Prevents entry-hazard damage, Toxic Spikes poison and Sticky Web Speed drops.
siegetusks.shortDesc: Mold Breaker; immune to entry hazards.

silentact.name: Silent Act
silentact.desc: Soundproof. A successful status move stores one 1.3x power bonus for the next damaging Psychic/Fairy attack. Consumed on attempt even on miss, protection or immunity; does not stack and clears on switching.
silentact.shortDesc: Soundproof; successful status stores next Psychic/Fairy attack at 1.3x power.

silentflight.name: Silent Flight
silentflight.desc: Levitate makes this Pokemon airborne unless grounded. It is immune to entry hazards even while grounded. The first damaging hit to its HP each switch-in deals 25% less damage; only that hit of a multi-hit move is reduced. Hits absorbed by Substitute are reduced but do not spend the protection. Suppression disables these effects without resetting spent protection. Switching out resets the protection.
silentflight.shortDesc: Levitate; immune to entry hazards; first HP hit each entry deals 25% less.

silenthunter.name: Silent Hunter
silenthunter.desc: Super Luck raises the critical-hit rate of all moves by one stage. Biting moves gain one additional critical-hit stage. In current-generation battles, ordinary biting moves have a 50% critical-hit chance, or 100% with Scope Lens or Razor Claw. Normal critical-hit damage and critical-hit prevention apply.
silenthunter.shortDesc: Super Luck; biting moves gain another critical-hit stage.

silentreprisal.name: Silent Reprisal
silentreprisal.desc: Soundproof + full local Anticipation. Immune to other Pokemon's sound moves. On entry, exposes opposing Illusion and checks for super-effective attacks or OHKO moves; if none trigger its warning, gains two Sp. Atk stages on Psychic Terrain, matching local Anticipation. Its Anticipation component: Checks each active opponent separately when the holder enters, and rechecks each incoming opponent on every switch-in, including repeat entries. Allies are not checked, and initial checks do not trigger twice. Each check retains its usual Psychic Terrain bonus condition and latest-warned-move protection.

silkendecoy.name: Silken Decoy
silkendecoy.desc: Mega Ariados spins a persistent cocoon, renewed when another Pokemon faints. It blocks status moves and status conditions while intact, and absorbs one damaging move including all its hits and secondary effects. Full local Swarm and Self Sufficient exactly once: restores 1/16 base max HP each turn and prevents sandstorm and hail damage.
silkendecoy.shortDesc: Protective cocoon + Swarm + Self Sufficient; other faints renew the cocoon.

silkensalvo.name: Silken Salvo
silkensalvo.desc: Fluffy. Eligible single-target, single-hit attacks become 2–5 hits at 40% calculated power each, rounded to nearest with ties down before modifiers. Hit distribution is 2, 2, 3, 3, 4, 5; Loaded Dice gives 5 hits for converted attacks only. One initial accuracy check, separate critical rolls and drain each hit; move secondaries run only on the first two hits. Fury Cutter and Stacking Shot advance their shared chain once per move. Native multi-hit moves are unchanged. Fixed-damage, OHKO, charge, recharge, self-KO, delayed, Z/Max moves and Fling, Endeavor, Beat Up, Rollout, Ice Ball and Uproar are excluded.
silkensalvo.shortDesc: Fluffy; eligible single-hit attacks hit 2–5 times at 40% power per hit.

silkshuriken.name: Silk Shuriken
silkshuriken.desc: Water Shuriken becomes Bug-type and hits exactly three times at 20 base power per hit, retaining its priority. Does not alter Z/Max moves.
silkshuriken.shortDesc: Water Shuriken becomes Bug-type: three hits, 20 power each. Priority unchanged.

silksights.name: Silk Sights
silksights.desc: Keen Eye prevents external accuracy drops, ignores evasion boosts and reveals opposing Illusions. Mirror Arena entry grants +1 accuracy and Laser Focus once, shared with passive Compound Eyes. Electric attacks ignore positive defensive stages against slowed foes. Once per entry, Bug attacks dealing opposing HP damage to a foe whose Speed was already lowered attempt to Disable its last move through the following turn. Normal Disable eligibility applies; only success consumes the use.
silksights.shortDesc: Keen Eye; Electric ignores slowed foes’ boosts; once/entry Bug HP hit can Disable a slowed foe.

silkward.name: Silk Ward
silkward.desc: Once per entry, the first super-effective damaging hit deals half damage. After that ward activates, clears its negative Speed stages if it survives, without granting an extra Speed stage. Positive Speed is preserved.
silkward.shortDesc: First super-effective hit each entry: half damage; surviving clears negative Speed.

simple.name: Simple
simple.desc: When one of its stat stages is raised or lowered, the amount is doubled.
simple.shortDesc: When one of its stat stages is raised or lowered, the amount is doubled.

sinisterblaze.name: Sinister Blaze
sinisterblaze.desc: This Ability cannot be suppressed, copied, or transferred. It is burned on entry, even through Misty Terrain, and its burn can overwrite other status conditions. In Fairy Tale, Starlight Arena, New World, Burning Field, Volcanic Field, Superheated Field, or Cold Eclipse, its Defense and Special Defense rise by 1 stage on entry. Its burn damage becomes healing; foes take 1/16 max HP each turn, or 1/8 if already burned. It does not heal from this generated damage, but heals from real burn damage dealt to foes. Its physical attacks are not weakened by burn. It is immune to hail and sandstorm damage and counts as Ice type in hail, snow, and ice fields, except for Abysseon and Divineon.
sinisterblaze.shortDesc: Burn heals user; foes take 1/16, or 1/8 if burned; no burn penalty; hail/sand immune.

sirius.name: Sirius
sirius.desc: Has full Apex Venom, Whiplash, Venam’s Kiss and local Shed Skin (50% end-turn ailment/low-HP recovery; Dragon’s Den guaranteed). Mega Seviper’s Poison Fang slot becomes Drake Fang: 85 BP Dragon Physical, 100 accuracy, 15 PP, bite/contact and inherited poison effects.
