Current PP and slot persist through switching; actual form reversal restores Poison Fang. Strong Jaw gives Fang attacks 1.5x power before STAB, with no separate signature multiplier. Dragon Drake Fang uses ordinary Dragon effectiveness and does not trigger Poison-only Venam effects. Poison HP hits poison eligible Steel/Poison foes; all foes can be drained (one-third damage, capped at 1/4 base max HP per turn), while already-poisoned foes are heal-blocked and have 0.75x Speed. Cannot be suppressed, replaced or bypassed by Mold Breaker.
sirius.shortDesc: Apex Venom + Whiplash + Venam’s Kiss; Poison Fang becomes Drake Fang.

skilllink.name: Skill Link
skilllink.desc: Multi-hit moves always use their maximum hit count and have 1.5x power. Moves that normally check accuracy per hit check only once.

skywarden.name: Skywarden
skywarden.desc: Wind Rider. After successful Defog clears effects, creates five-turn Mist without shortening longer Mist. The first successful Defog each entry heals 1/8 max HP; this allowance is consumed even at full HP. Defog is not a wind move.
skywarden.shortDesc: Wind Rider; successful Defog sets Mist and first per entry heals 1/8 HP.

slipstream.name: Slipstream
slipstream.desc: Airborne: immune to Ground attacks, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web and Arena Trap unless grounded. Thousand Arrows can still hit. Once per switch-in, its first Flying-type attack to damage a foe sets Tailwind on its side for 3 turns. Existing Tailwind is extended to at least 3 turns, never shortened. Keen Eye prevents opposing accuracy drops, ignores evasion boosts and reveals opposing Illusions on activation. Mirror Arena grants +1 accuracy and Laser Focus; shared accuracy entry rewards apply once.
slipstream.shortDesc: Airborne; first landed Flying attack each entry sets 3-turn Tailwind.

slowclamp.name: Slow Clamp
slowclamp.desc: Full local Own Tempo prevents and cures confusion and blocks Intimidate's Attack drop, subject to normal suppression and ability bypass. Analytic has its 1.3x power when no other active Pokemon has a move left to use that turn.

slowstart.name: Slow Start
slowstart.desc: On switch-in, its Attack is 0.65x and Speed is 0.5x for 3 turns, and its Defense is doubled. On Holy Field, the Attack and Speed drops are removed and its Defense is 1.5x instead.
slowstart.shortDesc: 3 turns: Atk 0.65x, Spe 0.5x, Def 2x; Holy removes drops and gives Def 1.5x.

slumberinggiant.name: Slumbering Giant
slumberinggiant.desc: Comatose + Thick Fat: always considered asleep for relevant moves and fields while able to act normally; cannot receive major status or Yawn. Fire and Ice attacks use half offensive power against it, and hail cannot damage it. Has Comatose's suppression and ability-replacement restrictions.
slumberinggiant.shortDesc: Comatose + Thick Fat; immune to major status, Yawn and hail damage.

slushrush.name: Slush Rush
slushrush.desc: Doubles Speed in hail, snow or on Icy, Snowy Mountain and Cold Eclipse.
slushrush.shortDesc: Double Speed in hail, snow and icy fields.

smolderingshroud.name: Smoldering Shroud
smolderingshroud.desc: Prevents opposing stat drops. Gains +1 Attack and Sp. Atk on Volcanic entry. The first foe-caused stat drop it prevents each switch-in also raises its Sp. Atk by one stage.
smolderingshroud.shortDesc: First blocked opposing stat drop each entry raises Sp. Atk by 1.

sniper.name: Sniper
sniper.desc: It gains 1 Accuracy on entry. Its critical hits deal 2.25x damage instead of 1.5x.
sniper.shortDesc: +1 Accuracy on entry; critical hits deal 2.25x damage.

snowcloak.name: Snow Cloak
snowcloak.desc: If Snow is active, the accuracy of moves used against it is multiplied by 0.8.
snowcloak.shortDesc: If Snow is active, its evasiveness is 1.25x.

snowpack.name: Snowpack
snowpack.desc: Full local Ice Body: immune to hail; contact attackers have a 30% frostbite chance. Heals 1/16 max HP in hail/snow, or on Icy, Snowy Mountain and Cold Eclipse without those weathers; hail on Cold Eclipse heals 1/8. Mamoswine supplies Thick Fat separately as its species passive.

solarbloom.name: Solar Bloom
solarbloom.desc: If sun is active, it transforms into Cherrim-Sunshine and restores 1/8 of its max HP. While sun is active, its Speed is doubled.
solarbloom.shortDesc: In sun: becomes Sunshine, heals 1/8, and has doubled Speed.

solarbud.name: Solar Bud
solarbud.desc: Once per entry, finishing a turn in effective sun stores one bud. The next Grass attack dealing HP damage to a foe consumes it to cure status and restore 1/8 max HP.
solarbud.shortDesc: Once/entry: sun stores a bud; Grass HP damage spends it to cure status/heal 1/8.

solarhydra.name: Solar Hydra
solarhydra.desc: Full local Hydra Bond and Grassy Surge.

solaridol.name: Solar Idol
solaridol.desc: Its Fire-type moves have 1.5x power, its Attack is 1.5x during sun, and Grass-type attacks are resisted.
solaridol.shortDesc: Fire power 1.5x; Attack 1.5x in sun; resists Grass.

solarmimicry.name: Solar Mimicry
solarmimicry.desc: Bug STAB and resistances. Always treated as sunny. Solar Blade lowers Speed by 1.
solarmimicry.shortDesc: Bug STAB and resistances. Always treated as sunny. Solar Blade lowers Speed by 1.

solarpower.name: Solar Power
solarpower.desc: In effective sun, Attack and Sp. Atk are 1.5x and it loses 1/8 max HP each turn. Cold Eclipse disables both effects.
solarpower.shortDesc: Sun: 1.5x Attack and Sp. Atk, loses 1/8 HP per turn; disabled on Cold Eclipse.

solarrecharge.name: Solar Recharge
solarrecharge.desc: Its Fire-type moves have STAB. It is immune to Fire-type moves and restores 1/4 of its max HP when hit by one. In Sun, it restores 1/8 of its max HP at turn end.
solarrecharge.shortDesc: Fire STAB; Fire immunity heals 1/4; heals 1/8 each turn in Sun.

solarrush.name: Solar Rush
solarrush.desc: Doubles Speed in sandstorm or on Desert and Ashen Beach. Immune to sandstorm damage. Doubles Speed in sun or Stage 4 Flower Garden.
solarrush.shortDesc: No sand damage; Double Speed in sun or Stage 4 Flower Garden.

solarstride.name: Solar Stride
solarstride.desc: Chlorophyll, including the Flower Garden stage-four Speed boost. While sunlight is effective, damaging Electric attacks remove opposing Reflect, Light Screen and Aurora Veil before damage using normal screen-breaking rules. Does not bypass Protect or immunities, and grants no extra damage multiplier.
solarstride.shortDesc: In effective sun, Electric attacks break opposing screens before damage.

solartrap.name: Solar Trap
solartrap.desc: Accumulation and Liquid Ooze. Has automatic Stockpiles and releases, defensive effects, and damage to draining attackers. Digestive Sap is not part of this ability.
solartrap.shortDesc: Automatic Stockpiles/releases; draining moves hurt their user.

solidrock.name: Solid Rock
solidrock.desc: Takes 20% less attack damage, or 40% less from super-effective attacks.
solidrock.shortDesc: 20% less attack damage; 40% less if super effective.

songstress.name: Songstress
songstress.desc: Copies another Pokemon’s successful sound move without spending PP or its turn. Copies cannot trigger further copies.
songstress.shortDesc: Copies another Pokemon’s sound move immediately after it succeeds.

soothingbouquet.name: Soothing Bouquet
soothingbouquet.desc: Friend Guard and Infiltrator. Sweet Scent has normal and field effects. Each reached opposing target loses up to two positive stages from its highest boosted combat stat (Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, Speed tie order), stopping at zero, and loses Focus Energy. This direct reset bypasses stat-change reactions. If any normal stat drop, reset or Focus Energy removal succeeds, after the whole move the living holder and living adjacent allies heal 1/8 max HP and lose confusion independently of healing success. Then uses one ordinary free Giga Drain at the first affected surviving active foe in slot order. Protect blocks; reflected or generated Sweet Scent grants no custom effects or rewards. Normal healing and Giga Drain accuracy, protection, immunity and drain apply. No PP cost or recursion.
soothingbouquet.shortDesc: Friend Guard + Infiltrator; Sweet Scent calms foes, heals allies, then uses Giga Drain.

soothingcream.name: Soothing Cream
soothingcream.desc: Full local Ripen. After an opposing contact move damages its HP, lowers the attacker's Attack by 1 once after the whole move.
soothingcream.shortDesc: Ripen; contact HP damage lowers attacker Attack once per move.

soothingpresence.name: Soothing Presence
soothingpresence.desc: Allies take 25% less attack damage; this does not protect the holder. Protects itself and allies from Attract, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Taunt and Torment. Other allies take 25% less attack damage; this does not reduce the holder's damage taken. The holder and its allies are protected from Attract, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Taunt, and Torment.
soothingpresence.shortDesc: Allies take 25% less attack damage; this does not protect the holder.

soulanchor.name: Soul Anchor
soulanchor.desc: Steelworker: Steel attacks gain STAB and 1.5x Attack or Sp. Atk (2x on Factory); on Short-Circuit they also become Electric-type. Immune to Poison attacks; resists Normal, Flying, Rock, Bug, Steel, Grass, Psychic, Ice, Dragon and Fairy attacks. A foe successfully trapped by its Anchor Shot loses 1/16 max HP each turn end; the holder heals by actual damage dealt. Only one tether per holder; a new tether replaces the old, and either Pokemon leaving ends it. Trap immunity, escape, indirect-damage immunity, suppression and healing restrictions apply.
soulanchor.shortDesc: Its Anchor Shot tethers one trapped foe, draining 1/16 HP each turn.

soulcremation.name: Soul Cremation
soulcremation.desc: Direct Fire/Ghost attacks heal 1/3 of actual opposing HP damage, capped at 1/6 max HP per turn, and block surviving targets' healing through the following turn. Switching clears the block; repeated hits refresh it. Native draining moves, substitutes, allies, residual and delayed damage do not grant this drain. Once per turn, a Ghost hit on an already-burned surviving foe also attempts -1 Sp. Def. At turn end, heals 1/8 max HP if any foe actually took burn damage; this is separate from the drain cap. Once per actual entry, the first executed opposing damaging move targeting it grants +1 Sp. Atk after the entire move if it survives and remains active, even after misses, protection or immunity. This use is spent at +6 and is not reset by ability changes or suppression; switching resets it. Contact attackers have a 30% burn chance (60% on Volcanic). Absorbs Fire for a 1.5x Fire boost; Burning or grounded Volcanic also grants the boost. On Cold Eclipse, Fire absorption and contact burns stop, and entry gives +2 Defense and Sp. Def total. Normal healing and drain rules apply. Mega Chandelure with active Soul Cremation bypasses Soul Fire's Fire/Ghost attack absorption only. Ordinary type effectiveness and type immunities remain; this grants neither general Mold Breaker nor a damage multiplier. Will-O-Wisp and Soul Fire redirection are unchanged.
soulcremation.shortDesc: Soul Siphon + Soul Pyre + Malice Well.

soulescort.name: Soul Escort
soulescort.desc: When this Pokemon faints with an eligible replacement available, its immediate replacement in the same battle slot ignores all entry hazards for that single entry. Hazards remain on the field. Does not cure status, protect another slot, or grant lasting immunity. No protection is stored when no replacement is available.
soulescort.shortDesc: On fainting, the immediate replacement ignores hazards for that entry.

soulfire.name: Soul Fire
soulfire.desc: It draws in Fire- and Ghost-type moves to itself and is immune to Fire-type moves, Ghost-type moves, Will-O-Wisp, and damaging weather conditions, raising Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage when hit by them. Its Fire- and Ghost-type moves bypass type immunities, cannot hit Normal-type Pokemon with Ghost-type attacks, and are resisted by Steel- and Dark-type Pokemon. Burns caused by its Fire- and Ghost-type moves or Will-O-Wisp bypass burn immunities, Misty Terrain, and Mist. Fire- and Ghost-type moves from this Ability deal 4x damage to opposing Soul Fire users.
soulfire.shortDesc: Draws in and absorbs Fire/Ghost; burns bypass immunities; attacks ignore most resists.

soulheart.name: Soul-Heart
soulheart.desc: Gains +1 Sp. Atk when any Pokemon faints, plus +2 Sp. Def on Misty or Rainbow Field.
soulheart.shortDesc: Faints give +1 Sp. Atk; Misty/Rainbow also give +2 Sp. Def.

soulpyre.name: Soul Pyre
soulpyre.desc: Restores 1/8 max HP at the end of a turn when an opposing Pokemon actually took burn damage. Ghost hits against already-burned foes lower Sp. Def by 1 stage once per turn. Prevented burn damage does not grant healing.
soulpyre.shortDesc: Heals 1/8 after foe burn damage; Ghost hits lower burned foes' Sp. Def.

soulreaver.name: Soul Reaver
soulreaver.desc: Infiltrator: bypasses opposing Substitute, Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil, Safeguard and Mist. Physical and special Ghost attacks, including Night Shade, restore HP equal to 25% of actual damage dealt. Uses the greater of native drain and 25%, never adds them; Spectral Scream remains 25%. Curse residual damage does not drain. Normal ability suppression disables both effects.
soulreaver.shortDesc: Infiltrator; Ghost attacks drain at least 25% of damage dealt.

soulsiphon.name: Soul Siphon
soulsiphon.desc: Direct Fire/Ghost damage to opponents heals one-third of actual HP damage, capped at one-sixth max HP per turn across all hits and targets. Also prevents the damaged target from recovering HP through the end of the following turn; switching clears this effect and repeated hits refresh it. Does not siphon from substitutes, allies, residual or future damage, or moves that already drain. Normal drain interactions apply. Absorbs Fire moves and gains a 1.5x Fire boost until switching out or losing the ability. Burning Field or grounded Volcanic Field also grants the boost. On Cold Eclipse, Fire absorption is disabled and entry gives +1 Defense and Sp. Def.
soulsiphon.shortDesc: Absorbs Fire; Fire/Ghost hits drain 1/3 damage, capped at 1/6 HP per turn, and block healing.

soulstrike.name: Soul Strike
soulstrike.desc: Its moves ignore accuracy checks. It is immune to Ghost-type moves and restores 1/4 max HP when hit by one. Soul Fire cannot redirect or bypass this immunity. When it faints, it creates Haunted Field for 5 turns, ignoring Neutralization. This Ability cannot be ignored or suppressed by Mold Breaker-style effects.
soulstrike.shortDesc: Moves never miss; Ghost absorb; faint sets Haunted Field.

soundproof.name: Soundproof
soundproof.desc: Immune to other Pokemon's sound moves.

sovereignarsenal.name: Sovereign Arsenal
sovereignarsenal.desc: Poison and Ground attacks choose Physical or Special using the higher Attack/Defense or Sp. Atk/Sp. Def stat ratio, like Shell Side Arm. Horn and tail moves gain +1 critical-hit stage. Contact flags are unchanged.
sovereignarsenal.shortDesc: Poison/Ground attacks use the stronger damage category; horn and tail moves crit more often.

speedboost.name: Speed Boost
speedboost.desc: Gains +1 Speed at the end of each full turn it spends active.
speedboost.shortDesc: +1 Speed after each full active turn.

spentforce.name: Spent Force
spentforce.desc: After executing a damaging move, it has half attack damage and Speed for the next two complete turns, then automatically recovers. The triggering move finishes at full power, including all hits and spread targets. Attacking during fatigue does not extend it, and status moves or waiting do not accelerate recovery. Executed misses, Protect and immunities trigger fatigue; prevented execution and charging-only turns do not. Switching clears fatigue. Suppression disables the penalties but does not reset or pause the timer, and ability replacement does not reset it. Fixed-damage moves retain their fixed damage.
spentforce.shortDesc: After an attack, half damage and Speed for two complete turns; then recovers.

spicyspray.name: Spicy Spray
spicyspray.desc: When it is hit by an attack, the attacker becomes burned. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn.
spicyspray.shortDesc: Attackers are burned after hitting its HP; heals 1/16 HP each turn.

spinfiend.name: Spin Fiend
spinfiend.desc: Moves with effective power of 60 or less have 1.5x power; the threshold is 80 on Factory Field. Prevents and cures sleep.
spinfiend.shortDesc: 1.5x power for moves at 60 power or less (80 on Factory); Prevents and cures sleep.

spiralevolution.name: Spiral Evolution
spiralevolution.desc: Full local Power Drill: drill and horn moves have 1.5x power, or 2x on Rocky, Mountain, Snowy Mountain, Cave and Volcanic, where they bypass protection at full power. Has Adaptability and double Twineedle power with its native hit count. Other damaging moves pierce protection at half power. Normal-priority moves act first in Trick Room without gaining priority. Ignores field Speed penalties and takes 20% less attack damage. Levitate remains separate.
spiralevolution.shortDesc: Power Drill + Adaptability; double Twineedle power; protection piercing.

sporeshroud.name: Spore Shroud
sporeshroud.desc: Damaging hits have separate 10% chances to inflict sleep, paralysis or poison on the attacker; powder immunity blocks this. If Sleep Clause blocks sleep, a further roll can inflict paralysis or poison instead. Contact attacks deal 0.75x damage; non-contact physical attacks are unaffected.
sporeshroud.shortDesc: Takes 25% less damage from contact attacks.

springfur.name: Spring Fur
springfur.desc: Fur Coat. Once per genuine entry, after an opposing damaging move breaks its Substitute and the whole attack finishes, the living user attempts +1 Attack. Consumed even if blocked or capped. Self-removal, Tidy Up and bypassing the Substitute do not qualify; ability restarts do not reset it.
springfur.shortDesc: Fur Coat; once per entry, a foe breaking its Substitute grants +1 Attack after the move.

springherald.name: Spring Herald
springherald.desc: Full local Drizzle. Its damaging Electric moves do not hit allies.
springherald.shortDesc: Drizzle. Its Electric attacks spare allies.

springpressure.name: Spring Pressure
springpressure.desc: Full local Static and Pressure, including their field effects. Pressure has its once-per-opponent entry memory.

springtempest.name: Spring Tempest
springtempest.desc: Full local Lightning Rod and Storm Power: redirects and absorbs Electric moves; rain boosts Sp. Atk by 1.5x and costs 1/8 max HP each turn.

stagesweep.name: Stage Sweep
stagesweep.desc: Screen Cleaner. Holder and adjacent active allies have Infiltrator while the holder remains active. A successful Rapid Spin, including Substitute damage, gives ordinary current-turn Helping Hand to an eligible partner and pivots if a legal replacement exists. An already-acted partner is ineligible unless newly switched. Once per entry, actual hazard removal also clears all negative stat stages and heals 1/8 base max HP. No-hazard success can still support/pivot; misses, protection, immunity and contact KO cannot. Ally Infiltrator ends when the holder leaves.
stagesweep.shortDesc: Screen Cleaner; ally Infiltrator; Rapid Spin supports partner and pivots.

stakeout.name: Stakeout
stakeout.desc: Attacks use double the offensive stat against targets that entered this turn.
stakeout.shortDesc: Double attacking stats against newly entered targets.

stall.name: Stall
stall.desc: It moves last among Pokemon using the same or greater priority moves.
stall.shortDesc: It moves last among Pokemon using the same or greater priority moves.

stalwart.name: Stalwart
stalwart.desc: Moves cannot be redirected. On New World, Starlight Arena, Fairy Tale and Chessboard entry, gains +1 Sp. Atk.
stalwart.shortDesc: Ignores redirection; +1 Sp. Atk on specified fields.

stamina.name: Stamina
stamina.desc: Each opposing attack hit that damages HP heals 1/16 max HP. The first such hit each turn also raises Defense by 1, before later hits of a multi-hit move.
stamina.shortDesc: Opposing HP hits heal 1/16; +1 Defense once per turn.

stancechange.name: Stance Change
stancechange.desc: Aegislash enters Blade before damaging moves and Shield before King’s Shield. Blade deals 20% more damage; Shield takes 20% less, plus a further 30% reduction after its first damaging hit each turn in Free-for-All. Fairy Tale and Chessboard stance stat changes apply. Transform and Gmax do not gain these stance changes.
stancechange.shortDesc: Attacks enter Blade (+20% power); King’s Shield enters Shield (20% less damage).

starboxer.name: Star Boxer
starboxer.desc: Eligible punching moves hit four times at 40% damage per hit, without changing base power. Secondary and self effects occur once after the sequence. Contact and ordinary draining occur per hit; the sequence stops when the user or target faints and never retargets.
starboxer.shortDesc: Punches hit 4 times at 40% damage; secondary/self effects once after the sequence.

static.name: Static
static.desc: Contact attackers have a 30% paralysis chance, or 60% on Electric Terrain and Short-Circuit.

staticreserve.name: Static Reserve
staticreserve.desc: Static: contact attackers have a 30% paralysis chance, or 60% on Electric Terrain and Short-Circuit. Once per entry, successfully causing paralysis with Static grants Charge. Failed status attempts do not spend the use.
staticreserve.shortDesc: Its first successful Static paralysis each entry grants Charge.

steadfast.name: Steadfast
steadfast.desc: If it flinches, its Speed is raised by 1 stage.
steadfast.shortDesc: If it flinches, its Speed is raised by 1 stage.

steadyaim.name: Steady Aim
steadyaim.desc: Prevents accuracy-stage drops caused by another Pokemon or the field. Self-inflicted accuracy costs still apply. Does not bypass evasion or grant perfect accuracy or additional field effects.
steadyaim.shortDesc: Prevents external accuracy drops; self-inflicted costs remain.

steamengine.name: Steam Engine
steamengine.desc: It has Magma Armor. Fire- or Water-type hits raise its Speed by 6 stages; heat fields activate it on entry, and Water Surface, Underwater, or Volcanic Terrain raises Speed each turn.
steamengine.shortDesc: Magma Armor; Fire/Water hits raise Speed by 6; certain fields also activate it.

steelplumage.name: Steel Plumage
steelplumage.desc: Once per entry, after surviving an opposing contact move's full hit sequence and taking actual HP damage, sets one layer of Spikes on that attacker's side. Normal Spikes layer limit applies.
steelplumage.shortDesc: Once/entry, surviving a foe contact attack sets Spikes on its side.

steelwingescort.name: Steelwing Escort
steelwingescort.desc: Sworn Duty: on entry heals adjacent allies by 1/4 max HP, or 1/3 on Fairy Tale Field. A successful U-turn protects its incoming replacement from entry-hazard damage during that entry only. Hazard statuses, Sticky Web and hazard layers remain.
steelwingescort.shortDesc: Sworn Duty; U-turn shields the replacement from entry-hazard damage once.

steelworker.name: Steelworker
steelworker.desc: Steel moves receive STAB and use 1.5x Attack or Sp. Atk (2x on Factory). On Short-Circuit, Steel moves also gain Electric typing. Adds Steel resistances and Poison immunity without Steel weaknesses.
steelworker.shortDesc: Steel STAB and attacking boost; Steel resistances without weaknesses.

steelyspirit.name: Steely Spirit
steelyspirit.desc: It and its allies' Steel-type moves have their power multiplied by 1.5. This affects Doom Desire even if the user is not on the field.
steelyspirit.shortDesc: It and its allies' Steel-type moves have their power multiplied by 1.5.

stench.name: Stench
stench.desc: Its attacks without a chance to make the target flinch gain a 10% chance to make the target flinch.
stench.shortDesc: Its attacks without a chance to flinch gain a 10% chance to flinch.

stickyhold.name: Sticky Hold
stickyhold.desc: Other Pokemon cannot remove its item while it survives. Sticky Barb can still transfer.
stickyhold.shortDesc: Protects its item while it survives.

stillmind.name: Still Mind
stillmind.desc: Anticipation reveals opposing Illusions and warns of super-effective or OHKO moves, with its Psychic Terrain Sp. Atk boost. Oblivious prevents infatuation, Taunt, Captivate and Intimidate Attack drops and cures infatuation or Taunt. Its Anticipation component: Checks each active opponent separately when the holder enters, and rechecks each incoming opponent on every switch-in, including repeat entries. Allies are not checked, and initial checks do not trigger twice. Each check retains its usual Psychic Terrain bonus condition and latest-warned-move protection.

stillwater.name: Stillwater
stillwater.desc: Absorbs other Pokemon's Water moves, healing 1/4 max HP instead of being hit. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn on Underwater, grounded on Water Surface, or grounded and Poison-type on Murkwater Surface. Absorbing a Water move while already at full HP raises Sp. Def by 1 stage once per turn.
stillwater.shortDesc: Absorbs Water; absorbing it at full HP gives +1 Sp. Def once per turn.

stillwaters.name: Still Waters
stillwaters.desc: Suppresses weather effects. On Rainbow Field, gains a random eligible stat stage each turn. Ignores opposing stat changes through local Unaware and reveals Illusions on entry. Fairy Tale entry has +1 Sp. Def.
stillwaters.shortDesc: Cloud Nine + Unaware; Fairy Tale entry grants +1 Sp. Def.

stokebelly.name: Stoke Belly
stokebelly.desc: Gluttony. Consuming a Berry clears its negative Attack stages, preserving positive Attack and other stages.
stokebelly.shortDesc: Eating a Berry clears its negative Attack stages.

stonewall.name: Stonewall
stonewall.desc: Prevents OHKO moves. At full HP, survives an otherwise fatal attack hit with 1 HP. When Sturdy saves it from a direct hit, it sets one layer of Spikes on the opposing side.
stonewall.shortDesc: When Sturdy saves it, sets one Spikes layer on the opposing side.

stormbell.name: Storm Bell
stormbell.desc: Sets rain with full local Drizzle and grants Levitate's Ground immunity.

stormcalling.name: Storm Calling
stormcalling.desc: Drizzle summons rain. Liquid Voice changes sound moves to Water, or Ice on Icy Field, with 1.2x power. Dissonant Echo adds repeatable shared marks after the holder or an adjacent ally deals resisted sound HP damage to a foe. The next allied sound attempt against that foe through next turn consumes the mark and ignores resistance, not immunity. One mark per side; no same-attack rearming. Provider suppression/departure or target departure clears it. The two sound power components share a single 1.2x boost, not 1.44x.
stormcalling.shortDesc: Drizzle + Liquid Voice + shared Dissonant Echo marks; sound power is 1.2x once.

stormcircuit.name: Storm Circuit
stormcircuit.desc: On entry, creates Electric Terrain or Electric Aura for 5 turns, or 8 with Amplifield Rock, subject to field rules. Airborne: immune to Ground attacks and grounded hazards unless grounded. Move KOs raise its highest stat by 1, ignoring stat stages when choosing the stat. Doubles Speed in rain or on Water Surface, Murkwater Surface, Underwater and Midnight Zone. Coil also gives +1 Sp. Atk.
stormcircuit.shortDesc: Entry: Electric Terrain or Aura for 5 turns (8 with Amplifield Rock).

stormdrain.name: Storm Drain
stormdrain.desc: It is immune to Water-type moves and raises its Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage when hit by a Water-type move. If it is not the target of a single-target Water-type move used by another Pokemon, it redirects that move to itself if it is within the range of that move. If multiple Pokemon could redirect with this Ability, it goes to the one with the highest Speed, or in the case of a tie to the one that has had this Ability active longer.
stormdrain.shortDesc: It draws Water moves to itself to raise Atk and Sp. Atk by 1; Water immunity.

stormfright.name: Storm Fright
stormfright.desc: Rain multiplies Sp. Atk by 1.5 and costs 1/8 max HP at turn end. Redirects eligible Electric moves, including allied moves, and absorbs them for +1 Attack and Sp. Atk. Electric Terrain entry grants both boosts.

stormpower.name: Storm Power
stormpower.desc: If Rain Dance or Primordial Sea is active, its Special Attack is multiplied by 1.5 and it loses 1/8 of its max HP at turn end.
stormpower.shortDesc: In rain, 1.5x Sp. Atk and loses 1/8 max HP each turn.

stormsong.name: Storm Song
stormsong.desc: Sound moves become Water-type, or Ice-type on Icy Field, and have 1.2x power. On entry, summons rain for 5 turns, or 8 with Damp Rock.
stormsong.shortDesc: Sound moves become Water-type, or Ice-type on Icy Field, and have 1.2x power.

stormsovereign.name: Storm Sovereign
stormsovereign.desc: Summons replaceable Strong Winds for 8 turns on entry. Each turn, non-immune foes take Flying damage equal to 1/16 base maximum HP; type effectiveness scales this chip only in Free-for-All. Flying-type foes are immune. Updraft: Competitive: opposing stat drops raise Special Attack by 2 outside Chessboard; on Chessboard, instead boosts damage with missing HP up to 2x at 20% HP. Flying moves ignore evasion boosts. Once per switch-in, the first Flying attack dealing opposing HP damage raises the living adjacent ally with the lowest HP percentage by 1 Speed stage, or the holder if no such ally exists. Only one recipient is boosted; ability restarts and Mega Evolution do not reset the entry allowance. Mega Pidgeot receives No Guard from its species passive and has no Gale Wings priority. Other holders retain their full-HP Flying priority and never-miss effect when no No Guard passive is present.
stormsovereign.shortDesc: Updraft (Competitive), eight-turn Strong Winds and opposing Flying chip.

streettyrant.name: Street Tyrant
streettyrant.desc: On entry, lowers adjacent foes' Attack by 1 with normal Substitute and Intimidate protections. Moves ignore bypassable opposing abilities.

strikerfrenzy.name: Striker Frenzy
strikerfrenzy.desc: Kicking moves have 1.4x power. Prevents and cures sleep; blocks Yawn. Fighting attacks use 1.3x Attack.
strikerfrenzy.shortDesc: 1.4x kicking power; no sleep or Yawn; Fighting moves use 1.3x Attack.

strikersmomentum.name: Striker's Momentum
strikersmomentum.desc: Kicking moves have 1.4x power. Gains +2 Attack when a foe lowers its stats. Moves cannot miss. Before a directly used damaging move, changes to its type; excludes called, bounced, delayed and Snatched moves. Once per entry, a move KO gives +1 Speed.
strikersmomentum.shortDesc: Stronger kicks; foe stat drops boost Attack; never misses; changes type; first KO boosts Speed.

sturdy.name: Sturdy
sturdy.desc: Prevents OHKO moves. At full HP, survives an otherwise fatal attack hit with 1 HP.
sturdy.shortDesc: Survives a hit at full HP; immune to OHKO moves.

suctioncups.name: Suction Cups
suctioncups.desc: Cannot be forced out by another Pokemon's moves or items. Voluntary switching still works.

summerherald.name: Summer Herald
summerherald.desc: Full local Drought. Immune to Fire moves. An opposing Fire move heals 1/8 max HP, at most once per turn; allied Fire moves do not heal it.
summerherald.shortDesc: Drought. Fire immunity; opposing Fire heals 1/8 HP once per turn.

summerpressure.name: Summer Pressure
summerpressure.desc: Full local Flame Body and Pressure, including their field effects. Pressure has its once-per-opponent entry memory.

summerrenewal.name: Summer Renewal
summerrenewal.desc: Full local Regenerator and Solar Power, including their field effects and Solar Power HP cost.

suncharm.name: Sun Charm
suncharm.desc: On entry, summons sun for 5 turns, or 8 with Heat Rock. Its first landed Fire hit each entry extends the sunlight it summoned by 1 turn, capped at 8 remaining turns. Once per entry, burning a foe also curses it: 1/8 max HP lost per turn under this server's ability-Curse rules. No HP cost to Ninetales.
suncharm.shortDesc: Summons sun; first Fire hit extends its sun; first inflicted burn each entry also curses the foe.

sunreserve.name: Sun Reserve
sunreserve.desc: Flash Fire, including its Fire power boost and field effects. Absorbing a Fire attack additionally heals 1/8 max HP at most once per turn, subject to healing restrictions. Cold Eclipse has Flash Fire's entry Defense/Sp. Def boosts and disables Fire absorption, so no absorption heal occurs there. Field-granted Flash Fire boosts do not trigger healing.
sunreserve.shortDesc: Absorbing a Fire attack also heals 1/8 HP once per turn.

sunsovereign.name: Sun Sovereign
sunsovereign.desc: Summons sun for 8 turns on entry. Eligible Normal moves become Dragon with 1.2x power, or 1.5x on Dragon's Den and Fairy Tale. Dragon moves receive STAB. Prevents freezing outside Cold Eclipse and cures freeze. Incoming Water and Ice attacks use half the attacker's offensive stat. Dragon's Den blocks Fire moves. On Dragon's Den, Volcanic or Cold Eclipse entry, gains +1 Defense and Sp. Def. Immune to hail damage. At turn end, deals Fire-type damage to foes equal to 1/16 max HP, doubled if the foe is burned or the holder used a Fire or Dragon move that turn. Fire immunities block this damage; type effectiveness scales it only in Free-for-All.

superluck.name: Super Luck
superluck.desc: Raises critical-hit rate by one stage.

supersweetsyrup.name: Supersweet Syrup
supersweetsyrup.desc: On switch-in, it lowers the evasiveness of adjacent opposing Pokemon by 1 stage every time it switches in. Substitute blocks this. Flower Garden stages 3–5 add the stat drops; Misty Terrain lowers its accuracy.
supersweetsyrup.shortDesc: On every entry, lowers adjacent foes’ evasiveness 1 stage.

supremeoverlord.name: Supreme Overlord
supremeoverlord.desc: Each fainted ally adds 10% move damage; in Free-for-All, allies count twice. At 2+ fallen allies it gains Infiltrator; 4+, flinch immunity from Inner Focus; 5+, indirect-damage immunity and a one-time +1 Attack and Sp. Atk. It does not block stat drops. Effective fallen count is capped at 5 after Free-for-All doubling, for a maximum 1.5x Supreme Overlord power multiplier.
supremeoverlord.shortDesc: 10% damage per fallen ally (max 50%); 2+ grants Infiltrator, 4+ Inner Focus.

surefoot.name: Surefoot
surefoot.desc: Ground-type moves have 1.3x power while its Defense stage is positive. The bonus ends when Defense returns to zero or below. Does not ignore opposing defensive stat stages.
surefoot.shortDesc: Ground moves have 1.3x power while Defense is raised.

surgeconduit.name: Surge Conduit
surgeconduit.desc: Redirects eligible Electric moves, including allied moves, and absorbs Electric hits for +1 Attack and Sp. Atk. Electric Terrain entry grants both boosts. Rock Head prevents move recoil except Struggle.

surgesurfer.name: Surge Surfer
surgesurfer.desc: The Pokemon's Speed is doubled on Electric Terrain, Water Surface, Underwater, Murkwater Surface and Short-Circuit fields.
surgesurfer.shortDesc: Doubles Speed on Electric, Water Surface, Underwater, Murkwater Surface and Short-Circuit fields.

sushitrick.name: Sushi Trick
sushitrick.desc: On entry, heals each adjacent active ally by 1/4 max HP and removes its confusion. If there is no adjacent active ally to serve, instead clears its own confusion and negative accuracy stages, preserving positive accuracy, without self-healing.
sushitrick.shortDesc: Entry: allies heal 1/4 HP and clear confusion; alone, clears own confusion/negative accuracy.

swarm.name: Swarm
swarm.desc: When it has 1/3 or less of its max HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Bug-type attack.
swarm.shortDesc: At 1/3 or less of its max HP, its offensive stat is 1.5x with Bug attacks.

swarmdrive.name: Swarm Drive
swarmdrive.desc: When it has 1/3 or less of its max HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Bug-type attack. Once per switch-in, knocking out a foe with a Bug-type move that does not switch the user out raises its Speed by one stage. U-turn and other pivot moves cannot trigger the Speed boost.
swarmdrive.shortDesc: First non-pivot Bug-move KO each switch-in raises Speed by 1.

sweetdecay.name: Sweet Decay
sweetdecay.desc: Attack is 1.5x, but physical moves have 0.8x accuracy. Berries normally eaten at 1/4 HP activate at 1/2 HP instead. Prevents sleep and Yawn for itself and allies, including Rest. Does not cure sleep. Can poison Poison and Steel types; Poison moves bypass Steel immunity. Newly poisoned foes lose 1 Defense and Sp. Def. On Wasteland, move secondary effects become separate 2.5% frostbite, burn, paralysis and poison chances. On Corrosive and Corrosive Mist, incoming damage is multiplied by 1.5.
sweetdecay.shortDesc: Attack is 1.5x, but physical moves have 0.8x accuracy.

sweetresonance.name: Sweet Resonance
sweetresonance.desc: Full local Hydra Bond. On entry, lowers adjacent foes' evasion by 1 unless protected by Substitute. The entry effect has its Flower Garden and Misty field extensions.
sweetresonance.shortDesc: Hydra Bond; lowers adjacent foes' evasion on entry. Field effects vary.

sweetsanctuary.name: Sweet Sanctuary
sweetsanctuary.desc: Full local Stamina: opposing HP hits heal 1/16 max HP; the first each turn also raises Defense by 1. Protects itself and active allies from opposing Defense/Sp. Def drops. Stat resets and self-inflicted drops still apply.
sweetsanctuary.shortDesc: Stamina; protects own and allies' Defense/Sp. Def from opposing drops.

sweetveil.name: Sweet Veil
sweetveil.desc: Prevents sleep and Yawn for itself and allies, including Rest. Does not cure sleep.
sweetveil.shortDesc: Prevents sleep and Yawn for itself and allies.

swiftdrill.name: Swift Drill
swiftdrill.desc: Doubles Speed in rain or on Water Surface, Murkwater Surface, Underwater and Midnight Zone. Drill and horn moves have 1.5x power, or 2x on Rocky, Mountain, Snowy Mountain, Cave and Volcanic, where they also bypass protection. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn in effective rain.
swiftdrill.shortDesc: Doubles Speed in rain or on Water Surface, Murkwater Surface, Underwater and Midnight Zone.

swiftswim.name: Swift Swim
swiftswim.desc: Doubles Speed in rain or on Water Surface, Murkwater Surface, Underwater and Midnight Zone.
swiftswim.shortDesc: Double Speed in rain and water fields.

swiftvenom.name: Swift Venom
swiftvenom.desc: Swift Swim and Merciless. Doubles Speed in effective rain or on Water Surface, Murkwater Surface, Underwater and Midnight Zone. Attacks always critically hit poisoned targets and on Corrosive, Corrosive Mist, Murkwater Surface and Wasteland, unless critical hits are blocked. On Chessboard, gains one critical-hit stage per 20% of the target's missing base max HP, up to three.

swordofruin.name: Sword of Ruin
swordofruin.desc: Active Pokemon without this Ability have their Defense multiplied by 0.75.
swordofruin.shortDesc: Active Pokemon without this Ability have their Defense multiplied by 0.75.

swornduty.name: Sworn Duty
swornduty.desc: On entry, heals each adjacent ally by 1/4 max HP, or 1/3 on Fairy Tale.
swornduty.shortDesc: Entry heals adjacent allies by 1/4 HP (1/3 on Fairy Tale).

symbiosis.name: Symbiosis
symbiosis.desc: If an ally uses its item, it gives its item to that ally immediately. Does not activate if the ally's item was stolen or knocked off, or if the ally used an Eject Button or Eject Pack.
symbiosis.shortDesc: If an ally uses its item, it gives its item to that ally immediately.

synchronize.name: Synchronize
synchronize.desc: If another Pokemon burns, paralyzes, poisons, or badly poisons it, that Pokemon receives the same non-volatile status condition.
synchronize.shortDesc: If another Pokemon burns/poisons/paralyzes it, it also gets that status.

tabletsofruin.name: Tablets of Ruin
tabletsofruin.desc: Active Pokemon without this Ability have their Attack multiplied by 0.75.
tabletsofruin.shortDesc: Active Pokemon without this Ability have their Attack multiplied by 0.75.

tacticalretreat.name: Tactical Retreat
tacticalretreat.desc: When damage takes it from above half HP to half or less and it survives, switches out if a replacement is available. If its selected damaging attack is still queued, waits until that action finishes, even if the attack is prevented. Status moves and already completed actions do not defer the retreat. Does not change priority, grant an attack, interrupt multi-hit moves, heal, or clear stat changes.
tacticalretreat.shortDesc: At half HP from above half, retreats after its queued attack, or normally if none.

tangledfeet.name: Tangled Feet
tangledfeet.desc: While confused, incoming moves have half accuracy and its critical-hit rate rises by one stage. Mirror Arena or Big Top entry gives +1 evasion.
tangledfeet.shortDesc: Confusion boosts evasion and critical-hit rate.

taptempo.name: Tap Tempo
taptempo.desc: Own Tempo. After an Ice- or Psychic-type attack damages an opponent, attempts to lower that opponent's Speed by one stage with 30% probability, once per whole move. Does not trigger on allies or Substitute-only damage.
taptempo.shortDesc: Own Tempo; damaging Ice/Psychic attacks have one 30% Speed-drop roll.

teaceremony.name: Tea Ceremony
teaceremony.desc: Sticky Hold protects the held item from removal. Aroma Veil protects the user and allies from infatuation, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Taunt and Torment.

technician.name: Technician
technician.desc: Moves with effective power of 60 or less have 1.5x power; the threshold is 80 on Factory Field.
technician.shortDesc: 1.5x power for moves at 60 power or less (80 on Factory).

telepathy.name: Telepathy
telepathy.desc: Avoids allied damaging moves. Speed doubles on Psychic Terrain or Psychic Aura.
telepathy.shortDesc: Avoids allied attacks; double Speed on Psychic field/aura.

temperedalloy.name: Tempered Alloy
temperedalloy.desc: Filter. Blocks secondary effects of damaging moves that would affect it; effects on the attacker still apply.
temperedalloy.shortDesc: Filter. Immune to damaging-move secondary effects.

tempestfury.name: Tempest Fury
tempestfury.desc: Surviving an opposing direct attack charges its next damaging Water move to critically hit. A landed Water hit spends the non-stacking charge; misses and Protect do not. Includes full local Anger Point: the first damaging hit after activation raises Attack by 1, and a surviving critical hit maximizes Attack at the normal +6 cap.
tempestfury.shortDesc: After surviving a direct hit, next Water move critically hits.

templechime.name: Temple Chime
templechime.desc: Move KOs raise its highest stat by 1, ignoring stat stages when choosing the stat. Once per entry, Heal Bell actually curing at least one status also resets only the user's negative Special Defense stages.
templechime.shortDesc: Move KOs boost highest stat; once per entry, Heal Bell curing status clears negative Sp. Def.

temporalshift.name: Temporal Shift
temporalshift.desc: Its stats cannot be lowered by opposing Pokemon. On the turn after it uses a damaging move, it queues a 100 BP Future Sight matching its primary type against a random valid opposing target; multiple attacks can be queued and announce their strike turns.
temporalshift.shortDesc: Stats cannot be lowered; after attacking, queues 100 BP Temporal Shift Future Sight.

teraformzero.name: Teraform Zero
teraformzero.desc: Terapagos: Terastallizing ends the effects of weather and terrain. Once per battle.
teraformzero.shortDesc: Terapagos: Terastallizing ends the effects of weather and terrain. Once per battle.

terashell.name: Tera Shell
terashell.desc: If it is a Terapagos at full HP, the effectiveness of attacks against it is changed to 0.5 unless it is immune to the move. Multi-hit moves retain the same effectiveness throughout the attack.
terashell.shortDesc: Terapagos: If full HP, attacks taken have 0.5x effectiveness unless naturally immune.

terashift.name: Tera Shift
terashift.desc: If it is a Terapagos, it transforms into its Terastal Form on entry.
terashift.shortDesc: If it is a Terapagos, it transforms into its Terastal Form on entry.

terastaladaptability.name: Terastal Adaptability
terastaladaptability.desc: Same-type attack bonus becomes 2x instead of 1.5x, or 2.25x instead of a 2x bonus. This STAB increase applies only to Rock and Poison moves. Off-type damaging moves have 1.5x power. After any move, takes half damage from types resisted by that move's type until it uses another move.
terastaladaptability.shortDesc: Stronger Rock/Poison STAB; 1.5x off-type power; gains last move type's resistances.

terragift.name: Terra Gift
terragift.desc: On entry, heals each adjacent ally by 1/4 of that ally's max HP. Ignores target Defense/Sp. Def/evasion stages when attacking, and attacker Attack/Defense/Sp. Atk/accuracy stages when defending. Reveals opposing Illusions on entry. Same-type moves have 1.3x power.

terraresolve.name: Terra Resolve
terraresolve.desc: Each opposing attack hit that damages HP heals 1/16 max HP. The first such hit each turn also raises Defense by 1, before later hits of a multi-hit move. Takes 20% less attack damage, or 40% less from super-effective attacks.
terraresolve.shortDesc: Each opposing attack hit that damages HP heals 1/16 max HP.

territorial.name: Territorial
territorial.desc: Each opposing physical or special hit that damages its HP heals 1/16 base max HP; the first such hit each turn immediately raises Defense by 1, including between multi-hit strikes. Opposing forced switching is blocked and Intimidate raises Attack instead. Opponents cannot eat Berries or use field seeds; Cold Eclipse entry lowers opposing Speed.
territorial.shortDesc: Blocks Berries/forced switching; HP hits heal 1/16, +1 Defense once/turn; Intimidate: +1 Attack.

thermalexchange.name: Thermal Exchange
thermalexchange.desc: Fire hits give +1 Attack. Prevents and cures burns. Gains +1 Attack each turn on Superheated, Dragon's Den, Burning and Volcanic.
thermalexchange.shortDesc: Fire hits/hot fields give +1 Attack; no burns.

thickfat.name: Thick Fat
thickfat.desc: Incoming Fire and Ice attacks use half the attacker's offensive stat. Immune to hail damage.
thickfat.shortDesc: Half Fire/Ice attacking stats; immune to hail damage.

thorntempered.name: Thorn-Tempered
thorntempered.desc: Prevents damage from Rocky Helmet, Rough Skin and Iron Barbs, including those ability components within composites. Does not block recoil, other contact damage, status or stat effects. Brave Bird recoil still applies.
thorntempered.shortDesc: Ignores Rocky Helmet, Rough Skin and Iron Barbs damage.

threadshelter.name: Thread Shelter
threadshelter.desc: Successfully using Silk Trap or Sticky Web stores one guard. The next damaging move to hit it deals 25% less damage across every hit, including Substitute damage. Guards do not stack and end on switching. Failed moves do not grant a guard.
threadshelter.shortDesc: Successful Silk Trap/Sticky Web stores one 25% guard for the next damaging move.

tidaldominion.name: Tidal Dominion
tidaldominion.desc: Doubles Speed in rain or on Water Surface, Murkwater Surface, Underwater and Midnight Zone. Opponents with a lowered Speed stage cannot hit it or its allies with priority moves. Pairs with G-Max Foam Burst's Speed drops.
tidaldominion.shortDesc: Foes with lowered Speed cannot use priority against its side.

tidaljaw.name: Tidal Jaw
tidaljaw.desc: Biting moves have 1.5x power. Doubles Speed in rain or on Water Surface, Murkwater Surface, Underwater and Midnight Zone. Takes 20% less attack damage, or 40% less from super-effective attacks.
tidaljaw.shortDesc: 1.5x biting power; rain/water fields double Speed; 20%/40% less attack damage.

tidalvoice.name: Tidal Voice
tidalvoice.desc: Liquid Voice changes sound moves to Water, or Ice on Icy Field, with exactly 1.2x power. Soundproof blocks other Pokemon's sound moves. Sound moves spare allies. Damaging sound moves bypass ordinary Protect-family moves and Wide Guard for full damage, but not Max Guard. After a complete sound attack deals opposing HP damage, the living, active user has one 30% chance to gain 1 Special Attack. Spread and multiple hits roll only once; Substitute-only hits, ally damage, misses and immunities do not qualify. This ability chance is unaffected by Serene Grace or Sheer Force.
tidalvoice.shortDesc: Liquid Voice + Soundproof; sound bypasses ordinary guards; 30% +1 SpA after foe HP damage.

tidalwave.name: Tidal Wave
tidalwave.desc: Full local Hydration and Rain Dish.

tirelessmuscle.name: Tireless Muscle
tirelessmuscle.desc: Full local Inner Focus prevents flinching and Intimidate Attack drops. At the end of a turn in which it survived opposing direct damaging-move HP damage, heals 1/16 max HP once. Recoil, allied attacks, Substitute-only hits and residual damage do not qualify. Normal healing modifiers and Heal Block apply.
tirelessmuscle.shortDesc: Inner Focus; heals 1/16 HP at turn end after surviving opposing attack HP damage.

titanpincer.name: Titan Pincer
titanpincer.desc: Crabhammer and physical Steel-type moves use its Defense instead of Attack when its Defense is higher.
titanpincer.shortDesc: Crabhammer and physical Steel moves use Defense when higher than Attack.

torrent.name: Torrent
torrent.desc: When it has 1/3 or less of its max HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Water-type attack.
torrent.shortDesc: At 1/3 or less of its max HP, its offensive stat is 1.5x with Water attacks.

toxicarmor.name: Toxic Armor
toxicarmor.desc: Full local Dual Wield, Metal Claw with two 60%-power hits, and opening Violent Rush. While poisoned, opposing Pokemon cannot lower its Attack; self-inflicted drops remain. A native positive-priority damaging attack that damages opposing HP prepares the next eligible Dual Wield attack on the following turn for +1 priority. Consumes on attempt, including miss, protection or immunity; expires at that turn end and clears on switching. No stacking, generated attacks, Z/Max attacks or self-rearming from the granted priority. Cannot be suppressed, replaced or bypassed by Mold Breaker.
toxicarmor.shortDesc: Dual Wield + opening Violent Rush; priority hits prepare next-turn priority.

toxicbloom.name: Virulence
toxicbloom.desc: Incoming Fire and Ice attacks use half the attacker's offensive stat. Immune to hail damage. Ignores target Defense/Sp. Def/evasion stages when attacking, and attacker Attack/Defense/Sp. Atk/accuracy stages when defending. Reveals opposing Illusions on entry. At turn end, opposing non-Grass Pokemon take Grass-type damage equal to 1/16 max HP, blocked by Grass immunities; it heals the damage dealt by that chip. Only in Free-for-All does Grass type effectiveness scale this chip.

toxicboost.name: Toxic Boost
toxicboost.desc: While it is poisoned, the power of its physical attacks is multiplied by 1.5.
toxicboost.shortDesc: While it is poisoned, its physical attacks have 1.5x power.

toxicchain.name: Toxic Chain
toxicchain.desc: Its attacks have a 30% chance of badly poisoning. This effect comes before a move's inherent secondary effect chance.
toxicchain.shortDesc: Its attacks have a 30% chance of badly poisoning.

toxiccocoon.name: Toxic Cocoon
toxiccocoon.desc: Full local Shield Dust blocks incoming move secondary effects on this Pokemon, while preserving attacker self-effects and primary effects; normal Shield Dust ability bypass applies. Once per actual entry, the first opposing Special attack to damage its HP has its ordinary damage halved for the whole triggering move, including all hits. As before, Special damage to a Substitute can be halved before the charge is spent, but Substitute-only damage does not consume it. Separately, its first opposing contact HP hit each entry attempts to poison the attacker; immunity still spends that attempt. Suppression, ability restarts and reacquisition do not refresh either charge; switching out and actually entering again does.
toxiccocoon.shortDesc: Shield Dust; halves first Special HP attack each entry; poisons first contact attacker.

toxicdebris.name: Toxic Debris
toxicdebris.desc: Physical HP hits set one Toxic Spikes layer on the attacker's side, up to two; allied attacks use the opposing side. Contact attackers also lose 1/6 max HP.
toxicdebris.shortDesc: Physical hits set Toxic Spikes; contact attackers lose 1/6 HP.

toxicevolution.name: Toxic Evolution
toxicevolution.desc: Full local Corrosion and Shield Dust. Can poison Poison and Steel types; Poison attacks bypass Steel immunity. Newly poisoned foes lose 1 Defense and Sp. Def. Has Wasteland secondary replacement and 1.5x incoming damage on Corrosive/Corrosive Mist. Successfully poisoning a foe with its own move, or dealing attack HP damage to a foe poisoned before that hit, can heal 1/8 base max HP, sharing one activation per turn.
toxicevolution.shortDesc: Corrosion + Shield Dust; poison infliction/damage shares one 1/8 heal per turn.

toxicrenewal.name: Toxic Renewal
toxicrenewal.desc: Uses full local Adaptability for same-type moves, including its higher-STAB interaction. Contact hits have a 30% chance to poison; Shield Dust and Covert Cloak block this effect.

toxicserenity.name: Toxic Serenity
toxicserenity.desc: Poison damage instead heals 1/8 max HP. Also heals 1/8 each turn on Corrosive Mist and Murkwater Surface, or while grounded on Corrosive and Wasteland. While poisoned or badly poisoned, Dragon moves cannot miss.
toxicserenity.shortDesc: Dragon moves cannot miss while poisoned.

toxicsignature.name: Toxic Signature
toxicsignature.desc: Unnerve, including its field effects. Poison attacks dealing opposing HP damage place one Toxic Spikes layer on that side only if none exists. Damaging attacks against poisoned targets ignore accuracy and evasion stages but retain their base accuracy and other accuracy modifiers.
toxicsignature.shortDesc: Poison HP hits lay a first Toxic Spikes layer; ignores stages vs poisoned foes.

toxicsink.name: Toxic Sink
toxicsink.desc: Redirects eligible single-target Poison moves within range. Absorbs other Pokemon’s Poison moves, including status moves and spread hits on this holder, raising Sp. Atk by 1 stage. Spread moves are not redirected. Normal suppression and ability bypass rules apply.
toxicsink.shortDesc: Redirects and absorbs Poison moves; absorption raises Sp. Atk by 1.

toxicspines.name: Toxic Spines
toxicspines.desc: Physical HP hits set one Toxic Spikes layer on the attacker’s side, up to two; allied attackers use the opposing side. Contact attackers lose 1/6 base max HP, without an additional Iron Barbs hit. Can poison Poison and Steel types; Poison attacks bypass Steel immunity. Poisoning does not lower defenses. Wasteland has four separate 2.5% frostbite, burn, paralysis and poison secondary chances; incoming damage remains 1.5x on Corrosive and Corrosive Mist.
toxicspines.shortDesc: Physical hits set Toxic Spikes; contact retaliates for 1/6 HP; poison bypass.

trace.name: Trace
trace.desc: On switch-in, it copies a random opposing Pokemon's Ability. Abilities that cannot be copied are As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Teraform Zero, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Trace, Zen Mode, and Zero to Hero. If no opposing Pokemon has an Ability that can be copied, this Ability will activate as soon as one does.
trace.shortDesc: On switch-in, or when it can, it copies a random adjacent foe's Ability.

transfixinggaze.name: Transfixing Gaze
transfixinggaze.desc: Frisk: removes opposing Illusions, reveals their held items, and each revealed item holder has a 30% chance of Embargo. While it remains active with its ability functioning, opposing moves cannot switch their user out. Damage, stat changes and other move effects still occur. Manual switching, forced switching and item-triggered switches remain allowed. If it faints, leaves or loses its ability before the move finishes, the pivot succeeds. No lingering mark.
transfixinggaze.shortDesc: Opposing moves cannot pivot while it stays active.

transistor.name: Transistor
transistor.desc: Electric attacks use 1.3x Attack or Sp. Atk, or 2x on Electric and Factory fields. On Electric Terrain, incoming Ground attacks use half the attacker's offensive stat.
transistor.shortDesc: Boosts Electric attacking stats; Electric Terrain weakens Ground.

treasuretitan.name: Treasure Titan
treasuretitan.desc: Doubles weight and halves physical attack damage. Factory entry gives +1 Defense and -1 Speed. On entry, lowers adjacent foes' Attack by 1. Substitute and Intimidate protections still apply. Takes 25% less super-effective attack damage. Absorbs Ground moves from other Pokemon and heals 1/4 max HP. Copperajah-Gmax's weight-based moves have at least 120 power.
treasuretitan.shortDesc: Lowers foes' Attack; absorbs Ground; 25% less super-effective damage.

tremor.name: Tremor
tremor.desc: Immune to Ground moves. Its Bug-type attacks receive STAB. Damaging sound moves used by it or its allies have 1.5x power; its sound moves use its higher offensive stat, and allies are protected from allied sound moves. In Sandstorm, Desert Terrain, or Ashen Beach Terrain, its Rock-, Ground-, and Steel-type attacks have 1.3x power. It is immune to sandstorm damage.
tremor.shortDesc: Bug STAB; stronger allied sound moves; stronger Rock/Ground/Steel moves in sand fields.

triage.name: Triage
triage.desc: Healing moves and Aromatherapy, Heal Bell, Jungle Healing, Purify and Refresh gain +3 priority.
triage.shortDesc: Healing and status-cleansing moves gain +3 priority.

trickperformer.name: Trick Performer
trickperformer.desc: Technician and Prankster. Reflect and Light Screen receive +1 priority when Mimecraft is also present.
trickperformer.shortDesc: Technician + Prankster; Mimecraft screens total +1 priority.

triplethreat.name: Triple Threat
triplethreat.desc: Prevents flinching, confusion and Intimidate Attack drops; cures confusion. Full local Hydra Bond and Keen Eye: eligible attacks gain Hydra Bond's extra hits and format/field behavior. Prevents opposing accuracy drops, ignores evasion boosts, reveals opposing Illusions on activation, and gains accuracy and Laser Focus on Mirror Arena entry.
triplethreat.shortDesc: Hydra Bond; Keen Eye, Inner Focus and Own Tempo.

truant.name: Truant
truant.desc: It skips every other turn instead of using a move.
truant.shortDesc: It skips every other turn instead of using a move.

truedevotion.name: True Devotion
truedevotion.desc: Full local Prankster, Serene Grace and Technician. Status moves gain +1 priority with Prankster targeting rules and its Bewitched Woods exception. Doubles secondary-effect chances up to 60%, preserving effects already above the cap, including guaranteed effects. Skips move charge turns. Repeated Serene Grace applications do not multiply the same effect again. Moves with 60 or less effective base power (80 on Factory) gain Technician's 1.5x power boost, retaining its multi-hit interactions.

truehydra.name: True Hydra
truehydra.desc: Eligible single-target attacks hit three times. In singles and doubles, native variable multi-hit moves use their maximum hit count, keeping native per-hit accuracy and damage. Remaining native hits can continue into another living opposing active Pokemon after a KO at 70% damage. Excludes non-FFA spread, charge, delayed, Z/Max and extra-hit-barred moves. Follow-ups deal 30% damage, retargeting another living opposing active Pokemon after a KO. In FFA, single-target moves hit all foes at 1.3x power; spread moves hit all foes three times with 30% follow-ups. Full-power spread stays full power. Moves have 1.2x power on Dragon's Den. Heals 1/3 max HP on switching out. At turn end, if statused, affected by a listed ailment, negatively boosted or at half HP or less, has a 50% chance to heal 1/4 max HP, cure status, clear negative stages and remove Attract, confusion, Curse, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Leech Seed, Nightmare, Perish Song, Taunt, Torment and Yawn. On Dragon's Den, activation is guaranteed but only cures status and heals, then raises its higher attacking stat by 1 and lowers both defenses by 1. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn. Immune to sandstorm and hail damage.
truehydra.shortDesc: Eligible attacks hit three times; switch and turn-end healing; ailment recovery.

tundramarch.name: Tundra March
tundramarch.desc: Prevents and cures attraction and Taunt. Blocks Captivate and Intimidate's Attack drop. Landing a Ground attack on a foe removes Spikes, Toxic Spikes and Sticky Web from its own side. Ground immunity, Protect and Substitute prevent this activation. Stealth Rock remains.
tundramarch.shortDesc: Ground hits remove Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Sticky Web.

tunnelclearance.name: Tunnel Clearance
tunnelclearance.desc: Hyper Cutter. Successful Rapid Spin damage removes opposing Reflect and Light Screen after damage, including when hitting Substitute. Does not remove Aurora Veil or other walls.
tunnelclearance.shortDesc: Damaging Rapid Spin removes opposing Reflect and Light Screen after damage.

twilightinstinct.name: Twilight Instinct
twilightinstinct.desc: Full local Ultra Instinct and Battle Fervor, including their timing power, incoming-damage protection, recovery, first-hit attacking boosts and berry/seed prevention. Has their field suppression and Ultra Ego rivalry rules.

twinblades.name: Twin Blades
twinblades.desc: Single-target Fire and Ghost slicing attacks hit twice at half power per hit (60% power per hit in FFA). In FFA the second hit targets a random different eligible foe, or the original foe if none exists; elsewhere it redirects after a KO. The second hit ignores positive defensive stages. Secondary effects roll only on the first hit. Excludes Z/Max, fixed-damage and multi-hit moves.
twinblades.shortDesc: Fire/Ghost slicing moves hit twice: 50% each, or 60% in FFA; second hit bypasses Defense boosts.

twincannons.name: Twin Cannons
twincannons.desc: Single-target special Fire and Psychic attacks hit twice at half power per hit (full power in FFA). In FFA the second hit targets a random different eligible foe, or the original foe if none exists; elsewhere it redirects after a KO. Both use Sp. Atk: the first targets Sp. Def, the second Defense. Secondary effects roll only on the first hit. Excludes Z/Max, fixed-damage and existing multi-hit moves.
twincannons.shortDesc: Fire/Psychic attacks hit twice; the second hit targets Defense instead of Sp. Def.

twindrills.name: Twin Drills
twindrills.desc: Full local Dual Wield and Power Drill. Eligible single-hit moves hit twice at 60% power each with independent accuracy checks. Drill and horn moves gain 1.5x power, or 2x on Rocky, Mountain, Snowy Mountain, Cave and Volcanic fields, where they bypass protection. Each generated drill/horn hit is therefore 0.9x power normally or 1.2x on those fields, before other modifiers. Native multihit moves retain their normal hit counts and receive only the Power Drill boost. Overlapping active/passive components apply once.
twindrills.shortDesc: Dual Wield + Power Drill; two 60% hits with normal drill/horn boosts.

twinfang.name: Twin Fang
twinfang.desc: Special Attack uses calculated unboosted Attack, including Attack EVs, IVs and nature, then applies its own Special Attack stages and modifiers. Attack stages and Attack-only multipliers are not copied; species base stats remain unchanged. Normally single-hit contact attacks gain a second hit at 30% calculated damage. No stacking with other extra-hit effects, retargeting after KO, recursive hits, extra secondaries or self-stat rolls. Excludes native multihit, spread, fixed/OHKO, Z/Max, delayed, charge/recharge, self-KO and item-consuming/repeating exceptions. Full local Rivalry gives damaging moves 1.3x power against a same-gender or genderless target, with no opposite-gender penalty. Other active allies take 25% less calculated attack damage, including friendly fire; the holder is not protected by its own Rivalry. Separate holders retain normal stacking. Selected-ability suppression disables these added effects.
twinfang.shortDesc: Rivalry; Sp. Atk copies unboosted Attack; eligible contact attacks gain a 30% second hit.

tyrantdomain.name: Tyrant Domain
tyrantdomain.desc: On entry, summons sandstorm for 5 turns, or 8 with Smooth Rock. Each fainted ally adds 10% move damage; in Free-for-All, allies count twice. At 2+ fallen allies it gains Infiltrator; 4+, flinch immunity; 5+, indirect-damage immunity and a one-time +1 Attack and Sp. Atk. Does not block stat drops. On fainting, creates Dragon's Den for 5 turns. Its effective faint count is capped at 5 after Free-for-All doubling. The fallen-ally power multiplier is capped at 1.5x.
tyrantdomain.shortDesc: Sandstorm and fallen-ally power; Dragon's Den on fainting.

tyrantstream.name: Tyrant Stream
tyrantstream.desc: Recoil and crash moves, Explosion, Self-Destruct and Misty Explosion have 1.2x power; Struggle is excluded. On Chessboard, all moves gain a further 1.2x power. Prevents move recoil except Struggle. Crash and Life Orb damage still apply. On entry, summons sandstorm for 5 turns, or 8 with Smooth Rock. Biting moves have 1.5x power.

ultraego.name: Ultra Ego
ultraego.desc: Moves ignore bypassable abilities. After dealing HP damage, heals 1/16 max HP once per turn. The first opposing HP hit gives +1 Attack and Sp. Atk and heals 1/16 max HP; later hits heal 1/20 until it completes a damaging move and resets this trigger. On Ashen Beach, New World, Starlight Arena, Cold Eclipse and Fairy Tale, the first qualifying physical and special hits also give +1 Defense and Sp. Def respectively. In those fields, a qualifying hit at half HP or less instead heals 1/4 max HP once per activation; blocked healing does not spend it. These effects stop on Bewitched Woods, Haunted and Holy Field. Against an opposing effective Ultra Instinct (including composites), its attacks ignore its own negative Attack and Sp. Atk stages. Ultra Instinct instead reduces its first HP-damaging move each turn by 40% and ignores positive Attack or Sp. Atk stages for that protected move. Stored stages are unchanged; normal +1 retaliation is unchanged. The rivalry is disabled on Bewitched Woods, Haunted and Holy.
ultraego.shortDesc: Ability bypass; healing from damage dealt/taken; attack boosts and field bonuses.

ultrainstinct.name: Ultra Instinct
ultrainstinct.desc: Mold Breaker + Inner Focus. Attacks have 1.3x power against an opposing target still queued to move or that switched in this turn, except a target with Battle Bond. The first opposing HP-damaging move each turn deals 30% less damage across all hits. Substitute-only damage preserves the allowance. After a whole attack deals opposing HP damage, heals 1/16 max HP once per turn while alive; healing restrictions apply. Multi-hit and spread moves heal only once; a failed heal cannot retry within the same move. On Ashen Beach, New World, Starlight Arena and Cold Eclipse: 35% reduction and 1/8 healing. The turn allowance persists through switches, form/ability changes and Transform. Bewitched Woods, Haunted and Holy disable Ultra Instinct's effects. Against Ultra Ego or its composites, the protected move deals 40% less damage and ignores positive offensive stages. Ultra Ego ignores its own negative Attack or Sp. Atk stages when attacking Ultra Instinct. Has the Predator interaction.
ultrainstinct.shortDesc: Mold Breaker + Inner Focus; timing power, first-attack protection and attack healing.

unaware.name: Unaware
unaware.desc: Ignores target Defense/Sp. Def/evasion stages when attacking, and attacker Attack/Defense/Sp. Atk/accuracy stages when defending. Reveals opposing Illusions on entry.
unaware.shortDesc: Ignores opposing combat/accuracy stages; reveals Illusions.

unboundblaze.name: Unbound Blaze
unboundblaze.desc: Eligible Normal moves become Dragon with 1.2x power, or 1.5x on Dragon's Den and Fairy Tale. Dragon moves receive STAB. Prevents freezing outside Cold Eclipse and cures freeze. Incoming Water and Ice attacks use half the attacker's offensive stat. Dragon's Den blocks Fire moves. On Dragon's Den, Volcanic or Cold Eclipse entry, gains +1 Defense and Sp. Def. Immune to hail damage. At turn end, deals Fire-type damage to foes equal to 1/16 max HP, doubled if the foe is burned or the holder used a Fire or Dragon move that turn. Fire immunities block this damage; type effectiveness scales it only in Free-for-All.
unboundblaze.shortDesc: Dragon conversion/STAB, Magma Armor and Fire chip.

unboundspirit.name: Unbound Spirit
unboundspirit.desc: Full revised Vital Spirit prevents and cures sleep, blocks Yawn, and gives Fighting attacks 1.3x Attack or Sp. Atk. Ghost attacks ignore Reflect and Light Screen only. Does not bypass Aurora Veil, Substitute, type immunities or abilities.
unboundspirit.shortDesc: Vital Spirit; Ghost attacks ignore Reflect and Light Screen.

unboundwill.name: Unbound Will
unboundwill.desc: Magic Bounce + Clear Body. Immune to Taunt, Encore, Disable and Torment, including unreflectable effects.
unboundwill.shortDesc: Magic Bounce + Clear Body; blocks Taunt, Encore, Disable and Torment.

unbridledwrath.name: Unbridled Wrath
unbridledwrath.desc: Sheer Force removes eligible secondary effects and gives those moves approximately 1.3x power, once. Rampage moves still lock the user and cause their normal ending confusion. Inner Focus prevents flinching and Intimidate Attack drops.

unbrokencharge.name: Unbroken Charge
unbrokencharge.desc: After Raging Bull successfully damages opposing HP, the living active holder clears all negative stat stages, including accuracy and evasion, once after the whole attack. Positive stages are preserved. No trigger on a miss, protection, immunity, Substitute-only damage or ally damage. This species passive stays active under selected-ability suppression and does not double with a copied selected instance.
unbrokencharge.shortDesc: After Raging Bull damages opposing HP, clears all negative stat stages after the whole attack.

unburden.name: Unburden
unburden.desc: If it loses its held item for any reason, its Speed is doubled as long as it remains active, has this Ability, and is not holding an item.
unburden.shortDesc: Speed is doubled on held item loss; boost is lost if it switches, gets new item/Ability.

uncheckedassault.name: Unchecked Assault
uncheckedassault.desc: Vital Spirit prevents and cures sleep, blocks Yawn, and gives Fighting attacks 1.3x Attack or Sp. Atk. Opportunist copies opposing positive stat changes after moves, entries, transformations and at turn end. Limber prevents and cures paralysis and has its Speed-drop protection. Existing confusion prevention and cure remain.

undertow.name: Undertow
undertow.desc: Water Absorb, including its field effects. Damaging Water hits ground surviving foes as with Smack Down. Does not trap them or bypass protection, Substitute or Water immunity.

unleashedego.name: Unleashed Ego
unleashedego.desc: Ultra Ego + Levitate + Raging Storm. Airborne unless grounded. Damaging hits from foes raise Attack and Sp. Atk once until it uses an attack; heals 1/16 max HP on that hit and 1/20 on further hits. Dealing attack damage heals 1/16 once per turn. Ashen Beach, New World, Starlight Arena, Cold Eclipse and Fairy Tale add once-per-entry Defense/Sp. Def boosts for physical/special hits and a one-use 1/4-HP pinch heal. Royal Decree or Empress enables 1.3x power (except against Battle Bond) and 0.7x incoming damage unless Neutralization is active. Bewitched Woods, Haunted and Holy fields disable Ultra Ego effects. Raging Storm bypasses abilities, screens, Substitute and defensive stat stages; +1 critical-hit ratio. Attack KOs splash 60% of the recorded hit damage onto remaining foes, or grant +1 Attack if no splash damage is dealt. Incoming priority damage is halved. Immune to hail; cannot be suppressed. Against an opposing effective Ultra Instinct (including composites), its attacks ignore its own negative Attack and Sp. Atk stages. Ultra Instinct instead reduces its first HP-damaging move each turn by 40% and ignores positive Attack or Sp. Atk stages for that protected move. Stored stages are unchanged; normal +1 retaliation is unchanged. The rivalry is disabled on Bewitched Woods, Haunted and Holy.
unleashedego.shortDesc: Ultra Ego boosts/healing; airborne; bypasses defenses; KO splash.

unnerve.name: Unnerve
unnerve.desc: While it is active, it prevents opposing Pokemon from using their Berries. This Ability activates before hazards and other Abilities take effect.
unnerve.shortDesc: While it is active, it prevents opposing Pokemon from using their Berries.

unovavanguard.name: Unova Vanguard
unovavanguard.desc: On its first active turn, its Speed is 1.5x and its Attack is 1.2x. Prevents flinching and Attack drops from Intimidate.

unovawing.name: Unova Wing
unovawing.desc: Critical-hit ratio is raised by one stage. Opposing stat drops raise Special Attack by two stages, except on Chessboard Field.

unsealedcurrent.name: Unsealed Current
unsealedcurrent.desc: Once per battle, surviving a damaging move that takes it from above half HP to half HP or less raises its Sp. Atk by 1.
unsealedcurrent.shortDesc: Once per battle, a hit crossing half HP raises Sp. Atk by 1.

unseenfist.name: Unseen Fist
unseenfist.desc: Contact moves pierce protection at 1/4 damage (75% less); Max Guard blocks them. Unprotected damage is unchanged. Punching moves have 1.4x power.
unseenfist.shortDesc: Contact pierces protection at 1/4 damage; punches have 1.4x power.

unstableevo.name: Unstable Evo
unstableevo.desc: Eevee-Starter's IVs carry through form changes. Before using a Let's Go move, it changes into the matching evolution and uses that form's stats, typing, and Speed. It keeps Unstable Evo, Filter, and Self Sufficient, and gains both of the evolution's listed Ability effects. Switching out restores Eevee-Starter. It cannot use battle gimmicks or hold Eevium Z.
unstableevo.shortDesc: Let's Go moves change form and grant two Ability effects; no gimmicks.

unyielding.name: Unyielding
unyielding.desc: Inner Focus prevents flinching and Intimidate Attack drops. Opponents cannot force it to switch, regardless of its stat stages. Voluntary switching still works.
unyielding.shortDesc: Inner Focus; opponents cannot force it to switch.

updraft.name: Updraft
updraft.desc: Updraft: Competitive: opposing stat drops raise Special Attack by 2 outside Chessboard; on Chessboard, instead boosts damage with missing HP up to 2x at 20% HP. Flying moves ignore evasion boosts. Once per switch-in, the first Flying attack dealing opposing HP damage raises the living adjacent ally with the lowest HP percentage by 1 Speed stage, or the holder if no such ally exists. Only one recipient is boosted; ability restarts and Mega Evolution do not reset the entry allowance.
updraft.shortDesc: Competitive; Flying ignores evasion; one ally Speed boost per entry.

vanguard.name: Vanguard
vanguard.desc: On entry, lowers adjacent foes' Attack by 1. Substitute and Intimidate protections still apply. Extreme Speed has 1.5x power and becomes Fire when its matchup is better, including against Normal immunity. Direct single-target opposing HP damage grants one 50% guard against the next damaging hit from that opponent that turn.

varietyrush.name: Variety Rush
varietyrush.desc: Each non-Normal type gets 1.4x power for its first successful attack against an opponent each genuine entry, across the whole move. Substitute damage counts. Misses, protection and immunity preserve the use; ally damage is not boosted. Ability restarts do not reset spent types.
varietyrush.shortDesc: First successful opposing attack of each non-Normal type per entry has 1.4x power.

vaultkeeper.name: Vault Keeper
vaultkeeper.desc: Compatibility name for local Prankster: status moves gain +1 priority; opposing Dark types block them except on Bewitched Woods. Does not prevent screen removal. Klefki receives Prankster as its species passive; this compatibility name has the same priority effect.

venamskiss.name: Venam's Kiss
venamskiss.desc: Poison attacks treat Steel typing as a weakness, with other typing counted normally, and actual opposing HP damage attempts regular poison even on Steel/Poison types. They drain one-third actual HP damage against any foe, capped at 1/4 base max HP per turn. Foes poisoned before the attack are also heal-blocked through the following turn. Ability drain is not added to draining moves; Heal Block and Liquid Ooze apply. Active poisoned foes have 0.75x Speed; multiple holders do not stack. Full local Shed Skin: at turn end, when statused, affected by a listed ailment, negatively boosted or at half HP or less, has a 50% chance to cure status (including frostbite), clear negative stages, remove Attract, confusion, Curse, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Leech Seed, Nightmare, Perish Song, Taunt, Torment and Yawn, and heal 1/4 max HP. On Dragon's Den, eligible activation is guaranteed; instead it cures status, heals 1/4 max HP, raises its higher staged attacking stat by 1 (Attack on ties), and lowers both defenses by 1 without clearing other ailments or negative stages.
venamskiss.shortDesc: Shed Skin; Poison hits drain HP; pre-poisoned foes cannot heal. Poisoned foes are slower.

vendetta.name: Vendetta
vendetta.desc: Full Inner Focus prevents flinching and Intimidate Attack drops. Once per entry, surviving an opposing damaging hit that removes HP attempts to Taunt its living attacker under normal Taunt protections. The attempt spends the use even if blocked; Substitute-only damage does not trigger it. Switching resets the use; ability changes do not.
vendetta.shortDesc: Inner Focus; once per entry, surviving an opposing hit Taunts its attacker.

venomarmor.name: Venom Armor
venomarmor.desc: Full local Dual Wield: eligible moves hit twice at 60% power with independent accuracy checks; Metal Claw has its two 60%-power hits. While poisoned, opposing Pokemon cannot lower its Attack; self-inflicted drops remain. Rival Resolve remains separate.
venomarmor.shortDesc: Dual Wield; poisoned holder blocks opposing Attack drops.

venombastion.name: Venom Bastion
venombastion.desc: Stamina: each opposing HP hit heals 1/16 max HP; the first each turn also gives +1 Defense. Bug moves receive STAB, without changing typing or stacking with Bug STAB. Once per entry, Poison/Steel HP damage to an already-poisoned surviving foe blocks healing through the next turn. Only a newly applied Heal Block spends the use.
venombastion.shortDesc: Stamina + Bug STAB; once per entry, Poison/Steel hits block a poisoned foe’s healing for 2 turns.

venomcanticle.name: Venom Canticle
venomcanticle.desc: Damaging sound moves have 1.2x power. Damaging Normal-type sound moves become Poison-type. Status moves and targeting are unchanged.
venomcanticle.shortDesc: Sound attacks: 1.2x power; Normal sound attacks become Poison.

venomheal.name: Venom Heal
venomheal.desc: Other Pokemon cannot lower its Attack. Poison damage instead heals 1/8 max HP. Also heals 1/8 each turn on Corrosive Mist and Murkwater Surface, or while grounded on Corrosive and Wasteland. Contact attackers have a 30% poison chance, or 60% on Wasteland. Its Poison-type moves have 1.5x STAB.

venomignition.name: Venom Ignition
venomignition.desc: Fire attacks deal 1.2x damage to poisoned or badly poisoned targets. Checks status separately for each hit; poison is not consumed.
venomignition.shortDesc: Fire attacks deal 1.2x damage against poisoned targets.

venompincer.name: Venom Pincer
