venompincer.desc: Poison Touch: contact attacks have a 30% poison chance, subject to Shield Dust, Covert Cloak and normal poison immunities. The first damaging contact hit dealing opposing HP damage each entry lowers that target's Speed by 1. Switching resets this allowance; ability changes do not. Misses, protection, immunity and Substitute-only damage do not spend it. A knockout spends it without lowering a fainted target's Speed.
venompincer.shortDesc: Poison Touch; first opposing contact HP hit per entry lowers target Speed.

venomspurs.name: Venom Spurs
venomspurs.desc: Corrosion. Damaging Bug moves gain a 30% poison secondary.
venomspurs.shortDesc: Corrosion; Bug attacks have a 30% poison chance.

venomthread.name: Venom Thread
venomthread.desc: While active, poisoned opposing Pokemon have 0.75x Speed; multiple holders do not stack this reduction. Attacks from poisoned opponents deal 20% less damage to this holder. Both regular and bad poison qualify. These are modifiers, not stat drops; curing poison or the holder leaving immediately ends the applicable effect.
venomthread.shortDesc: Poisoned foes have 0.75x Speed and deal 20% less attack damage to it.

venomveil.name: Venom Veil
venomveil.desc: Draining moves, Leech Seed and Strength Sap damage their user by the HP they would restore. This damage doubles on Murkwater Surface and Wasteland. Prevents and cures burns; immune to sandstorm and hail damage. Gains Aqua Ring on entry. Cures status each turn on Water Surface and Underwater. Moves can poison Steel- and Poison-type foes. Poisoning does not lower their defenses.
venomveil.shortDesc: Drain users take damage; can poison Steel/Poison foes; burn/weather protection and Aqua Ring.

verdantdrake.name: Raging Thicket
verdantdrake.desc: Redirects single-target Electric moves and absorbs other Pokemon Electric moves for +1 Attack and Sp. Atk. Electric Terrain entry also grants both boosts. Switching heals 1/3 max HP. Moves bypass Substitute, Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil, Safeguard and Mist.

verdantedge.name: Verdant Edge
verdantedge.desc: Full local Sharpness and Grass Pelt, including their field effects.

verdanthospitality.name: Verdant Hospitality
verdanthospitality.desc: Same-type moves have 1.3x power. Allies take 25% less attack damage. On entry, heals active allies by 1/8 max HP. At turn end, heals itself by 1/16 max HP and active allies by 1/16.
verdanthospitality.shortDesc: 1.3x same-type power; allies take 25% less damage; entry and end-turn healing.

verdantsanctuary.name: Verdant Sanctuary
verdantsanctuary.desc: On entry, sets Grassy Terrain and Hospitality heals each adjacent ally by 1/4 max HP. Friend Guard reduces damage to allies to 3/4.
verdantsanctuary.shortDesc: Grassy Terrain on entry; Hospitality and Friend Guard.

vesselofruin.name: Vessel of Ruin
vesselofruin.desc: Active Pokemon without this Ability have their Special Attack multiplied by 0.75.
vesselofruin.shortDesc: Active Pokemon without this Ability have their Special Attack multiplied by 0.75.

victorystar.name: Victory Star
victorystar.desc: It and its allies' moves have their accuracy multiplied by 1.1.
victorystar.shortDesc: It and its allies' moves have their accuracy multiplied by 1.1.

violentrush.name: Violent Rush
violentrush.desc: On its first active turn, its Speed is 1.5x and its Attack is 1.2x.
violentrush.shortDesc: First active turn: 1.5x Spe and 1.2x Atk.

vitalcircuit.name: Vital Circuit
vitalcircuit.desc: Electric attacks without an existing drain effect restore 25% of damage dealt to foes, capped at 1/8 max HP per turn, including Big Root. Respects Liquid Ooze and Heal Block. Does not add to or cap a move's drain effect.
vitalcircuit.shortDesc: Electric attacks drain 25% of damage, capped at 1/8 HP per turn.

vitalsigns.name: Vital Signs
vitalsigns.desc: Includes Invigorate: healing received by the holder and its allies is multiplied by 1.3, each adjacent ally has a 50% chance to have its major status cured at turn end, and Safeguard lasts 5 turns. After an opposing damaging move finishes, each active teammate, including the holder, that lost HP to that move, survived, and is at half HP or less is healed by 1/4 max HP and cured of major status. Invigorate normally increases this healing to 32.5%. Each recipient can receive this emergency treatment only once per battle, even after switching, changing abilities or being revived. Healing obeys normal restrictions; the allowance is spent only if healing or curing succeeds. Allied, residual and Substitute-only damage do not trigger it.
vitalsigns.shortDesc: Heals and cures each teammate once when an attack leaves it at half HP or less.

vitalspirit.name: Vital Spirit
vitalspirit.desc: Prevents and cures sleep and blocks Yawn. Fighting attacks use 1.3x Attack or Sp. Atk.

voidcommand.name: Void Command
voidcommand.desc: Insomnia + Super Luck. Takes 20% less attack damage from other Pokemon. Each move KO raises its higher attacking stat by 1, choosing Attack on a tie. Once per battle, successfully executing any Z-Move also grants this boost after the move, including status Z-Moves. A Z-Move KO receives the ordinary per-KO boost without an additional Z-use boost. Damaging Z-Moves that deal reduced damage through Protect count; misses, immunity and failed base moves do not. A status Z bonus alone does not count when its base move fails.
voidcommand.shortDesc: 20% less damage; KOs boost higher offense; first Z-Move also boosts, without a double KO reward.

voidcraft.name: Void Craft
voidcraft.desc: Airborne. Takes 20% less attack damage at any HP, or 40% less from super-effective attacks. These reductions cannot be bypassed by ability-ignoring moves; its other protections can. Cannot sleep or be affected by Yawn, and foes cannot lower its stats. Dark and Ghost attacks have 1.3x power. Move KOs raise its highest stat by 1. Starting on Mega Evolution, queues a 120 BP Ghost Future Sight every other turn; each strikes two turns later. Immune to hail damage on Cold Eclipse. Ability suppression disables these effects.
voidcraft.shortDesc: 20% less attack damage (40% if super effective); no sleep/stat drops; recurring Ghost Future Sight.

voidcrossing.name: Void Crossing
voidcrossing.desc: Magic Guard + Infiltrator. After a damaging Ghost move or Power Gem hits an opponent, curses it through the end of the following turn. Its next damaging move deals 20% less damage across all hits and targets, then consumes the curse. Status moves do not consume it. Reapplying refreshes the duration without stacking; switching removes it.
voidcrossing.shortDesc: Ghost hits or Power Gem curse foes: their next attack deals 20% less damage.

voiddrift.name: Void Drift
voiddrift.desc: Overcoat. Restores 1/16 of its base max HP each turn during sand. While airborne on effective New World, its special Ground moves ignore its negative Sp. Atk stages for damage calculation. Positive stages and other modifiers remain; its actual stages are unchanged.
voiddrift.shortDesc: On New World, its special Ground moves ignore lowered Sp. Atk while airborne.

voidguile.name: Void Guile
voidguile.desc: Magician + Infiltrator, including all local field effects, entry boosts and normal item-theft rules. Its moves bypass opposing screens, Substitute and Safeguard as usual for Infiltrator.

voidhex.name: Void Hex
voidhex.desc: Prankster + Cursed Body. Any directly executed damaging move that deals opposing HP damage traps each surviving target through the following turn. Called and spread attacks qualify. Repeated hits refresh the same-source trap to two turns without stacking duration; another source cannot steal a live trap. The trap deals no damage and ends when its source leaves or faints. Ghost types, Shed Shell and normal pivot escapes remain valid. Substitute, immunity, protection, delayed attacks and residual damage do not trigger it.
voidhex.shortDesc: Direct damaging hits trap surviving foes through the next turn; further hits refresh the trap.

voidomen.name: Void Omen
voidomen.desc: Friend Guard reduces attack damage to other allies by 25%. While active, increases move secondary-effect chances for its holder and actual allies, capped at 60% while preserving higher native chances and guaranteed effects. Grants one required charge-turn skip per receiving Pokemon per stay, sharing the same allowance as Lunar Orbit. Only that recipient switching resets it; provider switches, ability changes, Transform and multiple providers do not refill it. Field skips, Power Herb and independent Serene Grace do not consume it. Suppression disables the grant. Once per entry, the first successful damaging-move secondary or successful self-targeted status move sets or refreshes Safeguard to at least 3 turns. Separately, after activation, the first successfully applied secondary effect creates a ward against the next opposing stat-drop event targeting the holder or an adjacent active ally. Positive changes and self-inflicted drops remain. The ward ends when spent or the holder leaves.
voidomen.shortDesc: Friend Guard; shared secondary boosts, limited charge skip, Safeguard and ward.

voidpromise.name: Void Promise
voidpromise.desc: Unaware. Its Wish clears the eventual recipient’s negative stat stages when it resolves, even after the user switches out. Successful Moonlight healing also clears the holder’s negative stages. Positive stages are preserved; Moonlight that restores no HP grants no cleanup.
voidpromise.shortDesc: Wish clears its recipient’s negative stages; actual Moonlight healing clears its own.

voidreprisal.name: Void Reprisal
voidreprisal.desc: Guts. Surviving opposing HP damage or actual burn residual HP damage stores one punch charge. Its next damaging punch ignores positive stages of the defense used for that hit, without changing category or defensive-stat choice. Successful punch damage spends the charge; misses and blocked attacks preserve it. Charges do not stack and switching clears them. Applying burn without HP damage does not charge it.
voidreprisal.shortDesc: Surviving foe hits or burn damage charges a punch to ignore positive defensive stages.

voidsanctum.name: Void Sanctum
voidsanctum.desc: Snow Warning. While its side has Aurora Veil, blocks opposing stat drops for itself and active allies; self-inflicted drops remain. Once per battle, its first switch-out with an active Aurora Veil extends that Veil by one turn. Normal switching and Eject Button qualify; fainting does not. Adds no entry cleanse or extra damage reduction.
voidsanctum.shortDesc: Veil blocks foe stat drops; first exit under Veil extends it 1 turn, once per battle.

voidtyrant.name: Void Tyrant
voidtyrant.desc: Eligible single-target attacks hit three times. In singles and doubles, native variable multi-hit moves use their maximum hit count, keeping native per-hit accuracy and damage. Remaining native hits can continue into another living opposing active Pokemon after a KO at 70% damage. Excludes non-FFA spread, charge, delayed, Z/Max and extra-hit-barred moves. Follow-ups deal 30% damage, retargeting another living opposing active Pokemon after a KO. In FFA, single-target moves hit all foes at 1.3x power; spread moves hit all foes three times with 30% follow-ups. Full-power spread stays full power. Moves have 1.2x power on Dragon's Den. When an attack takes it from above half HP to half or less, gains +1 Attack and Sp. Atk after the move. Dragon's Den entry gives +2 Attack and Sp. Atk. Once per battle, after Draco Meteor applies its Sp. Atk drops, restores all negative stat stages to zero after the entire attack finishes. Positive stages remain.
voidtyrant.shortDesc: Once per battle, Draco Meteor clears its negative stages before White Herb is needed.

voidveil.name: Void Veil
voidveil.desc: Levitate and Telepathy. Ordinary Gardevoir ignores Gravity grounding and airborne-move restrictions and receives beneficial terrain and aura eligibility while airborne: power bonuses, status and priority protection, and Grassy recovery. It remains airborne for Ground immunity and entry hazards. Other grounding effects and ability suppression remain effective. Misty Fairy Special Defense and move bonuses follow the existing field rules.
voidveil.shortDesc: Levitate + Telepathy; Gravity immunity; airborne terrain and aura benefits.

voidvoice.name: Void Voice
voidvoice.desc: Eligible Normal moves become Fairy and have 1.2x power, or 1.5x on Misty Terrain. Excludes moves whose type is set by their own effect, damaging Z-Moves and Terastallized Tera Blast. Blocks opposing priority moves aimed at it or its allies. Attacks deal 1.5x damage on Fairy Tale, or on Chessboard unless it has the Queen role. Has Telepathy, including avoiding allied damaging moves and doubled Speed in Psychic Terrain or Psychic Aura. At turn end, it and its active allies each heal 1/16 max HP. Once per switch-in, if an opposing move would knock out an ally, that ally survives at 1 HP and it loses 1/4 max HP, provided it has more HP than the cost.
voidvoice.shortDesc: Normal moves become Fairy; blocks foe priority; heals allies and can save one.

voidwrath.name: Void Wrath
voidwrath.desc: Moves ignore bypassable opposing abilities and bypass Substitute, Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil, Safeguard and Mist. Outrage does not cause a rampage lock or its ending confusion. Other move restrictions, including Choice locks, still apply.
voidwrath.shortDesc: Mold Breaker + Infiltrator; Outrage has no rampage lock or confusion.

voltabsorb.name: Volt Absorb
voltabsorb.desc: Absorbs other Pokemon's Electric moves, healing 1/4 max HP instead of being hit. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn on Electric Terrain and Short-Circuit.
voltabsorb.shortDesc: Absorbs Electric for 1/4 HP; electric-field healing.

wailingsnow.name: Wailing Snow
wailingsnow.desc: Once per switch-in, damaging a foe with an Ice attack primes the next damaging Ghost move for +1 priority. Using the Ghost attack spends the effect even if blocked or missed.
wailingsnow.shortDesc: An Ice hit charges the next Ghost attack for +1 priority.

wanderingspirit.name: Wandering Spirit
wanderingspirit.desc: Pokemon making contact with it have their Ability swapped with this one. Does not affect Pokemon with the Abilities As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.
wanderingspirit.shortDesc: Pokemon making contact with it have their Ability swapped with this one.

warship.name: War Ship
warship.desc: Doubles Speed in rain or on Water Surface, Murkwater Surface, Underwater and Midnight Zone. Takes 20% less attack damage, or 40% less from super-effective attacks. Biting moves have 1.5x power.
warship.shortDesc: Double Speed in rain and water fields; 40% less if super effective; Bites have 1.5x power.

wastingsurge.name: Wasting Surge
wastingsurge.desc: On entry, it sets Wasteland Terrain. On Water Surface or Underwater, it creates Murkwater Surface instead; from Underwater, non-Poison and non-Steel Pokemon that are not semi-invulnerable faint. If Neutralization is active on Water Surface or Underwater, this effect fails. Its Poison-type damaging moves restore 1/4 of the damage dealt. Ground-type moves deal 1/2 damage to it.
wastingsurge.shortDesc: Sets Wasteland or Murkwater; Poison moves drain 1/4 damage; half Ground damage.

waterabsorb.name: Water Absorb
waterabsorb.desc: Absorbs other Pokemon's Water moves, healing 1/4 max HP instead of being hit. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn on Underwater, grounded on Water Surface, or grounded and Poison-type on Murkwater Surface.
waterabsorb.shortDesc: Absorbs Water for 1/4 HP; water-field healing.

waterbarrage.name: Water Barrage
waterbarrage.desc: Stalwart bypasses redirection and grants +1 Sp. Atk on New World, Starlight Arena, Fairy Tale or Chessboard entry. Eligible slicing, pulse, bullet, horn, drill, and Arrow moves hit twice at 60% power, with an independent accuracy check for each hit. A literal Mega Launcher + Water Barrage combination instead boosts both eligible pulse/bullet hits by 1.5x: 0.9x each in every battle format. In Free-for-All, both hits still use 60% power: the first hits the selected foe and the second targets another random living foe when possible. Existing multi-hit moves are not given an additional Dual Wield pair. At turn end, foes take cycling Water damage of 1/16, 2/16, then 3/16 max HP. Water immunities block it; type effectiveness scales it only in Free-for-All.
waterbarrage.shortDesc: Dual Wield + Stalwart; cycling Water chip.

waterbubble.name: Water Bubble
waterbubble.desc: Its offensive stat is doubled while using Water attacks. Fire attacks against it use half the attacker's offensive stat. It also has Water Veil's effects.
waterbubble.shortDesc: Doubles Water attacking stats; halves incoming Fire attacking stats.

watercompaction.name: Water Compaction
watercompaction.desc: Damage from Water-type attacks is halved. After it is damaged by a Water-type move, its Defense rises by 2 stages.
watercompaction.shortDesc: Halves Water damage; taking Water damage raises Defense by 2.

waterveil.name: Water Veil
waterveil.desc: Prevents and cures burns; immune to sandstorm and hail damage. Gains Aqua Ring on entry. Cures status each turn on Water Surface and Underwater.
waterveil.shortDesc: No burn or weather damage; Aqua Ring; water-field status cure.

weakarmor.name: Weak Armor
weakarmor.desc: If a physical attack hits it, its Defense is lowered by 1 stage and its Speed is raised by 2 stages.
weakarmor.shortDesc: If a physical attack hits it, Defense is lowered by 1, Speed is raised by 2.

webassassin.name: Web Assassin
webassassin.desc: Doubles Speed. Attacks have maximum critical-hit ratio against poisoned foes or foes with lowered Speed. Critical-hit damage uses the normal multiplier.
webassassin.shortDesc: Double Speed; maximum critical-hit ratio against poisoned or slowed foes.

wellbakedbody.name: Well-Baked Body
wellbakedbody.desc: Absorbs Fire moves for +2 Defense. Gains +1 Defense each turn on Burning, Superheated, Dragon's Den and Volcanic.
wellbakedbody.shortDesc: Absorbs Fire for +2 Defense; hot fields raise Defense.

whiplash.name: Whiplash
whiplash.desc: On entry, it gains +1 accuracy. Its Tail moves have their power multiplied by 1.5.
whiplash.shortDesc: On entry: +1 accuracy. Tail moves have 1.5x power.

whitesmoke.name: White Smoke
whitesmoke.desc: Prevents opposing stat drops. Gains +1 Attack and Sp. Atk on Volcanic entry.
whitesmoke.shortDesc: Blocks other Pokemon's stat drops; Volcanic entry boosts attacks.

wickedsnare.name: Wicked Snare
wickedsnare.desc: Intimidate lowers adjacent foes' Attack by one stage on entry, respecting its normal protections. After a damaging Dark move finishes all hits, each opponent that took positive HP damage loses one Defense stage, once per target per move. Substitute-only damage, misses, protection and immunity do not trigger this effect. Native effects remain independent: Crunch can also cause its own Defense drop.
wickedsnare.shortDesc: Intimidate; damaging Dark moves lower each damaged foe's Defense after all hits.

wickedweave.name: Wicked Weave
wickedweave.desc: Status moves gain +1 priority. Opposing Dark types block these moves except on Bewitched Woods. A successful status move readies the next contact attack to lower a foe's Speed by 1 after actual HP damage. The charge does not stack, is consumed by a qualifying hit, and expires at the end of the following turn.
wickedweave.shortDesc: Successful status moves ready a contact-hit Speed drop through the next turn.

wildspirit.name: Wild Spirit
wildspirit.desc: On entry, its accuracy rises by 1 stage. During its first turn out, its attacks are guaranteed to critical hit. It takes 30% less damage from attacks.
wildspirit.shortDesc: +1 accuracy on entry; first-turn critical hits; takes 30% less attack damage.

wimpout.name: Wimp Out
wimpout.desc: When it has more than 1/2 its max HP and takes damage bringing it to 1/2 or less of its max HP, it immediately switches out to a chosen ally. This effect applies after all hits from a multi-hit move. This effect is prevented if the move had a secondary effect removed by the Sheer Force Ability. This effect applies to both direct and indirect damage, except Curse and Substitute on use, Belly Drum, Pain Split, and confusion damage.
wimpout.shortDesc: It switches out when it reaches 1/2 or less of its max HP.

windchime.name: Wind Chime
windchime.desc: Eligible Normal moves become Steel with 1.2x power, or 1.5x on Factory, Short-Circuit, Fairy Tale, Dragon's Den, Starlight Arena, New World and Holy Field. Sound moves have 1.3x power, or 1.5x on Big Top and Cave. Takes half damage from sound moves. Airborne: immune to Ground attacks, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web and Arena Trap unless grounded. Thousand Arrows can still hit.
windchime.shortDesc: Normal moves become Steel; boosted sound moves; half sound damage.

windpower.name: Wind Power
windpower.desc: Absorbs wind moves for +1 Sp. Atk. Gains +1 Sp. Atk when Tailwind starts on its side or it enters during Tailwind. Strong Winds gives +1 Attack and Sp. Atk each turn. Successfully establishing Tailwind itself also clears its own confusion and negative accuracy stages, preserving positive accuracy.
windpower.shortDesc: Wind, Tailwind and Strong Winds grant +1 SpA; its Tailwind clears confusion and accuracy drops.

windrider.name: Wind Rider
windrider.desc: Absorbs wind moves for +1 Attack. Gains +1 Attack when Tailwind starts on its side or it enters during Tailwind. Strong Winds gives +1 Attack and Sp. Atk each turn.
windrider.shortDesc: Absorbs wind; Tailwind/Strong Winds raise Attack.

windysurge.name: Windy Surge
windysurge.desc: On entry, it sets Tailwind on its side for 2 turns.
windysurge.shortDesc: On entry, sets 2-turn Tailwind on its side.

wingedwraith.name: Winged Wraith
wingedwraith.desc: Moves bypass Substitute, Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil, Safeguard and Mist. Flying moves gain +1 priority at 75% HP or more. During unsuppressed Strong Winds, all moves gain +1 priority at any HP.
wingedwraith.shortDesc: Infiltrator; Flying moves gain +1 priority at full HP.

winterherald.name: Winter Herald
winterherald.desc: Full local Snow Warning. While hail or snow is effective, opponents cannot lower its or its active allies' Speed.
winterherald.shortDesc: Snow Warning. In hail/snow, foes cannot lower allied Speed.

winterpressure.name: Winter Pressure
winterpressure.desc: Full local Ice Body and Pressure, including their field effects. Pressure has its once-per-opponent entry memory.

winterrefuge.name: Winter Refuge
winterrefuge.desc: Full local Friend Guard and Ice Scales, including their field effects.

wintersmalice.name: Winter's Malice
wintersmalice.desc: Refrigerate, Berserk and Cursed Body. Eligible Normal moves become Ice and gain Refrigerate’s power boost. Direct attack damage crossing half HP raises Attack and Sp. Atk; Berserk also grants its Dragon’s Den entry boosts. Cursed Body can disable damaging moves, has its field exceptions, and curses foes when the holder faints. Components do not duplicate an existing species passive.

wisecounsel.name: Wise Counsel
wisecounsel.desc: Inner Focus prevents flinching and Intimidate Attack drops. Once per entry, successfully using Instruct on an active ally cures its confusion before the ordinary repeated action; failed Instruct or non-ally targets do not spend the use. Guardian Presence gives allies 1.3x move power, or 1.5x on Haunted, Bewitched Woods, Holy and Psychic fields, and reduces their attack damage by 25%. Neither support effect applies to the holder. Telepathy remains separate.
wisecounsel.shortDesc: Inner Focus + Guardian Presence; first successful allied Instruct cures confusion.

wishkeeper.name: Wishkeeper
wishkeeper.desc: Magic Bounce and Triage. When its Wish resolves, it cures the receiver's major status even at full HP.
wishkeeper.shortDesc: Magic Bounce + Triage. Its Wish also cures the receiver's status.

witheringshell.name: Withering Shell
witheringshell.desc: Physical HP hits set opposing Stealth Rock except on water fields. Heals 1/16 max HP in effective rain. Sticky Hold prevents other Pokemon from removing its item under the normal local rules.
witheringshell.shortDesc: Crumbling Shell + Rain Dish + Sticky Hold.

witheringtouch.name: Withering Touch
witheringtouch.desc: Contact hits have a 30% poison chance, blocked by Shield Dust and Covert Cloak. Can poison Poison and Steel types; Poison attacks bypass Steel immunity. Newly poisoned foes lose 1 Defense and Sp. Def. Wasteland has four separate 2.5% frostbite, burn, paralysis and poison secondary chances; incoming damage is 1.5x on Corrosive and Corrosive Mist. No additional Attack drop against already-poisoned foes.

wonderguard.name: Wonder Guard
wonderguard.desc: It can only be damaged by supereffective moves and indirect damage.
wonderguard.shortDesc: It can only be damaged by supereffective moves and indirect damage.

wonderskin.name: Wonder Skin
wonderskin.desc: Opposing status moves that check accuracy have 50% base accuracy. On Rainbow Field, opposing status moves fail their accuracy check.
wonderskin.shortDesc: Status moves have 50% base accuracy; fail on Rainbow.

woolyconductor.name: Wooly Conductor
woolyconductor.desc: Takes half damage from contact attacks and double damage from Fire attacks; contact Fire attacks deal normal damage. Moves ignore bypassable opposing abilities. Once per turn after an opposing contact attack deals HP damage, lowers its attacker's Speed by 1.
woolyconductor.shortDesc: Half contact damage, double Fire damage; ignores abilities; contact paralysis chance.

worldbinder.name: Worldbinder
worldbinder.desc: Mold Breaker. After the whole damaging move, clears positive stat stages of opposing targets whose HP it damaged. Negative stages remain. Misses, protection, immunity and Substitute-only hits do not qualify.
worldbinder.shortDesc: Mold Breaker; damaging HP hits clear positive target stages after the attack.

worldbreaker.name: Worldbreaker
worldbreaker.desc: Full local Berserk and Duskilate. Surviving a move crossing half HP grants +1 Attack and Sp. Atk; Dragon Den entry grants +2 to both. Each damaging hit independently has a 30% chance to double base power, except Fickle Beam uses only its own all-out roll.
worldbreaker.shortDesc: Berserk + Duskilate; 30% double power per hit, except Fickle Beam.

worldforged.name: Worldforged
worldforged.desc: Its Dragon, Electric, Ice, Rock and Steel attacks have 1.3x power.
worldforged.shortDesc: Dragon, Electric, Ice, Rock and Steel attacks have 1.3x power.

wraithprocession.name: Wraith Procession
wraithprocession.desc: Eligible single-target Fire- and Ghost-type attacks strike the same target twice, with the second strike dealing 50% of its normal damage. Each strike can apply target secondary effects. Infernal Parade checks status for each strike, so a first-strike burn powers up the second. Uses one PP and the ordinary move accuracy check. The follow-up never transfers to another Pokemon. Spread, existing multi-hit, charging, delayed, OHKO, Z, Max and other moves excluded from bond follow-ups do not gain a strike. Does not bypass abilities or type immunities. Suppression prevents the additional strike.
wraithprocession.shortDesc: Single-target Fire/Ghost attacks hit twice; second strike deals 50% damage.

wrathshield.name: Wrath Shield
wrathshield.desc: Immune to bullet, pulse and Mega Launcher-boosted moves; takes 20% less attack damage. Stamina heals 1/16 maximum HP after each opposing damaging hit and raises Defense once per turn on the first such hit. Friend Guard reduces allies attack damage by 25%, not the holder. Entry grants +1 Sp. Def on Cold Eclipse, New World, Starlight Arena or Fairy Tale. Proficient remains separate.
wrathshield.shortDesc: Bulletproof + Stamina + Friend Guard; 20% less attack damage.

wreckingball.name: Wrecking Ball
wreckingball.desc: Prevents OHKO moves. At full HP, survives an otherwise fatal attack hit with 1 HP. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn. Immune to sandstorm and hail damage. When it is hit by a Physical attack, Stealth Rock is set on the attacker's side unless a water field is active or that side already has Stealth Rock.

wreckingcrew.name: Wrecking Crew
wreckingcrew.desc: Iron Fist gives punching moves 1.4x power. Damaging punches remove opposing Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil, Arenite Wall and Atlantis Wall before damage, under normal screen-breaking rules. Does not bypass protection, immunity or Substitute and grants no extra attacks.
wreckingcrew.shortDesc: Damaging punches break opposing screens and custom walls before damage.

yearningstar.name: Yearning Star
yearningstar.desc: Skips charge turns. Wish, Future Sight and Doom Desire resolve during their use, without leaving a delayed effect. Charge boosts, move costs and recharge turns remain.
yearningstar.shortDesc: Charge moves, Wish, Future Sight and Doom Desire resolve immediately.

zen.name: Zen
zen.desc: Absorbs other Pokemon's Water moves, healing 1/4 max HP instead of being hit. Heals 1/16 max HP each turn on Underwater, grounded on Water Surface, or grounded and Poison-type on Murkwater Surface. Ignores target Defense/Sp. Def/evasion stages when attacking, and attacker Attack/Defense/Sp. Atk/accuracy stages when defending. Reveals opposing Illusions on entry. Prevents Explosion, Self-Destruct, Mind Blown, Misty Explosion and Aftermath damage. Incoming Fire attacks use half the attacker's offensive stat. On Corrosive Mist, also prevents Eruption, Fire Pledge, Flame Burst, Heat Wave, Incinerate, Lava Plume, Searing Shot and Inferno Overdrive.
zen.shortDesc: Water-field healing; reveals Illusions; halves incoming Fire attacking stats.

zenmode.name: Zen Mode
zenmode.desc: If it is a Darmanitan or Galarian Darmanitan, it changes to Zen Mode if it has 1/2 or less of its max HP at the end of a turn. Standard Darmanitan is also Zen Mode in Ashen Beach or Psychic Terrain. Galarian Darmanitan is also Zen Mode in Icy Terrain, Snowy Mountain, or Cold Eclipse. If Darmanitan's HP is above 1/2 of its max HP and the matching field is not active, it changes back to Standard Mode.
zenmode.shortDesc: Darmanitan goes Zen at <=1/2 HP; fields force matching Zen formes.

zerotohero.name: Zero to Hero
zerotohero.desc: Gains Fighting-type STAB. Palafin changes to Hero Form after switching out or entering Water fields. In Doubles, Multi or Free-for-All, survives one KO at 1 HP. Hero Form has no additional healing or ally damage reduction.
zerotohero.shortDesc: Palafin becomes Hero; Fighting STAB; survives one KO in multiplayer battles.

zprotean.name: Z Protean
zprotean.desc: Before each attack other than Struggle, it changes to the move's type and gains STAB. If it is Eevee-Starter, its battle sprite shifts to the matching Eeveelution until it leaves battle.
zprotean.shortDesc: Before each attack, changes type and battle sprite to match its move.

10000000voltthunderbolt.name: 10,000,000 Volt Thunderbolt
10000000voltthunderbolt.desc: Has a very high chance for a critical hit.

absorb.name: Absorb
absorb.desc: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.
absorb.shortDesc: User recovers 50% of the damage dealt.

acid.name: Acid
acid.desc: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.
acid.shortDesc: 10% chance to lower the foe(s) Sp. Def by 1.

acidarmor.name: Acid Armor
acidarmor.desc: Raises the user's Defense by 2 stages.

aciddownpour.name: Acid Downpour
aciddownpour.desc: A one-use Poison-type Z-Move. Its power depends on the damaging Poison-type move selected as its base.
aciddownpour.shortDesc: Power depends on the base Poison-type move.

acidspray.name: Acid Spray
acidspray.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 2 stages.
acidspray.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 2.

acrobatics.name: Acrobatics
acrobatics.desc: Power doubles if the user has no held item.
acrobatics.shortDesc: Power doubles if the user has no held item.

acupressure.name: Acupressure
acupressure.desc: Raises a random stat by 2 stages as long as the stat is not already at stage 6. The user can choose to use this move on itself or an adjacent ally. Fails if no stat stage can be raised or if used on an ally with a substitute.
acupressure.shortDesc: Raises a random stat of the user or an ally by 2.

aerialace.name: Aerial Ace
aerialace.desc: This move does not check accuracy.
aerialace.shortDesc: This move does not check accuracy.

aeroblast.name: Aeroblast
aeroblast.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

afteryou.name: After You
afteryou.desc: The target makes its move immediately after the user this turn, no matter the priority of its selected move. Fails if the target would have moved next anyway, or if the target already moved this turn.
afteryou.shortDesc: The target makes its move right after the user.

agility.name: Agility
agility.desc: Raises the user's Speed by 2 stages.

aircutter.name: Air Cutter
aircutter.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.
aircutter.shortDesc: High critical hit ratio. Hits adjacent foes.

airslash.name: Air Slash
airslash.desc: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.
airslash.shortDesc: 30% chance to make the target flinch.

airstreamassault.name: Airstream Assault
airstreamassault.desc: Heather's move. Uses higher staged Attack or Sp. Atk with matching defense (Special on ties). After a hit, clears own-side entry hazards. Bypasses accuracy checks in Strong Winds. Clears fields that existing blowing moves clear. After successful HP or Substitute damage while the user survives, removes the active Aura once per whole move, preserving the underlying field. With no Aura, retains its normal field eligibility and transformations. Misses, protection and immunity do not clear it. Does not prevent later Auras.
airstreamassault.shortDesc: Heather's move. Adaptive; clears own hazards.

alloutpummeling.name: All-Out Pummeling
alloutpummeling.desc: A one-use Fighting-type Z-Move. Its power depends on the damaging Fighting-type move selected as its base.
alloutpummeling.shortDesc: Power depends on the base Fighting-type move.

alluringvoice.name: Alluring Voice
alluringvoice.desc: Has a 100% chance to confuse the target if it had a stat stage raised this turn.
alluringvoice.shortDesc: 100% confuse target that had a stat rise this turn.

allyswitch.name: Ally Switch
allyswitch.desc: The user swaps positions with its ally. Fails if the user is the only Pokemon on its side. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails or if the user's last move used is not Ally Switch.
allyswitch.shortDesc: User and ally swap positions; using again can fail.

amnesia.name: Amnesia
amnesia.desc: Raises the user's Special Defense by 2 stages.
amnesia.shortDesc: Raises the user's Sp. Def by 2.

anchorshot.name: Anchor Shot
anchorshot.desc: Prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field.
anchorshot.shortDesc: Prevents the target from switching out.

ancientpower.name: Ancient Power
ancientpower.desc: Has a 10% chance to raise the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage.
ancientpower.shortDesc: 10% chance to raise all stats by 1 (not acc/eva).

appleacid.name: Apple Acid
appleacid.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.
appleacid.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.

aquabatics.name: Aquabatics
aquabatics.desc: Valarie's move. Raises Sp. Atk and Speed by 1 stage. Big Top raises both stats by 2 stages instead. This is a dance move and can be copied by Dancer.
aquabatics.shortDesc: Valarie's move. +1 Sp. Atk and Speed; +2 on Big Top.

aquacutter.name: Aqua Cutter
aquacutter.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

aquaring.name: Aqua Ring
aquaring.desc: The user has 1/16 of its maximum HP, rounded down, restored at the end of each turn while it remains active. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down. If the user uses Baton Pass, the replacement will receive the healing effect.
aquaring.shortDesc: User recovers 1/16 max HP per turn.

aquastep.name: Aqua Step
aquastep.desc: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage.
aquastep.shortDesc: 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1.

arenitewall.name: Arenite Wall
arenitewall.desc: For 5 turns, the user's side takes half damage from super-effective attacks. This move can only be used during Sandstorm or on Desert Field, Rocky Field, Ashen Beach, or Cold Eclipse. If the user is holding Light Clay, or if used on Desert Field, Rocky Field, or Ashen Beach, the duration is 8 turns. Critical hits and moves that bypass screens ignore this effect.
arenitewall.shortDesc: 5 turns (8 when extended): side takes 0.5x from super-effective hits.

armorcannon.name: Armor Cannon
armorcannon.desc: Lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.
armorcannon.shortDesc: Lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def by 1.

armthrust.name: Arm Thrust
armthrust.desc: Hits two to five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 5-6 times.

aromatherapy.name: Aromatherapy
aromatherapy.desc: The user heals 1/8 max HP, or 1/4 total if its own status is cured, starts Safeguard on its side, and cures non-volatile status from its party. Active Pokemon with Sap Sipper are not cured unless they are the user.
aromatherapy.shortDesc: Heals user 1/8, or 1/4 if cured; Safeguard + party cure.

aromaticmist.name: Aromatic Mist
aromaticmist.desc: Raises the target's Special Defense by 1 stage. Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user.
aromaticmist.shortDesc: Raises an ally's Sp. Def by 1.

assist.name: Assist
assist.desc: A random move among those known by the user's party members is selected for use. Does not select Assist, Baneful Bunker, Beak Blast, Belch, Bestow, Blazing Torque, Bounce, Celebrate, Chatter, Circle Throw, Combat Torque, Copycat, Counter, Covet, Destiny Bond, Detect, Dig, Dive, Dragon Tail, Endure, Feint, Fly, Focus Punch, Follow Me, Helping Hand, Hold Hands, King's Shield, Magical Torque, Mat Block, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Coat, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Phantom Force, Protect, Rage Powder, Roar, Shadow Force, Shell Trap, Sketch, Sky Drop, Sleep Talk, Snatch, Spiky Shield, Spotlight, Struggle, Switcheroo, Tera Starstorm, Thief, Transform, Trick, Whirlwind, or Wicked Torque.
assist.shortDesc: Uses a random move known by a team member.

assurance.name: Assurance
assurance.desc: Power doubles if the target has already taken damage this turn, other than direct damage from Belly Drum, confusion, Curse, or Pain Split.
assurance.shortDesc: Power doubles if target was damaged this turn.

astonish.name: Astonish
astonish.desc: Has a 100% chance to make the target flinch. Fails unless it is the user's first turn on the field.
astonish.shortDesc: Ghost-type Fake Out. First turn out only; 100% flinch.

astralbarrage.name: Astral Barrage
astralbarrage.shortDesc: No additional effect. Hits adjacent foes.

atlantiswall.name: Atlantis Wall
atlantiswall.desc: Protects the user's side for 5 turns, halving damage from super-effective attacks, whether physical or special. Critical hits and attacks that bypass screens ignore the wall; screen-breaking moves remove it. Can be used only during effective rain or on Water Surface, Underwater, Misty Terrain, Murkwater Surface, or Midnight Zone; fails if Atlantis Wall is already active. Lasts 8 turns with Light Clay, during effective rain, or on Water Surface, Underwater, or Midnight Zone. Has +1 priority on any of the listed terrains. Air Lock and Cloud Nine suppress rain as a use condition.
atlantiswall.shortDesc: 5 turns (8 with Light Clay, rain, Water Surface, Underwater, or Midnight Zone); halves super-effective damage.

attackorder.name: Attack Order
attackorder.desc: Chooses Physical or Special according to which deals greater calculated damage to the actual target, using both offense and matching defense; Special on ties. Retains its high critical-hit ratio and 50% chance to raise the user's Attack by 1.
attackorder.shortDesc: Best damage category; high crit; 50% +1 Attack.

attract.name: Attract
attract.desc: Causes the target to become infatuated, making it unable to attack 50% of the time. Fails if both the user and the target are the same gender, if either is genderless, or if the target is already infatuated. The effect ends when either the user or the target is no longer active. Pokemon with the Oblivious Ability or protected by the Aroma Veil Ability are immune.
attract.shortDesc: A target of the opposite gender gets infatuated.

aurasphere.name: Aura Sphere
aurasphere.desc: This move does not check accuracy.
aurasphere.shortDesc: This move does not check accuracy.

aurawheel.name: Aura Wheel
aurawheel.desc: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage. If the user is a Morpeko in Full Belly Mode, this move is Electric type. If the user is a Morpeko in Hangry Mode, this move is Dark type. This move cannot be used successfully unless the user's current form, while considering Transform, is Full Belly or Hangry Mode Morpeko.

aurorabeam.name: Aurora Beam
aurorabeam.desc: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.
aurorabeam.shortDesc: 10% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1.

auroraveil.name: Aurora Veil
auroraveil.desc: For 5 turns, the user and its party members take 0.5x damage from physical and special attacks, or 0.66x damage if in a Double Battle; does not reduce damage further with Reflect or Light Screen. Critical hits ignore this protection. It is removed from the user's side if the user or an ally is successfully hit by Brick Break, Psychic Fangs, or Defog. Brick Break and Psychic Fangs remove the effect before damage is calculated. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Light Clay. Fails unless the weather is Snow.
auroraveil.shortDesc: For 5 turns, damage to allies halved. Snow only.

autotomize.name: Autotomize
autotomize.desc: Raises the user's Speed by 2 stages. If the user's Speed was changed, the user's weight is reduced by 100 kg as long as it remains active. This effect is stackable but cannot reduce the user's weight to less than 0.1 kg.
autotomize.shortDesc: Raises the user's Speed by 2; user loses 100 kg.

avalanche.name: Avalanche
avalanche.desc: Usually moves after other attacks (-4 priority). Power doubles from 80 to 160 if the target already damaged the user this turn. Has a higher chance for a critical hit.
avalanche.shortDesc: 80 BP; 160 if target hurt user this turn. High crit.

axekick.name: Axe Kick
axekick.desc: Has a 30% chance to confuse the target. If this attack is not successful, the user loses half of its maximum HP, rounded down, as crash damage. Pokemon with the Magic Guard Ability are unaffected by crash damage.
axekick.shortDesc: 30% confusion. User loses 50% max HP if miss.

babydolleyes.name: Baby-Doll Eyes
babydolleyes.desc: Lowers the target's Attack by 1 stage.

baddybad.name: Baddy Bad
baddybad.desc: This move summons Reflect for 5 turns upon use.

banefulbunker.name: Baneful Bunker
banefulbunker.desc: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn, and Pokemon making contact with the user become poisoned. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

barbbarrage.name: Barb Barrage
barbbarrage.desc: Has a 50% chance to poison the target. Power doubles if the target has a non-volatile status condition.
barbbarrage.shortDesc: 50% psn. 2x power if target is statused.

barbedweb.name: Barbed Web
barbedweb.desc: Crawli's move. Uses higher Attack or Sp. Atk; binds through the following turn; 30% poison. Adaptive damage uses the higher Attack or Sp. Atk including stat stages, with the matching defense and Special winning ties. Items, burn, screens and opposing defenses do not change this comparison.
barbedweb.shortDesc: Crawli's move. Adaptive; binds through next turn; 30% poison.

barrage.name: Barrage
barrage.desc: Hits two to five times. This move uses the user's higher attacking stat. Each hit has a 20% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage. If this move hits five times, the final hit is a critical hit.
barrage.shortDesc: Hits 2-5; uses higher Atk/SpA; 20% -SpD per hit.

barrier.name: Barrier
barrier.desc: Raises the user's Defense by 2 stages.

batonpass.name: Baton Pass
batonpass.desc: The user is replaced with another Pokemon in its party. The selected Pokemon has the user's stat stage changes transferred to it, as well as the effects of confusion, Aqua Ring, Curse, Dragon Cheer, Embargo, Focus Energy, Gastro Acid, Heal Block, Ingrain, Leech Seed, Lock-On (Mind Reader), Magnet Rise, Perish Song, Power Trick, Telekinesis, and a substitute with its remaining HP. The effect of Gastro Acid is not transferred if the recipient has an Ability that cannot be affected.
batonpass.shortDesc: User switches, passing stat changes and more.

beakblast.name: Beak Blast
beakblast.desc: If the user is hit by a contact move this turn before it can execute this move, the attacker is burned.
beakblast.shortDesc: Burns on contact with the user before it moves.

beasthunter.name: Beast Hunter
beasthunter.desc: Damien's move. Hits both foes. Independently chooses the Physical or Special category dealing greater calculated damage against each target; ties use Special. Makes contact in either category. Deals 25% damage through protection without removing it. Normal priority.
beasthunter.shortDesc: Damien's move. Hits foes; best category per target; 25% through Protect.

beatdown.name: Beatdown
beatdown.desc: Samson's move. Hits up to three times with a separate 95% accuracy check per hit, stopping on a miss. The first accuracy miss each switch-in raises the user's Attack by 2, even after earlier hits; the opportunity is spent even at the Attack cap. Direct HP hits Taunt a surviving target for 4 effect-counter turns, without refreshing existing Taunt. Protect, immunity and no target grant no boost. Blunder Policy can activate on a later miss unless the target is semi-invulnerable. Z-Move power: 160.
beatdown.shortDesc: Samson's move. 3 hits; first accuracy miss per entry: +2 Atk. HP hits Taunt (4). Z:160.

beatup.name: Beat Up
beatup.desc: Hits two to six times. Each hit has 30 base power.
beatup.shortDesc: Hits 2-6 times. Each hit has 30 power.

behemothbash.name: Behemoth Bash
behemothbash.desc: Uses user's Defense as the offensive stat.
behemothbash.shortDesc: Uses user's Defense as the offensive stat.

belch.name: Belch
belch.desc: This move cannot be selected until the user eats a Berry, either by eating one that was held, stealing and eating one off another Pokemon with Bug Bite or Pluck, or eating one that was thrown at it with Fling. Once the condition is met, this move can be selected and used for the rest of the battle even if the user gains or uses another item or switches out. Consuming a Berry with Natural Gift does not count for the purposes of eating one. Pokemon with Accumulation can use this move without eating a Berry.
belch.shortDesc: Requires eating a Berry, unless the user has Accumulation.

bellydrum.name: Belly Drum
bellydrum.desc: Raises the user's Attack by 12 stages in exchange for the user losing 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down. Fails if the user would faint or if its Attack stat stage is 6.
bellydrum.shortDesc: User loses 50% max HP. Maximizes Attack.

bestow.name: Bestow
bestow.desc: The target receives the user's held item. Fails if the user has no item or is holding a Mail or Z-Crystal, if the target is already holding an item, if the user is a Kyogre holding a Blue Orb, a Groudon holding a Red Orb, a Giratina holding a Griseous Orb, an Arceus holding a Plate, a Genesect holding a Drive, a Silvally holding a Memory, a Pokemon that can Mega Evolve holding the Mega Stone for its species, or if the target is one of those Pokemon and the user is holding the respective item.
bestow.shortDesc: User passes its held item to the target.

bide.name: Bide
bide.desc: The user spends two turns locked into this move and then, on the second turn after using this move, the user attacks the last Pokemon that hit it, inflicting double the damage in HP it lost to attacks during the two turns. If the last Pokemon that hit it is no longer active, the user attacks a random opposing Pokemon instead. If the user is prevented from moving during this move's use, the effect ends. This move does not check accuracy and does not ignore type immunity.
bide.shortDesc: Waits 2 turns; deals double the damage taken.

bind.name: Bind
bind.desc: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.
bind.shortDesc: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.

bite.name: Bite
bite.desc: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.
bite.shortDesc: 30% chance to make the target flinch.

bitterblade.name: Bitter Blade
bitterblade.desc: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.
bitterblade.shortDesc: User recovers 50% of the damage dealt.

bittermalice.name: Bitter Malice
bittermalice.desc: Power doubles if the target has a non-volatile status condition. Has a 30% chance to freeze the target. In Haunted Field, this move instead has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage and a 30% chance to freeze.

blackholeeclipse.name: Black Hole Eclipse
blackholeeclipse.desc: A one-use Dark-type Z-Move. Its power depends on the damaging Dark-type move selected as its base.
blackholeeclipse.shortDesc: Power depends on the base Dark-type move.

blastburn.name: Blast Burn
blastburn.desc: This 160-power Fire move uses Attack or Special Attack, whichever is higher. It has a 60% chance to burn. The user must recharge after a successful hit unless the target faints.
blastburn.shortDesc: 160 BP; higher Atk/SpA; 60% burn; recharge unless it KOs.

blazekick.name: Blaze Kick
blazekick.desc: Has a 10% chance to burn the target and a higher chance for a critical hit.
blazekick.shortDesc: High critical hit ratio. 10% chance to burn.

blazingtorque.name: Blazing Torque
blazingtorque.desc: Has a 30% chance to burn the target.

bleakwindstorm.name: Bleakwind Storm
bleakwindstorm.desc: Has a 30% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage. If the weather is Primordial Sea, Rain Dance, Hail, or Snow, this move does not check accuracy. If this move is used against a Pokemon holding Utility Umbrella, this move's accuracy remains at 80%.
bleakwindstorm.shortDesc: 30% to lower foe(s) Speed by 1. Rain/Hail/Snow: can't miss.

blizzard.name: Blizzard
blizzard.desc: Has a 10% chance to freeze the target. If the weather is Snow, this move does not check accuracy.
blizzard.shortDesc: 10% chance to freeze foe(s). Can't miss in Snow.

block.name: Block
block.desc: Prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field.
block.shortDesc: Prevents the target from switching out.

bloodmoon.name: Blood Moon
bloodmoon.desc: Cannot be selected the turn after it's used.
bloodmoon.shortDesc: Cannot be selected the turn after it's used.

bloomdoom.name: Bloom Doom
bloomdoom.desc: A one-use Grass-type Z-Move. Its power depends on the damaging Grass-type move selected as its base.
bloomdoom.shortDesc: Power depends on the base Grass-type move.

blueflare.name: Blue Flare
blueflare.desc: Has a 20% chance to burn the target.

bodypress.name: Body Press
bodypress.desc: Damage is calculated using the user's Defense stat as its Attack, including stat stage changes. Other effects that modify the Attack stat are used as normal.
bodypress.shortDesc: Uses user's Def stat as Atk in damage calculation.

bodyslam.name: Body Slam
bodyslam.desc: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.

boltbeak.name: Bolt Beak
boltbeak.desc: Power doubles if the user moves before the target.
boltbeak.shortDesc: Power doubles if user moves before the target.

boltstrike.name: Bolt Strike
boltstrike.desc: Has a 20% chance to paralyze the target.

boneclub.name: Bone Club
boneclub.desc: Usually moves first. As a Bone move, this move hits Flying-type Pokemon and Pokemon with Levitate for neutral damage. While Ground-type, this move bypasses field bans on Ground attacks and retains Ground typing instead of field-added Ice/Water typing or Midnight Zone conversion. Existing Bone-move immunity bypass, accuracy and protection rules are unchanged.
boneclub.shortDesc: Usually moves first. Hits airborne targets neutrally.

bonemerang.name: Bonemerang
bonemerang.desc: Hits twice. This move has a higher critical-hit ratio, and each hit has a 30% chance to make the target flinch. As a Bone move, it hits Flying-type Pokemon and Pokemon with Levitate for neutral damage. While Ground-type, this move bypasses field bans on Ground attacks and retains Ground typing instead of field-added Ice/Water typing or Midnight Zone conversion. Existing Bone-move immunity bypass, accuracy and protection rules are unchanged.
bonemerang.shortDesc: Hits twice; high critical-hit ratio; each hit has 30% flinch; hits airborne neutrally.

bonerush.name: Bone Rush
bonerush.desc: Hits two to six times. Each hit has a 10% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage. If the user holds a Thick Club, this move hits five or six times. As a Bone move, it hits Flying-type Pokemon and Pokemon with Levitate for neutral damage. While Ground-type, this move bypasses field bans on Ground attacks and retains Ground typing instead of field-added Ice/Water typing or Midnight Zone conversion. Existing Bone-move immunity bypass, accuracy and protection rules are unchanged.
bonerush.shortDesc: Hits 2-6 times; each hit can lower Defense; Thick Club: 5-6; hits airborne neutrally.

boomburst.name: Boomburst
boomburst.shortDesc: No additional effect. Hits adjacent Pokemon.

bounce.name: Bounce
bounce.desc: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks other than Gust, Hurricane, Sky Uppercut, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, Thunder, and Twister, and Gust and Twister have doubled power when used against it. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

bouncybubble.name: Bouncy Bubble
bouncybubble.desc: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.
bouncybubble.shortDesc: User recovers 50% of the damage dealt.

bravebird.name: Brave Bird
bravebird.desc: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

breakingswipe.name: Breaking Swipe
breakingswipe.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.
breakingswipe.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the foe(s) Attack by 1.

breakneckblitz.name: Breakneck Blitz
breakneckblitz.desc: A one-use Normal-type Z-Move. Its power depends on the damaging Normal-type move selected as its base.
breakneckblitz.shortDesc: Power depends on the base Normal-type move.

brickbreak.name: Brick Break
brickbreak.desc: If this attack does not miss, the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, and Aurora Veil end for the target's side of the field before damage is calculated.
brickbreak.shortDesc: Destroys screens, unless the target is immune.

brine.name: Brine
brine.desc: Power doubles if the target has less than or equal to half of its maximum HP remaining.
brine.shortDesc: Power doubles if the target's HP is 50% or less.

brutalswing.name: Brutal Swing
brutalswing.shortDesc: No additional effect. Hits adjacent Pokemon.

bubble.name: Bubble
bubble.desc: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.
bubble.shortDesc: 10% chance to lower the foe(s) Speed by 1.

bubblebeam.name: Bubble Beam
bubblebeam.desc: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.
bubblebeam.shortDesc: 10% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1.

bugbite.name: Bug Bite
bugbite.desc: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, it steals the target's held Berry if it is holding one and eats it immediately, gaining its effects even if the user's item is being ignored. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.
bugbite.shortDesc: User steals and eats the target's Berry.

bugbuzz.name: Bug Buzz
bugbuzz.desc: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.
bugbuzz.shortDesc: 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.

bulkup.name: Bulk Up
bulkup.desc: Raises the user's Attack and Defense by 1 stage.
bulkup.shortDesc: Raises the user's Attack and Defense by 1.

bulldoze.name: Bulldoze
bulldoze.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.
bulldoze.shortDesc: 100% chance lower adjacent Pkmn Speed by 1.

bulletseed.name: Bullet Seed
bulletseed.desc: Hits two to five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 5-6 times.

bunrakubeatdown.name: Bunraku Beatdown
bunrakubeatdown.desc: Puppet Master's move. Uses higher Attack or Sp. Atk. 80 power +15 per currently fainted teammate, capped at 140; bypasses Substitute. Adaptive damage uses the higher Attack or Sp. Atk including stat stages, with the matching defense and Special winning ties. Items, burn, screens and opposing defenses do not change this comparison.
bunrakubeatdown.shortDesc: Puppet Master's move. Adaptive; 80 +15 per fainted ally (max 140); bypasses Sub.

burningbulwark.name: Burning Bulwark
burningbulwark.desc: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn, and Pokemon trying to make contact with the user become burned. Non-damaging moves go through this protection. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.
burningbulwark.shortDesc: Protects from damaging attacks. Contact: burn.

burningjealousy.name: Burning Jealousy
burningjealousy.desc: Has a 100% chance to burn the target if it had a stat stage raised this turn.
burningjealousy.shortDesc: 100% burns a target that had a stat rise this turn.

burnup.name: Burn Up
burnup.desc: Fails unless the user is a Fire type. If this move is successful and the user is not Terastallized, the user's Fire type becomes typeless as long as it remains active.
burnup.shortDesc: User's Fire type becomes typeless; must be Fire.

buzzybuzz.name: Buzzy Buzz
buzzybuzz.desc: Has a 100% chance to paralyze the foe.

cactibash.name: Cacti Bash
cactibash.desc: Florinia's move. Hits twice. Knocking out the target adds one layer of Spikes to its side, at most once per use. Field effects: Desert: 1.5× power. Uses Big Top striker rules. Cannot add KO Spikes on Water Surface, Murkwater Surface or Midnight Zone.
cactibash.shortDesc: Florinia's move. Hits twice; a KO sets one layer of Spikes.

calmmind.name: Calm Mind
calmmind.desc: Raises the user's Special Attack and Special Defense by 1 stage.
calmmind.shortDesc: Raises the user's Sp. Atk and Sp. Def by 1.

camouflage.name: Camouflage
camouflage.desc: The user's type changes based on the battle terrain. Normal type on the regular Wi-Fi terrain, Electric type during Electric Terrain, Fairy type during Misty Terrain, Grass type during Grassy Terrain, and Psychic type during Psychic Terrain. Fails if the user's type cannot be changed or if the user is already purely that type.
camouflage.shortDesc: Changes user's type by terrain (default Normal).

captivate.name: Captivate
captivate.desc: Lowers the target's Special Attack by 2 stages. The target is unaffected if both the user and the target are the same gender, or if either is genderless. Pokemon with the Oblivious Ability are immune.
captivate.shortDesc: Lowers the foe(s) Sp. Atk by 2 if opposite gender.

catastropika.name: Catastropika
catastropika.desc: Pikachu's exclusive Z-Move, used through Volt Tackle. No additional effect.
catastropika.shortDesc: Exclusive Pikachu Z-Move; no additional effect.

cauterize.name: Cauterize
cauterize.desc: Deals Fire-type damage to foes. When used on an ally, it deals no damage and restores 50% of that ally's maximum HP.
cauterize.shortDesc: Fire damage; heals an ally for 50% max HP instead.

ceaselessedge.name: Ceaseless Edge
ceaselessedge.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit. If this move hits, it sets a layer of Spikes on the opposing side.
ceaselessedge.shortDesc: High critical-hit ratio; sets Spikes on the opposing side.

charge.name: Charge
charge.desc: Raises the user's Special Defense by 1 stage. The user's next Electric-type attack will have its power doubled; the effect ends when the user is no longer active, or after the user attempts to use any Electric-type move besides Charge, even if it is not successful.
charge.shortDesc: +1 SpD, user's next Electric move 2x power.

chargebeam.name: Charge Beam
chargebeam.desc: Raises the user's Special Attack by 1 stage.
chargebeam.shortDesc: Raises the user's Sp. Atk by 1.

charm.name: Charm
charm.desc: Lowers the target's Attack by 2 stages.

chatter.name: Chatter
chatter.desc: Has a 100% chance to confuse the target.

chillingwater.name: Chilling Water
chillingwater.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.
chillingwater.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1.

chillyreception.name: Chilly Reception
chillyreception.desc: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Snow. The user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members.

chipaway.name: Chip Away
chipaway.desc: Ignores the target's stat stage changes, including evasiveness.
chipaway.shortDesc: Ignores the target's stat stage changes.

chistrike.name: Chi Strike
chistrike.desc: Kiki's move. Always hits. Critical hits deal 2x damage; does not raise critical-hit chance. Field effects: Ashen Beach: 1.3× power.
chistrike.shortDesc: Kiki's move. Always hits; critical hits deal 2x damage.

chloroblast.name: Chloroblast
chloroblast.desc: If this move is successful, the user loses 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded up, unless the user has the Magic Guard or Rock Head Abilities.

circlethrow.name: Circle Throw
circlethrow.desc: If both the user and the target have not fainted, the target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. This effect fails if the target is under the effect of Ingrain, has the Suction Cups Ability, or this move hit a substitute.
circlethrow.shortDesc: Forces the target to switch to a random ally.

clamp.name: Clamp
clamp.desc: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.
clamp.shortDesc: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.

clangingscales.name: Clanging Scales
clangingscales.desc: Lowers the user's Defense by 1 stage.

clangoroussoul.name: Clangorous Soul
clangoroussoul.desc: Raises the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage in exchange for the user losing 33% of its maximum HP, rounded down. Fails if the user would faint or if its Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed stat stages would not change.
clangoroussoul.shortDesc: User loses 33% of its max HP. +1 to all stats.

clangoroussoulblaze.name: Clangorous Soulblaze
clangoroussoulblaze.desc: Raises the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage.

clearsmog.name: Clear Smog
clearsmog.desc: Resets all of the target's stat stages to 0.
clearsmog.shortDesc: Resets all of the target's stat stages to 0.

closecombat.name: Close Combat
closecombat.desc: Lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.
closecombat.shortDesc: Lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def by 1.

coaching.name: Coaching
coaching.desc: Raises the target's Attack and Defense by 1 stage. Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user.
coaching.shortDesc: Raises an ally's Attack and Defense by 1.

coil.name: Coil
coil.desc: Raises the user's Attack, Defense, and accuracy by 1 stage.
coil.shortDesc: Raises user's Attack, Defense, accuracy by 1.

coldsnap.name: Cold Snap
coldsnap.desc: Freezes the opposing Pokemon. This move does not check accuracy if used by a Ghost-type Pokemon.
coldsnap.shortDesc: Freezes the target. Ghost users never miss.

coldtruth.name: Cold Truth
coldtruth.desc: Angie's move. Applies Torment after damaging opposing HP.
coldtruth.shortDesc: Angie's move. Torments after damaging opposing HP.

collisioncourse.name: Collision Course
collisioncourse.desc: Damage is multiplied by 1.3333 if this move is super effective against the target.

combattorque.name: Combat Torque
combattorque.desc: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target.

cometpunch.name: Comet Punch
cometpunch.desc: Hits two to five times. Each hit has 30 Base Power, and the final hit has 60 Base Power and is always a critical hit. Counts as a punching move.
cometpunch.shortDesc: Hits 2-5 times. Final hit is 60 BP and always crits.

comeuppance.name: Comeuppance
comeuppance.desc: Deals damage to the last opposing Pokemon to hit the user with a physical or special attack this turn equal to 1.5 times the HP lost by the user from that attack, rounded down. If the user did not lose HP from that attack, this move deals 1 HP of damage instead. If that opposing Pokemon's position is no longer in use and there is another opposing Pokemon on the field, the damage is done to it instead. Only the last hit of a multi-hit attack is counted. Fails if the user was not hit by an opposing Pokemon's physical or special attack this turn.
comeuppance.shortDesc: If hit by an attack, returns 1.5x damage.

confide.name: Confide
confide.desc: Lowers the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.
confide.shortDesc: Lowers the target's Sp. Atk by 1.

confuseray.name: Confuse Ray
confuseray.desc: Causes the target to become confused.

confusion.name: Confusion
confusion.desc: Has a 10% chance to confuse the target.

constrict.name: Constrict
constrict.desc: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.
constrict.shortDesc: 10% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1.

continentalcrush.name: Continental Crush
continentalcrush.desc: A one-use Rock-type Z-Move. Its power depends on the damaging Rock-type move selected as its base.
continentalcrush.shortDesc: Power depends on the base Rock-type move.

conversion.name: Conversion
conversion.desc: The user's type changes to match the original type of the move in its first move slot. Fails if the user cannot change its type, or if the type is one of the user's current types.
conversion.shortDesc: Changes user's type to match its first move.

conversion2.name: Conversion 2
conversion2.desc: The user's type changes to match a type that resists or is immune to the type of the last move used by the target, but not either of its current types. The determined type of the move is used rather than the original type. Fails if the target has not made a move, if the user cannot change its type, or if this move would only be able to select one of the user's current types.
conversion2.shortDesc: Changes user's type to resist target's last move.

copycat.name: Copycat
copycat.desc: The user uses the last move used by any Pokemon, including itself. Fails if no move has been used, or if the last move used was Assist, Baneful Bunker, Beak Blast, Behemoth Bash, Behemoth Blade, Belch, Bestow, Blazing Torque, Celebrate, Chatter, Circle Throw, Combat Torque, Copycat, Counter, Covet, Destiny Bond, Detect, Dragon Tail, Dynamax Cannon, Endure, Feint, Focus Punch, Follow Me, Helping Hand, Hold Hands, King's Shield, Magical Torque, Mat Block, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Protect, Rage Powder, Roar, Shell Trap, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Snatch, Spiky Shield, Spotlight, Struggle, Switcheroo, Tera Starstorm, Thief, Transform, Trick, Whirlwind, or Wicked Torque.
copycat.shortDesc: Uses the last move used in the battle.

coreenforcer.name: Core Enforcer
coreenforcer.desc: If the user moves after the target, the target's Ability is rendered ineffective as long as it remains active. If the target uses Baton Pass, the replacement will remain under this effect. If the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero, this effect does not happen, and receiving the effect through Baton Pass ends the effect immediately.
coreenforcer.shortDesc: Nullifies the foe(s) Ability if the foe(s) move first.

corkscrewcrash.name: Corkscrew Crash
corkscrewcrash.desc: A one-use Steel-type Z-Move. Its power depends on the damaging Steel-type move selected as its base.
corkscrewcrash.shortDesc: Power depends on the base Steel-type move.

corrosivegas.name: Corrosive Gas
corrosivegas.desc: The target loses its held item. This move cannot cause Pokemon with the Sticky Hold Ability to lose their held item or cause a Kyogre, a Groudon, a Giratina, an Arceus, a Genesect, a Silvally, a Zacian, or a Zamazenta to lose their Blue Orb, Red Orb, Griseous Orb, Plate, Drive, Memory, Rusted Sword, or Rusted Shield respectively. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.

corrosivestrike.name: Corrosive Strike
corrosivestrike.desc: Corey's move. Uses higher staged Attack or Special Attack, Special on ties. Super effective against Steel. Inflicts non-stacking corrosion dealing 1/16 maximum HP each turn until the target switches. Field effects: Corrosive Terrain: 1.5× power.
corrosivestrike.shortDesc: Corey's move. Adaptive; Super effective on Steel; corrosion drains 1/16 HP per turn.

cosmicpower.name: Cosmic Power
cosmicpower.desc: Raises the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.
cosmicpower.shortDesc: Raises the user's Defense and Sp. Def by 1.

cottonguard.name: Cotton Guard
cottonguard.desc: Raises the user's Defense by 3 stages.

cottonspore.name: Cotton Spore
cottonspore.desc: Lowers the target's Speed by 2 stages.

counter.name: Counter
counter.desc: Deals damage to the last opposing Pokemon to hit the user with a physical attack this turn equal to twice the HP lost by the user from that attack. If the user did not lose HP from the attack, this move deals 1 HP of damage instead. If that opposing Pokemon's position is no longer in use and there is another opposing Pokemon on the field, the damage is done to it instead. Only the last hit of a multi-hit attack is counted. Fails if the user was not hit by an opposing Pokemon's physical attack this turn.
counter.shortDesc: If hit by physical attack, returns double damage.

courtchange.name: Court Change
courtchange.desc: Switches the Mist, Light Screen, Reflect, Spikes, Safeguard, Tailwind, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, Water Pledge, Fire Pledge, Grass Pledge, Sticky Web, Aurora Veil, G-Max Steelsurge, G-Max Cannonade, G-Max Vine Lash, and G-Max Wildfire effects from the user's side to the opposing side and vice versa.
courtchange.shortDesc: Swaps user's field effects with the opposing side.

covet.name: Covet
covet.desc: If this attack was successful and the user has not fainted, it steals the target's held item if the user is not holding one. The target's item is not stolen if it is a Mail or Z-Crystal, or if the target is a Kyogre holding a Blue Orb, a Groudon holding a Red Orb, a Giratina holding a Griseous Orb, an Arceus holding a Plate, a Genesect holding a Drive, a Silvally holding a Memory, or a Pokemon that can Mega Evolve holding the Mega Stone for its species. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.
covet.shortDesc: If the user has no item, it steals the target's.

crabhammer.name: Crabhammer
crabhammer.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

craftyshield.name: Crafty Shield
craftyshield.desc: The user and its party members are protected from non-damaging attacks made by other Pokemon, including allies, during this turn. Fails if the user moves last this turn or if this move is already in effect for the user's side.
craftyshield.shortDesc: Protects allies from Status moves this turn.

crestcleave.name: Crest Cleave
crestcleave.desc: Titania's move. Uses higher staged Attack or Sp. Atk with the corresponding defense (Special on ties). Drains 1/3 of damage dealt.

crosschop.name: Cross Chop
crosschop.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

crosspoison.name: Cross Poison
crosspoison.desc: Has a high critical hit ratio and a 30% chance to poison the target. If the target is poisoned or badly poisoned, this move ignores the target's positive Defense boosts.
crosspoison.shortDesc: High crit. 30% poison; ignores positive Def boosts vs poisoned targets.

crunch.name: Crunch
crunch.desc: Has a 20% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.
crunch.shortDesc: 20% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.

crushclaw.name: Crush Claw
crushclaw.desc: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.
crushclaw.shortDesc: 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.

crushgrip.name: Crush Grip
crushgrip.desc: Power is equal to 120 * (target's current HP / target's maximum HP), rounded half down, but not less than 1.
crushgrip.shortDesc: More power the more HP the target has left.

curse.name: Curse
curse.desc: If the user is not a Ghost type, lowers the user's Speed by 1 stage and raises the user's Attack and Defense by 1 stage. If the user is a Ghost type, the user loses 1/3 of its maximum HP, rounded down and even if it would cause fainting, in exchange for the target losing 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn while it is active. Cursed Keepsake users pay no HP. If the target uses Baton Pass, the replacement will continue to be affected. Fails if there is no target or if the target is already affected.
curse.shortDesc: Curses if Ghost, else -1 Spe, +1 Atk, +1 Def. Ghost cost is 1/4 HP.

cut.name: Cut
cut.desc: Steel-type slicing move with a high critical hit ratio. Before damage, removes the target's Defense boosts. If the target has no Defense boosts, this move has a 30% chance to lower Defense by 1 stage.

darkclasp.name: Dark Clasp
darkclasp.desc: Luna's move. Uses the user’s Sp. Def instead of Sp. Atk against the target’s Sp. Def. Field effects: Dark Crystal Cavern: 1.5x power. Changes Cave or Crystal Cavern to Dark Crystal Cavern, and Factory to Short Circuit, after damage. Field locks apply.
darkclasp.shortDesc: Luna's move. Uses user's Sp. Def to attack.

darkestlariat.name: Darkest Lariat
darkestlariat.desc: Ignores the target's stat stage changes, including evasiveness.
darkestlariat.shortDesc: Ignores the target's stat stage changes.

darkpulse.name: Dark Pulse
darkpulse.desc: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.
darkpulse.shortDesc: 20% chance to make the target flinch.

darkvoid.name: Dark Void
darkvoid.desc: Has 70% accuracy. Puts adjacent opposing Pokemon to sleep.

dazzlinggleam.name: Dazzling Gleam
dazzlinggleam.shortDesc: No additional effect. Hits adjacent foes.

decorate.name: Decorate
decorate.desc: Raises the target's Attack and Special Attack by 2 stages.
decorate.shortDesc: Raises the target's Attack and Sp. Atk by 2.

defendorder.name: Defend Order
defendorder.desc: Selects the user or one adjacent ally. Raises that target's Defense and Sp. Def by 1 stage (2 on Forest Field) and heals 1/4 maximum HP. Retains its existing flags and normal healing/stat-change rules.

defensecurl.name: Defense Curl
defensecurl.desc: Raises the user's Defense by 1 stage. As long as the user remains active, the power of the user's Ice Ball and Rollout will be doubled (this effect is not stackable).

defog.name: Defog
defog.desc: Lowers the target's evasiveness by 1 stage. If this move is successful and whether or not the target's evasiveness was affected, the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil, Safeguard, Mist, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, and Sticky Web end for the target's side, and the effects of Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, and Sticky Web end for the user's side. Ignores a target's substitute, although a substitute will still block the lowering of evasiveness. If there is a terrain active and this move is successful, the terrain will be cleared.
defog.shortDesc: -1 evasion; ends user and target hazards/terrain.

deiludicium.name: Dei Ludicium
deiludicium.desc: Elias's move. After a hit, cures the user of its status condition. Uses Judgment's existing named field boosts without its held-item typing. Rainbow Aura also grants its named 1.5x boost; matching Rainbow Terrain and Aura do not duplicate it.
deiludicium.shortDesc: Elias's move. Cures user's major status after a hit.

deluge.name: Deluge
