ironhead.shortDesc: 30% chance to make the target flinch.

irontail.name: Iron Tail
irontail.desc: Has a 30% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.
irontail.shortDesc: 30% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.

irritation.name: Irritation
irritation.desc: Power doubles from 60 to 120 if the target has a major status condition.
irritation.shortDesc: Double power against a statused target.

ivycudgel.name: Ivy Cudgel
ivycudgel.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit. If the user is an Ogerpon, this move's type changes depending on its form. Water type for Wellspring Mask, Fire type for Hearthflame Mask, and Rock type for Cornerstone Mask.
ivycudgel.shortDesc: High critical hit ratio. Type depends on user's form.

jawlock.name: Jaw Lock
jawlock.desc: Prevents the user and the target from switching out. The user and the target can still switch out if either of them is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field.
jawlock.shortDesc: Prevents both user and target from switching out.

judgment.name: Judgment
judgment.desc: This move's type depends on the user's held Plate.
judgment.shortDesc: Type varies based on the held Plate.

jumpkick.name: Jump Kick
jumpkick.desc: If this attack is not successful, the user loses half of its maximum HP, rounded down, as crash damage. Pokemon with the Magic Guard Ability are unaffected by crash damage.
jumpkick.shortDesc: User is hurt by 50% of its max HP if it misses.

junglehealing.name: Jungle Healing
junglehealing.desc: Each affected ally has its major status cured and restores 1/8 max HP, or 1/4 total if a status was actually cured.
junglehealing.shortDesc: Allies heal 1/8, or 1/4 total if status is cured.

kaboom.name: KABOOM!!
kaboom.desc: Julia's move. Uses the higher staged Attack or Sp. Atk (Special on ties), against the corresponding defense. Raises the matching offensive stat by 1 as a guaranteed secondary effect: Attack when Physical, Sp. Atk when Special. Recoil is 1/4 damage dealt. Field effects: Electric Terrain or Electric Aura removes recoil.
kaboom.shortDesc: Julia's move. Adaptive; +1 matching Atk/SpA; 1/4 recoil. Electric Terrain/Aura: no recoil.

karatechop.name: Karate Chop
karatechop.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

kinesis.name: Kinesis
kinesis.desc: Lowers the target's accuracy by 1 stage.

kingsshield.name: King's Shield
kingsshield.desc: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn, and Pokemon trying to make contact with the user have their Attack lowered by 1 stage. Non-damaging moves go through this protection. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.
kingsshield.shortDesc: Protects from damaging attacks. Contact: -1 Atk.

knockoff.name: Knock Off
knockoff.desc: If the target is holding an item that can be removed from it, ignoring the Sticky Hold Ability, this move's power is multiplied by 1.5. If the user has not fainted, the target loses its held item. This move cannot cause Pokemon with the Sticky Hold Ability to lose their held item or cause a Kyogre, a Groudon, a Giratina, an Arceus, a Genesect, a Silvally, a Zacian, or a Zamazenta to lose their Blue Orb, Red Orb, Griseous Orb, Plate, Drive, Memory, Rusted Sword, or Rusted Shield respectively. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.
knockoff.shortDesc: 1.5x damage if foe holds an item. Removes item.

kowtowcleave.name: Kowtow Cleave
kowtowcleave.desc: This move does not check accuracy.
kowtowcleave.shortDesc: This move does not check accuracy.

landswrath.name: Land's Wrath
landswrath.shortDesc: No additional effect. Hits adjacent foes.

laserfocus.name: Laser Focus
laserfocus.desc: Until the end of the next turn, the user's attacks will be critical hits.
laserfocus.shortDesc: Until the end of the next turn, user's moves crit.

lashout.name: Lash Out
lashout.desc: Power doubles if the user had a stat stage lowered this turn.
lashout.shortDesc: 2x power if the user had a stat lowered this turn.

lastresort.name: Last Resort
lastresort.desc: This move fails unless the user knows this move and at least one other move, and has used all the other moves it knows at least once each since it became active or Transformed.
lastresort.shortDesc: Fails unless each known move has been used.

lastrespects.name: Last Respects
lastrespects.desc: Uses the higher staged Attack or Sp. Atk (Special on ties), against Defense or Sp. Def respectively. Ghost attack with 100% accuracy and 10 PP. Power is 50 plus 20 per currently fainted teammate, capped at 140. Revival removes that teammate from the count; repeated fainting does not accumulate power.

lavaplume.name: Lava Plume
lavaplume.desc: Has a 30% chance to burn the target.

leafblade.name: Leaf Blade
leafblade.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

leafstorm.name: Leaf Storm
leafstorm.desc: Lowers the user's Special Attack by 2 stages.
leafstorm.shortDesc: Lowers the user's Sp. Atk by 2.

leaftornado.name: Leaf Tornado
leaftornado.desc: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1 stage.
leaftornado.shortDesc: 50% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1.

leechlife.name: Leech Life
leechlife.desc: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.
leechlife.shortDesc: User recovers 50% of the damage dealt.

leechseed.name: Leech Seed
leechseed.desc: The Pokemon at the user's position steals 1/8 of the target's maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn. If Big Root is held by the recipient, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down. If the target uses Baton Pass, the replacement will continue being leeched. If the target switches out or uses Mortal Spin or Rapid Spin successfully, the effect ends. Grass-type Pokemon are immune to this move on use, but not its effect.
leechseed.shortDesc: 1/8 of target's HP is restored to user every turn.

leer.name: Leer
leer.desc: Lowers the target's Defense by 1 stage.

letssnuggleforever.name: Let's Snuggle Forever
letssnuggleforever.desc: Mimikyu's exclusive Z-Move, used through Play Rough. No additional effect.
letssnuggleforever.shortDesc: Exclusive Mimikyu Z-Move; no additional effect.

lick.name: Lick
lick.desc: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target.

lifedew.name: Life Dew
lifedew.desc: Each Pokemon on the user's side restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded half up. On Water Surface, Underwater, and Midnight Zone, the user and its allies also gain Aqua Ring, even if already at full HP.
lifedew.shortDesc: Heals allies by 1/4; grants Aqua Ring on three water fields.

lightofruin.name: Light of Ruin
lightofruin.desc: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP. On Bewitched Woods, the recoil is reduced to 1/4.
lightofruin.shortDesc: Has 1/2 recoil; 1/4 recoil on Bewitched Woods.

lightscreen.name: Light Screen
lightscreen.desc: For 5 turns, the user and its party members take 0.5x damage from special attacks, or 0.66x damage if in a Double Battle. Damage is not reduced further with Aurora Veil. Critical hits ignore this effect. It is removed from the user's side if the user or an ally is successfully hit by Brick Break, Psychic Fangs, or Defog. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Light Clay. Fails if the effect is already active on the user's side.
lightscreen.shortDesc: For 5 turns, special damage to allies is halved.

lightthatburnsthesky.name: Light That Burns the Sky
lightthatburnsthesky.desc: This move becomes a physical attack if the user's Attack is greater than its Special Attack, including stat stage changes. This move and its effects ignore the Abilities of other Pokemon.
lightthatburnsthesky.shortDesc: Physical if user's Atk > Sp. Atk. Ignores Abilities.

liquidation.name: Liquidation
liquidation.desc: Has a 20% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.
liquidation.shortDesc: 20% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.

lockon.name: Lock-On
lockon.desc: Until the end of the next turn, the target cannot avoid the user's moves, even if the target is in the middle of a two-turn move. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field. Fails if this effect is active for the user.
lockon.shortDesc: User's next move will not miss the target.

lovelykiss.name: Lovely Kiss
lovelykiss.desc: Causes the target to fall asleep.
lovelykiss.shortDesc: Causes the target to fall asleep.

lowkick.name: Low Kick
lowkick.desc: This move's power is 20 if the target weighs less than 10 kg, 40 if less than 25 kg, 60 if less than 50 kg, 80 if less than 100 kg, 100 if less than 200 kg, and 120 if greater than or equal to 200 kg.
lowkick.shortDesc: More power the heavier the target.

lowsweep.name: Low Sweep
lowsweep.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.
lowsweep.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1.

luckychant.name: Lucky Chant
luckychant.desc: This move has +3 priority. For 5 turns, the user and its party members cannot be struck by a critical hit and take 10% less damage from attacks. Fails if the effect is already active on the user's side.
luckychant.shortDesc: +3 priority. 5 turns: blocks critical hits and reduces attack damage by 10%.

luminacrash.name: Lumina Crash
luminacrash.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 2 stages.
luminacrash.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 2.

lunarblessing.name: Lunar Blessing
lunarblessing.desc: Each affected ally has its major status cured and restores 1/8 max HP, or 1/4 total if a status was actually cured.
lunarblessing.shortDesc: Allies heal 1/8, or 1/4 total if status is cured.

lunardance.name: Lunar Dance
lunardance.desc: The user faints, and if the Pokemon brought out to replace it does not have full HP or PP, or has a non-volatile status condition, its HP and PP are fully restored along with having any non-volatile status condition cured. The replacement is sent out at the end of the turn, and the healing happens before hazards take effect. This effect continues until a Pokemon that meets any of these conditions switches in at the user's position or gets swapped into the position with Ally Switch. Fails if the user is the last unfainted Pokemon in its party.
lunardance.shortDesc: User faints. Next hurt Pkmn is cured, max HP/PP.

lunge.name: Lunge
lunge.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.
lunge.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1.

lusterpurge.name: Luster Purge
lusterpurge.desc: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.
lusterpurge.shortDesc: 50% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.

m3g4qu4k3.name: M3G4 QU4K3
m3g4qu4k3.desc: Terra's move. Hits all adjacent Pokemon; damaged opposing targets lose 1 Defense and Sp. Def. Glitch boosts power 1.3x; Big Top applies its Striker roll.
m3g4qu4k3.shortDesc: Terra's move. Hits all adjacent; damaged foes lose 1 Defense and Sp. Def.

magicalleaf.name: Magical Leaf
magicalleaf.desc: This move does not check accuracy.
magicalleaf.shortDesc: This move does not check accuracy.

magicaltorque.name: Magical Torque
magicaltorque.desc: Has a 30% chance to confuse the target.

magiccoat.name: Magic Coat
magiccoat.desc: Until the end of the turn, the user is unaffected by certain non-damaging moves directed at it and will instead use such moves against the original user. Moves reflected in this way are unable to be reflected again by this or the Magic Bounce Ability's effect. Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, and Toxic Spikes can only be reflected once per side, by the leftmost Pokemon under this or the Magic Bounce Ability's effect. The Lightning Rod and Storm Drain Abilities redirect their respective moves before this move takes effect.

magicpowder.name: Magic Powder
magicpowder.desc: Causes the target to become a Psychic type and creates Bewitched Field for 5 turns. Fails if the target is an Arceus or a Silvally, if the target is already purely Psychic type, or if the target is Terastallized.
magicpowder.shortDesc: Changes the target's type to Psychic; creates Bewitched Field.

magicroom.name: Magic Room
magicroom.desc: For 5 turns, the held items of all active Pokemon have no effect. An item's effect of causing forme changes is unaffected, but any other effects from such items are negated. During the effect, Fling and Natural Gift are prevented from being used by all active Pokemon. If this move is used during the effect, the effect ends.
magicroom.shortDesc: For 5 turns, all held items have no effect.

magmadrift.name: Magma Drift
magmadrift.desc: Hits all adjacent Pokémon, including allies. Thaws the user. Hits targets using Dive for double damage. Does not burn.
magmadrift.shortDesc: Hits all adjacent. Thaws user; 2x against Dive.

magmastorm.name: Magma Storm
magmastorm.desc: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.
magmastorm.shortDesc: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.

magnetbomb.name: Magnet Bomb
magnetbomb.desc: This move does not check accuracy.
magnetbomb.shortDesc: This move does not check accuracy.

magneticflux.name: Magnetic Flux
magneticflux.desc: Raises the Defense and Special Defense of allies with Plus or Minus by 1 stage. On the local Electric Field, normally raises both stats of all allies by 2 stages. A user's unspent Magnetic Bulwark instead allows one use per genuine entry to raise both stats of itself and adjacent allies by 1 regardless of Plus or Minus. Normal boost restrictions apply; an entirely failed use does not spend this benefit.
magneticflux.shortDesc: Raises Def, Sp. Def of allies with Plus/Minus by 1.

magnetrise.name: Magnet Rise
magnetrise.desc: For 5 turns, the user is immune to Ground-type attacks and the effects of Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web, and the Arena Trap Ability as long as it remains active. If the user uses Baton Pass, the replacement will gain the effect. Ingrain, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, and Iron Ball override this move if the user is under any of their effects. Fails if the user is already under this effect or the effects of Ingrain, Smack Down, or Thousand Arrows.
magnetrise.shortDesc: For 5 turns, the user has immunity to Ground.

magnitude.name: Magnitude
magnitude.desc: The power of this move varies; 5% chances for 10 and 150 power, 10% chances for 30 and 110 power, 20% chances for 50 and 90 power, and 30% chance for 70 power. Damage doubles if the target is using Dig.
magnitude.shortDesc: Hits adjacent Pokemon. Power varies; 2x on Dig.

makeitrain.name: Make It Rain
makeitrain.desc: Lowers the user's Special Attack by 1 stage.
makeitrain.shortDesc: Lowers the user's Sp. Atk by 1. Hits foe(s).

maliciousmoonsault.name: Malicious Moonsault
maliciousmoonsault.desc: Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.
maliciousmoonsault.shortDesc: Damage doubles if the target used Minimize.

malignantchain.name: Malignant Chain
malignantchain.desc: Has a 50% chance to badly poison the target.
malignantchain.shortDesc: 50% chance to badly poison the target.

matblock.name: Mat Block
matblock.desc: The user and its party members are protected from damaging attacks made by other Pokemon, including allies, during this turn. Fails unless it is the user's first turn on the field, if the user moves last this turn, or if this move is already in effect for the user's side.
matblock.shortDesc: Protects allies from damaging attacks. Turn 1 only.

matchagotcha.name: Matcha Gotcha
matchagotcha.desc: Has a 20% chance to burn the target. The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down. The target thaws out if it is frozen.
matchagotcha.shortDesc: 20% burn. Recovers 50% dmg dealt. Thaws foe(s).

matrixshot.name: Matrix Shot
matrixshot.desc: Adam's move. Uses Attack against the target Sp. Def. Dragon's Den adds a 1.5x named boost alongside its Rock boost.
matrixshot.shortDesc: Adam's move. Uses Attack against Sp. Def.

maxairstream.name: Max Airstream
maxairstream.desc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, the Speed of each Pokemon on the user's side is raised by 1 stage, even if they have a substitute. This effect does not happen if the user is not Dynamaxed. If this move is used as a base move, it deals damage with a power of 0.
maxairstream.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Allies: +1 Speed.

maxdarkness.name: Max Darkness
maxdarkness.desc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, the Special Defense of each Pokemon on the opposing side is lowered by 1 stage, even if they have a substitute. This effect does not happen if the user is not Dynamaxed. If this move is used as a base move, it deals damage with a power of 0.
maxdarkness.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Foes: -1 Sp. Def.

maxflare.name: Max Flare
maxflare.desc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, the effect of Sunny Day begins. This effect does not happen if the user is not Dynamaxed. If this move is used as a base move, it deals damage with a power of 0.
maxflare.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Starts Sunny Day.

maxflutterby.name: Max Flutterby
maxflutterby.desc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, the Special Attack of each Pokemon on the opposing side is lowered by 1 stage, even if they have a substitute. This effect does not happen if the user is not Dynamaxed. If this move is used as a base move, it deals damage with a power of 0.
maxflutterby.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Foes: -1 Sp. Atk.

maxgeyser.name: Max Geyser
maxgeyser.desc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, the effect of Rain Dance begins. This effect does not happen if the user is not Dynamaxed. If this move is used as a base move, it deals damage with a power of 0.
maxgeyser.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Starts Rain Dance.

maxguard.name: Max Guard
maxguard.desc: The user is protected from nearly all attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn, including Max and G-Max Moves. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.
maxguard.shortDesc: Protects user from moves & Max Moves this turn.

maxhailstorm.name: Max Hailstorm
maxhailstorm.desc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, the effect of Hail begins. This effect does not happen if the user is not Dynamaxed. If this move is used as a base move, it deals damage with a power of 0.
maxhailstorm.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Starts Hail.

maxknuckle.name: Max Knuckle
maxknuckle.desc: Boosts the user and its allies' Attack by 1 stage. BP scales with the base move's BP. This effect does not happen if the user is not Dynamaxed. If this move is used as a base move, it deals damage with a power of 0.
maxknuckle.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Allies: +1 Attack.

maxlightning.name: Max Lightning

maxlightning.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Starts Electric Terrain.

maxmindstorm.name: Max Mindstorm

maxmindstorm.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Starts Psychic Terrain.

maxooze.name: Max Ooze
maxooze.desc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, the Special Attack of each Pokemon on the user's side is raised by 1 stage, even if they have a substitute. This effect does not happen if the user is not Dynamaxed. If this move is used as a base move, it deals damage with a power of 0.
maxooze.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Allies: +1 Sp. Atk.

maxovergrowth.name: Max Overgrowth
maxovergrowth.desc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, the effect of Grassy Terrain begins. This effect does not happen if the user is not Dynamaxed. If this move is used as a base move, it deals damage with a power of 0.
maxovergrowth.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Starts Grassy Terrain.

maxphantasm.name: Max Phantasm
maxphantasm.desc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, the Defense of each Pokemon on the opposing side is lowered by 1 stage, even if they have a substitute. This effect does not happen if the user is not Dynamaxed. If this move is used as a base move, it deals damage with a power of 0.
maxphantasm.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Foes: -1 Defense.

maxquake.name: Max Quake
maxquake.desc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, the Special Defense of each Pokemon on the user's side is raised by 1 stage, even if they have a substitute. This effect does not happen if the user is not Dynamaxed. If this move is used as a base move, it deals damage with a power of 0.
maxquake.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Allies: +1 Sp. Def.

maxrockfall.name: Max Rockfall
maxrockfall.desc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, the effect of Sandstorm begins. This effect does not happen if the user is not Dynamaxed. If this move is used as a base move, it deals damage with a power of 0.
maxrockfall.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Starts Sandstorm.

maxstarfall.name: Max Starfall
maxstarfall.desc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, the effect of Misty Terrain begins. This effect does not happen if the user is not Dynamaxed. If this move is used as a base move, it deals damage with a power of 0.
maxstarfall.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Starts Misty Terrain.

maxsteelspike.name: Max Steelspike
maxsteelspike.desc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, the Defense of each Pokemon on the user's side is raised by 1 stage, even if they have a substitute. This effect does not happen if the user is not Dynamaxed. If this move is used as a base move, it deals damage with a power of 0.
maxsteelspike.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Allies: +1 Defense.

maxstrike.name: Max Strike
maxstrike.desc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, the Speed of each Pokemon on the opposing side is lowered by 1 stage, even if they have a substitute. This effect does not happen if the user is not Dynamaxed. If this move is used as a base move, it deals damage with a power of 0.
maxstrike.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Foes: -1 Speed.

maxwyrmwind.name: Max Wyrmwind
maxwyrmwind.desc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, the Attack of each Pokemon on the opposing side is lowered by 1 stage, even if they have a substitute. This effect does not happen if the user is not Dynamaxed. If this move is used as a base move, it deals damage with a power of 0.
maxwyrmwind.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Foes: -1 Attack.

meanlook.name: Mean Look
meanlook.desc: Prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field.
meanlook.shortDesc: Prevents the target from switching out.

meditate.name: Meditate
meditate.desc: Heals one quarter of maximum HP and raises the higher staged Attack or Special Attack by one stage (Attack on ties). Either effect can succeed independently. After a successful use, cannot be used again that turn or the following turn; an intervening turn without acting also clears this restriction. Switching out clears it. Subject to Heal Block and healing-move priority effects.
meditate.shortDesc: Heals 1/4 HP; +1 higher offense. Cannot repeat next turn.

mefirst.name: Me First
mefirst.desc: The user uses the move the target chose for use this turn against it, if possible, with its power multiplied by 1.5. The move must be a damaging move other than Beak Blast, Belch, Blazing Torque, Combat Torque, Comeuppance, Counter, Covet, Focus Punch, Magical Torque, Me First, Metal Burst, Mirror Coat, Noxious Torque, Shell Trap, Struggle, Thief, or Wicked Torque. Fails if the target moves before the user. Ignores the target's substitute for the purpose of copying the move.
mefirst.shortDesc: Copies a foe at 1.5x power. User must be faster.

megadrain.name: Mega Drain
megadrain.desc: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.
megadrain.shortDesc: User recovers 50% of the damage dealt.

megahorn.name: Megahorn
megahorn.desc: 10% chance to make the target flinch.
megahorn.shortDesc: 10% chance to make the target flinch.

memento.name: Memento
memento.desc: Lowers the target's Attack and Special Attack by 2 stages. The user faints unless this move misses or there is no target. Fails entirely if this move hits a substitute, but does not fail if the target's stats cannot be changed.
memento.shortDesc: Lowers target's Attack, Sp. Atk by 2. User faints.

menacingmoonrazemaelstrom.name: Menacing Moonraze Maelstrom
menacingmoonrazemaelstrom.desc: This move and its effects ignore the Abilities of other Pokemon.
menacingmoonrazemaelstrom.shortDesc: Ignores the Abilities of other Pokemon.

metalburst.name: Metal Burst
metalburst.desc: Deals damage to the last opposing Pokemon to hit the user with a physical or special attack this turn equal to 1.5 times the HP lost by the user from that attack, rounded down. If the user did not lose HP from that attack, this move deals 1 HP of damage instead. If that opposing Pokemon's position is no longer in use and there is another opposing Pokemon on the field, the damage is done to it instead. Only the last hit of a multi-hit attack is counted. Fails if the user was not hit by an opposing Pokemon's physical or special attack this turn.
metalburst.shortDesc: If hit by an attack, returns 1.5x damage.

metalclaw.name: Metal Claw
metalclaw.desc: Has a 30% chance to raise the user's Attack by 1 stage.
metalclaw.shortDesc: 30% chance to raise the user's Attack by 1.

metalsound.name: Metal Sound
metalsound.desc: Lowers the target's Special Defense by 2 stages.
metalsound.shortDesc: Lowers the target's Sp. Def by 2.

meteorassault.name: Meteor Assault
meteorassault.desc: Has a 60% chance to paralyze the target. If this move succeeds and does not knock out the target, the user must recharge on the next turn.
meteorassault.shortDesc: 60% paralysis; recharges next turn unless it gets a KO.

meteorbeam.name: Meteor Beam
meteorbeam.desc: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. Raises the user's Special Attack by 1 stage on the first turn. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.
meteorbeam.shortDesc: Raises user's Sp. Atk by 1 on turn 1. Hits turn 2.

meteormash.name: Meteor Mash
meteormash.desc: Has a 30% chance to raise the user's Attack by 1 stage.
meteormash.shortDesc: 30% chance to raise the user's Attack by 1.

metronome.name: Metronome
metronome.desc: A random move is selected for use.

milkdrink.name: Milk Drink
milkdrink.desc: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.
milkdrink.shortDesc: Heals the user by 50% of its max HP.

mimic.name: Mimic
mimic.desc: While the user remains active, this move is replaced by the last move used by the target. The copied move has the maximum PP for that move. Fails if the target has not made a move, if the user has Transformed, if the user already knows the move, or if the move is Assist, Behemoth Bash, Behemoth Blade, Belch, Blazing Torque, Celebrate, Chatter, Combat Torque, Copycat, Dynamax Cannon, Hold Hands, Magical Torque, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Struggle, Tera Starstorm, Transform, or Wicked Torque.
mimic.shortDesc: The last move the target used replaces this one.

mindblown.name: Mind Blown
mindblown.desc: Whether or not this move is successful and even if it would cause fainting, the user loses 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded up, unless the user has the Magic Guard Ability. This move is prevented from executing and the user does not lose HP if any active Pokemon has the Damp Ability, or if this move is Fire type and the user is affected by Powder or the weather is Primordial Sea.
mindblown.shortDesc: User loses 50% max HP. Hits adjacent Pokemon.

mindreader.name: Mind Reader
mindreader.desc: Until the end of the next turn, the target cannot avoid the user's moves, even if the target is in the middle of a two-turn move. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field. Fails if this effect is active for the user.
mindreader.shortDesc: User's next move will not miss the target.

minimize.name: Minimize
minimize.desc: Raises the user's evasiveness by 2 stages. Whether or not the user's evasiveness was changed, Body Slam, Dragon Rush, Flying Press, Heat Crash, Heavy Slam, Malicious Moonsault, Steamroller, Stomp, and Supercell Slam will not check accuracy and have their damage doubled if used against the user while it is active.

miracleeye.name: Miracle Eye
miracleeye.desc: As long as the target remains active, its positive evasiveness stat stage is ignored and Psychic-type attacks can hit it if it is a Dark type. The user also takes half damage from Ghost-type attacks until it switches out. On Psychic Terrain, Fairy Tale Field, and Holy Field, the user's Special Attack rises by 2 stages. Fails if the target is already affected, or affected by Foresight or Odor Sleuth.
miracleeye.shortDesc: Psychic hits Dark; ignores Evasion; user resists Ghost; field +2 SpA.

mirrorbeam.name: Mirror Beam
mirrorbeam.desc: Uses the best damage type from Steel and the user's reflected types; field boosts apply.
mirrorbeam.shortDesc: 90 BP; best Steel/reflected type; field boosts.

mirrorcoat.name: Mirror Coat
mirrorcoat.desc: Deals damage to the last opposing Pokemon to hit the user with a special attack this turn equal to twice the HP lost by the user from that attack. If the user did not lose HP from the attack, this move deals 1 HP of damage instead. If that opposing Pokemon's position is no longer in use and there is another opposing Pokemon on the field, the damage is done to it instead. Only the last hit of a multi-hit attack is counted. Fails if the user was not hit by an opposing Pokemon's special attack this turn.
mirrorcoat.shortDesc: If hit by special attack, returns double damage.

mirrormove.name: Mirror Move
mirrormove.desc: The user uses the last move used by the target. The copied move is used against that target, if possible. Fails if the target has not made a move, or if the last move used cannot be copied by this move.
mirrormove.shortDesc: User uses the target's last used move against it.

mirrorshot.name: Mirror Shot
mirrorshot.desc: Has a 30% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1 stage.
mirrorshot.shortDesc: 30% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1.

mist.name: Mist
mist.desc: For 5 turns, or 8 turns during Snow or Hail, the user and its party members are protected from stat drops by opposing Pokemon and opposing Abilities. Allies take 0.75x damage from spread moves, Ice- and Fairy-type allies restore 1/16 max HP each turn, and Misty Terrain is created for 3 turns. On Bewitched Woods, this extends Bewitched Woods instead of creating Misty Terrain. Fails if the effect is already active on the user's side.
mist.shortDesc: Blocks stat drops; weakens spread; heals Ice/Fairy allies.

mistball.name: Mist Ball
mistball.desc: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.
mistball.shortDesc: 50% chance to lower the target's Sp. Atk by 1.

mistyexplosion.name: Misty Explosion
mistyexplosion.desc: If the current terrain is Misty Terrain and the user is grounded, this move's power is multiplied by 1.5. The user faints after using this move, even if this move fails for having no target. This move is prevented from executing if any active Pokemon has the Damp Ability.
mistyexplosion.shortDesc: User faints. User on Misty Terrain: 1.5x power.

mistyterrain.name: Misty Terrain
mistyterrain.desc: For 5 turns, the terrain becomes Misty Terrain. During the effect, Fairy-type attacks are boosted without requiring the user to be grounded, the power of Dragon-type attacks used against grounded Pokemon is multiplied by 0.5, and grounded Pokemon cannot be inflicted with a non-volatile status condition nor confusion. Grounded Pokemon can become affected by Yawn but cannot fall asleep from its effect. Camouflage transforms the user into a Fairy type, Nature Power becomes Moonblast, and Secret Power has a 30% chance to lower Special Attack by 1 stage. Fails if the current terrain is Misty Terrain.
mistyterrain.shortDesc: 5 turns. Fairy moves boosted; grounded Pokemon resist Dragon/status.

moonblast.name: Moonblast
moonblast.desc: Has a 30% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.
moonblast.shortDesc: 30% chance to lower the target's Sp. Atk by 1.

moongeistbeam.name: Moongeist Beam
moongeistbeam.desc: This move and its effects ignore the Abilities of other Pokemon.
moongeistbeam.shortDesc: Ignores the Abilities of other Pokemon.

moonlight.name: Moonlight
moonlight.desc: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP if Delta Stream or no weather conditions are in effect or if the user is holding Utility Umbrella, 2/3 of its maximum HP if the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, and 1/4 of its maximum HP if the weather is Primordial Sea, Rain Dance, Sandstorm, or Snow, all rounded half down.
moonlight.shortDesc: Heals the user by a weather-dependent amount.

morningsun.name: Morning Sun
morningsun.desc: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP if Delta Stream or no weather conditions are in effect or if the user is holding Utility Umbrella, 2/3 of its maximum HP if the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, and 1/4 of its maximum HP if the weather is Primordial Sea, Rain Dance, Sandstorm, or Snow, all rounded half down.
morningsun.shortDesc: Heals the user by a weather-dependent amount.

mortalspin.name: Mortal Spin
mortalspin.desc: Hits one adjacent target and has a 100% chance to poison it. If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the effects of Leech Seed and binding moves end for the user, and all hazards are removed from the user's side of the field.
mortalspin.shortDesc: Poisons one target; clears user's hazards, bind and Leech Seed.

mountaingale.name: Mountain Gale
mountaingale.desc: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.
mountaingale.shortDesc: 30% chance to make the target flinch.

mudbarrage.name: Mud Barrage
mudbarrage.desc: Special Ground-type attack with 25 Base Power and 95% accuracy. Hits two to five times. On Murkwater Surface, the field changes this move to Water type.
mudbarrage.shortDesc: 25 BP special Ground. Hits 2-5 times. Water on Murkwater Surface.

mudbomb.name: Mud Bomb
mudbomb.desc: Has a 30% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1 stage.
mudbomb.shortDesc: 30% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1.

muddywater.name: Muddy Water
muddywater.desc: Has a 30% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1 stage.
muddywater.shortDesc: 30% chance to lower the foe(s) accuracy by 1.

mudshot.name: Mud Shot
mudshot.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.
mudshot.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1.

mudsport.name: Mud Sport
mudsport.desc: For 5 turns, all Electric-type attacks used by any active Pokemon have their power multiplied by 0.33. Fails if this effect is already active.
mudsport.shortDesc: For 5 turns, Electric-type attacks have 1/3 power.

multiattack.name: Multi-Attack
multiattack.desc: This move's type depends on the user's held Memory.
multiattack.shortDesc: Type varies based on the held Memory.

multipulse.name: Multipulse
multipulse.desc: Marianette's move. 80 power; type follows the held Plate. Pulse move. Holy Field adds a 1.3x named boost regardless of Plate type.
multipulse.shortDesc: Marianette's move. Type follows held Plate. Pulse move.

mysticalfire.name: Mystical Fire
mysticalfire.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.
mysticalfire.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the target's Sp. Atk by 1.

mysticalpower.name: Mystical Power
mysticalpower.desc: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Special Attack by 1 stage.
mysticalpower.shortDesc: 100% chance to raise the user's Sp. Atk by 1.

nastyplot.name: Nasty Plot
nastyplot.desc: Raises the user's Special Attack by 2 stages.
nastyplot.shortDesc: Raises the user's Sp. Atk by 2.

naturalgift.name: Natural Gift
naturalgift.desc: The type and power of this move depend on the user's held Berry, and the Berry is lost. Fails if the user is not holding a Berry, if the user has the Klutz Ability, or if Embargo or Magic Room is in effect for the user.
naturalgift.shortDesc: Power and type depends on the user's Berry.

naturepower.name: Nature Power
naturepower.desc: This move calls another move for use based on the battle terrain. Tri Attack on the regular Wi-Fi terrain, Thunderbolt during Electric Terrain, Moonblast during Misty Terrain, Energy Ball during Grassy Terrain, and Psychic during Psychic Terrain.
naturepower.shortDesc: Attack depends on terrain (default Tri Attack).

naturesmadness.name: Nature's Madness
naturesmadness.desc: Deals damage to the target equal to half of its current HP, rounded down, but not less than 1 HP.
naturesmadness.shortDesc: Does damage equal to 1/2 target's current HP.

needlearm.name: Needle Arm
needlearm.desc: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.
needlearm.shortDesc: 30% chance to make the target flinch.

needlegun.name: Needle Gun
needlegun.desc: A 30 Base Power Steel-type attack that hits exactly six times. Its category matches the chosen attacking stat (Physical on a tie). It uses whichever is higher, the user's Attack or Special Attack, against whichever is lower, the target's Defense or Special Defense.
needlegun.shortDesc: Hits 6 times; adaptive category; higher offense vs lower defense.

neverendingnightmare.name: Never-Ending Nightmare
neverendingnightmare.desc: A one-use Ghost-type Z-Move. Its power depends on the damaging Ghost-type move selected as its base.
neverendingnightmare.shortDesc: Power depends on the base Ghost-type move.

nightdaze.name: Night Daze
nightdaze.desc: Has a 40% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1 stage.
nightdaze.shortDesc: 40% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1.

nightmare.name: Nightmare
nightmare.desc: Causes the target to lose 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn as long as it is asleep. This move does not affect the target unless it is asleep. The effect ends when the target wakes up, even if it falls asleep again in the same turn.
nightmare.shortDesc: A sleeping target is hurt by 1/4 max HP per turn.

nightshade.name: Night Shade
nightshade.desc: Deals damage to the target equal to the user's level.
nightshade.shortDesc: Does damage equal to the user's level.

nightslash.name: Night Slash
nightslash.desc: Has 80 Base Power and a higher chance for a critical hit.

nihillight.name: Nihil Light
nihillight.desc: Hits all adjacent foes, ignoring their evasion and defensive stat changes. Fairy-type targets remain immune to this Dragon-type move.
nihillight.shortDesc: Hits adjacent foes; ignores evasion and defensive stat changes.

nobleroar.name: Noble Roar
nobleroar.desc: Lowers the target's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage.
nobleroar.shortDesc: Lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk by 1.

nomoswish.name: Nomos' Wish
nomoswish.desc: Noel's move. Raises Defense and Sp. Def by 1 and sets native Wish in the user’s position, healing at the end of the following turn. Field effects: Misty, Rainbow, Fairy Tale, Holy and Starlight Arena: native Wish restores 75% maximum HP. Misty Aura and Rainbow Aura also grant this healing snapshot.
nomoswish.shortDesc: Noel's move. +1 Defense and Sp. Def; sets Wish.

noretreat.name: No Retreat
noretreat.desc: Raises the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage, but it becomes prevented from switching out. The user can still switch out if it uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. Fails if the user has already been prevented from switching by this effect.
noretreat.shortDesc: Raises all stats by 1 (not acc/eva). Traps user.

nostraswish.name: Nostras Wish
nostraswish.desc: Anna's move. At +1 setup priority, schedules a 140-power Fairy attack on the opposing position 2 turns later, and a Wish on the user position at the end of the following turn. Ordinary healing stores half the original caster maximum HP rounded up; native field-enhanced healing is preserved. Misty Aura or Rainbow Aura stores 75% healing at setup. The two slots succeed independently. Setup does not count as a healing move. At impact, it is super effective against Steel only in Starlight Arena or New World. Its attack receives a total 2x field boost in weatherless Starlight Arena and 4x in New World.
nostraswish.shortDesc: Anna's move. +1 priority; delayed Fairy attack in 2 turns; sets Wish.

noxioustorque.name: Noxious Torque
noxioustorque.desc: Has a 30% chance to poison the target.

nuzzle.name: Nuzzle
nuzzle.desc: Has a 100% chance to paralyze the target.

oblivionwing.name: Oblivion Wing
oblivionwing.desc: The user recovers 3/4 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.
oblivionwing.shortDesc: User recovers 75% of the damage dealt.

obstruct.name: Obstruct
obstruct.desc: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn, and Pokemon trying to make contact with the user have their Defense lowered by 2 stages. Non-damaging moves go through this protection. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.
obstruct.shortDesc: Protects from damaging attacks. Contact: -2 Def.

oceanicoperetta.name: Oceanic Operetta
oceanicoperetta.desc: Primarina's exclusive Z-Move, used through Sparkling Aria. No additional effect.
oceanicoperetta.shortDesc: Exclusive Primarina Z-Move; no additional effect.

octazooka.name: Octazooka
octazooka.desc: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1 stage.
octazooka.shortDesc: 50% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1.

octolock.name: Octolock
octolock.desc: Prevents the target from switching out. At the end of each turn during effect, the target's Defense, Special Defense, and Speed are lowered by 1 stage. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field.
octolock.shortDesc: Traps target, lowers Def, SpD, and Spe by 1 each turn.

odorsleuth.name: Odor Sleuth
odorsleuth.desc: As long as the target remains active, its positive evasiveness stat stage is ignored and Normal- and Fighting-type attacks can hit it if it is a Ghost type. The user also takes half damage from Ghost-type attacks until it switches out. Fails if the target is already affected, or affected by Foresight or Miracle Eye.
odorsleuth.shortDesc: Normal/Fighting hit Ghost; ignores Evasion; user resists Ghost.

ominouswind.name: Ominous Wind
ominouswind.desc: Has a 10% chance to raise the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage.
ominouswind.shortDesc: 10% chance to raise all stats by 1 (not acc/eva).

orderup.name: Order Up
orderup.desc: If an ally Tatsugiri has activated its Commander Ability, this move raises the user's Attack by 1 stage if the Tatsugiri is Curly Form, Defense by 1 stage if Droopy Form, or Speed by 1 stage if Stretchy Form. The effect happens even if the Tatsugiri that activated the effect has since fainted.

originpulse.name: Origin Pulse
originpulse.shortDesc: No additional effect. Hits adjacent foes.

outrage.name: Outrage
outrage.desc: Has a 30% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1. Choose an adjacent opposing Pokemon on the initial turn. Forced continuation turns target an opposing Pokemon at random. Locks the user into this move for 2-3 turns, then confuses the user if it is not already confused. If the user cannot act, starts a turn asleep, or fails to hit before the final locked turn, the lock ends without confusion. Sleep Talk uses it once without confusion while the user is asleep. Sheer Force removes the 30% effect and gives its normal power boost once; the lock and ending confusion remain. Raging Storm makes it a single-turn attack with no lock or ending confusion; it does not cure existing confusion. On Superheated Field, the lock ends after the attack; ending it early does not cause confusion.
outrage.shortDesc: 30% -1 target Def. Locks 2-3 turns, then confuses user. Choose initial foe; later hits random.

overheat.name: Overheat
overheat.desc: Lowers the user's Special Attack by 2 stages.
overheat.shortDesc: Lowers the user's Sp. Atk by 2.

painsplit.name: Pain Split
painsplit.desc: The user and the target's HP become the average of their current HP, rounded down, but not more than the maximum HP of either one.
painsplit.shortDesc: Shares HP of user and target equally.

paleowave.name: Paleo Wave
paleowave.desc: Has a 20% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.
paleowave.shortDesc: 20% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1.

paraboliccharge.name: Parabolic Charge
paraboliccharge.desc: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.
paraboliccharge.shortDesc: User recovers 50% of the damage dealt.

partingshot.name: Parting Shot
partingshot.desc: Lowers the target's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage. If this move is successful, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if the target's Attack and Special Attack stat stages were both unchanged, or if there are no unfainted party members.
partingshot.shortDesc: Lowers target's Atk, Sp. Atk by 1. User switches.

payback.name: Payback
payback.desc: Usually moves after other attacks (-4 priority). Power doubles from 80 to 160 if the target already damaged the user this turn. Has a higher chance for a critical hit.
payback.shortDesc: 80 BP; 160 if target hurt user this turn. High crit.

perishsong.name: Perish Song
perishsong.desc: Each active Pokemon receives a perish count of 4 if it doesn't already have a perish count. At the end of each turn including the turn used, the perish count of all active Pokemon lowers by 1 and Pokemon faint if the number reaches 0. The perish count is removed from Pokemon that switch out. If a Pokemon uses Baton Pass while it has a perish count, the replacement will gain the perish count and continue to count down.
perishsong.shortDesc: All active Pokemon will faint in 3 turns.

petalblizzard.name: Petal Blizzard
petalblizzard.shortDesc: No additional effect. Hits adjacent Pokemon.

petaldance.name: Petal Dance
petaldance.desc: Has a 30% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1. Choose an adjacent opposing Pokemon on the initial turn. Forced continuation turns target an opposing Pokemon at random. Locks the user into this move for 2-3 turns, then confuses the user if it is not already confused. If the user cannot act, starts a turn asleep, or fails to hit before the final locked turn, the lock ends without confusion. Sleep Talk uses it once without confusion while the user is asleep. Sheer Force removes the 30% effect and gives its normal power boost once; the lock and ending confusion remain. Raging Storm makes it a single-turn attack with no lock or ending confusion; it does not cure existing confusion. On Superheated Field, the lock ends after the attack; ending it early does not cause confusion.
petaldance.shortDesc: 30% -1 target SpD. Locks 2-3 turns, then confuses user. Choose initial foe; later hits random.

phantomforce.name: Phantom Force
phantomforce.desc: If this move is successful, it breaks through the target's Baneful Bunker, Detect, King's Shield, Protect, or Spiky Shield for this turn, allowing other Pokemon to attack the target normally. If the target's side is protected by Crafty Shield, Mat Block, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard, that protection is also broken for this turn and other Pokemon may attack the target's side normally. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.
phantomforce.shortDesc: Disappears turn 1. Hits turn 2. Breaks protection.

photongeyser.name: Photon Geyser
photongeyser.desc: This move becomes a physical attack if the user's Attack is greater than its Special Attack, including stat stage changes. This move and its effects ignore the Abilities of other Pokemon.
photongeyser.shortDesc: Physical if user's Atk > Sp. Atk. Ignores Abilities.

pikapapow.name: Pika Papow
pikapapow.desc: Power is equal to the greater of (user's Happiness * 2/5), rounded down, or 1.

pinmissile.name: Pin Missile
pinmissile.desc: Hits two to five times. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 5-6 times.

plasmafists.name: Plasma Fists
plasmafists.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit. If this move succeeds, it turns Normal-type moves into Electric-type moves for the rest of the turn and creates Electric Aura for 3 turns, or 5 with Amplifield Rock, without replacing the base field. Existing Electric Terrain or Electric Aura is left unchanged, including its remaining duration and promotion eligibility. A new Aura created by this move cannot promote into Electric Terrain. If Electric Terrain can be set, this move gains 30% power.
plasmafists.shortDesc: High crit; electrifies Normal moves; creates Electric Aura only if no Electric field/Aura exists.

playnice.name: Play Nice
playnice.desc: Lowers the target's Attack by 1 stage.

playrough.name: Play Rough
playrough.desc: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.
playrough.shortDesc: 10% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1.

pluck.name: Pluck
pluck.desc: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, it steals the target's held Berry if it is holding one and eats it immediately, gaining its effects even if the user's item is being ignored. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.
pluck.shortDesc: User steals and eats the target's Berry.

poisonfang.name: Poison Fang
poisonfang.desc: Has a 50% chance to badly poison the target.
poisonfang.shortDesc: 50% chance to badly poison the target.

poisonjab.name: Poison Jab
poisonjab.desc: Has a 30% chance to poison the target.

poisonsting.name: Poison Sting
poisonsting.desc: Has a 30% chance to poison the target.

poisonsweep.name: Poison Sweep
poisonsweep.desc: Makes contact. Has a 30% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

poisontail.name: Poison Tail
poisontail.desc: Power doubles if the target has a non-volatile status condition, including frostbite. Confusion and other volatile conditions do not count.
poisontail.shortDesc: Power doubles if the target has a major status.

polarflare.name: Polar Flare
polarflare.desc: Has a 10% chance to freeze the target. This move cannot thaw a frozen target. If this move is successful on at least one target and the user is a Ramnarok, it changes to Radiant Forme if it is currently in Dormant Forme, or changes to Dormant Forme if it is currently in Radiant Forme. This forme change does not happen if the Ramnarok has the Sheer Force Ability. The Radiant Forme reverts to Dormant Forme when Ramnarok is not active.
polarflare.shortDesc: 10% chance to frz foe(s). Ramnarok transforms.

pollenpuff.name: Pollen Puff
pollenpuff.desc: If the target is an ally, this move restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down, instead of dealing damage.
pollenpuff.shortDesc: If the target is an ally, heals 50% of its max HP.

poltergeist.name: Poltergeist
poltergeist.desc: Fails if the target has no held item.
poltergeist.shortDesc: Fails if the target has no held item.

populationbomb.name: Population Bomb
populationbomb.desc: Hits ten times. This move checks accuracy for each hit, and the attack ends if the target avoids a hit. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit ten times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move hits four to ten times at random without checking accuracy between hits.
populationbomb.shortDesc: Hits 10 times. Each hit can miss.

pounce.name: Pounce
pounce.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.
pounce.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1.

powder.name: Powder
powder.desc: This move has +1 priority. The target is covered in powder until it tries to use a Fire-type move. When triggered, the Fire move is prevented and each active Pokemon on that target's side loses 1/4 max HP. This effect does not happen if Primordial Sea prevents the Fire move first.
powder.shortDesc: +1 priority. Fire move fails; target's active side loses 1/4 HP.

powdersnow.name: Powder Snow
powdersnow.desc: Has a 10% chance to freeze the target.

powershift.name: Power Shift
powershift.desc: The user swaps its Attack and Defense stats, and stat stage changes remain on their respective stats. This move can be used again to swap the stats back. If the user uses Baton Pass, the replacement will have its Attack and Defense stats swapped if the effect is active. If the user has its stats recalculated by changing forme while its stats are swapped, this effect is ignored but is still active for the purposes of Baton Pass.
powershift.shortDesc: Switches user's Attack and Defense stats.

powersplit.name: Power Split
powersplit.desc: The user and the target have their Attack and Special Attack stats set to be equal to the average of the user and the target's Attack and Special Attack stats, respectively, rounded down. Stat stage changes are unaffected.
powersplit.shortDesc: Averages Attack and Sp. Atk stats with target.

powerswap.name: Power Swap
powerswap.desc: The user swaps its Attack and Special Attack stat stage changes with the target.
powerswap.shortDesc: Swaps Attack and Sp. Atk stat stages with target.

powertrick.name: Power Trick
powertrick.desc: The user swaps its Attack and Defense stats, and stat stage changes remain on their respective stats. This move can be used again to swap the stats back. If the user uses Baton Pass, the replacement will have its Attack and Defense stats swapped if the effect is active. If the user has its stats recalculated by changing forme while its stats are swapped, this effect is ignored but is still active for the purposes of Baton Pass.
powertrick.shortDesc: Switches user's Attack and Defense stats.

powertrip.name: Power Trip
powertrip.desc: Power is equal to 20+(X*20), where X is the user's total stat stage changes that are greater than 0.
powertrip.shortDesc: + 20 power for each of the user's stat boosts.

poweruppunch.name: Power-Up Punch
poweruppunch.desc: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Attack by 1 stage.
poweruppunch.shortDesc: 100% chance to raise the user's Attack by 1.

precipiceblades.name: Precipice Blades
precipiceblades.shortDesc: No additional effect. Hits adjacent foes.

present.name: Present
present.desc: If this move is successful, it deals damage or heals the target. 40% chance for 40 power, 30% chance for 80 power, 10% chance for 120 power, and 20% chance to heal the target by 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down. If the user has Evil Santa, this move becomes a 120 Base Power Dark-type attack that targets all opposing Pokemon and applies one successful random extra effect.
present.shortDesc: Random power/heal. Evil Santa: 120 BP Dark spread.

prismaticlaser.name: Prismatic Laser
prismaticlaser.desc: Has a 50% chance to put the target to sleep. If this move succeeds and does not knock out the target, the user must recharge on the next turn.
prismaticlaser.shortDesc: 50% sleep; recharges next turn unless it gets a KO.

protect.name: Protect
protect.desc: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.
protect.shortDesc: Prevents moves from affecting the user this turn.

psybeam.name: Psybeam
psybeam.desc: Has a high critical-hit ratio and a 10% chance to confuse the target. This move is boosted by Mega Launcher and Dual Wield.
psybeam.shortDesc: High critical-hit ratio; 10% confusion; launcher/Dual Wield boost.

psyblade.name: Psyblade
psyblade.desc: If the current terrain is Electric Terrain, this move's power is multiplied by 1.5.

psychic.name: Psychic
psychic.desc: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.
psychic.shortDesc: 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.

psychicfangs.name: Psychic Fangs
psychicfangs.desc: If this attack does not miss, the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, and Aurora Veil end for the target's side of the field before damage is calculated.
psychicfangs.shortDesc: Destroys screens, unless the target is immune.

psychicnoise.name: Psychic Noise
psychicnoise.desc: For 2 turns, the target is prevented from restoring any HP as long as it remains active. During the effect, healing and draining moves are unusable, and Abilities and items that grant healing will not heal the user. If an affected Pokemon uses Baton Pass, the replacement will remain unable to restore its HP. Pain Split and the Regenerator Ability are unaffected.
psychicnoise.shortDesc: For 2 turns, the target is prevented from healing.

psychicterrain.name: Psychic Terrain
psychicterrain.desc: For 5 turns, the terrain becomes Psychic Terrain. During the effect, the power of Psychic-type attacks made by grounded Pokemon is multiplied by 1.3 and grounded Pokemon cannot be hit by moves with priority greater than 0, unless the target is an ally. Camouflage transforms the user into a Psychic type, Nature Power becomes Psychic, and Secret Power has a 30% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage. Fails if the current terrain is Psychic Terrain.

psychoboost.name: Psycho Boost
psychoboost.desc: Lowers the user's Special Attack by 2 stages.
psychoboost.shortDesc: Lowers the user's Sp. Atk by 2.

psychocut.name: Psycho Cut
psychocut.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

psychoshift.name: Psycho Shift
psychoshift.desc: The user's non-volatile status condition is transferred to the target, and the user is then cured. Fails if the user has no non-volatile status condition or if the target already has one.
psychoshift.shortDesc: Transfers the user's status ailment to the target.

psychup.name: Psych Up
psychup.desc: The user copies all of the target's current stat stage changes.
psychup.shortDesc: Copies the target's current stat stages.

psyshieldbash.name: Psyshield Bash
psyshieldbash.desc: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Defense by 1 stage.
psyshieldbash.shortDesc: 100% chance to raise the user's Defense by 1.

psyshock.name: Psyshock
psyshock.desc: Deals damage to the target based on its Defense instead of Special Defense.
psyshock.shortDesc: Damages target based on Defense, not Sp. Def.

psystrike.name: Psystrike
psystrike.desc: Deals damage to the target based on its Defense instead of Special Defense.
psystrike.shortDesc: Damages target based on Defense, not Sp. Def.

psywave.name: Psywave
psywave.desc: Deals damage to the target equal to (user's level) * (X + 50) / 100, where X is a random number from 0 to 100, rounded down, but not less than 1 HP.
psywave.shortDesc: Random damage equal to 0.5x-1.5x user's level.

pulverizingpancake.name: Pulverizing Pancake
pulverizingpancake.desc: Snorlax's exclusive Z-Move, used through Giga Impact. No additional effect.
pulverizingpancake.shortDesc: Exclusive Snorlax Z-Move; no additional effect.

punchypummel.name: Punchy Pummel
punchypummel.desc: Lowers the target's Defense and Speed by 1 stage after a successful hit.
punchypummel.shortDesc: Lowers Defense and Speed by 1 after a successful hit.

punishment.name: Punishment
punishment.desc: Power is equal to 60+(X*20), where X is the target's total stat stage changes that are greater than 0, but not more than 160 power. This move ignores the target's stat boosts when calculating damage.
punishment.shortDesc: 60 BP +20 per target boost, max 160. Ignores boosts.

purify.name: Purify
purify.desc: The target is cured if it has a non-volatile status condition. If the target was cured, the user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down.
purify.shortDesc: Cures target's status; heals user 1/2 max HP if so.

pursuit.name: Pursuit
pursuit.desc: If an opposing Pokemon switches out this turn, this move hits that Pokemon before it leaves the field, even if it was not the original target. If the user moves after an opponent using Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch, but not Baton Pass, it will hit that opponent before it leaves the field. Power doubles and no accuracy check is done if the user hits an opponent switching out, and the user's turn is over; if an opponent faints from this, the replacement Pokemon does not become active until the end of the turn.
pursuit.shortDesc: If a foe is switching out, hits it at 2x power.

pyroball.name: Pyro Ball
pyroball.desc: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.
pyroball.shortDesc: 10% chance to burn the target. Thaws user.

quash.name: Quash
quash.desc: Causes the target to take its turn after all other Pokemon this turn, no matter the priority of its selected move. Fails if the target already moved this turn.
quash.shortDesc: Forces the target to move last this turn.

queensgambit.name: Queen's Gambit
queensgambit.desc: Radomus's move. Uses the higher current Attack or Sp. Atk and corresponding defense; ties use Special. Lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def by 1 afterward. Field effects: Uses Chess move and piece rules. A Queen always lands a critical hit. Target Opportunist halves and Gorilla Tactics doubles the matchup modifier; user Klutz makes the move fail.
queensgambit.shortDesc: Radomus's move. Adaptive; lowers user's Defense and Sp. Def by 1.

quickguard.name: Quick Guard
quickguard.desc: The user and its party members are protected from attacks with original or altered priority greater than 0 made by other Pokemon, including allies, during this turn. This move modifies the same 1/X chance of being successful used by other protection moves, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used, but does not use the chance to check for failure. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn or if this move is already in effect for the user's side.
quickguard.shortDesc: Protects allies from priority attacks this turn.

quiverdance.name: Quiver Dance
quiverdance.desc: Raises the user's Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage.
quiverdance.shortDesc: Raises the user's Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, Speed by 1.

radiantassault.name: Radiant Assault
radiantassault.desc: Hits all opposing Pokemon and uses the higher offensive stat, including stages and field modifiers. Against active Mega, Dynamax/Gmax or Stellar-Terastallized targets, is 2x effective and deals another 1.2x damage, each once even if states overlap. Other Tera types, Primal and Ultra forms do not qualify. Recharges unless it knocks out at least one target.
radiantassault.shortDesc: Adaptive spread; 2x effective and 1.2x damage vs Mega/Dynamax/Stellar Tera. Recharges unless KO.

radiantclaw.name: Radiant Claw
radiantclaw.desc: A 120-power Fairy-type slicing move with a high critical-hit ratio. Makes contact and deals one quarter of its normal recoil to the user.
radiantclaw.shortDesc: 120 BP; slicing; high crit; 1/4 recoil; contact.

rage.name: Rage
rage.desc: Raises the user's Attack by 1 stage after it hits. If the user was hit by a damaging move before it attacks this turn, this move's power is doubled.
rage.shortDesc: Raises user's Attack by 1 on hit. 2x power if user was hit first.

ragefist.name: Rage Fist
ragefist.desc: Starts at 50 power and gains 20 power per qualifying hit taken, up to 150 after five hits. Switching preserves the accumulated bonus. New hits add 20, capped at 100 bonus power. Retains existing hit eligibility, Transform copying and progress through fainting/revival. In Free-for-All, hits all adjacent foes at full spread power.
ragefist.shortDesc: 50 BP +20 per hit taken, max 150; progress persists on switching.

ragepowder.name: Rage Powder
ragepowder.desc: Until the end of the turn, opposing single-target attacks are redirected to the user. In Free-for-All battles, this targets one opponent and redirects only that opponent's attacks. The user takes 0.75x damage from redirected moves and heals 1/8 max HP if it redirects 2 or more attacks. This effect is ignored during Sky Drop.
ragepowder.shortDesc: Redirects attacks. FFA: pick one foe; 0.75x damage, 2+ heals.

ragingbull.name: Raging Bull
ragingbull.desc: If this attack does not miss, the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, and Aurora Veil end for the target's side of the field before damage is calculated. If the user's current form is a Paldean Tauros, this move's type changes to match. Fighting type for Combat Breed, Fire type for Blaze Breed, and Water type for Aqua Breed.
ragingbull.shortDesc: Destroys screens. Type depends on user's form.

ragingfury.name: Raging Fury
ragingfury.desc: Has a 30% chance to burn the target. Choose an adjacent opposing Pokemon on the initial turn. Forced continuation turns target an opposing Pokemon at random. Locks the user into this move for 2-3 turns, then confuses the user if it is not already confused. If the user cannot act, starts a turn asleep, or fails to hit before the final locked turn, the lock ends without confusion. Sleep Talk uses it once without confusion while the user is asleep. Sheer Force removes the 30% effect and gives its normal power boost once; the lock and ending confusion remain. Raging Storm makes it a single-turn attack with no lock or ending confusion; it does not cure existing confusion. On Burning or Volcanic Field, ending the rampage does not cause confusion. On Volcanic Field, each use also raises the user's Attack by 1.
ragingfury.shortDesc: 30% burn. Locks 2-3 turns, then confuses user. Choose initial foe; later hits random.

raindance.name: Rain Dance
raindance.desc: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Rain Dance. The damage of Water-type attacks is multiplied by 1.5 and the damage of Fire-type attacks is multiplied by 0.5 during the effect. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Damp Rock. Fails if the current weather is Rain Dance.
raindance.shortDesc: For 5 turns, heavy rain powers Water moves.

rapidspin.name: Rapid Spin
rapidspin.desc: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the effects of Leech Seed and binding moves end for the user, and all hazards are removed from the user's side of the field. Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage.
rapidspin.shortDesc: Free user from hazards/bind/Leech Seed; +1 Spe.

razorleaf.name: Razor Leaf
razorleaf.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.
razorleaf.shortDesc: High critical hit ratio. Hits adjacent foes.

razorshell.name: Razor Shell
razorshell.desc: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.
razorshell.shortDesc: 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.

razorwind.name: Razor Wind
razorwind.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the charge turn, it creates Tailwind for 2 turns, with normal field interactions. If Tailwind is already active on the user's side, the move completes in one turn. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.
razorwind.shortDesc: Charges with 2-turn Tailwind; fires immediately in Tailwind.

recover.name: Recover
recover.desc: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.
recover.shortDesc: Heals the user by 50% of its max HP.

recycle.name: Recycle
recycle.desc: The user regains the item it last used. Fails if the user is holding an item, if the user has not held an item, if the item was a popped Air Balloon, if the item was picked up by a Pokemon with the Pickup Ability, or if the item was lost to Bug Bite, Corrosive Gas, Covet, Incinerate, Knock Off, Pluck, or Thief. Items thrown with Fling can be regained.
recycle.shortDesc: Restores the item the user last used.

reflect.name: Reflect
reflect.desc: For 5 turns, the user and its party members take 0.5x damage from physical attacks, or 0.66x damage if in a Double Battle. Damage is not reduced further with Aurora Veil. Critical hits ignore this effect. It is removed from the user's side if the user or an ally is successfully hit by Brick Break, Psychic Fangs, or Defog. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Light Clay. Fails if the effect is already active on the user's side.
reflect.shortDesc: For 5 turns, physical damage to allies is halved.

reflecttype.name: Reflect Type
reflecttype.desc: Causes the user's types to become the same as the current types of the target. If the target's current types include typeless and a non-added type, typeless is ignored. If the target's current types include typeless and an added type from Forest's Curse or Trick-or-Treat, typeless is copied as the Normal type instead. Fails if the user is an Arceus or a Silvally, if the user is Terastallized, or if the target's current type is typeless alone.
reflecttype.shortDesc: User becomes the target's types; Reflector refreshes copied types without replacing its typing.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.desc: The user cures its non-volatile status condition. If a status was cured, the user restores 1/4 of its maximum HP. If the user was not statused, it restores 1/8 of its maximum HP instead.
refresh.shortDesc: Cures status and heals 1/4; no status heals 1/8.

relicsong.name: Relic Song
relicsong.desc: Has a 10% chance to cause the target to fall asleep. If this move is successful on at least one target and the user is a Meloetta, it changes to Pirouette Forme if it is currently in Aria Forme, or changes to Aria Forme if it is currently in Pirouette Forme. This forme change does not happen if the Meloetta has the Sheer Force Ability. The Pirouette Forme reverts to Aria Forme when Meloetta is not active.
relicsong.shortDesc: 10% chance to sleep foe(s). Meloetta transforms.

rest.name: Rest
rest.desc: The user falls asleep for the next two turns and restores all of its HP, curing itself of any non-volatile status condition in the process. Fails if the user has full HP, is already asleep, or if another effect is preventing sleep.
rest.shortDesc: User sleeps 2 turns and restores HP and status.

retaliate.name: Retaliate
retaliate.desc: Power doubles if one of the user's party members fainted last turn.
retaliate.shortDesc: Power doubles if an ally fainted last turn.

return.name: Return
return.desc: Power is equal to the greater of (user's Happiness * 2/5), rounded down, or 1.

revelationdance.name: Revelation Dance
revelationdance.desc: This move's type depends on the user's primary type. If the user's primary type is typeless, this move's type is the user's secondary type if it has one, otherwise the added type from Forest's Curse or Trick-or-Treat. This move is typeless if the user's type is typeless alone.
revelationdance.shortDesc: Type varies based on the user's primary type.

revenge.name: Revenge
revenge.desc: Usually moves after other attacks (-4 priority). Power doubles from 80 to 160 if the target already damaged the user this turn. Has a higher chance for a critical hit.
revenge.shortDesc: 80 BP; 160 if target hurt user this turn. High crit.

reversal.name: Reversal
reversal.desc: The power of this move is 20 if X is 33 to 48, 40 if X is 17 to 32, 80 if X is 10 to 16, 100 if X is 5 to 9, 150 if X is 2 to 4, and 200 if X is 0 or 1, where X is equal to (user's current HP * 48 / user's maximum HP), rounded down.
reversal.shortDesc: More power the less HP the user has left.

revivalblessing.name: Revival Blessing
revivalblessing.desc: A fainted party member is selected and revived with 1/2 its max HP, rounded down. Fails if there are no fainted party members.
revivalblessing.shortDesc: Revives a fainted Pokemon to 50% HP.

risingvoltage.name: Rising Voltage
risingvoltage.desc: If the current terrain is Electric Terrain and the target is grounded, this move's power is doubled.
risingvoltage.shortDesc: 2x power if target is grounded in Electric Terrain.

roar.name: Roar
roar.desc: The target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. Fails if the target is the last unfainted Pokemon in its party, or if the target used Ingrain previously or has the Suction Cups Ability.
roar.shortDesc: Forces the target to switch to a random ally.

roaroftime.name: Roar of Time
roaroftime.desc: Uses the user's higher offensive stat. When used by Dialga, Fairy-type targets take resisted Dragon damage instead of being immune, the move breaks protection, has +3 priority in Trick Room, and a non-KO hit queues another Roar of Time two turns later. A missed delayed hit is sent further into the future. For any user, a direct opposing KO removes recharge.
roaroftime.shortDesc: Uses higher offense. Dialga: breaks Protect, future hit, Fairies resist, +3 in Trick Room.

rockblast.name: Rock Blast
rockblast.desc: Hits two to five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 5-6 times.

rockclimb.name: Rock Climb
rockclimb.desc: Has a 30% chance to confuse the target. If this move hits a confused target, the user's Attack and Speed rise by 1 stage. On Mountain, Rocky, Cave, and Desert fields, this move has a high critical hit ratio.
rockclimb.shortDesc: 30% confuse. Vs confused: +Atk/Spe. +crit on rough fields.

rocknroll.name: Rockn'Roll
rocknroll.desc: Hardy's move. Lowers the target Defense by 1 and sets Stealth Rock on its side. Cannot place Stealth Rock in Midnight Zone.
rocknroll.shortDesc: Hardy's move. Lowers Defense by 1; sets Stealth Rock.

rockpolish.name: Rock Polish
rockpolish.desc: Raises the user's Speed by 2 stages.

rockslide.name: Rock Slide
rockslide.desc: Has a 20% chance to make each target flinch.
rockslide.shortDesc: 20% chance to make the foe(s) flinch.

rocksmash.name: Rock Smash
rocksmash.desc: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage. If this lowers Defense, the user's next Fighting-, Rock-, or Ground-type move against that target deals 1.3x damage. If the target already has lowered Defense, this move hits twice.
rocksmash.shortDesc: 50% -1 Def; next hit 1.3x. Hits twice if Def is down.

rocktomb.name: Rock Tomb
rocktomb.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.
rocktomb.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1.

rockwrecker.name: Rock Wrecker
rockwrecker.desc: A successful hit has a 60% chance to paralyze the surviving target. Protect, misses, immunity and Substitute prevent paralysis; Shield Dust and Covert Cloak block this secondary effect. The user must recharge after a successful hit unless the target faints.
rockwrecker.shortDesc: 60% paralysis on hit; recharge unless it KOs.

rockyrampage.name: Rocky Rampage
rockyrampage.desc: After a successful hit, sets Stealth Rock on the target's side if it is not already active.
rockyrampage.shortDesc: After hitting, sets Stealth Rock on the target's side.

roleplay.name: Role Play
roleplay.desc: The user's Ability changes to match the target's Ability. Fails if the user's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, Zero to Hero, or already matches the target, or if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Trace, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.
roleplay.shortDesc: User replaces its Ability with the target's.

rollingkick.name: Rolling Kick
rollingkick.desc: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.
rollingkick.shortDesc: 30% chance to make the target flinch.

rollout.name: Rollout
rollout.desc: If this move is successful, the user is locked into this move and cannot make another move until it misses, 5 turns have passed, or the attack cannot be used. Power doubles with each successful hit of this move and doubles again if Defense Curl was used previously by the user. If this move is called by Sleep Talk, the move is used for one turn.
rollout.shortDesc: Power doubles with each hit. Repeats for 5 turns.
