winddance.shortDesc: Ciel's move. Sets 4-turn Strong Winds after a hit; +1 priority in them.

wish.name: Wish
wish.desc: At the end of the next turn, the Pokemon at the user's position has 1/2 of the user's maximum HP restored to it, rounded down. Fails if this move is already in effect for the user's position.
wish.shortDesc: Next turn, 50% of the user's max HP is restored.

wisteriamaelstrom.name: Wisteria Maelstrom
wisteriamaelstrom.desc: Laura's move. Uses higher staged Attack or Sp. Atk with matching defense (Special on ties). After a hit, each active allied Grass or Bug Pokemon raises its higher staged offense by 1, once per use (Sp. Atk on ties). Grows Flower Garden by one stage per damaging use, up to stage 5.
wisteriamaelstrom.shortDesc: Laura's move. Adaptive; hit boosts active Grass/Bug allies' stronger offense.

withdraw.name: Withdraw
withdraw.desc: Raises the user's Defense by 1 stage.

wonderroom.name: Wonder Room
wonderroom.desc: For 5 turns, all active Pokemon have their Defense and Special Defense stats swapped. Stat stage changes are unaffected. If this move is used during the effect, the effect ends.
wonderroom.shortDesc: For 5 turns, all Defense and Sp. Def stats switch.

woodhammer.name: Wood Hammer
woodhammer.desc: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

workup.name: Work Up
workup.desc: Raises the user's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage.
workup.shortDesc: Raises the user's Attack and Sp. Atk by 1.

worryseed.name: Worry Seed
worryseed.desc: Causes the target's Ability to become Insomnia. Fails if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Insomnia, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Truant, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.

wrap.name: Wrap
wrap.desc: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.
wrap.shortDesc: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.

wringout.name: Wring Out
wringout.desc: Power is equal to 120 * (target's current HP / target's maximum HP), rounded half down, but not less than 1.
wringout.shortDesc: More power the more HP the target has left.

yawn.name: Yawn
yawn.desc: Causes the target to fall asleep at the end of the next turn. Fails when used if the target cannot fall asleep or if it already has a non-volatile status condition. At the end of the next turn, if the target is still active, does not have a non-volatile status condition, and can fall asleep, it falls asleep. If the target becomes affected, this effect cannot be prevented by Safeguard or a substitute, or by falling asleep and waking up during the effect.
yawn.shortDesc: Puts the target to sleep after 1 turn.

zapcannon.name: Zap Cannon
zapcannon.desc: Has a 100% chance to paralyze the target.

zenheadbutt.name: Zen Headbutt
zenheadbutt.desc: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.
zenheadbutt.shortDesc: 20% chance to make the target flinch.

zingzap.name: Zing Zap
zingzap.desc: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.
zingzap.shortDesc: 30% chance to make the target flinch.

zippyzap.name: Zippy Zap
zippyzap.desc: Usually moves before other attacks. This move will always result in a critical hit.

aguavberry.name: Aguav Berry
aguavberry.desc: Restores 1/2 max HP at 1/4 max HP or less; confuses if -SpD Nature. Single use.
aguavberry.shortDesc: Restores 1/2 max HP at 1/4 max HP or less; confuses if -SpD Nature. Single use.

anomalycore.name: Anomaly Core
anomalycore.desc: Allows designated Pokemon to undergo Pulse/Rift Evolution. Pulse and Rift forms cannot have a Substitute; existing or transferred substitutes break. Camerupt must be at full HP immediately before Pulse Evolution or it faints.
anomalycore.shortDesc: Pulse/Rift Evolution; no Substitute. Camerupt must be at full HP or faints.

apicotberry.name: Apicot Berry
apicotberry.desc: Raises holder's Sp. Def by 1 stage when at 1/4 max HP or less. Single use.
apicotberry.shortDesc: Raises holder's Sp. Def by 1 stage when at 1/4 max HP or less. Single use.

blacksludge.name: Black Sludge
blacksludge.desc: Each turn, Poison types or Parasitism holders heal 1/16 max HP; others lose 1/8.
blacksludge.shortDesc: Each turn, Poison types or Parasitism holders heal 1/16 max HP; others lose 1/8.

bugmemory.name: Bug Memory
bugmemory.desc: Holder's Multi-Attack is Bug type. RKS System gives Tinted Lens and Shield Dust.
bugmemory.shortDesc: Holder's Multi-Attack is Bug type. RKS System gives Tinted Lens and Shield Dust.

choiceband.name: Choice Band
choiceband.desc: Holder's Attack is 1.5x, but it can only select the first move it executes.
choiceband.shortDesc: Holder's Attack is 1.5x, but it can only select the first move it executes.

choicescarf.name: Choice Scarf
choicescarf.desc: Holder's Speed is 1.5x, but it can only select the first move it executes.
choicescarf.shortDesc: Holder's Speed is 1.5x, but it can only select the first move it executes.

choicespecs.name: Choice Specs
choicespecs.desc: Holder's Sp. Atk is 1.5x, but it can only select the first move it executes.
choicespecs.shortDesc: Holder's Sp. Atk is 1.5x, but it can only select the first move it executes.

custapberry.name: Custap Berry
custapberry.desc: Holder moves first in its priority bracket when at 1/4 max HP or less. Single use.
custapberry.shortDesc: Holder moves first in its priority bracket when at 1/4 max HP or less. Single use.

damprock.name: Damp Rock
damprock.desc: Holder's use of Rain Dance lasts 8 turns instead of 5.
damprock.shortDesc: Holder's use of Rain Dance lasts 8 turns instead of 5.

darkmemory.name: Dark Memory
darkmemory.desc: Holder's Multi-Attack is Dark type. RKS System gives Pressure and Intimidate.
darkmemory.shortDesc: Holder's Multi-Attack is Dark type. RKS System gives Pressure and Intimidate.

dragonmemory.name: Dragon Memory
dragonmemory.desc: Holder's Multi-Attack is Dragon type. RKS System gives Marvel Scale and Tough Claws.
dragonmemory.shortDesc: Holder's Multi-Attack is Dragon type. RKS System gives Marvel Scale and Tough Claws.

duskstone.name: Dusk Stone
duskstone.desc: Evolves Murkrow into Honchkrow, Misdreavus into Mismagius, Lampent into Chandelure, and Doublade into Aegislash when used.
